latin_iast: parama karuṇāmaẏa, asīma daẏālu āllāhara nāme (śuru karachi).
latin_ascii: parama karunamaya, asima dayalu allahara name (suru karachi).

latin_iast: āllāharai janya samasta praśaṃsā, yini viśvajagatera rāvva.
latin_ascii: allaharai janya samasta prasamsa, yini visvajagatera ravva.

latin_iast: yini parama daẏālu, atiśaẏa karuṇāmaẏa.
latin_ascii: yini parama dayalu, atisaya karunamaya.

latin_iast: yini vicāra dinera mālika.
latin_ascii: yini vicara dinera malika.

latin_iast: āmarā āpanārai ivādāta karachi evaṃ āpanārai nikaṭa sāhāyya cācchi.
latin_ascii: amara apanarai ivadata karachi evam apanarai nikata sahayya cacchi.

latin_iast: āmāderake sarala saṭhika patha pradarśana karuna.
latin_ascii: amaderake sarala sathika patha pradarsana karuna.

latin_iast: tādera patha, yādera prati āpani anugraha karechena. tādera pathe naẏa, yādera prati āpanāra gayava varṣita haẏeche, tādera pathao naẏa yārā pathabhraṣṭa haẏeche. āmīna!!
latin_ascii: tadera patha, yadera prati apani anugraha karechena. tadera pathe naya, yadera prati apanara gayava varsita hayeche, tadera pathao naya yara pathabhrasta hayeche. amina!!

latin_iast: ālipha-lāma-mīma.
latin_ascii: alipha-lama-mima.

latin_iast: ihā ai grantha yāra madhye kona sandeha-saṃśaẏera avakāśa nei; dharma-bhīrudera janya e grantha pathanirdeśa.
latin_ascii: iha ai grantha yara madhye kona sandeha-samsayera avakasa nei; dharma-bhirudera janya e grantha pathanirdesa.

latin_iast: yārā adṛśya viṣaẏagulite viśvāsa sthāpana kare evaṃ sālāta pratiṣṭhā kare evaṃ āmi tāderake ye upajīvikā pradāna karechi tā hate dāna kare thāke .
latin_ascii: yara adrsya visayagulite visvasa sthapana kare evam salata pratistha kare evam ami taderake ye upajivika pradana karechi ta hate dana kare thake .

latin_iast: evaṃ tomāra prati yā avatīrṇa haẏeche o tomāra pūrve yā avatīrṇa haẏechila, yārā tadviṣaẏe viśvāsa sthāpana kare evaṃ ākhirātera prati yārā dṛr̤ha viśvāsa rākhe.
latin_ascii: evam tomara prati ya avatirna hayeche o tomara purve ya avatirna hayechila, yara tadvisaye visvasa sthapana kare evam akhiratera prati yara drrha visvasa rakhe.

latin_iast: erāi tādera ravera pakṣa hate prāpta hidāẏātera upara pratiṣṭhita raẏeche evaṃ erāi pūrṇa saphalakāma.
latin_ascii: erai tadera ravera paksa hate prapta hidayatera upara pratisthita rayeche evam erai purna saphalakama.

latin_iast: niścaẏai yārā aviśvāsa karache tādera janya ubhaẏai samāna; tumi tāderake bhaẏa pradarśana kara vā nā kara, tārā īmāna ānavenā.
latin_ascii: niscayai yara avisvasa karache tadera janya ubhayai samana; tumi taderake bhaya pradarsana kara va na kara, tara imana anavena.

latin_iast: āllāha tādera antarasamūhera upara o tādera karṇasamūhera upara moharāṃkita kare diẏechena evaṃ tādera cakṣusamūhera upara āvaraṇa par̤e āche evaṃ tādera janya raẏeche bhaẏānaka śāsti.
latin_ascii: allaha tadera antarasamuhera upara o tadera karnasamuhera upara moharamkita kare diyechena evam tadera caksusamuhera upara avarana pare ache evam tadera janya rayeche bhayanaka sasti.

latin_iast: āra mānuṣera madhye emana loka āche yārā vale, āmarā āllāhara upara evaṃ śeṣa dinera upara īmāna enechi, athaca tārā moṭei īmānadāra naẏa.
latin_ascii: ara manusera madhye emana loka ache yara vale, amara allahara upara evam sesa dinera upara imana enechi, athaca tara motei imanadara naya.

latin_iast: tārā āllāha o mu’minadera saṅge dho~kāvājī kare. prakṛta pakṣe tārā nijedera vyatīta āra kārao sāthe dho~kāvājī karenā, athaca tārā e samvandhe anubhava karate pārenā.
latin_ascii: tara allaha o mu’minadera sange dho~kavaji kare. prakrta pakse tara nijedera vyatita ara karao sathe dho~kavaji karena, athaca tara e samvandhe anubhava karate parena.

latin_iast: tādera antare pīr̤ā raẏeche, paranta āllāha tādera pīr̤ā ārao vār̤iẏe diẏechena evaṃ tādera janya gurutara śāsti raẏeche yehetu tārā asatya valata.
latin_ascii: tadera antare pira rayeche, paranta allaha tadera pira arao variye diyechena evam tadera janya gurutara sasti rayeche yehetu tara asatya valata.

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana tāderake valā haẏaḥ tomarā pṛthivīte aśānti sṛṣṭi karanā takhana tārā valeḥ āmarāto śudhui śānti sthāpanakārī.
latin_ascii: evam yakhana taderake vala hayah tomara prthivite asanti srsti karana takhana tara valeh amarato sudhui santi sthapanakari.

latin_iast: sāvadhāna! niścaẏai tārāi aśānti sṛṣṭikārī, kintu tārā vujhenā.
latin_ascii: savadhana! niscayai tarai asanti srstikari, kintu tara vujhena.

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana tāderake valā haẏaḥ loke yerūpa viśvāsa kareche tomarāo tadrupa viśvāsa sthāpana kara, takhana tārā valeḥ nirvodherā yerūpa viśvāsa kareche āmarāo ki seirūpa viśvāsa karava? sāvadhāna! niścaẏai tārāi nirvodha, kintu tā tārā avagata naẏa.
latin_ascii: evam yakhana taderake vala hayah loke yerupa visvasa kareche tomarao tadrupa visvasa sthapana kara, takhana tara valeh nirvodhera yerupa visvasa kareche amarao ki seirupa visvasa karavay savadhana! niscayai tarai nirvodha, kintu ta tara avagata naya.

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana tārā mu’minadera sāthe milita haẏa takhana tārā valeḥ āmarā viśvāsa sthāpana karechi; evaṃ yakhana tārā nijedera dalapati o duṣṭa netādera sāthe gopane milita haẏa takhana valeḥ āmarā tomādera saṅgei āchi, āmarāto śudhu ṭhāṭṭā-vidrupa o prahasana kare thāki.
latin_ascii: evam yakhana tara mu’minadera sathe milita haya takhana tara valeh amara visvasa sthapana karechi; evam yakhana tara nijedera dalapati o dusta netadera sathe gopane milita haya takhana valeh amara tomadera sangei achi, amarato sudhu thatta-vidrupa o prahasana kare thaki.

latin_iast: āllāha tādera saṅge ṭhāṭṭā-vidrupa karachena evaṃ tāderake avakāśa dicchena. phale tārā nijedera avādhyatāra madhye udbhrānta haẏe phirache.
latin_ascii: allaha tadera sange thatta-vidrupa karachena evam taderake avakasa dicchena. phale tara nijedera avadhyatara madhye udbhranta haye phirache.

latin_iast: erā tārāi yārā su-pathera parivarte ku-pathake kraẏa kareche, sutarāṃ tādera vāṇijya lābhajanaka haẏani evaṃ tārā sarala saṭhika pathe caleni.
latin_ascii: era tarai yara su-pathera parivarte ku-pathake kraya kareche, sutaram tadera vanijya labhajanaka hayani evam tara sarala sathika pathe caleni.

latin_iast: edera avasthā ai vyaktira nyāẏa ye āguna prajjvalita karala, ataḥpara yakhana tāra pārśvavartī samasta sthāna ālokita hala, takhana āllāha tādera ālo chiniẏe nilena evaṃ tāderake andhakārera madhye cher̤e dilena, sutarāṃ tārā kichui dekhate pāẏanā.
latin_ascii: edera avastha ai vyaktira nyaya ye aguna prajjvalita karala, atahpara yakhana tara parsvavarti samasta sthana alokita hala, takhana allaha tadera alo chiniye nilena evam taderake andhakarera madhye chere dilena, sutaram tara kichui dekhate payana.

latin_iast: tārā vadhira, mūka, andha. ataeva tārā pratyāvṛtta havenā.
latin_ascii: tara vadhira, muka, andha. ataeva tara pratyavrtta havena.

latin_iast: athavā ākāśa hate vāri varṣaṇera nyāẏa yāte andhakāra, garjana o vidyut raẏeche, tārā vajradhvani vaśataḥ mṛtyubhaẏe tādera karṇasamūhe sva sva aṅgulī guje deẏa, evaṃ āllāha aviśvāsīdera pariveṣṭanakārī.
latin_ascii: athava akasa hate vari varsanera nyaya yate andhakara, garjana o vidyut rayeche, tara vajradhvani vasatah mrtyubhaye tadera karnasamuhe sva sva anguli guje deya, evam allaha avisvasidera parivestanakari.

latin_iast: acire vidyut tādera dṛṣṭi haraṇa karave, yakhana tādera prati āloka pradīpta haẏa takhana tārā calate thāke evaṃ yakhana tādera upara andhakāra ācchanna haẏa takhana tārā ṭhāẏa dā~r̤iẏe thāke evaṃ yadi āllāha icchā karena - niścaẏai tādera śravaṇaśakti o tādera dṛṣṭiśakti haraṇa karate pārena, niścaẏai āllāha sarva viṣaẏe śaktimāna.
latin_ascii: acire vidyut tadera drsti harana karave, yakhana tadera prati aloka pradipta haya takhana tara calate thake evam yakhana tadera upara andhakara acchanna haya takhana tara thaya da~riye thake evam yadi allaha iccha karena - niscayai tadera sravanasakti o tadera drstisakti harana karate parena, niscayai allaha sarva visaye saktimana.

latin_iast: he mānavavṛnda! tomarā tomādera ravera ivādāta kara yini tomāderake evaṃ tomādera pūrvavartīderake sṛṣṭi karechena, yena tomarā dharmabhīru hao.
latin_ascii: he manavavrnda! tomara tomadera ravera ivadata kara yini tomaderake evam tomadera purvavartiderake srsti karechena, yena tomara dharmabhiru hao.

latin_iast: yini tomādera janya bhūtalake śayyā o ākāśake chāda svarūpa sṛṣṭi karechena evaṃ ākāśa hate vāri varṣaṇa karena, ataḥpara tadvārā tomādera janya upajīvikā svarūpa phalapuñja utpādana karena, ataeva tomarā āllāhara samakakṣa sthira karanā evaṃ tomarā eṭā avagata ācha.
latin_ascii: yini tomadera janya bhutalake sayya o akasake chada svarupa srsti karechena evam akasa hate vari varsana karena, atahpara tadvara tomadera janya upajivika svarupa phalapunja utpadana karena, ataeva tomara allahara samakaksa sthira karana evam tomara eta avagata acha.

latin_iast: evaṃ āmi āmāra vāndāra prati yā avatīrṇa karechi, yadi tomarā tāte sandihāna hao tāhale tatsadṛśa ekaṭi ‘‘sūrā’’ ānaẏana kara evaṃ tomādera sei sāhāyyakārīderake ḍeke nāo yārā āllāha hate pṛthaka, yadi tomarā satyavādī hao!
latin_ascii: evam ami amara vandara prati ya avatirna karechi, yadi tomara tate sandihana hao tahale tatsadrsa ekati ‘‘sura’’ anayana kara evam tomadera sei sahayyakariderake deke nao yara allaha hate prthaka, yadi tomara satyavadi hao!

latin_iast: ataḥpara yadi tomarā tā karate nā pāra evaṃ tomarā tā kakhanao karate pāravenā, tāhale tomarā sei jāhānnāmera bhaẏa kara yāra khorāka manuṣya o prastara khanḍa - yā aviśvāsīdera janya prastuta karā haẏeche.
latin_ascii: atahpara yadi tomara ta karate na para evam tomara ta kakhanao karate paravena, tahale tomara sei jahannamera bhaya kara yara khoraka manusya o prastara khanda - ya avisvasidera janya prastuta kara hayeche.

latin_iast: evaṃ yārā viśvāsa sthāpana kareche o sat kāryāvalī sampādana kare thāke tāderake susaṃvāda pradāna kara ye, tādera janya emana jānnāta raẏeche yāra taladeśa diẏe nadīsamūha pravāhita hacche; yakhanai sekhāne tāderake khāvāra hisāve phalapuñja pradāna karā have takhanai tārā valaveḥ āmāderato eṭā pūrvei pradatta haẏechila, vastutaḥ tāderake ekai sadṛśa phala pradāna karā have, evaṃ tādera janya tanmadhye śuddhā sahadharminīgaṇa raẏeche, evaṃ tanmadhye tārā cirakāla avasthāna karave.
latin_ascii: evam yara visvasa sthapana kareche o sat karyavali sampadana kare thake taderake susamvada pradana kara ye, tadera janya emana jannata rayeche yara taladesa diye nadisamuha pravahita hacche; yakhanai sekhane taderake khavara hisave phalapunja pradana kara have takhanai tara valaveh amaderato eta purvei pradatta hayechila, vastutah taderake ekai sadrsa phala pradana kara have, evam tadera janya tanmadhye suddha sahadharminigana rayeche, evam tanmadhye tara cirakala avasthana karave.

latin_iast: niścaẏai āllāha maśā athavā tadapekṣā kṣudratara dṛṣṭānta varṇanā karate lajjāvodha karenanā. sutarāṃ yārā īmāna eneche tārāto viśvāsa karave ye, e upamā tādera ravera pakṣa hate khuvai sthānopayogī haẏeche, āra yārā kāphira sarvāvasthāẏa tārā eṭāi valave ye, e sava nagaṇya vasttara upamā dvārā āllāhara uddeśyai vā ki? tini era dvārā anekake vipathagāmī karena evaṃ era dvārā anekake saṭhika patha pradarśana karena, āra era dvārā tini śudhu phāsikaderakei vipathagāmī kare thākena.
latin_ascii: niscayai allaha masa athava tadapeksa ksudratara drstanta varnana karate lajjavodha karenana. sutaram yara imana eneche tarato visvasa karave ye, e upama tadera ravera paksa hate khuvai sthanopayogi hayeche, ara yara kaphira sarvavasthaya tara etai valave ye, e sava naganya vasttara upama dvara allahara uddesyai va kiy tini era dvara anekake vipathagami karena evam era dvara anekake sathika patha pradarsana karena, ara era dvara tini sudhu phasikaderakei vipathagami kare thakena.

latin_iast: yārā āllāhara saṅge dṛr̤habhāve pratijñāvaddha haoẏāra para tā bhaṅga kare evaṃ ai sava samvandha chinna kare yā avicchinna rākhate āllāha nirdeśa diẏechena evaṃ yārā bhūpṛṣṭhe vivāda sṛṣṭi kare tārāi pūrṇa kṣatigrasta.
latin_ascii: yara allahara sange drrhabhave pratijnavaddha haoyara para ta bhanga kare evam ai sava samvandha chinna kare ya avicchinna rakhate allaha nirdesa diyechena evam yara bhuprsthe vivada srsti kare tarai purna ksatigrasta.

latin_iast: kirūpe tomarā āllāhake aviśvāsa karacha? athaca tomarā chile prāṇahīna? ataḥpara tinii tomāderake sañjīvita karechena, punarāẏa tini tomāderake nirjīva karavena evaṃ punarāẏa tomāderake jīvita karā have. avaśeṣe tomāderake tā~rai dike pratyāgamana karate have.
latin_ascii: kirupe tomara allahake avisvasa karachay athaca tomara chile pranahinay atahpara tinii tomaderake sanjivita karechena, punaraya tini tomaderake nirjiva karavena evam punaraya tomaderake jivita kara have. avasese tomaderake ta~rai dike pratyagamana karate have.

latin_iast: pṛthivīte yā kichu āche samastai tini tomādera janya sṛṣṭi karechena; ataḥpara tini ākāśera prati manaḥsaṃyoga karena, ataḥpara sapta ākāśa suvinyasta karena evaṃ tini sarva viṣaẏe mahājñānī.
latin_ascii: prthivite ya kichu ache samastai tini tomadera janya srsti karechena; atahpara tini akasera prati manahsamyoga karena, atahpara sapta akasa suvinyasta karena evam tini sarva visaye mahajnani.

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana tomāra rāvva mālāikā/phereśatādera valalenaḥ niścaẏai āmi pṛthivīte pratinidhi sṛṣṭi karava; tārā valalaḥ āpani ki yamīne emana kehake sṛṣṭi karavena yārā tanmadhye aśānti sṛṣṭi karave evaṃ raktapāta karave? evaṃ āmarāito āpanāra guṇagāna karachi evaṃ āpanārai pavitratā varṇanā kare thāki. tini valalenaḥ tomarā yā avagata nao niścaẏai āmi tā jñāta āchi.
latin_ascii: evam yakhana tomara ravva malaika/pheresatadera valalenah niscayai ami prthivite pratinidhi srsti karava; tara valalah apani ki yamine emana kehake srsti karavena yara tanmadhye asanti srsti karave evam raktapata karavey evam amaraito apanara gunagana karachi evam apanarai pavitrata varnana kare thaki. tini valalenah tomara ya avagata nao niscayai ami ta jnata achi.

latin_iast: evaṃ tini ādamake samasta nāma śikṣā dilena, anantara tatsamūdaẏa mālāikā/phereśatādera sāmane upasthāpita karalena, ataḥpara valalenaḥ yadi tomarā satyavādī hao tāhale āmāke e sava vastura nāmasamūha varṇanā kara.
latin_ascii: evam tini adamake samasta nama siksa dilena, anantara tatsamudaya malaika/pheresatadera samane upasthapita karalena, atahpara valalenah yadi tomara satyavadi hao tahale amake e sava vastura namasamuha varnana kara.

latin_iast: tārā valechilaḥ āpani parama pavitra! āpani āmāderake yā śikṣā diẏechena tadvyatīta āmādera konai jñāna nei, niścaẏai āpani mahājñānī, vijñānamaẏa.
latin_ascii: tara valechilah apani parama pavitra! apani amaderake ya siksa diyechena tadvyatita amadera konai jnana nei, niscayai apani mahajnani, vijnanamaya.

latin_iast: tini valechilenaḥ he ādama! tumi tāderake ai sakalera nāmasamūha varṇanā kara; ataḥpara yakhana se tāderake aigulira nāmasamūha valechila takhana tini valechilenaḥ āmi ki tomāderake valini ye, niścaẏai āmi āsamāna o yamīnera adṛśya viṣaẏa avagata āchi evaṃ tomarā yā prakāśa kara o yā gopana kara āmi tāo parijñāta āchi?
latin_ascii: tini valechilenah he adama! tumi taderake ai sakalera namasamuha varnana kara; atahpara yakhana se taderake aigulira namasamuha valechila takhana tini valechilenah ami ki tomaderake valini ye, niscayai ami asamana o yaminera adrsya visaya avagata achi evam tomara ya prakasa kara o ya gopana kara ami tao parijnata achiy

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana āmi mālāikā/phereśatāderake valechilāma ye, tomarā ādamake sājadāha kara, takhana ivalīsa vyatīta sakale sājadāha karechila; se agrāhya karala o ahaṃkāra karala evaṃ kāphiradera antarbhukta haẏe gela.
latin_ascii: evam yakhana ami malaika/pheresataderake valechilama ye, tomara adamake sajadaha kara, takhana ivalisa vyatita sakale sajadaha karechila; se agrahya karala o ahamkara karala evam kaphiradera antarbhukta haye gela.

latin_iast: evaṃ āmi valalāmaḥ he ādama! tumi o tomāra strī jānnāte avasthāna kara evaṃ tā hate yā icchā svacchande āhāra kara; kintu ai vṛkṣera nikaṭavartī haẏonā, tāhale tomarā atyācārīdera antarbhukta haẏe yāve.
latin_ascii: evam ami valalamah he adama! tumi o tomara stri jannate avasthana kara evam ta hate ya iccha svacchande ahara kara; kintu ai vrksera nikatavarti hayona, tahale tomara atyacaridera antarbhukta haye yave.

latin_iast: anantara śāitāna tādera ubhaẏake sekhāna hate vicyuta karala, ataḥpara tārā ubhaẏe yekhāne chila sekhāna hate tāderake varhigata karala; evaṃ āmi valalāmaḥ tomarā nīce neme yāo, tomarā paraspara parasparera śatru; evaṃ pṛthivītei raẏeche tomādera janya eka nirdiṣṭa kālera avasthiti o bhoga sampada.
latin_ascii: anantara saitana tadera ubhayake sekhana hate vicyuta karala, atahpara tara ubhaye yekhane chila sekhana hate taderake varhigata karala; evam ami valalamah tomara nice neme yao, tomara paraspara parasparera satru; evam prthivitei rayeche tomadera janya eka nirdista kalera avasthiti o bhoga sampada.

latin_iast: ataḥpara ādama svīẏa rāvva hate katipaẏa vāṇī śikṣā lābha karala, āllāha takhana tāra prati kṛpā dṛṣṭi dilena; niścaẏai tini kṣamāśīla, karuṇāmaẏa!
latin_ascii: atahpara adama sviya ravva hate katipaya vani siksa labha karala, allaha takhana tara prati krpa drsti dilena; niscayai tini ksamasila, karunamaya!

latin_iast: āmi valalāmaḥ tomarā savāi ekhāna theke nīce neme yāo; anantara āmāra pakṣa hate tomādera nikaṭa ye upadeśa upasthita have-yārā āmāra sei upadeśa anusaraṇa karave vastutaḥ tādera konai bhaẏa nei evaṃ tārā cintitao havenā.
latin_ascii: ami valalamah tomara savai ekhana theke nice neme yao; anantara amara paksa hate tomadera nikata ye upadesa upasthita have-yara amara sei upadesa anusarana karave vastutah tadera konai bhaya nei evam tara cintitao havena.

latin_iast: āra yārā aviśvāsa karave evaṃ āmāra nidarśanasamūhe asatyāropa karave, tārāi jāhānnāmera adhivāsī - tanmadhye tārā sadā avasthāna karave.
latin_ascii: ara yara avisvasa karave evam amara nidarsanasamuhe asatyaropa karave, tarai jahannamera adhivasi - tanmadhye tara sada avasthana karave.

latin_iast: he isarāīlī vaṃśadhara! āmi tomāderake ye sukha sampada dāna karechi tā smaraṇa kara evaṃ āmāra aṅgīkāra pūrṇa kara - āmio tomādera prati kṛta aṅgīkāra pūrṇa karava evaṃ tomarā śudhu āmākei bhaẏa kara.
latin_ascii: he isaraili vamsadhara! ami tomaderake ye sukha sampada dana karechi ta smarana kara evam amara angikara purna kara - amio tomadera prati krta angikara purna karava evam tomara sudhu amakei bhaya kara.

latin_iast: evaṃ āmi yā avatīrṇa karechi tatprati viśvāsa sthāpana kara, ihā (kuraāna) tomādera kāche yā āche uhārai satyatā pranaẏanakārī evaṃ ete tomarāi prathama aviśvāsī haẏonā evaṃ āmāra nidarśanāvalīra parivarte sāmānya mūlya grahaṇa karanā evaṃ tomarā varaṃ āmākei bhaẏa kara.
latin_ascii: evam ami ya avatirna karechi tatprati visvasa sthapana kara, iha (kuraana) tomadera kache ya ache uharai satyata pranayanakari evam ete tomarai prathama avisvasi hayona evam amara nidarsanavalira parivarte samanya mulya grahana karana evam tomara varam amakei bhaya kara.

latin_iast: evaṃ tomarā satyake mithyāra sāthe miśrita karanā evaṃ jene śune satya gopana karanā.
latin_ascii: evam tomara satyake mithyara sathe misrita karana evam jene sune satya gopana karana.

latin_iast: āra tomarā sālāta pratiṣṭhita kara o yākāta pradāna kara evaṃ rukukārīdera sāthe ruku kara.
latin_ascii: ara tomara salata pratisthita kara o yakata pradana kara evam rukukaridera sathe ruku kara.

latin_iast: tomarā ki lokaderake sat kāje ādeśa karacha evaṃ tomādera nijedera samvandhe vismṛta haccha? athaca tomarā grantha pāṭha kara; tāhale ki tomarā hṛdaẏaṅgama karachanā?
latin_ascii: tomara ki lokaderake sat kaje adesa karacha evam tomadera nijedera samvandhe vismrta hacchay athaca tomara grantha patha kara; tahale ki tomara hrdayangama karachanay

latin_iast: evaṃ tomarā dhairya o sālātera mādhyame sāhāyya cāo; avaśyai oṭā kaṭhina, kintu vinītadera pakṣe naẏa.
latin_ascii: evam tomara dhairya o salatera madhyame sahayya cao; avasyai ota kathina, kintu vinitadera pakse naya.

latin_iast: yārā dhāraṇā kare ye, niścaẏai tārā tādera ravera sāthe sammilita have evaṃ tārā tā~rai dike pratigamana karave.
latin_ascii: yara dharana kare ye, niscayai tara tadera ravera sathe sammilita have evam tara ta~rai dike pratigamana karave.

latin_iast: he vānī isarāīla! āmi tomāderake ye sukha sampada dāna karechi tā smaraṇa kara evaṃ niścaẏai āmi tomāderake samagra pṛthivīra upara śreṣṭhatva dāna karechi.
latin_ascii: he vani isaraila! ami tomaderake ye sukha sampada dana karechi ta smarana kara evam niscayai ami tomaderake samagra prthivira upara sresthatva dana karechi.

latin_iast: evaṃ tomarā sei dinera bhaẏa kara, ye dina eka vyakti anya vyakti hate kichumātra upakṛta havenā evaṃ kona vyakti hate kona supāriśao gṛhīta havenā, kona vyakti hate kona vinimaẏao grahaṇa karā havenā evaṃ tāderake sāhāyya karāo havenā.
latin_ascii: evam tomara sei dinera bhaya kara, ye dina eka vyakti anya vyakti hate kichumatra upakrta havena evam kona vyakti hate kona suparisao grhita havena, kona vyakti hate kona vinimayao grahana kara havena evam taderake sahayya karao havena.

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana āmi tomāderake phira‘āunera sampradāẏa hate vimukta karechilāma - tārā tomāderake kaṭhora śāsti pradāna karata, tomādera putraderake hatyā karata evaṃ tomādera kanyāderake jīvita rākhata evaṃ ete tomādera rāvva hate tomādera janya mahā parīkṣā chila.
latin_ascii: evam yakhana ami tomaderake phira‘aunera sampradaya hate vimukta karechilama - tara tomaderake kathora sasti pradana karata, tomadera putraderake hatya karata evam tomadera kanyaderake jivita rakhata evam ete tomadera ravva hate tomadera janya maha pariksa chila.

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana āmi tomādera janya samudrake vibhakta karechilāma, ataḥpara tomāderake uddhāra karechilāma o phira‘āunera svajanaderake nimajjita karechilāma evaṃ tomarā tā pratyakṣa karechile.
latin_ascii: evam yakhana ami tomadera janya samudrake vibhakta karechilama, atahpara tomaderake uddhara karechilama o phira‘aunera svajanaderake nimajjita karechilama evam tomara ta pratyaksa karechile.

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana āmi mūsāra saṅge calliśa rajanīra aṅgīkāra karechilāma, anantara tomarā go-vatsake upāsyarūpe grahaṇa karechile evaṃ tomarā chile atyācārī.
latin_ascii: evam yakhana ami musara sange callisa rajanira angikara karechilama, anantara tomara go-vatsake upasyarupe grahana karechile evam tomara chile atyacari.

latin_iast: era pareo āmi tomāderake mārjanā karechilāma - yena tomarā kṛtajñatā prakāśa kara.
latin_ascii: era pareo ami tomaderake marjana karechilama - yena tomara krtajnata prakasa kara.

latin_iast: āra yakhana āmi mūsāke grantha evaṃ satya o mithyāra prabhedakārī nirdeśa diẏechilāma, yena tomarā supatha prāpta hao.
latin_ascii: ara yakhana ami musake grantha evam satya o mithyara prabhedakari nirdesa diyechilama, yena tomara supatha prapta hao.

latin_iast: āra yakhana mūsā svīẏa sampradāẏake valalaḥ he āmāra sampradāẏa! niścaẏai tomarā go-vatsake upāsya rūpe grahaṇa kare tomādera nijedera prati atyācāra karecha. ataeva tomarā tomādera ravera nikaṭa kṣamā prārthanā kara, ataḥpara tomarā tomādera nija nija prāṇa visarjana dāo, tomādera ravera nikaṭa eṭāi tomādera janya kalyāṇakara; anantara tini tomādera prati kṣamā pradarśana karalena, niścaẏai tini kṣamāśīla, karuṇāmaẏa.
latin_ascii: ara yakhana musa sviya sampradayake valalah he amara sampradaya! niscayai tomara go-vatsake upasya rupe grahana kare tomadera nijedera prati atyacara karecha. ataeva tomara tomadera ravera nikata ksama prarthana kara, atahpara tomara tomadera nija nija prana visarjana dao, tomadera ravera nikata etai tomadera janya kalyanakara; anantara tini tomadera prati ksama pradarsana karalena, niscayai tini ksamasila, karunamaya.

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana tomarā valechileḥ he mūsā! āmarā āllāhake prakāśyabhāve darśana nā karā paryanta tomāke viśvāsa karavanā - takhana vajrapāta tomāderake ākramaṇa karechila evaṃ tomarā tā pratyakṣa karechile.
latin_ascii: evam yakhana tomara valechileh he musa! amara allahake prakasyabhave darsana na kara paryanta tomake visvasa karavana - takhana vajrapata tomaderake akramana karechila evam tomara ta pratyaksa karechile.

latin_iast: ataḥpara tomādera mṛtyura para āmi tomāderake punarujjīvita karechilāma, yena tomarā kṛtajñatā prakāśa kara.
latin_ascii: atahpara tomadera mrtyura para ami tomaderake punarujjivita karechilama, yena tomara krtajnata prakasa kara.

latin_iast: evaṃ āmi tomādera upara meghamālāra chāẏā dāna karechilāma evaṃ tomādera prati ‘mānnā’ o ‘sālaoẏā’ avatīrṇa karechilāma; āmi tomāderake ye upajīvikā dāna karechi sei pavitra jinisa hate āhāra kara; evaṃ tārā āmāra kona aniṣṭa kareni, varaṃ tārā nijedera aniṣṭa karechila.
latin_ascii: evam ami tomadera upara meghamalara chaya dana karechilama evam tomadera prati ‘manna’ o ‘salaoya’ avatirna karechilama; ami tomaderake ye upajivika dana karechi sei pavitra jinisa hate ahara kara; evam tara amara kona anista kareni, varam tara nijedera anista karechila.

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana āmi valalāmaḥ tomarā ei nagare praveśa kara, ataḥpara yā icchā svacchande āhāra kara evaṃ sājadāhavanatabhāve dvāre praveśa kara evaṃ tomarā valaḥ āmarā kṣamā prārthanā karachi, tāhale āmi tomādera aparādha kṣamā karava evaṃ acirei satkarmaśīlagaṇake adhikatara dāna karava.
latin_ascii: evam yakhana ami valalamah tomara ei nagare pravesa kara, atahpara ya iccha svacchande ahara kara evam sajadahavanatabhave dvare pravesa kara evam tomara valah amara ksama prarthana karachi, tahale ami tomadera aparadha ksama karava evam acirei satkarmasilaganake adhikatara dana karava.

latin_iast: anantara yārā atyācāra karechila tāderake yā valā haẏechila, tatparivarte tārā sei kathāra parivartana karala, pare atyācārīrā ye duskarma karechila tajjanya āmi tādera upara ākāśa hate śāsti avatīrṇa karechilāma.
latin_ascii: anantara yara atyacara karechila taderake ya vala hayechila, tatparivarte tara sei kathara parivartana karala, pare atyacarira ye duskarma karechila tajjanya ami tadera upara akasa hate sasti avatirna karechilama.

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana mūsā svīẏa sampradāẏera janya pāni prārthanā karechila takhana āmi valechilāmaḥ tumi svīẏa lāṭhi dvārā prastare āghāta kara, anantara tā hate dvādaśa prasravana viniḥsṛta hala, pratyekei sva sva sthāna jene nila, tomarā āllāhara upajīvikā hate āhāra kara o pāna kara evaṃ pṛthivīte śānti bhaṅgakārī rūpe vicaraṇa karanā.
latin_ascii: evam yakhana musa sviya sampradayera janya pani prarthana karechila takhana ami valechilamah tumi sviya lathi dvara prastare aghata kara, anantara ta hate dvadasa prasravana vinihsrta hala, pratyekei sva sva sthana jene nila, tomara allahara upajivika hate ahara kara o pana kara evam prthivite santi bhangakari rupe vicarana karana.

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana tomarā valechile - he mūsā! āmarā ekairūpa khādye dhairya dhāraṇa karate pārachinā, ataeva tumi āmādera janya tomāra ravera nikaṭa prārthanā kara yena tini āmādera janmabhūmite yā utpanna haẏa tā hate ora śāka-śavji, ora kā~kur̤a, ora gama, ora masura evaṃ ora piẏāja utpādana karena. se valechilaḥ yā utkṛṣṭa tomarā ki tāra saṅge yā nikṛṣṭa tāra vinimaẏa karate cāo? kona nagare upanīta hao, tomādera prārthita dravyaguli avaśyai prāpta have. tādera upara lāñchanā o dāridratā nipatita hala evaṃ tārā āllāhara kope patita hala ei hetu ye, niścaẏai tārā āllāhara nidarśanasamūhe aviśvāsa karata evaṃ anyāẏabhāve nāvīgaṇake hatyā karata; evaṃ ei hetu ye, tārā avādhyācaraṇa karechila o tārā sīmā atikrama karechila.
latin_ascii: evam yakhana tomara valechile - he musa! amara ekairupa khadye dhairya dharana karate parachina, ataeva tumi amadera janya tomara ravera nikata prarthana kara yena tini amadera janmabhumite ya utpanna haya ta hate ora saka-savji, ora ka~kura, ora gama, ora masura evam ora piyaja utpadana karena. se valechilah ya utkrsta tomara ki tara sange ya nikrsta tara vinimaya karate caoy kona nagare upanita hao, tomadera prarthita dravyaguli avasyai prapta have. tadera upara lanchana o daridrata nipatita hala evam tara allahara kope patita hala ei hetu ye, niscayai tara allahara nidarsanasamuhe avisvasa karata evam anyayabhave naviganake hatya karata; evam ei hetu ye, tara avadhyacarana karechila o tara sima atikrama karechila.

latin_iast: niścaẏai musalima, iẏāhudī, khṛṣṭāna evaṃ sāveīna sampradāẏa, (edera madhye) yārā āllāhara prati o kiẏāmātera prati viśvāsa rākhe evaṃ bhāla kāja kare, tādera janya tādera ravera nikaṭa puraskāra raẏeche, tādera kona prakāra bhaẏa nei evaṃ tārā cintitao havenā.
latin_ascii: niscayai musalima, iyahudi, khrstana evam saveina sampradaya, (edera madhye) yara allahara prati o kiyamatera prati visvasa rakhe evam bhala kaja kare, tadera janya tadera ravera nikata puraskara rayeche, tadera kona prakara bhaya nei evam tara cintitao havena.

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana āmi tomādera aṅgīkāra grahaṇa karechilāma evaṃ tomādera upara tūra parvata samucca karechilāma ye, āmi tomāderake yā diẏechi tā dṛr̤ha rūpe dhāraṇa kara evaṃ ete yā āche tā smaraṇa kara - sambhavataḥ tomarā niskṛti pāve.
latin_ascii: evam yakhana ami tomadera angikara grahana karechilama evam tomadera upara tura parvata samucca karechilama ye, ami tomaderake ya diyechi ta drrha rupe dharana kara evam ete ya ache ta smarana kara - sambhavatah tomara niskrti pave.

latin_iast: erapara punarāẏa tomarā phire gele, ataeva yadi tomādera prati āllāhara anugraha evaṃ tā~ra karuṇā nā thākata tāhale avaśyai tomarā vināśa prāpta hate.
latin_ascii: erapara punaraya tomara phire gele, ataeva yadi tomadera prati allahara anugraha evam ta~ra karuna na thakata tahale avasyai tomara vinasa prapta hate.

latin_iast: evaṃ avaśyai tomarā avagata ācha ye, tomādera madhye yārā śanivārera vyāpāre sīmā laṃghana karechila. āmi tāderake valechilāma ye, tomarā adhama vānara haẏe yāo.
latin_ascii: evam avasyai tomara avagata acha ye, tomadera madhye yara sanivarera vyapare sima lamghana karechila. ami taderake valechilama ye, tomara adhama vanara haye yao.

latin_iast: anantara āmi eṭā tādera samasāmaẏika o tādera paravartīdera janya dṛṣṭānta evaṃ dharmabhīrugaṇera janya upadeśa svarūpa karechilāma.
latin_ascii: anantara ami eta tadera samasamayika o tadera paravartidera janya drstanta evam dharmabhiruganera janya upadesa svarupa karechilama.

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana mūsā nija sampradāẏake valechilaḥ niścaẏai āllāha tomāderake ādeśa karechena ye, tomarā ekaṭi garu yavāha kara. tārā valechilaḥ tumi ki āmāderake upahāsa karacha? se valechilaḥ āmi āllāhara nikaṭa āśraẏa prārthanā karachi, yena āmi mūrkhadera antarbhukta nā hai.
latin_ascii: evam yakhana musa nija sampradayake valechilah niscayai allaha tomaderake adesa karechena ye, tomara ekati garu yavaha kara. tara valechilah tumi ki amaderake upahasa karachay se valechilah ami allahara nikata asraya prarthana karachi, yena ami murkhadera antarbhukta na hai.

latin_iast: tārā valechilaḥ tumi āmādera janya tomāra ravera nikaṭa prārthanā kara ye, tini āmāderake yena oṭā ki ki guṇa viśiṣṭa haoẏā darakāra tā vale dena. se valechilaḥ tini valechena ye, niścaẏai sei garu vaẏoḥvṛddha naẏa evaṃ śāvakao naẏa, e du’ẏera madhyavartī; ataeva tomarā yerūpa ādiṣṭa haẏecha tā kare phela.
latin_ascii: tara valechilah tumi amadera janya tomara ravera nikata prarthana kara ye, tini amaderake yena ota ki ki guna visista haoya darakara ta vale dena. se valechilah tini valechena ye, niscayai sei garu vayohvrddha naya evam savakao naya, e du’yera madhyavarti; ataeva tomara yerupa adista hayecha ta kare phela.

latin_iast: tārā valechilaḥ tumi āmādera janya tomāra ravera nikaṭa prārthanā kara ye, tini yena ora varṇa kirūpa tā āmāderake vale dena. se valechilaḥ tini valechena ye, niścaẏai sei garura varṇa gār̤ha pīta, oṭā darśakaderake ānanda dāna kare.
latin_ascii: tara valechilah tumi amadera janya tomara ravera nikata prarthana kara ye, tini yena ora varna kirupa ta amaderake vale dena. se valechilah tini valechena ye, niscayai sei garura varna garha pita, ota darsakaderake ananda dana kare.

latin_iast: tārā valechilaḥ tumi āmādera janya tomāra ravera nikaṭa prārthanā kara ye, tini yena oṭā kirūpa tā āmādera janya varṇanā karena, niścaẏai āmādera nikaṭa sakala garui samatulya evaṃ āllāha icchā karale āmarā supathagāmī hava.
latin_ascii: tara valechilah tumi amadera janya tomara ravera nikata prarthana kara ye, tini yena ota kirupa ta amadera janya varnana karena, niscayai amadera nikata sakala garui samatulya evam allaha iccha karale amara supathagami hava.

latin_iast: se valechilaḥ niścaẏai tini valechena ye, avaśyai sei garu susthakāẏa, nikhu~ta, oṭā cāṣāvādera kāje lāgāno haẏani evaṃ kṣete pāni secaneo niyukta haẏani. tārā valechilaḥ ekṣaṇe tumi satya enecha, ataḥpara tārā oṭā yavāha karala yā tādera karāra icchā chilanā.
latin_ascii: se valechilah niscayai tini valechena ye, avasyai sei garu susthakaya, nikhu~ta, ota casavadera kaje lagano hayani evam ksete pani secaneo niyukta hayani. tara valechilah eksane tumi satya enecha, atahpara tara ota yavaha karala ya tadera karara iccha chilana.

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana tomarā eka vyaktike hatyā karāra para tadviṣaẏe virodha karachile evaṃ tomarā yā gopana karachile āllāha tāra prakāśaka halena.
latin_ascii: evam yakhana tomara eka vyaktike hatya karara para tadvisaye virodha karachile evam tomara ya gopana karachile allaha tara prakasaka halena.

latin_iast: ataḥpara āmi valechilāmaḥ ora eka khanḍa dvārā tāke āghāta kara, ei rūpe āllāha mṛtake jīvita karena evaṃ svīẏa nidarśanasamūha pradarśana karena yāte tomarā hṛdaẏaṅgama kara.
latin_ascii: atahpara ami valechilamah ora eka khanda dvara take aghata kara, ei rupe allaha mrtake jivita karena evam sviya nidarsanasamuha pradarsana karena yate tomara hrdayangama kara.

latin_iast: ataḥpara tomādera hṛdaẏa prastarera nyāẏa kaṭhina, varaṃ ora ceẏeo kaṭhinatara hala evaṃ niścaẏai prastara hateo prasravana nirgata haẏa evaṃ niścaẏai ogulira madhye kona konaṭi vidīrṇa haẏa, ataḥpara tā hate pāni nirgata haẏa evaṃ niścaẏai aigulira madhye konaṭi āllāhara bhaẏe patita haẏa evaṃ tomarā yā karacha tatprati āllāha amanoyogī nana.
latin_ascii: atahpara tomadera hrdaya prastarera nyaya kathina, varam ora ceyeo kathinatara hala evam niscayai prastara hateo prasravana nirgata haya evam niscayai ogulira madhye kona konati vidirna haya, atahpara ta hate pani nirgata haya evam niscayai aigulira madhye konati allahara bhaye patita haya evam tomara ya karacha tatprati allaha amanoyogi nana.

latin_iast: tomarā ki āśā kara ye, tomādera kathāẏa tārā īmāna ānave? athaca tādera madhye emana kataka loka gata haẏeche yārā āllāhara kālāma śunata, ataḥpara uhā vujhāra para uhāke vikṛta karata, athaca tārā jānata.
latin_ascii: tomara ki asa kara ye, tomadera kathaya tara imana anavey athaca tadera madhye emana kataka loka gata hayeche yara allahara kalama sunata, atahpara uha vujhara para uhake vikrta karata, athaca tara janata.

latin_iast: yakhana tārā mu’minadera sāthe milita haẏa takhana valeḥ āmarā īmāna enechi; āra yakhana tādera keha kārao (iẏāhudīra) nikaṭa gopane yāẏa takhana tārā valeḥ tomarā ki musalimaderake emana kathā vale dāo yā āllāha tomādera nikaṭa prakāśa karechena? pariṇāme tārā tomāderake tarke parājita karave (ei vale) ye, e viṣaẏaṭi ravera nikaṭa hate tomādera kitāve raẏeche, tomarā ki vujhanā?
latin_ascii: yakhana tara mu’minadera sathe milita haya takhana valeh amara imana enechi; ara yakhana tadera keha karao (iyahudira) nikata gopane yaya takhana tara valeh tomara ki musalimaderake emana katha vale dao ya allaha tomadera nikata prakasa karechenay pariname tara tomaderake tarke parajita karave (ei vale) ye, e visayati ravera nikata hate tomadera kitave rayeche, tomara ki vujhanay

latin_iast: tārā ki jānenā ye, tārā yā gopana rākhe evaṃ yā prakāśa kare, āllāha savai jānena?
latin_ascii: tara ki janena ye, tara ya gopana rakhe evam ya prakasa kare, allaha savai janenay

latin_iast: evaṃ tādera madhye aneka aśikṣita loka āche yārā pravṛtti vyatīta kona grantha avagata naẏa evaṃ tārā śudhu kalpanāsamūha racanā kare thāke.
latin_ascii: evam tadera madhye aneka asiksita loka ache yara pravrtti vyatita kona grantha avagata naya evam tara sudhu kalpanasamuha racana kare thake.

latin_iast: tādera janya ākṣepa yārā svahaste pustaka racanā kare, yārā vale ye, eṭā āllāhara nikaṭa hate samāgata! era dvārā tārā sāmānya mūlya arjana karache, tādera hasta yā lipivaddha kareche tajjanya tādera prati ākṣepa! evaṃ tārā yā upārjana karache tajjanyao tādera prati ākṣepa!
latin_ascii: tadera janya aksepa yara svahaste pustaka racana kare, yara vale ye, eta allahara nikata hate samagata! era dvara tara samanya mulya arjana karache, tadera hasta ya lipivaddha kareche tajjanya tadera prati aksepa! evam tara ya uparjana karache tajjanyao tadera prati aksepa!

latin_iast: evaṃ tārā valeḥ nirdhārita dinasamūha vyatīta (jāhannāmera) āguna āmāderake sparśa karavenā. tumi valaḥ tomarā ki āllāhara nikaṭa hate aṅgīkāra niẏecha ye, pare āllāha kakhanai svīẏa aṅgīkārera anyathā karavenanā? athavā āllāha samvandhe yā jānonā tomarā tā’i valacha?
latin_ascii: evam tara valeh nirdharita dinasamuha vyatita (jahannamera) aguna amaderake sparsa karavena. tumi valah tomara ki allahara nikata hate angikara niyecha ye, pare allaha kakhanai sviya angikarera anyatha karavenanay athava allaha samvandhe ya janona tomara ta’i valachay

latin_iast: hyā~, yārā aniṣṭa arjana kareche evaṃ svīẏa pāpera dvārā pariveṣṭita haẏeche tārāi agnivāsī, sekhāne tārā sadā avasthāna karave.
latin_ascii: hya~, yara anista arjana kareche evam sviya papera dvara parivestita hayeche tarai agnivasi, sekhane tara sada avasthana karave.

latin_iast: evaṃ yārā viśvāsa sthāpana kareche o sat kāja karache tārāi jānnātavāsī, tanmadhye tārā cirakāla avasthāna karave.
latin_ascii: evam yara visvasa sthapana kareche o sat kaja karache tarai jannatavasi, tanmadhye tara cirakala avasthana karave.

latin_iast: āra yakhana āmi vānī isarāīla hate aṅgīkāra niẏechilāma ye, tomarā āllāha vyatīta āra kārao ivādāta karavenā evaṃ mātāpitāra saṅge sadvyavahāra karave o ātmīẏadera, pitṛhīnadera o misakīnadera saṅgeo (sadvyavahāra karave), āra tomarā lokera sāthe uttamabhāve kathā valave evaṃ sālāta pratiṣṭhita karave o yākāta pradāna karave; ataḥpara tomādera madhya hate alpa saṃkhyaka vyatīta tomarā sakalei vimukha haẏechile, yehetu tomarā chile agrāhyakārī.
latin_ascii: ara yakhana ami vani isaraila hate angikara niyechilama ye, tomara allaha vyatita ara karao ivadata karavena evam matapitara sange sadvyavahara karave o atmiyadera, pitrhinadera o misakinadera sangeo (sadvyavahara karave), ara tomara lokera sathe uttamabhave katha valave evam salata pratisthita karave o yakata pradana karave; atahpara tomadera madhya hate alpa samkhyaka vyatita tomara sakalei vimukha hayechile, yehetu tomara chile agrahyakari.

latin_iast: evaṃ āmi yakhana tomādera aṅgīkāra grahaṇa karechilāma ye, paraspara śoṇitapāta karavenā evaṃ svīẏa vāsasthāna hate āpana vyaktiderake vahiskāra karavenā; ataḥpara tomarā svīkṛta haẏechile evaṃ tomarāi ora sākṣī chile.
latin_ascii: evam ami yakhana tomadera angikara grahana karechilama ye, paraspara sonitapata karavena evam sviya vasasthana hate apana vyaktiderake vahiskara karavena; atahpara tomara svikrta hayechile evam tomarai ora saksi chile.

latin_iast: ataḥpara sei tomarāi paraspara khunākhuni karacha evaṃ tomarā tomādera madhya hate eka dalake tādera gṛha hate vahiskāra kare diccha, tādera viruddhe (śatrutā vaśataḥ) pāpa o anyāẏa kāje sāhāyya karacha evaṃ tārā vandī haẏe tomādera nikaṭa ānīta hale tomarā tāderake vinimaẏa pradāna kara, athaca tāderake vahiskāra karā tomādera janya avaidha chila, tāhale ki tomarā granthera kichu aṃśa viśvāsa kara evaṃ kichu aṃśa aviśvāsa kara? tomādera madhye yārā erūpa kare tādera pārthiva jīvane durgati vyatīta kichui nei evaṃ utthāna dine tārā kaṭhora śāstira dike nikṣipta have evaṃ tomarā yā karacha, tadviṣaẏe āllāha amanoyogī nana.
latin_ascii: atahpara sei tomarai paraspara khunakhuni karacha evam tomara tomadera madhya hate eka dalake tadera grha hate vahiskara kare diccha, tadera viruddhe (satruta vasatah) papa o anyaya kaje sahayya karacha evam tara vandi haye tomadera nikata anita hale tomara taderake vinimaya pradana kara, athaca taderake vahiskara kara tomadera janya avaidha chila, tahale ki tomara granthera kichu amsa visvasa kara evam kichu amsa avisvasa karay tomadera madhye yara erupa kare tadera parthiva jivane durgati vyatita kichui nei evam utthana dine tara kathora sastira dike niksipta have evam tomara ya karacha, tadvisaye allaha amanoyogi nana.

latin_iast: erāi ākhirātera vinimaẏe pārthiva jīvana kraẏa kareche, ataeva tādera danḍa laghu karā havenā evaṃ tārā sāhāyya prāptao havenā.
latin_ascii: erai akhiratera vinimaye parthiva jivana kraya kareche, ataeva tadera danda laghu kara havena evam tara sahayya praptao havena.

latin_iast: evaṃ avaśyai āmi mūsāke kitāva pradāna karechi o tatpare kramānvaẏe rāsūlagaṇake preraṇa karechi, evaṃ āmi māraiẏāma nandana īsāke nidarśanasamūha pradāna karechilāma evaṃ pavitra ātmāyoge tāke śakti sampanna karechilāma; kintu pare yakhana tomādera nikaṭa kona rāsūla - tomādera pravṛtti yā icchā karatanā tā niẏe upasthita hala takhana tomarā ahaṃkāra karale, avaśeṣe eka dalake mithyāvādī valale evaṃ ekadalake hatyā karale.
latin_ascii: evam avasyai ami musake kitava pradana karechi o tatpare kramanvaye rasulaganake prerana karechi, evam ami maraiyama nandana isake nidarsanasamuha pradana karechilama evam pavitra atmayoge take sakti sampanna karechilama; kintu pare yakhana tomadera nikata kona rasula - tomadera pravrtti ya iccha karatana ta niye upasthita hala takhana tomara ahamkara karale, avasese eka dalake mithyavadi valale evam ekadalake hatya karale.

latin_iast: evaṃ tārā vale, āmādera hṛdaẏa āvṛta; evaṃ tādera aviśvāsera janya āllāha tāderake abhisampāta karechena - yehetu tārā ati alpai viśvāsa kare.
latin_ascii: evam tara vale, amadera hrdaya avrta; evam tadera avisvasera janya allaha taderake abhisampata karechena - yehetu tara ati alpai visvasa kare.

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana āllāhara sannidhāna hate tādera nikaṭa yā āche tāra satyatā pratipādaka grantha upasthita hala evaṃ yā pūrva hatei tārā kāphiradera upara vijaẏa prārthanā karata; ataḥpara yakhana tādera nikaṭa sei paricita kitāva ela takhana tārā tāke asvīkāra karala. sutarāṃ erūpa kāphiradera upara āllāhara lā’nata varṣita hoka.
latin_ascii: evam yakhana allahara sannidhana hate tadera nikata ya ache tara satyata pratipadaka grantha upasthita hala evam ya purva hatei tara kaphiradera upara vijaya prarthana karata; atahpara yakhana tadera nikata sei paricita kitava ela takhana tara take asvikara karala. sutaram erupa kaphiradera upara allahara la’nata varsita hoka.

latin_iast: yāra vinimaẏe tārā nijedera vikri kareche tā khuvai manda, yehetu tārā āllāha yā nāyila karechena tā asvīkāra kareche - ei haṭhakāritāra janya ye, āllāha svīẏa vāndādera madhye yāra prati icchā anugraha avatāraṇa karena. ataeva tārā krodhera upara krodha arjana kareche. evaṃ kāphiradera janya lāñchanādāẏaka śāsti raẏeche.
latin_ascii: yara vinimaye tara nijedera vikri kareche ta khuvai manda, yehetu tara allaha ya nayila karechena ta asvikara kareche - ei hathakaritara janya ye, allaha sviya vandadera madhye yara prati iccha anugraha avatarana karena. ataeva tara krodhera upara krodha arjana kareche. evam kaphiradera janya lanchanadayaka sasti rayeche.

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana tāderake valā haẏa - āllāha yā avatīrṇa karechena tā viśvāsa kara takhana tārā valeḥ yā āmādera prati avatīrṇa haẏeche āmarā tā’i viśvāsa kari evaṃ tā chār̤ā yā raẏeche tā aviśvāsa kari; athaca e granthaṭi satya, tādera kāche yā āche eṭā tārai satyatāra pratipādaka. tumi valaḥ yadi tomarā viśvāsīi chile tāhale itopūrve kena āllāhara nāvīgaṇake hatyā karechile?
latin_ascii: evam yakhana taderake vala haya - allaha ya avatirna karechena ta visvasa kara takhana tara valeh ya amadera prati avatirna hayeche amara ta’i visvasa kari evam ta chara ya rayeche ta avisvasa kari; athaca e granthati satya, tadera kache ya ache eta tarai satyatara pratipadaka. tumi valah yadi tomara visvasii chile tahale itopurve kena allahara naviganake hatya karechiley

latin_iast: evaṃ niścaẏai mūsā ujjvala nidarśanāvalīsaha tomādera nikaṭa upasthita haẏechila; anantara tomarā go-vatsake upāsya rūpe grahaṇa karechile, yehetu tomarā atyācārī chile.
latin_ascii: evam niscayai musa ujjvala nidarsanavalisaha tomadera nikata upasthita hayechila; anantara tomara go-vatsake upasya rupe grahana karechile, yehetu tomara atyacari chile.

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana āmi tomādera aṅgīkāra grahaṇa karechilāma evaṃ tomādera upara tūra parvata samucca karechilāma evaṃ valechilāma ye, āmi yā pradāna karalāma tā dṛr̤harūpe dhāraṇa kara evaṃ śravaṇa kara. tārā valechila, āmarā śunalāma o agrāhya karalāma, evaṃ tādera aviśvāsera nimitta tādera antarasamūhe go-vatsa priẏatā siñcita haẏechila. tumi valaḥ yadi tomarā viśvāsī hao tāhale tomādera viśvāsa yā kichu ādeśa karache tā atyanta nindanīẏa.
latin_ascii: evam yakhana ami tomadera angikara grahana karechilama evam tomadera upara tura parvata samucca karechilama evam valechilama ye, ami ya pradana karalama ta drrharupe dharana kara evam sravana kara. tara valechila, amara sunalama o agrahya karalama, evam tadera avisvasera nimitta tadera antarasamuhe go-vatsa priyata sincita hayechila. tumi valah yadi tomara visvasi hao tahale tomadera visvasa ya kichu adesa karache ta atyanta nindaniya.

latin_iast: tumi valaḥ yadi apara vyaktigaṇa apekṣā tomādera janya āllāhara nikaṭa viśeṣa pāralaukika ālaẏa thāke tāhale tomarā mṛtyu kāmanā kara, yadi tomarā satyavādī hao.
latin_ascii: tumi valah yadi apara vyaktigana apeksa tomadera janya allahara nikata visesa paralaukika alaya thake tahale tomara mrtyu kamana kara, yadi tomara satyavadi hao.

latin_iast: evaṃ tādera hastasamūha pūrve yā preraṇa kareche tajjanya tārā kakhanai tā kāmanā karavenā evaṃ āllāha atyācārīdera samvandhe saviśeṣa avagata āchena.
latin_ascii: evam tadera hastasamuha purve ya prerana kareche tajjanya tara kakhanai ta kamana karavena evam allaha atyacaridera samvandhe savisesa avagata achena.

latin_iast: evaṃ niścaẏai tumi tāderake anyānya loka evaṃ aṃśīvādīdera apekṣāo adhikatara āẏu-ākāṃkṣī pāve; tādera madhye pratyeke kāmanā kare yena tāke hājāra vachara āẏu deẏā haẏa, evaṃ airūpa āẏu prāptio tāderake śāsti hate mukta karate pāravenā evaṃ tārā yā karache āllāha tāra paridarśaka.
latin_ascii: evam niscayai tumi taderake anyanya loka evam amsivadidera apeksao adhikatara ayu-akamksi pave; tadera madhye pratyeke kamana kare yena take hajara vachara ayu deya haya, evam airupa ayu praptio taderake sasti hate mukta karate paravena evam tara ya karache allaha tara paridarsaka.

latin_iast: tumi valaḥ ye vyakti jivarāīlera sāthe śatrutā rākhe e janya ye, se āllāhara hukume ei kuraānake tomāra antaḥkaraṇa paryanta pau~chiẏeche, yā pūrvavatī kitāvasamūhera satyatā pramāṇa karache evaṃ mu’minadera susaṃvāda dicche .
latin_ascii: tumi valah ye vyakti jivarailera sathe satruta rakhe e janya ye, se allahara hukume ei kuraanake tomara antahkarana paryanta pau~chiyeche, ya purvavati kitavasamuhera satyata pramana karache evam mu’minadera susamvada dicche .

latin_iast: ye vyakti āllāhara, tā~ra mālāikā/phereśatāgaṇera, tā~ra rāsūlagaṇera, jivarāīlera evaṃ mikāīlera śatru, niścaẏai āllāha erūpa kāphiradera śatru.
latin_ascii: ye vyakti allahara, ta~ra malaika/pheresataganera, ta~ra rasulaganera, jivarailera evam mikailera satru, niscayai allaha erupa kaphiradera satru.

latin_iast: evaṃ niścaẏai āmi tomāra prati spaṣṭa nidarśanasamūha avataraṇa karechi evaṃ duskarmakārī vyatīta kehai tā aviśvāsa karavenā.
latin_ascii: evam niscayai ami tomara prati spasta nidarsanasamuha avatarana karechi evam duskarmakari vyatita kehai ta avisvasa karavena.

latin_iast: ki āścarya! yakhana tārā kona aṅgīkāre āvaddha hala takhanai tādera ekadala tā bhaṅga karala. varaṃ tādera adhikāṃśai viśvāsa karenā.
latin_ascii: ki ascarya! yakhana tara kona angikare avaddha hala takhanai tadera ekadala ta bhanga karala. varam tadera adhikamsai visvasa karena.

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana āllāhara nikaṭa hate, tādera nikaṭa yā āche tāra satya pratyaẏanakārī rāsūla tādera nikaṭa āgamana karala, takhana yāderake grantha pradāna karā haẏeche tādera ekadala āllāhara granthake nijedera paścādabhāge nikṣepa karala, yena tārā kichui jānenā.
latin_ascii: evam yakhana allahara nikata hate, tadera nikata ya ache tara satya pratyayanakari rasula tadera nikata agamana karala, takhana yaderake grantha pradana kara hayeche tadera ekadala allahara granthake nijedera pascadabhage niksepa karala, yena tara kichui janena.

latin_iast: evaṃ sulāimānera rājatvakāle śāitānarā yā āvṛtti karata, tārā orai anusaraṇa karache, evaṃ sulāimāna aviśvāsī haẏani - kintu śāitānarāi aviśvāsa karechila. tārā lokaderake yādu vidyā evaṃ yā vāvela śahare hārūta-mārūta mālāka/phereśatādvaẏera prati avatīrṇa haẏechila tā śikṣā dita, evaṃ tārā ubhaẏe kehakeo oṭā e kathā nā vale śikṣā ditanā ye, ‘āmarā parīkṣādhīna chār̤ā kichui nai, ataeva tomarā kupharī karanā’. anantara tārā yāte svāmī o strīra madhye viccheda saṃghaṭita haẏa tā tādera nikaṭa theke śikṣā grahaṇa karata. kintu tārā āllāhara ādeśa vyatīta tadvārā kārao aniṣṭa karate pāratanā, kintu tārā oṭāi śikṣā karache yāte tādera kṣati haẏa evaṃ tādera kona upakāra sādhita nā haẏa; evaṃ niścaẏai tārā jñāta āche - ye keha oṭā kraẏa kareche tāra janya ākhirāte sukha lābha nei evaṃ tāra vinimaẏe tārā ye ātmavikraẏa kareche tā nikṛṣṭa - yadi tārā tā jānata!
latin_ascii: evam sulaimanera rajatvakale saitanara ya avrtti karata, tara orai anusarana karache, evam sulaimana avisvasi hayani - kintu saitanarai avisvasa karechila. tara lokaderake yadu vidya evam ya vavela sahare haruta-maruta malaka/pheresatadvayera prati avatirna hayechila ta siksa dita, evam tara ubhaye kehakeo ota e katha na vale siksa ditana ye, ‘amara pariksadhina chara kichui nai, ataeva tomara kuphari karana’. anantara tara yate svami o strira madhye viccheda samghatita haya ta tadera nikata theke siksa grahana karata. kintu tara allahara adesa vyatita tadvara karao anista karate paratana, kintu tara otai siksa karache yate tadera ksati haya evam tadera kona upakara sadhita na haya; evam niscayai tara jnata ache - ye keha ota kraya kareche tara janya akhirate sukha labha nei evam tara vinimaye tara ye atmavikraya kareche ta nikrsta - yadi tara ta janata!

latin_iast: evaṃ yadi tārā satya satyai viśvāsa karata o dharmabhīru hata tāhale āllāhara nikaṭa hate kalyāṇa lābha karata - yadi tārā eṭā vujhato.
latin_ascii: evam yadi tara satya satyai visvasa karata o dharmabhiru hata tahale allahara nikata hate kalyana labha karata - yadi tara eta vujhato.

latin_iast: he mu’minagaṇa! tomarā ‘rā‘ẏenā’ valanā, varaṃ ‘unayuranā’ vala evaṃ śune nāo - aviśvāsīdera janya raẏeche yantranāmaẏa śāsti.
latin_ascii: he mu’minagana! tomara ‘ra‘yena’ valana, varam ‘unayurana’ vala evam sune nao - avisvasidera janya rayeche yantranamaya sasti.

latin_iast: āhale kitāvadera madhye yārā kāphira (arthāt iẏāhudī o nāsārā) evaṃ muśarikarā moṭei pachanda karenā ye, tomādera ravera pakṣa hate tomādera upara kona kalyāṇa varṣita hoka, āra āllāha yāke icchā karena tā~ra karuṇāra janya nirdiṣṭa kare nena evaṃ āllāha mahā karuṇāmaẏa.
latin_ascii: ahale kitavadera madhye yara kaphira (arthat iyahudi o nasara) evam musarikara motei pachanda karena ye, tomadera ravera paksa hate tomadera upara kona kalyana varsita hoka, ara allaha yake iccha karena ta~ra karunara janya nirdista kare nena evam allaha maha karunamaya.

latin_iast: āmi kona āẏātera hukuma rahita karale kiṃvā āẏātaṭike vismṛta kariẏe dile tadapekṣā uttama athavā tadanurūpa āẏāta ānaẏana kari. tumi ki jānanā ye, āllāha sarva viṣaẏera uparai kṣamatāvāna?
latin_ascii: ami kona ayatera hukuma rahita karale kimva ayatatike vismrta kariye dile tadapeksa uttama athava tadanurupa ayata anayana kari. tumi ki janana ye, allaha sarva visayera uparai ksamatavanay

latin_iast: tumi ki jānanā ye, ākāśa o pṛthivīra ādhipatya āllāharai evaṃ āllāha vyatīta tomādera kona vandhuo nei evaṃ kona sāhāyyakārīo nei?
latin_ascii: tumi ki janana ye, akasa o prthivira adhipatya allaharai evam allaha vyatita tomadera kona vandhuo nei evam kona sahayyakario neiy

latin_iast: tomarā ki cāo ye, tomādera rāsūlera nikaṭa āvedana karave yemana itopūrve mūsāra nikaṭa (haṭhakāritā vaśataḥ eirūpa vahu nirarthaka) āvedana karā haẏechila? āra ye vyakti īmānera parivarte kupharī avalamvana kare, niścaẏai se saṭhika patha hate dūre sare par̤e.
latin_ascii: tomara ki cao ye, tomadera rasulera nikata avedana karave yemana itopurve musara nikata (hathakarita vasatah eirupa vahu nirarthaka) avedana kara hayechilay ara ye vyakti imanera parivarte kuphari avalamvana kare, niscayai se sathika patha hate dure sare pare.

latin_iast: kitāvīdera aneke tādera prati satya prakāśita haoẏāra para tārā tādera antarhita vidveṣa vaśataḥ tomāderake viśvāsa sthāpanera pare aviśvāsī karate icchā kare; kintu ye paryanta āllāha svaẏaṃ ādeśa ānaẏana nā karena se paryanta tomarā kṣamā kara o upekṣā karate thāka; niścaẏai āllāha sarva viṣaẏera upara kṣamatāvāna.
latin_ascii: kitavidera aneke tadera prati satya prakasita haoyara para tara tadera antarhita vidvesa vasatah tomaderake visvasa sthapanera pare avisvasi karate iccha kare; kintu ye paryanta allaha svayam adesa anayana na karena se paryanta tomara ksama kara o upeksa karate thaka; niscayai allaha sarva visayera upara ksamatavana.

latin_iast: āra tomarā sālāta pratiṣṭhita kara o yākāta pradāna kara; evaṃ tomarā sva sva jīvanera janya ye satkāja agre preraṇa karecha tā āllāhara nikaṭa prāpta have; tomarā yā karacho niścaẏai āllāha tāra paridarśaka.
latin_ascii: ara tomara salata pratisthita kara o yakata pradana kara; evam tomara sva sva jivanera janya ye satkaja agre prerana karecha ta allahara nikata prapta have; tomara ya karacho niscayai allaha tara paridarsaka.

latin_iast: evaṃ tārā valeḥ iẏāhudī vā khṛṣṭāna chār̤ā āra kehai jānnāte praveśa karavenā; eṭā tādera mithyā āśā. tumi valaḥ yadi tomarā satyavādī hao tāhale tomādera pramāṇa upasthita kara.
latin_ascii: evam tara valeh iyahudi va khrstana chara ara kehai jannate pravesa karavena; eta tadera mithya asa. tumi valah yadi tomara satyavadi hao tahale tomadera pramana upasthita kara.

latin_iast: avaśya ye vyakti nijeke āllāhara nikaṭa sarmapana kareche evaṃ satkāja kareche, phalataḥ tāra janya tāra ravera nikaṭa pratidāna raẏeche evaṃ tādera janya kona āśaṃkā nei o tārā cintita havenā.
latin_ascii: avasya ye vyakti nijeke allahara nikata sarmapana kareche evam satkaja kareche, phalatah tara janya tara ravera nikata pratidana rayeche evam tadera janya kona asamka nei o tara cintita havena.

latin_iast: āra iẏāhudīrā valeḥ khṛṣṭānarā kona viṣaẏera upara nei; evaṃ khṛṣṭānarā vale, iẏāhudīrāo kona viṣaẏera upara nei - athaca tārā grantha pāṭha kare. erūpa yārā jānenā, tārāo odera kathāra anurūpa kathā vale thāke; ataeva ye viṣaẏe tārā matavirodha karechila, utthāna dine āllāha tādera madhye tadviṣaẏe phāẏasālā kare divena.
latin_ascii: ara iyahudira valeh khrstanara kona visayera upara nei; evam khrstanara vale, iyahudirao kona visayera upara nei - athaca tara grantha patha kare. erupa yara janena, tarao odera kathara anurupa katha vale thake; ataeva ye visaye tara matavirodha karechila, utthana dine allaha tadera madhye tadvisaye phayasala kare divena.

latin_iast: evaṃ ye āllāhara māsajidasamūhera madhye tā~ra nāma uccāraṇa karate niṣedha karache evaṃ tā ujār̤a karate ceṣṭā karache se apekṣā ke adhika atyācārī? tādera pakṣe upayukta naẏa ye, tārā śaṃkita haoẏā vyatīta tanmadhye praveśa kare; tādera janya ihaloke durgati evaṃ paraloke kaṭhora śāsti raẏeche.
latin_ascii: evam ye allahara masajidasamuhera madhye ta~ra nama uccarana karate nisedha karache evam ta ujara karate cesta karache se apeksa ke adhika atyacariy tadera pakse upayukta naya ye, tara samkita haoya vyatita tanmadhye pravesa kare; tadera janya ihaloke durgati evam paraloke kathora sasti rayeche.

latin_iast: āllāharai janya pūrva o paścima; ataeva tomarā ye dikei mukha phirāo sei dikei āllāhara dika; kenanā āllāha (sarvadika) pariveṣṭanakārī, pūrṇa jñānavāna.
latin_ascii: allaharai janya purva o pascima; ataeva tomara ye dikei mukha phirao sei dikei allahara dika; kenana allaha (sarvadika) parivestanakari, purna jnanavana.

latin_iast: evaṃ tārā vale, āllāha santāna grahaṇa karechena. tini parama pavitra! varaṃ yā kichu āsamāne o bhūmanḍale raẏeche tā tā~rai janya; savai tā~ra ājñādhīna.
latin_ascii: evam tara vale, allaha santana grahana karechena. tini parama pavitra! varam ya kichu asamane o bhumandale rayeche ta ta~rai janya; savai ta~ra ajnadhina.

latin_iast: tini ākāśa o pṛthivīra sṛṣṭikartā evaṃ yakhana tini kona kāja sampādana karate icchā karena takhana tāra janya śudhumātra ‘hao’ valena, āra tātei tā haẏe yāẏa.
latin_ascii: tini akasa o prthivira srstikarta evam yakhana tini kona kaja sampadana karate iccha karena takhana tara janya sudhumatra ‘hao’ valena, ara tatei ta haye yaya.

latin_iast: evaṃ mūrkherā valeḥ āllāha āmādera sāthe kena kathā valenanā, athavā kena āmādera janya kona nidarśana upasthita haẏanā? edera pūrve yārā chila tārāo edera anurūpa kathā valata; tādera savārai antara paraspara sādṛśyapūrṇa; niścaẏai āmi viśvāsī sampradāẏera janya ujjvala nidarśanāvalī varṇanā kari.
latin_ascii: evam murkhera valeh allaha amadera sathe kena katha valenana, athava kena amadera janya kona nidarsana upasthita hayanay edera purve yara chila tarao edera anurupa katha valata; tadera savarai antara paraspara sadrsyapurna; niscayai ami visvasi sampradayera janya ujjvala nidarsanavali varnana kari.

latin_iast: niścaẏai āmi tomāke satyasaha susaṃvādadātā o bhaẏa pradarśaka rūpe preraṇa karechi evaṃ tumi jāhānnāmavāsīdera samvandhe jijñāsita havenā.
latin_ascii: niscayai ami tomake satyasaha susamvadadata o bhaya pradarsaka rupe prerana karechi evam tumi jahannamavasidera samvandhe jijnasita havena.

latin_iast: evaṃ iẏāhudī o khṛṣṭānarā - tumi tādera dharma anusaraṇa nā karā paryanta tomāra prati santuṣṭa havenā; tumi valaḥ āllāhara pradarśita pathai supatha; evaṃ jñāna prāptira para tumi yadi tādera kheẏāla-khuśira anusaraṇa kara tāhale āllāha hate tomāra janya konai abhibhāvaka o sāhāyyakārī nei.
latin_ascii: evam iyahudi o khrstanara - tumi tadera dharma anusarana na kara paryanta tomara prati santusta havena; tumi valah allahara pradarsita pathai supatha; evam jnana praptira para tumi yadi tadera kheyala-khusira anusarana kara tahale allaha hate tomara janya konai abhibhavaka o sahayyakari nei.

latin_iast: āmi yāderake ye dharmagrantha dāna karechi tā yārā saṭhikabhāve satya vujhe pāṭha kare tārāi era prati viśvāsa sthāpanakārī, evaṃ ye keha eṭā aviśvāsa kare phalataḥ tārāi kṣatigrasta have.
latin_ascii: ami yaderake ye dharmagrantha dana karechi ta yara sathikabhave satya vujhe patha kare tarai era prati visvasa sthapanakari, evam ye keha eta avisvasa kare phalatah tarai ksatigrasta have.

latin_iast: he vānī isarāīla! āmi tomāderake ye sukha sampada dāna karechi evaṃ āmi pṛthivīra upara tomāderake ye śreṣṭhatva dāna karechi - tomarā tā smaraṇa kara.
latin_ascii: he vani isaraila! ami tomaderake ye sukha sampada dana karechi evam ami prthivira upara tomaderake ye sresthatva dana karechi - tomara ta smarana kara.

latin_iast: āra tomarā ai dinera bhaẏa kara yedina ekajana anyajana hate kichumātra upakṛta havenā evaṃ kārao nikaṭa hate vinimaẏa gṛhīta havenā, kārao supāriśa phalaprada havenā evaṃ tārā sāhāyya prāpta havenā.
latin_ascii: ara tomara ai dinera bhaya kara yedina ekajana anyajana hate kichumatra upakrta havena evam karao nikata hate vinimaya grhita havena, karao suparisa phalaprada havena evam tara sahayya prapta havena.

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana tomāra rāvva ivarāhīmake katipaẏa vākya dvārā parīkṣā karechilena pare se tā pūrṇa karechila; tini valechilenaḥ niścaẏai āmi tomāke mānavamanḍalīra netā karava. se valechilaḥ āmāra vaṃśadharagaṇa hateo. tini valechilenaḥ āmāra aṅgīkāra atyācārīdera prati prayojya havenā.
latin_ascii: evam yakhana tomara ravva ivarahimake katipaya vakya dvara pariksa karechilena pare se ta purna karechila; tini valechilenah niscayai ami tomake manavamandalira neta karava. se valechilah amara vamsadharagana hateo. tini valechilenah amara angikara atyacaridera prati prayojya havena.

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana āmi kā‘vā gṛhake mānava jātira janya surakṣita sthāna o puṇyadhāma karechilāma, evaṃ mākāme ivarāhīmake sālātera jāẏagā nirdhāraṇa karechilāma; evaṃ āmi ivarāhīma o isamāīlera nikaṭa aṅgīkāra niẏechilāma ye, tomarā āmāra gṛhake tāoẏāphakārī o i’tikāphakārī evaṃ ruku o sājadāhakārīdera janya pavitra rekha.
latin_ascii: evam yakhana ami ka‘va grhake manava jatira janya suraksita sthana o punyadhama karechilama, evam makame ivarahimake salatera jayaga nirdharana karechilama; evam ami ivarahima o isamailera nikata angikara niyechilama ye, tomara amara grhake taoyaphakari o i’tikaphakari evam ruku o sajadahakaridera janya pavitra rekha.

latin_iast: yakhana ivarāhīma valalaḥ he āmāra rāvva! e sthānake āpani nirāpattāmaẏa śahare pariṇata karuna evaṃ era adhivāsīdera madhye yārā āllāha o ākhirāte viśvāsa sthāpana kareche tāderake upajīvikāra janya phala-śaṣya pradāna karuna. (āllāha) valenaḥ yārā kupharī kare tāderake āmi alpa kichu dina jīvanopabhoga karate diva, ataḥpara tāderake agnira śāsti bhoga karate vādhya karava, ai gantavya sthāna nikṛṣṭatama.
latin_ascii: yakhana ivarahima valalah he amara ravva! e sthanake apani nirapattamaya sahare parinata karuna evam era adhivasidera madhye yara allaha o akhirate visvasa sthapana kareche taderake upajivikara janya phala-sasya pradana karuna. (allaha) valenah yara kuphari kare taderake ami alpa kichu dina jivanopabhoga karate diva, atahpara taderake agnira sasti bhoga karate vadhya karava, ai gantavya sthana nikrstatama.

latin_iast: yakhana ivarāhīma o isamāīla kā‘vāra bhitti sthāpana karala (takhana valala) he āmādera rāvva! āmādera pakṣa hate eṭi grahaṇa karuna, niścaẏai āpani śravaṇakārī, mahājñānī.
latin_ascii: yakhana ivarahima o isamaila ka‘vara bhitti sthapana karala (takhana valala) he amadera ravva! amadera paksa hate eti grahana karuna, niscayai apani sravanakari, mahajnani.

latin_iast: he āmādera rāvva! āmādera ubhaẏake āpanāra anugata karuna, evaṃ āmādera vaṃśadharadera madhya hateo āpanāra anugata eka dala loka sṛṣṭi karuna, āra āmāderake hājjera āhakāma vale dina evaṃ āmādera prati daẏā karuna, niścaẏai āpani kṣamāśīla, karuṇāmaẏa.
latin_ascii: he amadera ravva! amadera ubhayake apanara anugata karuna, evam amadera vamsadharadera madhya hateo apanara anugata eka dala loka srsti karuna, ara amaderake hajjera ahakama vale dina evam amadera prati daya karuna, niscayai apani ksamasila, karunamaya.

latin_iast: he āmādera rāvva! tāderai madhya hate emana ekajana rāsūla preraṇa karuna yini tāderake āpanāra nidarśanāvalī pāṭha kare śunāvena evaṃ tāderake grantha o vijñāna śikṣā dāna karavena o tāderake pavitra karavena. niścaẏai āpani parākrānta, vijñānamaẏa.
latin_ascii: he amadera ravva! taderai madhya hate emana ekajana rasula prerana karuna yini taderake apanara nidarsanavali patha kare sunavena evam taderake grantha o vijnana siksa dana karavena o taderake pavitra karavena. niscayai apani parakranta, vijnanamaya.

latin_iast: evaṃ ye nijake nirvodha kare tuleche se vyatīta ke ivarāhīmera dharma hate vimukha have? evaṃ niścaẏai āmi tāke ei pṛthivīte manonīta karechilāma, niścaẏai se sat karmaśīlagaṇera antarbhukta chila.
latin_ascii: evam ye nijake nirvodha kare tuleche se vyatita ke ivarahimera dharma hate vimukha havey evam niscayai ami take ei prthivite manonita karechilama, niscayai se sat karmasilaganera antarbhukta chila.

latin_iast: yakhana tāra rāvva tāke valechilenaḥ tumi ānugatya svīkāra kara; se valechila: āmi viśvajagatera ravera nikaṭa ātmasamarpaṇa karalāma.
latin_ascii: yakhana tara ravva take valechilenah tumi anugatya svikara kara; se valechila: ami visvajagatera ravera nikata atmasamarpana karalama.

latin_iast: āra ivarāhīma o iẏākūva svīẏa santānaderake sadupadeśa pradāna karechilaḥ he āmāra vaṃśadharagaṇa! niścaẏai āllāha tomādera janya ei dharma manonīta karechena, ataeva tomarā musalima nā haẏe mṛtyu varaṇa karanā.
latin_ascii: ara ivarahima o iyakuva sviya santanaderake sadupadesa pradana karechilah he amara vamsadharagana! niscayai allaha tomadera janya ei dharma manonita karechena, ataeva tomara musalima na haye mrtyu varana karana.

latin_iast: yakhana iẏākūvera mṛtyu upasthita hala takhana ki tomarā upasthita chile, yakhana se nija putraderake valechilaḥ āmāra pare tomarā kon jinisera ivādāta karave? tārā valechilaḥ āmarā tomāra upāsyera evaṃ tomāra pitṛpuruṣa ivarāhīma, isamāīla o isahākera upāsya - sei advitīẏa upāsyera ivādāta karava evaṃ āmarā tā~rai anugata thākava.
latin_ascii: yakhana iyakuvera mrtyu upasthita hala takhana ki tomara upasthita chile, yakhana se nija putraderake valechilah amara pare tomara kon jinisera ivadata karavey tara valechilah amara tomara upasyera evam tomara pitrpurusa ivarahima, isamaila o isahakera upasya - sei advitiya upasyera ivadata karava evam amara ta~rai anugata thakava.

latin_iast: oṭi ekaṭi dala chila, yā atīta haẏe geche; tārā yā arjana karechila tā tādera janya evaṃ tomarā yā arjana karecha tā tomādera janya evaṃ tārā yā kare geche tajjanya tomarā jijñāsita havenā.
latin_ascii: oti ekati dala chila, ya atita haye geche; tara ya arjana karechila ta tadera janya evam tomara ya arjana karecha ta tomadera janya evam tara ya kare geche tajjanya tomara jijnasita havena.

latin_iast: evaṃ tārā vale ye, tomarā iẏāhudī athavā khṛṣṭāna hao, tāhalei supatha prāpta have; tumi valaḥ varaṃ āmarā ivarāhīmera sudṛr̤ha dharme āchi evaṃ se aṃśīvādīdera antarbhukta chilanā.
latin_ascii: evam tara vale ye, tomara iyahudi athava khrstana hao, tahalei supatha prapta have; tumi valah varam amara ivarahimera sudrrha dharme achi evam se amsivadidera antarbhukta chilana.

latin_iast: tomarā valaḥ āmarā āllāhara prati evaṃ yā āmādera prati avatīrṇa haẏeche, āra yā ivarāhīma, isamāīla, isahāka, iẏākūva o tadīẏa vaṃśadharagaṇera prati avatīrṇa haẏechila evaṃ yā mūsā o īsāke pradāna karā haẏechila evaṃ anyānya nāvīgaṇake tādera rāvva hate yā pradatta haẏechila, tadasamudaẏera upara viśvāsa sthāpana karachi, tādera madhye kehakeo āmarā prabheda karinā, evaṃ āmarā tā~rai prati ātmasamarpaṇakārī.
latin_ascii: tomara valah amara allahara prati evam ya amadera prati avatirna hayeche, ara ya ivarahima, isamaila, isahaka, iyakuva o tadiya vamsadharaganera prati avatirna hayechila evam ya musa o isake pradana kara hayechila evam anyanya naviganake tadera ravva hate ya pradatta hayechila, tadasamudayera upara visvasa sthapana karachi, tadera madhye kehakeo amara prabheda karina, evam amara ta~rai prati atmasamarpanakari.

latin_iast: anantara tomarā yerūpa viśvāsa sthāpana karecha, tārāo yadi tadrupa viśvāsa sthāpana kare tāhale niścaẏai tārā supatha prāpta have; evaṃ yadi tārā phire yāẏa tāhale tārā śudhu viruddhācaraṇei phire yāve; ataeva acirei āllāha tādera pratikūle tomākei yatheṣṭa karavena evaṃ tinii śravaṇakārī, mahājñānī.
latin_ascii: anantara tomara yerupa visvasa sthapana karecha, tarao yadi tadrupa visvasa sthapana kare tahale niscayai tara supatha prapta have; evam yadi tara phire yaya tahale tara sudhu viruddhacaranei phire yave; ataeva acirei allaha tadera pratikule tomakei yathesta karavena evam tinii sravanakari, mahajnani.

latin_iast: āmarā āllāharai raṃẏe rañjita, āllāha apekṣā ke śreṣṭhatama rañjanakārī? evaṃ āmarā tā~rai vāndā.
latin_ascii: amara allaharai ramye ranjita, allaha apeksa ke sresthatama ranjanakariy evam amara ta~rai vanda.

latin_iast: tumi valaḥ tomarā ki āllāha samvandhe āmādera saṅge virodha karacha? athaca tinii āmādera rāvva o tomādera rāvva, evaṃ āmādera janya āmādera kāryasamūha evaṃ tomādera janya tomādera kāryasamūha evaṃ āmarā tā~rai prati viśvasta.
latin_ascii: tumi valah tomara ki allaha samvandhe amadera sange virodha karachay athaca tinii amadera ravva o tomadera ravva, evam amadera janya amadera karyasamuha evam tomadera janya tomadera karyasamuha evam amara ta~rai prati visvasta.

latin_iast: tomarā ki valacha - ivarāhīma, isamāīla, isahāka, iẏākūva o tadīẏa vaṃśadharagaṇa iẏāhudī o khṛṣṭāna chila? tumi valaḥ tomarāi saṭhika jñānī nā āllāha evaṃ āllāhara nikaṭa hate prāpta sākṣya ye vyakti gopana karache se apekṣā ke veśi atyācārī? evaṃ tomarā yā karacha tā hate āllāha amanoyogī nana.
latin_ascii: tomara ki valacha - ivarahima, isamaila, isahaka, iyakuva o tadiya vamsadharagana iyahudi o khrstana chilay tumi valah tomarai sathika jnani na allaha evam allahara nikata hate prapta saksya ye vyakti gopana karache se apeksa ke vesi atyacariy evam tomara ya karacha ta hate allaha amanoyogi nana.

latin_iast: oṭā ekaṭi jāmā‘āta chila yā vigata haẏeche; tārā yā arjana kareche tā tādera janya evaṃ tomarā yā arjana karecha tā tomādera janya, evaṃ tārā yā kare geche tadviṣaẏe tomarā jijñāsita havenā.
latin_ascii: ota ekati jama‘ata chila ya vigata hayeche; tara ya arjana kareche ta tadera janya evam tomara ya arjana karecha ta tomadera janya, evam tara ya kare geche tadvisaye tomara jijnasita havena.

latin_iast: mānavamanḍalīra madhyasthita nirvodherā acirei valave, kise tāderake sei kivalā hate pratyāvṛtta karala yāra dike tārā chila? tumi vale dāoḥ pūrva o paścima āllāharai janya, tini yāke icchā sarala patha pradarśana karena.
latin_ascii: manavamandalira madhyasthita nirvodhera acirei valave, kise taderake sei kivala hate pratyavrtta karala yara dike tara chilay tumi vale daoh purva o pascima allaharai janya, tini yake iccha sarala patha pradarsana karena.

latin_iast: ebhāve āmi tomāderake ādarśa jāti karechi, yena tomarā mānavagaṇera janya sākṣī hao evaṃ rāsūlao tomādera janya sākṣī haẏa; evaṃ tumi ye kivalāra dike chile tā āmi e janya pratiṣṭhita karechilāma ye, ke rāsūlera anusaraṇa kare, āra ke tā hate svīẏa padadvaẏe paścāte phire yāẏa āmi tā jene niva evaṃ āllāha yāderake patha pradarśana karechena tārā chār̤ā aparera janya eṭi avaśyai kaṭhoratara; evaṃ āllāha erūpa nana ye, tomādera viśvāsa vinaṣṭa karena; niścaẏai āllāha mānuṣera prati snehaśīla, karuṇāmaẏa.
latin_ascii: ebhave ami tomaderake adarsa jati karechi, yena tomara manavaganera janya saksi hao evam rasulao tomadera janya saksi haya; evam tumi ye kivalara dike chile ta ami e janya pratisthita karechilama ye, ke rasulera anusarana kare, ara ke ta hate sviya padadvaye pascate phire yaya ami ta jene niva evam allaha yaderake patha pradarsana karechena tara chara aparera janya eti avasyai kathoratara; evam allaha erupa nana ye, tomadera visvasa vinasta karena; niscayai allaha manusera prati snehasila, karunamaya.

latin_iast: niścaẏai āmi ākāśera dike tomāra mukhamanḍala uttolana avalokana karechi. tāi āmi tomāke ai kivalāhamukhīi karācchi yā tumi kāmanā karacho. ataeva tumi māsajidula hārāmera dike tomāra mukhamanḍala phiriẏe dāo evaṃ tomarā yekhānei thāka tomādera ānana se dikei pratyāvartita kara; evaṃ niścaẏai yāderake kitāva deẏā haẏeche tārā avaśyai avagata āche ye, niścaẏai eṭi tādera ravera nikaṭa hate prerita satya; evaṃ tārā yā karache tadviṣaẏe āllāha amanoyogī nana.
latin_ascii: niscayai ami akasera dike tomara mukhamandala uttolana avalokana karechi. tai ami tomake ai kivalahamukhii karacchi ya tumi kamana karacho. ataeva tumi masajidula haramera dike tomara mukhamandala phiriye dao evam tomara yekhanei thaka tomadera anana se dikei pratyavartita kara; evam niscayai yaderake kitava deya hayeche tara avasyai avagata ache ye, niscayai eti tadera ravera nikata hate prerita satya; evam tara ya karache tadvisaye allaha amanoyogi nana.

latin_iast: evaṃ yāderake grantha pradatta haẏeche tādera nikaṭa yadi tumi samudaẏa nidarśana ānaẏana kara tavuo tārā tomāra kivalāhake grahaṇa karavenā; evaṃ tumio tādera kivalāha grahaṇa karate pāranā, āra tādera kona dalao anya dalera kivalāhake svīkāra kareni, evaṃ tomāra nikaṭa ye jñāna eseche era pareo yadi tumi tādera pravṛttira anusaraṇa kara tāhale niścaẏai tumi atyācārīdera antarbhukta haẏe yāve.
latin_ascii: evam yaderake grantha pradatta hayeche tadera nikata yadi tumi samudaya nidarsana anayana kara tavuo tara tomara kivalahake grahana karavena; evam tumio tadera kivalaha grahana karate parana, ara tadera kona dalao anya dalera kivalahake svikara kareni, evam tomara nikata ye jnana eseche era pareo yadi tumi tadera pravrttira anusarana kara tahale niscayai tumi atyacaridera antarbhukta haye yave.

latin_iast: yāderake āmi kitāva pradāna karechi tārā tāke erūpabhāve cine, yemana cine tārā āpana santānaderake evaṃ niścaẏai tādera eka dala jñātasāre satyake gopana karache.
latin_ascii: yaderake ami kitava pradana karechi tara take erupabhave cine, yemana cine tara apana santanaderake evam niscayai tadera eka dala jnatasare satyake gopana karache.

latin_iast: ei vāstava satya tomāra ravera pakṣa hate; sutarāṃ tumi saṃśaẏīdera antarbhukta haẏonā.
latin_ascii: ei vastava satya tomara ravera paksa hate; sutaram tumi samsayidera antarbhukta hayona.

latin_iast: pratyekera janya eka ekaṭi lakṣyasthala raẏeche, ai dikei se mukhamanḍala pratyāvartita kare, ataeva tomarā kalyāṇera dike dhāvita hao; tomarā yekhānei thākanā kena, āllāha tomādera sakalakei ekatrita karavena; niścaẏai āllāha sarva viṣaẏe pūrṇa kṣamatāvāna.
latin_ascii: pratyekera janya eka ekati laksyasthala rayeche, ai dikei se mukhamandala pratyavartita kare, ataeva tomara kalyanera dike dhavita hao; tomara yekhanei thakana kena, allaha tomadera sakalakei ekatrita karavena; niscayai allaha sarva visaye purna ksamatavana.

latin_iast: evaṃ tumi yekhāna hatei vera have- tomāra mukha pavitratama māsajidera dike pratyāvartita kara evaṃ niścaẏai eṭāi tomāra ravera nikaṭa hate prerita satya evaṃ tomarā yā karacha tadviṣaẏe āllāha amanoyogī nana.
latin_ascii: evam tumi yekhana hatei vera have- tomara mukha pavitratama masajidera dike pratyavartita kara evam niscayai etai tomara ravera nikata hate prerita satya evam tomara ya karacha tadvisaye allaha amanoyogi nana.

latin_iast: āra tumi yekhāna hatei niskrānta hao - tomāra mukha pavitratama māsajidera dike phirāo evaṃ ye yekhāne ācha tomādera mukhamanḍala taddikei pratyāvartita kara yena atyācārīrā vyatīta apare tomādera sāthe virtaka karate nā pāre. ataeva tomarā tāderake bhaẏa karanā, varaṃ āmākei bhaẏa kara yena āmi tomādera upara āmāra anugraha pūrṇa kari, evaṃ yena tomarā supatha prāpta hao.
latin_ascii: ara tumi yekhana hatei niskranta hao - tomara mukha pavitratama masajidera dike phirao evam ye yekhane acha tomadera mukhamandala taddikei pratyavartita kara yena atyacarira vyatita apare tomadera sathe virtaka karate na pare. ataeva tomara taderake bhaya karana, varam amakei bhaya kara yena ami tomadera upara amara anugraha purna kari, evam yena tomara supatha prapta hao.

latin_iast: āmi tomādera madhya hate erūpa rāsūla preraṇa karechi ye tomādera nikaṭa āmāra nidarśanāvalī pāṭha kare evaṃ tomāderake pavitra kare, tomāderake grantha o vijñāna śikṣā deẏa evaṃ tomarā yā avagata chilenā tā śikṣā dāna kare.
latin_ascii: ami tomadera madhya hate erupa rasula prerana karechi ye tomadera nikata amara nidarsanavali patha kare evam tomaderake pavitra kare, tomaderake grantha o vijnana siksa deya evam tomara ya avagata chilena ta siksa dana kare.

latin_iast: ataeva tomarā āmākei smaraṇa kara, āmio tomāderakei smaraṇa karava evaṃ tomarā āmārai nikaṭa kṛtajña hao evaṃ aviśvāsī haẏonā.
latin_ascii: ataeva tomara amakei smarana kara, amio tomaderakei smarana karava evam tomara amarai nikata krtajna hao evam avisvasi hayona.

latin_iast: he viśvāsa sthāpanakārīgaṇa! tomarā dhairya o sālātera mādhyame sāhāyya prārthanā kara; niścaẏai āllāha dhairyaśīlagaṇera sāthe āchena.
latin_ascii: he visvasa sthapanakarigana! tomara dhairya o salatera madhyame sahayya prarthana kara; niscayai allaha dhairyasilaganera sathe achena.

latin_iast: āra yārā āllāhara pathe nihata haẏeche tāderake mṛta valanā, varaṃ tārā jīvita; kintu tomarā tā avagata nao.
latin_ascii: ara yara allahara pathe nihata hayeche taderake mrta valana, varam tara jivita; kintu tomara ta avagata nao.

latin_iast: evaṃ niścaẏai āmi tomāderake bhaẏa, kṣudhā, dhana, prāṇa evaṃ phala-phasalera dvārā parīkṣā karava; evaṃ ai sava dhairyaśīladera susaṃvāda pradāna kara.
latin_ascii: evam niscayai ami tomaderake bhaya, ksudha, dhana, prana evam phala-phasalera dvara pariksa karava; evam ai sava dhairyasiladera susamvada pradana kara.

latin_iast: yādera upara kona vipada nipatita hale tārā vale, niścaẏai āmarā āllāharai janya evaṃ niścaẏai āmarā tā~rai dike pratyāvartanakārī.
latin_ascii: yadera upara kona vipada nipatita hale tara vale, niscayai amara allaharai janya evam niscayai amara ta~rai dike pratyavartanakari.

latin_iast: edera upara tādera ravera pakṣa hate śānti o karunā varṣita have evaṃ erāi supathagāmī.
latin_ascii: edera upara tadera ravera paksa hate santi o karuna varsita have evam erai supathagami.

latin_iast: niścaẏai ‘sāphā’ o ‘māraoẏā’ āllāhara nidarśanasamūhera antargata. ataeva ye vyakti ei gṛhe ‘hājja’ athavā ‘umarāha’ pālana’ kare tāra janya etadubhaẏera pradakṣiṇa karā doṣaṇīẏa naẏa, evaṃ kona vyakti svecchāẏa sat kāja karale āllāha guṇagrāhī, sarvajñāta.
latin_ascii: niscayai ‘sapha’ o ‘maraoya’ allahara nidarsanasamuhera antargata. ataeva ye vyakti ei grhe ‘hajja’ athava ‘umaraha’ palana’ kare tara janya etadubhayera pradaksina kara dosaniya naya, evam kona vyakti svecchaya sat kaja karale allaha gunagrahi, sarvajnata.

latin_iast: āmi ye sava ujjvala nidarśana o patha-nirdeśa avatīrṇa karechi aigulike sarva sādhāraṇera nikaṭa prakāśa karāra parao yārā aisava viṣaẏake gopana kare, āllāha tāderake abhisampāta karena evaṃ abhisampātakārīrāo tāderake abhisampāta kare thāke.
latin_ascii: ami ye sava ujjvala nidarsana o patha-nirdesa avatirna karechi aigulike sarva sadharanera nikata prakasa karara parao yara aisava visayake gopana kare, allaha taderake abhisampata karena evam abhisampatakarirao taderake abhisampata kare thake.

latin_iast: kintu yārā tāovāha kare o saṃśodhita haẏa evaṃ satya prakāśa kare, vasttataḥ āmi tādera prati kṣamā pradānakārī, karuṇāmaẏa.
latin_ascii: kintu yara taovaha kare o samsodhita haya evam satya prakasa kare, vasttatah ami tadera prati ksama pradanakari, karunamaya.

latin_iast: yārā aviśvāsa kareche o aviśvāsī avasthāẏa mṛtyu varaṇa kareche, niścaẏai tādera upara āllāhara mālāka/phereśatā evaṃ mānavakūlera savārai abhisampāta.
latin_ascii: yara avisvasa kareche o avisvasi avasthaya mrtyu varana kareche, niscayai tadera upara allahara malaka/pheresata evam manavakulera savarai abhisampata.

latin_iast: tanmadhye tārā sarvadā avasthāna karave, tādera śāsti praśamita havenā evaṃ tāderake avakāśa deẏā havenā.
latin_ascii: tanmadhye tara sarvada avasthana karave, tadera sasti prasamita havena evam taderake avakasa deya havena.

latin_iast: evaṃ tomādera ilāha ekamātra āllāha; sei sarvadātā karuṇāmaẏa vyatīta anya keha upāsya nei.
latin_ascii: evam tomadera ilaha ekamatra allaha; sei sarvadata karunamaya vyatita anya keha upasya nei.

latin_iast: niścaẏai nabhomanḍala o bhūmanḍala sṛṣṭite, dina o rātera parivartane, nau-pathe jāhājasamūhera calācale - yāte raẏeche mānuṣera janya kalyāṇa. mṛta pṛthivīke sañjīvita karaṇe, tāte nānāvidha jīvajantu sañcārita karāra janya āllāha ākāśa hate vṛṣṭi varṣaṇa karena. vāẏurāśira gati parivartane evaṃ ākāśa o pṛthivīra madhyastha sañcita meghera sañcāraṇe satyi satyii jñānavāna sampradāẏera janya nidarśana raẏeche.
latin_ascii: niscayai nabhomandala o bhumandala srstite, dina o ratera parivartane, nau-pathe jahajasamuhera calacale - yate rayeche manusera janya kalyana. mrta prthivike sanjivita karane, tate nanavidha jivajantu sancarita karara janya allaha akasa hate vrsti varsana karena. vayurasira gati parivartane evam akasa o prthivira madhyastha sancita meghera sancarane satyi satyii jnanavana sampradayera janya nidarsana rayeche.
