latin_iast: evaṃ mānavamanḍalīra madhye erūpa āche - yārā āllāha vyatīta aparake sadṛśa sthira kare, āllāhake bhālavāsāra nyāẏa tārā tāderake bhālavāse. evaṃ yārā viśvāsa sthāpana kareche āllāhara prati - tādera prema dṛr̤hatara evaṃ yārā atyācāra kareche tārā yadi śāsti avalokana karata tāhale dekhata, samudaẏa śaktii āllāhara evaṃ niścaẏai āllāha śāsti dāne kaṭhora.
latin_ascii: evam manavamandalira madhye erupa ache - yara allaha vyatita aparake sadrsa sthira kare, allahake bhalavasara nyaya tara taderake bhalavase. evam yara visvasa sthapana kareche allahara prati - tadera prema drrhatara evam yara atyacara kareche tara yadi sasti avalokana karata tahale dekhata, samudaya saktii allahara evam niscayai allaha sasti dane kathora.

latin_iast: yādera anusaraṇa karā haẏeche tārā yakhana anusārīderake pratyākhyāna karave takhana tārā śāsti pratyakṣa karave evaṃ tādera samparka vicchinna haẏe yāve.
latin_ascii: yadera anusarana kara hayeche tara yakhana anusariderake pratyakhyana karave takhana tara sasti pratyaksa karave evam tadera samparka vicchinna haye yave.

latin_iast: anusaraṇakārīrā valaveḥ yadi āmarā phire yete pāratāma tāhale tārā yerūpa āmāderake pratyākhyāna kareche āmarāo tadrupa tāderake pratyākhyāna karatāma. ebhāve āllāha tādera kṛtakarmera pariṇāma duḥkhajanakabhāve pradarśana karavena evaṃ tārā agni hate uddhāra pāvenā.
latin_ascii: anusaranakarira valaveh yadi amara phire yete paratama tahale tara yerupa amaderake pratyakhyana kareche amarao tadrupa taderake pratyakhyana karatama. ebhave allaha tadera krtakarmera parinama duhkhajanakabhave pradarsana karavena evam tara agni hate uddhara pavena.

latin_iast: he mānavamanḍalī! pṛthivīra madhye yā vaidha o pavitra, tā hate āhāra kara evaṃ śāitānera padāṅka anusaraṇa karanā, niścaẏai se tomādera prakāśya śatru.
latin_ascii: he manavamandali! prthivira madhye ya vaidha o pavitra, ta hate ahara kara evam saitanera padanka anusarana karana, niscayai se tomadera prakasya satru.

latin_iast: se etadvyatīta tomāderake ādeśa kare śāitānī o aślīla kāja karate evaṃ āllāha samvandhe tomarā yā jānanā tā valate.
latin_ascii: se etadvyatita tomaderake adesa kare saitani o aslila kaja karate evam allaha samvandhe tomara ya janana ta valate.

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana tāderake valā haẏa ye, āllāha yā avatīrṇa karechena tā anusaraṇa kara takhana tārā valeḥ varaṃ āmarā orai anusaraṇa karava yā āmādera pitṛ-puruṣagaṇa hate prāpta haẏechi; yadio tādera pitṛ-puruṣadera konai jñāna chilanā evaṃ tārā supathagāmīo chilanā.
latin_ascii: evam yakhana taderake vala haya ye, allaha ya avatirna karechena ta anusarana kara takhana tara valeh varam amara orai anusarana karava ya amadera pitr-purusagana hate prapta hayechi; yadio tadera pitr-purusadera konai jnana chilana evam tara supathagamio chilana.

latin_iast: āra yārā aviśvāsa kareche tādera dṛṣṭānta odera nyāẏa - yemana keha āhavāna karale śudhu cītkāra o dhvani vyatīta āra kichui śonenā, tārā vadhira, muka, andha; kājei tārā vujhate pārenā.
latin_ascii: ara yara avisvasa kareche tadera drstanta odera nyaya - yemana keha ahavana karale sudhu citkara o dhvani vyatita ara kichui sonena, tara vadhira, muka, andha; kajei tara vujhate parena.

latin_iast: he viśvāsa sthāpanakārīgaṇa! āmi tomāderake yā upajīvikā svarūpa dāna karechi sei pavitra vastusamūha āhāra kara evaṃ āllāhara nikaṭa kṛtajñatā prakāśa kara, yadi tomarā tā~rai ivādāta kare thāka.
latin_ascii: he visvasa sthapanakarigana! ami tomaderake ya upajivika svarupa dana karechi sei pavitra vastusamuha ahara kara evam allahara nikata krtajnata prakasa kara, yadi tomara ta~rai ivadata kare thaka.

latin_iast: tini śudhu tomādera janya mṛta jīva, rakta, śukarera māṃsa evaṃ yā āllāha vyatīta aparera uddeśe nivedita - tadvyatīta avaidha karenani; vastutaḥ ye vyakti nirūpāẏa, kintu sīmā laṃghanakārī naẏa, tāra janya pāpa nei; evaṃ niścaẏai āllāha kṣamāśīla, karuṇāmaẏa.
latin_ascii: tini sudhu tomadera janya mrta jiva, rakta, sukarera mamsa evam ya allaha vyatita aparera uddese nivedita - tadvyatita avaidha karenani; vastutah ye vyakti nirupaya, kintu sima lamghanakari naya, tara janya papa nei; evam niscayai allaha ksamasila, karunamaya.

latin_iast: āllāha yā granthe avatīrṇa karechena tā yārā gopana kare o tatparivarte nagaṇya mūlya grahaṇa kare, niścaẏai tārā agni chār̤ā anya kichu bhakṣana karenā; evaṃ utthāna dine āllāha tādera sāthe kathā valavenanā, tāderake pavitra karavenanā evaṃ tādera janya raẏeche yantranādāẏaka śāsti.
latin_ascii: allaha ya granthe avatirna karechena ta yara gopana kare o tatparivarte naganya mulya grahana kare, niscayai tara agni chara anya kichu bhaksana karena; evam utthana dine allaha tadera sathe katha valavenana, taderake pavitra karavenana evam tadera janya rayeche yantranadayaka sasti.

latin_iast: orāi supathera vinimaẏe kupatha evaṃ kṣamāra parivarte śāsti kraẏa kareche, ataḥpara jāhānnāmera āguna kirūpe sahya karave?
latin_ascii: orai supathera vinimaye kupatha evam ksamara parivarte sasti kraya kareche, atahpara jahannamera aguna kirupe sahya karavey

latin_iast: e janyai āllāha satyasaha grantha avatīrṇa karechena evaṃ yārā grantha samvandhe virodha kare vāstavikai tārā viruddhācaraṇe sudūragāmī.
latin_ascii: e janyai allaha satyasaha grantha avatirna karechena evam yara grantha samvandhe virodha kare vastavikai tara viruddhacarane suduragami.

latin_iast: tomarā tomādera mukhamanḍala pūrva vā paścima dike pratyāvartita karalei tāte puṇya nei, varaṃ puṇya tāra ye vyakti āllāha, ākhirāta, mālāikā/phereśatā, kitāva o nāvīgaṇera prati viśvāsa sthāpana kare evaṃ tā~rai preme dhana-sampadera prati ākarṣaṇa thākā sattveo se tā ātmīẏa-svajana, pitṛhīna, daridra, pathika o bhikṣukaderake evaṃ dāsatva mocanera janya vyaẏa kare, āra sālāta pratiṣṭhita kare o yākāta pradāna kare evaṃ aṅgīkāra karale tā pūraṇa kare evaṃ yārā abhāve o kleśe evaṃ yuddhakāle dhairyaśīla tārāi satya parāẏaṇa evaṃ tārāi dharmabhīru.
latin_ascii: tomara tomadera mukhamandala purva va pascima dike pratyavartita karalei tate punya nei, varam punya tara ye vyakti allaha, akhirata, malaika/pheresata, kitava o naviganera prati visvasa sthapana kare evam ta~rai preme dhana-sampadera prati akarsana thaka sattveo se ta atmiya-svajana, pitrhina, daridra, pathika o bhiksukaderake evam dasatva mocanera janya vyaya kare, ara salata pratisthita kare o yakata pradana kare evam angikara karale ta purana kare evam yara abhave o klese evam yuddhakale dhairyasila tarai satya parayana evam tarai dharmabhiru.

latin_iast: he viśvāsa sthāpanakārīgaṇa! nihatadera samvandhe tomādera janya pratiśodha grahaṇa vidhivaddha karā hala; svādhīnera parivarte svādhīna, dāsera parivarte dāsa evaṃ nārīra parivarte nārī. kintu yadi keha tāra bhāi kartṛka kona viṣaẏe kṣamā prāpta haẏa tāhale yena nyāẏa saṅgatabhāve pāonā sāvyasta karā haẏa evaṃ sadbhāve tā pariśodha kare. eṭā tomādera ravera pakṣa hate laghu vidhāna o karuṇā; ataḥpara ye keha sīmā laṃghana karave tāra janya yantranādāẏaka śāsti raẏeche.
latin_ascii: he visvasa sthapanakarigana! nihatadera samvandhe tomadera janya pratisodha grahana vidhivaddha kara hala; svadhinera parivarte svadhina, dasera parivarte dasa evam narira parivarte nari. kintu yadi keha tara bhai kartrka kona visaye ksama prapta haya tahale yena nyaya sangatabhave paona savyasta kara haya evam sadbhave ta parisodha kare. eta tomadera ravera paksa hate laghu vidhana o karuna; atahpara ye keha sima lamghana karave tara janya yantranadayaka sasti rayeche.

latin_iast: he jñānavāna lokerā! kisāsera madhye tomādera janya jīvana raẏeche, yena tomarā tākaoẏā avalamvana karate pāra.
latin_ascii: he jnanavana lokera! kisasera madhye tomadera janya jivana rayeche, yena tomara takaoya avalamvana karate para.

latin_iast: yakhana tomādera kārao mṛtyu nikaṭavartī vale mane haẏa, takhana se yadi dhana sampatti rekhe yāẏa tāhale mātā-pitā o ātmīẏa-svajanera janya vaidhabhāve asīẏāta karā tomādera janya vidhivaddha hala, dharma-bhīrudera eṭā avaśya karaṇīẏa.
latin_ascii: yakhana tomadera karao mrtyu nikatavarti vale mane haya, takhana se yadi dhana sampatti rekhe yaya tahale mata-pita o atmiya-svajanera janya vaidhabhave asiyata kara tomadera janya vidhivaddha hala, dharma-bhirudera eta avasya karaniya.

latin_iast: ataḥpara ye vyakti śonāra para tā parivartana kare, tāhale era pāpa tāderai have yārā eke parivartana karave; niścaẏai āllāha śravaṇakārī, mahājñānī.
latin_ascii: atahpara ye vyakti sonara para ta parivartana kare, tahale era papa taderai have yara eke parivartana karave; niscayai allaha sravanakari, mahajnani.

latin_iast: anantara yadi keha asīẏātakārīra pakṣe pakṣapātitva athavā pāpera āśaṅkā kare tādera madhye mīmāṃsā kare deẏa, tāte tāra pāpa nei; niścaẏai āllāha kṣamāśīla, karuṇāmaẏa.
latin_ascii: anantara yadi keha asiyatakarira pakse paksapatitva athava papera asanka kare tadera madhye mimamsa kare deya, tate tara papa nei; niscayai allaha ksamasila, karunamaya.

latin_iast: he viśvāsa sthāpanakārīgaṇa! tomādera pūrvavatī lokadera nyāẏa tomādera uparao siẏāmake aparihārya kartavya rūpe nirdhāraṇa karā hala yena tomarā saṃyamaśīla hate pāro.
latin_ascii: he visvasa sthapanakarigana! tomadera purvavati lokadera nyaya tomadera uparao siyamake apariharya kartavya rupe nirdharana kara hala yena tomara samyamasila hate paro.

latin_iast: oṭā nirdiṣṭa kaẏeka dina. kintu tomādera madhye ye keha pīr̤ita kiṃvā pravāsī haẏa tāra janya apara kona dina hate gaṇanā karave, āra yārā ote akṣama tārā tatparivarte ekajana daridrake āhārya dāna karave. ataeva ye vyakti svecchāẏa sat kāja kare tāra janya kalyāṇa evaṃ tomarā yadi vujhe thāka tāhale siẏāma pālanai tomādera janya kalyāṇakara.
latin_ascii: ota nirdista kayeka dina. kintu tomadera madhye ye keha pirita kimva pravasi haya tara janya apara kona dina hate ganana karave, ara yara ote aksama tara tatparivarte ekajana daridrake aharya dana karave. ataeva ye vyakti svecchaya sat kaja kare tara janya kalyana evam tomara yadi vujhe thaka tahale siyama palanai tomadera janya kalyanakara.

latin_iast: rāmāyāna māsa, ye māse viśvamānavera janya patha pradarśana evaṃ su-pathera ujjvala nidarśana evaṃ haka o vātilera prabhedakārī kuraāna avatīrṇa haẏeche. ataeva tomādera madhye ye vyakti sei māse (nija āvāse) upasthita thāke se yena siẏāma pālana kare evaṃ ye vyakti pīr̤ita athavā pravāsī, tāra janya apara kona dina hate gaṇanā karave; tomādera pakṣe yā sahajasādhya āllāha tā’i icchā karena o tomādera pakṣe yā duḥsādhya tā icchā karenanā evaṃ yena tomarā nirdhārita saṃkhyā pūraṇa kare nite pāra evaṃ tomāderake ye supatha dekhiẏechena tajjanya tomarā āllāhake mahimānvita kara evaṃ yena tomarā kṛtajñatā prakāśa kara.
latin_ascii: ramayana masa, ye mase visvamanavera janya patha pradarsana evam su-pathera ujjvala nidarsana evam haka o vatilera prabhedakari kuraana avatirna hayeche. ataeva tomadera madhye ye vyakti sei mase (nija avase) upasthita thake se yena siyama palana kare evam ye vyakti pirita athava pravasi, tara janya apara kona dina hate ganana karave; tomadera pakse ya sahajasadhya allaha ta’i iccha karena o tomadera pakse ya duhsadhya ta iccha karenana evam yena tomara nirdharita samkhya purana kare nite para evam tomaderake ye supatha dekhiyechena tajjanya tomara allahake mahimanvita kara evam yena tomara krtajnata prakasa kara.

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana āmāra sevakavṛnda (vāndā) āmāra samvandhe tomāke jijñesa kare takhana tāderake vale dāoḥ niścaẏai āmi sannikaṭavartī. kona āhavānakārī yakhanai āmāke āhavāna kare takhanai āmi tāra āhavāne sār̤ā dii; sutarāṃ tārāo yena āmāra ḍāke sār̤ā deẏa evaṃ āmāke viśvāsa kare - tāhalei tārā saṭhika pathaprāpta hate pārave.
latin_ascii: evam yakhana amara sevakavrnda (vanda) amara samvandhe tomake jijnesa kare takhana taderake vale daoh niscayai ami sannikatavarti. kona ahavanakari yakhanai amake ahavana kare takhanai ami tara ahavane sara dii; sutaram tarao yena amara dake sara deya evam amake visvasa kare - tahalei tara sathika pathaprapta hate parave.

latin_iast: rāmāyānera rāte āpana strīdera sāthe melāmeśā karā tomādera janya vaidha karā haẏeche, tārā tomādera janya evaṃ tomarā tādera janya āvaraṇa, tomarā ye nijedera kṣati karachile āllāha tā jñāta āchena, e janya tini tomādera prati pratyāvṛtta halena evaṃ tomādera (bhāra) lāghava kare dilena; ataeva ekṣaṇe tomarā (rāmāyānera rāteo) tādera sāthe milita hao evaṃ āllāha tomādera janya yā lipivaddha karechena tā anusandhāna kara evaṃ pratyuṣe kālo sūtā hate sādā sūtā prakāśita nā haoẏā paryanta tomarā āhāra o pāna kara, ataḥpara rāta samāgama paryanta tomarā siẏāma pūrṇa kara; tomarā māsajide i‘tikāpha karāra samaẏa (tomādera strīdera sāthe) milita havenā; eṭii āllāhara sīmā. ataeva tomarā uhāra nikaṭeo yāvenā; ebhāve āllāha mānavamanḍalīra janya tā~ra nidarśanasamūha vivṛta karena, yena tārā saṃyata haẏa.
latin_ascii: ramayanera rate apana stridera sathe melamesa kara tomadera janya vaidha kara hayeche, tara tomadera janya evam tomara tadera janya avarana, tomara ye nijedera ksati karachile allaha ta jnata achena, e janya tini tomadera prati pratyavrtta halena evam tomadera (bhara) laghava kare dilena; ataeva eksane tomara (ramayanera rateo) tadera sathe milita hao evam allaha tomadera janya ya lipivaddha karechena ta anusandhana kara evam pratyuse kalo suta hate sada suta prakasita na haoya paryanta tomara ahara o pana kara, atahpara rata samagama paryanta tomara siyama purna kara; tomara masajide i‘tikapha karara samaya (tomadera stridera sathe) milita havena; etii allahara sima. ataeva tomara uhara nikateo yavena; ebhave allaha manavamandalira janya ta~ra nidarsanasamuha vivrta karena, yena tara samyata haya.

latin_iast: evaṃ tomarā nijedera madhye parasparera dhana sampatti anyāẏabhāve grāsa karanā evaṃ tā vicārakera nikaṭa ṭopa hisāve upasthāpana karanā yāte tomarā jñātasāre lokera sampadera aṃśa anyāẏabhāve udarastha karate pāra.
latin_ascii: evam tomara nijedera madhye parasparera dhana sampatti anyayabhave grasa karana evam ta vicarakera nikata topa hisave upasthapana karana yate tomara jnatasare lokera sampadera amsa anyayabhave udarastha karate para.

latin_iast: tārā tomāke natuna cā~dasamūha samvandhe jijñesa karache. tumi valaḥ eguli hacche samagra mānava jātira janya samaẏasamūha (māsasamūha) nirdhāraṇa (gaṇanā vā hisāva) karāra mādhyama evaṃ hājjera janya; āra (ai hājjera cā~de) tomarā ye paścāt dika diẏe gṛhe praveśa kara eṭi puṇyera kāja naẏa, varaṃ puṇyera kāja hala ye vyakti saṃyamaśīlatā avalamvana karala. evaṃ tomarā gṛhasamūhe ogulira darayā diẏe praveśa kara evaṃ āllāhake bhaẏa kara, yāte tomarā suphala prāpta hao.
latin_ascii: tara tomake natuna ca~dasamuha samvandhe jijnesa karache. tumi valah eguli hacche samagra manava jatira janya samayasamuha (masasamuha) nirdharana (ganana va hisava) karara madhyama evam hajjera janya; ara (ai hajjera ca~de) tomara ye pascat dika diye grhe pravesa kara eti punyera kaja naya, varam punyera kaja hala ye vyakti samyamasilata avalamvana karala. evam tomara grhasamuhe ogulira daraya diye pravesa kara evam allahake bhaya kara, yate tomara suphala prapta hao.

latin_iast: evaṃ yārā tomādera sāthe yuddha kare, tomarāo tādera sāthe āllāhara pathe yuddha kara evaṃ sīmā atikrama karanā; niścaẏai āllāha sīmā laṃghanakārīderake bhālavāsenanā.
latin_ascii: evam yara tomadera sathe yuddha kare, tomarao tadera sathe allahara pathe yuddha kara evam sima atikrama karana; niscayai allaha sima lamghanakariderake bhalavasenana.

latin_iast: tāderake yekhānei pāo, hatyā kara evaṃ tārā tomāderake yekhāna hate vahiskāra kareche tomarāo tāderake sekhāna hate vahiskāra kara evaṃ hatyā apekṣā aśānti (phitanā) gurutara evaṃ tomarā tādera sāthe pavitratama māsajidera nikaṭa yuddha karanā, ye paryanta nā tārā tomādera sāthe tanmadhye yuddha kare; kintu yadi tārā tomādera sāthe yuddha kare tāhale tomarāo tāderake hatyā kara; aviśvāsīdera janya eṭāi pratiphala.
latin_ascii: taderake yekhanei pao, hatya kara evam tara tomaderake yekhana hate vahiskara kareche tomarao taderake sekhana hate vahiskara kara evam hatya apeksa asanti (phitana) gurutara evam tomara tadera sathe pavitratama masajidera nikata yuddha karana, ye paryanta na tara tomadera sathe tanmadhye yuddha kare; kintu yadi tara tomadera sathe yuddha kare tahale tomarao taderake hatya kara; avisvasidera janya etai pratiphala.

latin_iast: ataḥpara yadi nivṛtta haẏa tāhale niścaẏai āllāha kṣamāśīla, karuṇāmaẏa.
latin_ascii: atahpara yadi nivrtta haya tahale niscayai allaha ksamasila, karunamaya.

latin_iast: phitanā dūra haẏe āllāhara dīna pratiṣṭhita nā haoẏā paryanta tomarā tādera sāthe yuddha kara; ataḥpara yadi tārā nivṛtta haẏa tāhale atyācārīdera upara vyatīta śatrutā nei.
latin_ascii: phitana dura haye allahara dina pratisthita na haoya paryanta tomara tadera sathe yuddha kara; atahpara yadi tara nivrtta haya tahale atyacaridera upara vyatita satruta nei.

latin_iast: niṣiddha māsera parivarte niṣiddha māsa o samasta niṣiddha viṣaẏa paraspara samāna; ataḥpara ye keha tomādera prati atyācāra kare, tāhale se tomādera prati yerūpa atyācāra karave tomarāo tāra prati serūpa atyācāra kara evaṃ āllāhake bhaẏa kara o jene rekha ye, āllāha saṃyamaśīladera saṅgī.
latin_ascii: nisiddha masera parivarte nisiddha masa o samasta nisiddha visaya paraspara samana; atahpara ye keha tomadera prati atyacara kare, tahale se tomadera prati yerupa atyacara karave tomarao tara prati serupa atyacara kara evam allahake bhaya kara o jene rekha ye, allaha samyamasiladera sangi.

latin_iast: evaṃ tomarā āllāhara pathe vyaẏa kara evaṃ svīẏa hasta dhvaṃsera dike prasārita karanā evaṃ kalyāṇa sādhana karate thāko, niścaẏai āllāha kalyāṇa sādhanakārīdera bhālavāsena.
latin_ascii: evam tomara allahara pathe vyaya kara evam sviya hasta dhvamsera dike prasarita karana evam kalyana sadhana karate thako, niscayai allaha kalyana sadhanakaridera bhalavasena.

latin_iast: tomarā āllāhara uddeśe hājja o ‘omarāha sampūrṇa kara; kintu tomarā yadi vādhāprāpta hao tāhale yā sahaja prāpra tāi utsarga kara evaṃ kuravānīra jantuguli svasthāne nā pau~chā paryanta tomādera mastaka munḍana karanā. kintu keha yadi tomādera madhye pīr̤ita haẏa, athavā tāra mastiska yantranāgrasta haẏa tāhale se siẏāma kiṃvā sādākāha athavā kuravānī dvārā ora vinimaẏa karave, ataḥpara yakhana tomarā śāntite thāko takhana ye vyakti omarāh o hājja ekatre kāmanā kare tāhale yā sahaja prāpya tā’i utsarga karave. kintu keha yadi tā prāpta nā haẏa tāhale hājjera samaẏa tina dina evaṃ yakhana tomarā pratyāvartita hao takhana sāta dina - ei pūrṇa daśa dina siẏāma pālana karave; eṭā tārai janya - yāra parijana pavitratama māsajide upasthita nā thāke evaṃ āllāhake bhaẏa kara o jene rekha ye, āllāha kaṭhina śāsti dātā.
latin_ascii: tomara allahara uddese hajja o ‘omaraha sampurna kara; kintu tomara yadi vadhaprapta hao tahale ya sahaja prapra tai utsarga kara evam kuravanira jantuguli svasthane na pau~cha paryanta tomadera mastaka mundana karana. kintu keha yadi tomadera madhye pirita haya, athava tara mastiska yantranagrasta haya tahale se siyama kimva sadakaha athava kuravani dvara ora vinimaya karave, atahpara yakhana tomara santite thako takhana ye vyakti omarah o hajja ekatre kamana kare tahale ya sahaja prapya ta’i utsarga karave. kintu keha yadi ta prapta na haya tahale hajjera samaya tina dina evam yakhana tomara pratyavartita hao takhana sata dina - ei purna dasa dina siyama palana karave; eta tarai janya - yara parijana pavitratama masajide upasthita na thake evam allahake bhaya kara o jene rekha ye, allaha kathina sasti data.

latin_iast: hājjera māsaguli suvidita. keha yadi ai māsagulira madhye hājjera saṃkalpa kare tāhale se hājjera samaẏe sahavāsa, duskārya o kalaha karate pāravenā evaṃ tomarā ye kona sat kāja karanā kena āllāha tā jñāta āchena. āra tomarā tomādera sāthe pātheẏa niẏe nāo. vasttataḥ utkṛṣṭa pātheẏa hacche tākaoẏā vā ātmasaṃyama. sutarāṃ he jñānavānagaṇa! āmāke bhaẏa kara.
latin_ascii: hajjera masaguli suvidita. keha yadi ai masagulira madhye hajjera samkalpa kare tahale se hajjera samaye sahavasa, duskarya o kalaha karate paravena evam tomara ye kona sat kaja karana kena allaha ta jnata achena. ara tomara tomadera sathe patheya niye nao. vasttatah utkrsta patheya hacche takaoya va atmasamyama. sutaram he jnanavanagana! amake bhaya kara.

latin_iast: tomarā svīẏa ravera anugraha lābhera ceṣṭā karale tāte tomādera pakṣe kona aparādha nei; ataḥpara yakhana tomarā ārāphāta hate pratyāvartita hao takhana pavitra smṛti-sthānera nikaṭa āllāhake smaraṇa kara; evaṃ tini tomāderake yerūpa nirdeśa diẏechena tadrupa tā~ke smaraṇa kara; evaṃ niścaẏai tomarā era pūrve vibhrāntadera antarbhukta chile.
latin_ascii: tomara sviya ravera anugraha labhera cesta karale tate tomadera pakse kona aparadha nei; atahpara yakhana tomara araphata hate pratyavartita hao takhana pavitra smrti-sthanera nikata allahake smarana kara; evam tini tomaderake yerupa nirdesa diyechena tadrupa ta~ke smarana kara; evam niscayai tomara era purve vibhrantadera antarbhukta chile.

latin_iast: ataḥpara anyānyarā yekhāna hate pratyāvartana kare tomarāo pratyāvartana kara evaṃ āllāhara nikaṭa kṣamā prārthanā kara; niścaẏai āllāha kṣamāśīla, karuṇāmaẏa.
latin_ascii: atahpara anyanyara yekhana hate pratyavartana kare tomarao pratyavartana kara evam allahara nikata ksama prarthana kara; niscayai allaha ksamasila, karunamaya.

latin_iast: anantara yakhana tomarā tomādera (hājjera) anuṣṭhānaguli sampanna kare phela takhana yerūpa tomādera pitṛ-puruṣaderake smaraṇa karate tadrupa āllāhake smaraṇa kara, varaṃ tadapekṣā dṛr̤hatarabhāve smaraṇa kara; kintu mānavamanḍalīra madhye keha keha erūpa āche yārā valeḥ he āmādera rāvva! āmāderake ihakālei dāna kara evaṃ tādera janya ākhirāte konai aṃśa nei.
latin_ascii: anantara yakhana tomara tomadera (hajjera) anusthanaguli sampanna kare phela takhana yerupa tomadera pitr-purusaderake smarana karate tadrupa allahake smarana kara, varam tadapeksa drrhatarabhave smarana kara; kintu manavamandalira madhye keha keha erupa ache yara valeh he amadera ravva! amaderake ihakalei dana kara evam tadera janya akhirate konai amsa nei.

latin_iast: āra tādera madhye keha keha vale - he āmādera rāvva! āmāderake ihakāle kalyāṇa dāna karuna o ākhirāte kalyāṇa dāna karuna evaṃ jāhānnāmera śāsti hate āmāderake rakṣā karuna.
latin_ascii: ara tadera madhye keha keha vale - he amadera ravva! amaderake ihakale kalyana dana karuna o akhirate kalyana dana karuna evam jahannamera sasti hate amaderake raksa karuna.

latin_iast: tārā yā arjana kareche, tādera janya tārai aṃśa raẏeche evaṃ niścaẏai āllāha sattvara hisāva grahaṇakārī.
latin_ascii: tara ya arjana kareche, tadera janya tarai amsa rayeche evam niscayai allaha sattvara hisava grahanakari.

latin_iast: evaṃ nirdhārita dinasamūhe āllāhake smaraṇa kara; ataḥpara keha yadi du’ dinera madhye (mākkāẏa phire yete) tār̤āhur̤ā kare tāhale tāra janya kona pāpa nei. pakṣāntare keha yadi du‘ dina vilamva kare tāhale tāra janyao pāpa nei evaṃ tomarā āllāhake bhaẏa kara o jene rekha ye, tomādera sakalake tā~rai sannidhāne samaveta karā have.
latin_ascii: evam nirdharita dinasamuhe allahake smarana kara; atahpara keha yadi du’ dinera madhye (makkaya phire yete) tarahura kare tahale tara janya kona papa nei. paksantare keha yadi du‘ dina vilamva kare tahale tara janyao papa nei evam tomara allahake bhaya kara o jene rekha ye, tomadera sakalake ta~rai sannidhane samaveta kara have.

latin_iast: evaṃ mānuṣera madhye emanao āche yāra pārthiva jīvana saṃkrānta kathā tomāke camatkṛta kare, āra se nijera (antarastha satatā) samvandhe āllāhake sākṣī kare thāke, kintu vastutaḥ se hacche kaṭhora kalahaparāẏaṇa vyakti.
latin_ascii: evam manusera madhye emanao ache yara parthiva jivana samkranta katha tomake camatkrta kare, ara se nijera (antarastha satata) samvandhe allahake saksi kare thake, kintu vastutah se hacche kathora kalahaparayana vyakti.

latin_iast: yakhana se pratyāvartana kare takhana tāra uddeśya thāke duniẏāẏa aśānti sṛṣṭi karā evaṃ śasya-kṣetra o jīva-jantu vināśa karā; evaṃ āllāha aśānti bhālavāsena nā.
latin_ascii: yakhana se pratyavartana kare takhana tara uddesya thake duniyaya asanti srsti kara evam sasya-ksetra o jiva-jantu vinasa kara; evam allaha asanti bhalavasena na.

latin_iast: yakhana tāke valā haẏa, tumi āllāhake bhaẏa kara, takhana pratipattira ahamikā tāke adhikatara anācāre lipta kare. ataeva jāhānnāmai tāra janya yatheṣṭa evaṃ niścaẏai oṭā nikṛṣṭa āśraẏa sthala.
latin_ascii: yakhana take vala haya, tumi allahake bhaya kara, takhana pratipattira ahamika take adhikatara anacare lipta kare. ataeva jahannamai tara janya yathesta evam niscayai ota nikrsta asraya sthala.

latin_iast: pakṣāntare kona kona loka erūpa āche ye āllāhara santuṣṭi sādhanera janya ātmavirsajana kare, evaṃ āllāha hacchena samasta vāndāra prati sneha-parāẏaṇa.
latin_ascii: paksantare kona kona loka erupa ache ye allahara santusti sadhanera janya atmavirsajana kare, evam allaha hacchena samasta vandara prati sneha-parayana.

latin_iast: he mu’minagaṇa! tomarā pūrṇa rūpe isalāme praviṣṭa hao evaṃ śāitānera padāṃka anusaraṇa karanā, niścaẏai se tomādera janya prakāśya śatru.
latin_ascii: he mu’minagana! tomara purna rupe isalame pravista hao evam saitanera padamka anusarana karana, niscayai se tomadera janya prakasya satru.

latin_iast: ataḥpara spaṣṭa dalīla pramāṇādī tomādera nikaṭa samāgata haoẏāra pareo yadi tomarā padaskhalita haẏe yāo tāhale jene rekha, āllāha hacchena mahāparākrānta, vijñānamaẏa.
latin_ascii: atahpara spasta dalila pramanadi tomadera nikata samagata haoyara pareo yadi tomara padaskhalita haye yao tahale jene rekha, allaha hacchena mahaparakranta, vijnanamaya.

latin_iast: tārā śudhu ei apekṣāi karache ye, āllāha śubhra meghamālāra chāẏātale mālāikā/phereśatāderake saṅge niẏe tādera nikaṭa samāgata havena o samasta kājera nispatti karavena. evaṃ āllāharai nikaṭa samasta kārya pratyāvartita haẏe thāke.
latin_ascii: tara sudhu ei apeksai karache ye, allaha subhra meghamalara chayatale malaika/pheresataderake sange niye tadera nikata samagata havena o samasta kajera nispatti karavena. evam allaharai nikata samasta karya pratyavartita haye thake.

latin_iast: isarāīla vaṃśīẏaderake jijñesa kara, āmi kata spaṣṭa pramāṇa tāderake pradāna karechi. evaṃ ye keha tāra nikaṭa āllāhara anugraha sampada āsāra para tā parivartana kare tāhale jene rekha, niścaẏai āllāha kaṭhora śāstidātā.
latin_ascii: isaraila vamsiyaderake jijnesa kara, ami kata spasta pramana taderake pradana karechi. evam ye keha tara nikata allahara anugraha sampada asara para ta parivartana kare tahale jene rekha, niscayai allaha kathora sastidata.

latin_iast: yārā aviśvāsa kareche tādera pārthiva jīvana suśobhita karā haẏeche evaṃ tārā viśvāsa sthāpanakārīderake upahāsa kare thāke, evaṃ yārā dharmabhīru tāderake utthāna dine samunnata karā have; evaṃ āllāha yāke icchā karena aparimita jīvikā dāna kare thākena.
latin_ascii: yara avisvasa kareche tadera parthiva jivana susobhita kara hayeche evam tara visvasa sthapanakariderake upahasa kare thake, evam yara dharmabhiru taderake utthana dine samunnata kara have; evam allaha yake iccha karena aparimita jivika dana kare thakena.

latin_iast: mānava jāti ekai sampradāẏabhukta chila; ataḥpara āllāha susaṃvāda vāhaka o bhaẏa pradarśaka rūpe nāvīgaṇake preraṇa karalena evaṃ tini tādera sāthe satyasaha grantha avatīrṇa karalena yena (ai kitāva) tādera matabhedera viṣaẏaguli samvandhe mīmāṃsā kare deẏa, athaca yārā kitāva prāpta haẏechila, spaṣṭa nidarśanasamūha tādera nikaṭa samāgata haoẏāra para, parasparera prati hiṃsā vidveṣa vaśataḥ tārā sei kitāvake niẏe matabheda ghaṭiẏe vasalo, viśvāsa sthāpanakārīrā ye viṣaẏe bhinna mata poṣaṇa karata āllāha nija anugrahe sei viṣaẏe tāderake satya pathe paricālita karena. āllāhara yāke icchā saṭhika pathe paricālita karena.
latin_ascii: manava jati ekai sampradayabhukta chila; atahpara allaha susamvada vahaka o bhaya pradarsaka rupe naviganake prerana karalena evam tini tadera sathe satyasaha grantha avatirna karalena yena (ai kitava) tadera matabhedera visayaguli samvandhe mimamsa kare deya, athaca yara kitava prapta hayechila, spasta nidarsanasamuha tadera nikata samagata haoyara para, parasparera prati himsa vidvesa vasatah tara sei kitavake niye matabheda ghatiye vasalo, visvasa sthapanakarira ye visaye bhinna mata posana karata allaha nija anugrahe sei visaye taderake satya pathe paricalita karena. allahara yake iccha sathika pathe paricalita karena.

latin_iast: tomarā ki mane karecha ye, tomarāi jānnāte praveśa karave? athaca tomarā ekhanao tādera avasthā prāpta haoni yārā tomādera pūrve vigata haẏeche; tāderake vipada o duḥkha sparśa karechila evaṃ tāderake prakampita karā haẏechila; emana ki rāsūla o tatsaha viśvāsa sthāpanakārīgaṇa valechilaḥ kakhana āllāhara sāhāyya āsave? satarka hao, niścaẏai āllāhara sāhāyya nikaṭavartī.
latin_ascii: tomara ki mane karecha ye, tomarai jannate pravesa karavey athaca tomara ekhanao tadera avastha prapta haoni yara tomadera purve vigata hayeche; taderake vipada o duhkha sparsa karechila evam taderake prakampita kara hayechila; emana ki rasula o tatsaha visvasa sthapanakarigana valechilah kakhana allahara sahayya asavey satarka hao, niscayai allahara sahayya nikatavarti.

latin_iast: tārā tomāke jijñesa karache, tārā kirūpe vyaẏa karave? tumi valaḥ tomarā dhana sampatti hate yā vyaẏa karave tā mātā-pitāra, ātmīẏa-svajanera, pitṛhīnadera, daridradera o pathikavṛndera janya kara; evaṃ tomarā ye sava satkāja kara niścaẏai āllāha tā samyaka rūpe avagata.
latin_ascii: tara tomake jijnesa karache, tara kirupe vyaya karavey tumi valah tomara dhana sampatti hate ya vyaya karave ta mata-pitara, atmiya-svajanera, pitrhinadera, daridradera o pathikavrndera janya kara; evam tomara ye sava satkaja kara niscayai allaha ta samyaka rupe avagata.

latin_iast: jihādake tomādera janya aparihārya kartavya rūpe avadhārita karā haẏeche evaṃ eṭi tomādera nikaṭa aprītikara; vasttataḥ tomarā emana viṣaẏake apachanda karacha yā tomādera pakṣe vāstavikai maṅgalajanaka, pakṣāntare tomarā emana viṣaẏake pachanda karacha yā tomādera janya vāstavikai aniṣṭakara evaṃ āllāhai (tomādera bhāla-manda) avagata āchena evaṃ tomarā avagata nao.
latin_ascii: jihadake tomadera janya apariharya kartavya rupe avadharita kara hayeche evam eti tomadera nikata apritikara; vasttatah tomara emana visayake apachanda karacha ya tomadera pakse vastavikai mangalajanaka, paksantare tomara emana visayake pachanda karacha ya tomadera janya vastavikai anistakara evam allahai (tomadera bhala-manda) avagata achena evam tomara avagata nao.

latin_iast: tārā tomāke niṣiddha māse yuddha karā samvandhe jijñesa karache. tumi valaḥ ora madhye yuddha karā atīva anyāẏa. āra āllāhara pathe pratirodha karā evaṃ tā~ke aviśvāsa karā o pavitra māsajida hate tāra adhivāsīderake vahiskāra karā āllāhara nikaṭa tadapekṣā gurutara aparādha; evaṃ aśānti sṛṣṭi hatyā apekṣā gurutara evaṃ yadi tārā sakṣama haẏa tāhale tārā tomāderake tomādera dharma hate phirāte nā pārā paryanta nivṛtta havenā; āra tomādera madhyakāra keha yadi svadharma hate phire yāẏa evaṃ ai kāphira avasthāẏai tāra mṛtyu ghaṭe tāhale tāra ihakāla o parakāla saṃkrānta samasta sādhanāi vyartha haẏe yāve; tārāi agnira adhivāsī evaṃ tārai madhye tārā cirakāla avasthāna karave.
latin_ascii: tara tomake nisiddha mase yuddha kara samvandhe jijnesa karache. tumi valah ora madhye yuddha kara ativa anyaya. ara allahara pathe pratirodha kara evam ta~ke avisvasa kara o pavitra masajida hate tara adhivasiderake vahiskara kara allahara nikata tadapeksa gurutara aparadha; evam asanti srsti hatya apeksa gurutara evam yadi tara saksama haya tahale tara tomaderake tomadera dharma hate phirate na para paryanta nivrtta havena; ara tomadera madhyakara keha yadi svadharma hate phire yaya evam ai kaphira avasthayai tara mrtyu ghate tahale tara ihakala o parakala samkranta samasta sadhanai vyartha haye yave; tarai agnira adhivasi evam tarai madhye tara cirakala avasthana karave.

latin_iast: niścaẏai yārā viśvāsa sthāpana kareche evaṃ āllāhara pathe deśa tyāga kareche o dharma-yuddha kareche, tārāi āllāhara anugraha pratyāśī evaṃ āllāha kṣamāśīla, karuṇāmaẏa.
latin_ascii: niscayai yara visvasa sthapana kareche evam allahara pathe desa tyaga kareche o dharma-yuddha kareche, tarai allahara anugraha pratyasi evam allaha ksamasila, karunamaya.

latin_iast: mādaka dravya o juẏā khelā samvandhe tārā tomāke jijñesa karache. tumi valaḥ e du’ṭora madhye gurutara pāpa raẏeche evaṃ kona kona lokera (kichu) upakāra āche, kintu o du’ṭora lābha apekṣā pāpai gurutara; tārā tomāke (ārao) jijñesa karache, tārā ki (parimāna) vyaẏa karave? tumi valaḥ yā tomādera uddhṛtta; ebhāve āllāha tomādera janya nidarśanāvalī vyakta karena yena tomarā cintā-bhāvanā kara.
latin_ascii: madaka dravya o juya khela samvandhe tara tomake jijnesa karache. tumi valah e du’tora madhye gurutara papa rayeche evam kona kona lokera (kichu) upakara ache, kintu o du’tora labha apeksa papai gurutara; tara tomake (arao) jijnesa karache, tara ki (parimana) vyaya karavey tumi valah ya tomadera uddhrtta; ebhave allaha tomadera janya nidarsanavali vyakta karena yena tomara cinta-bhavana kara.

latin_iast: pārthiva o pāralaukika viṣaẏe. tārā tomāke iẏātīmadera samvandhe jijñesa karache; tumi valaḥ tādera hita sādhana karāi uttama; evaṃ yadi tomarā tāderake sammilita kare nāo tāhale tārā tomādera bhāi; āra ke aniṣṭakārī, ke hitākāṃkhī āllāha tā avagata āchena evaṃ yadi āllāha icchā karatena tāhale tini tomāderake vipade phelatena, niścaẏai āllāha parākrānta, vijñānamaẏa.
latin_ascii: parthiva o paralaukika visaye. tara tomake iyatimadera samvandhe jijnesa karache; tumi valah tadera hita sadhana karai uttama; evam yadi tomara taderake sammilita kare nao tahale tara tomadera bhai; ara ke anistakari, ke hitakamkhi allaha ta avagata achena evam yadi allaha iccha karatena tahale tini tomaderake vipade phelatena, niscayai allaha parakranta, vijnanamaya.

latin_iast: evaṃ muśarika nārīke īmāna nā ānā paryanta tomarā viẏe karanā evaṃ niścaẏai mu’mina kṛtadāsī muśarika mahilā apekṣā uttama yadio se tomāderake mohita kare; evaṃ aṃśīvādīrā viśvāsa sthāpana nā karā paryanta tādera sāthe (musalima nārīdera) viẏe dionā evaṃ niścaẏai aṃśīvādī tomādera manaḥputa haleo viśvāsī dāsa tadapekṣā śreẏatara; erāi jāhānnāmera dike āhavāna kare evaṃ āllāha svīẏa icchāẏa jānnāta o kṣamāra dike āhavāna karena o mānavamanḍalīra janya svīẏa nidarśanāvalī vivṛta karena yena tārā śikṣā grahaṇa kare.
latin_ascii: evam musarika narike imana na ana paryanta tomara viye karana evam niscayai mu’mina krtadasi musarika mahila apeksa uttama yadio se tomaderake mohita kare; evam amsivadira visvasa sthapana na kara paryanta tadera sathe (musalima naridera) viye diona evam niscayai amsivadi tomadera manahputa haleo visvasi dasa tadapeksa sreyatara; erai jahannamera dike ahavana kare evam allaha sviya icchaya jannata o ksamara dike ahavana karena o manavamandalira janya sviya nidarsanavali vivrta karena yena tara siksa grahana kare.

latin_iast: evaṃ tārā tomāke (strīlokadera) ṛtu samvandhe jijñesa karache; tumi valaḥ oṭā hacche aśuci. ataeva ṛtukāle strīlokaderake antarāla kara evaṃ uttama rūpe śuddha nā haoẏā paryanta tādera nikaṭe yeonā; ataḥpara yakhana tārā pavitra have takhana āllāhara nirdeśa mata tomarā tādera nikaṭa gamana kara, niścaẏai āllāha tāovāhakārīderake bhālavāsena evaṃ yārā pavitra thāke tāderakeo bhālavāsena.
latin_ascii: evam tara tomake (strilokadera) rtu samvandhe jijnesa karache; tumi valah ota hacche asuci. ataeva rtukale strilokaderake antarala kara evam uttama rupe suddha na haoya paryanta tadera nikate yeona; atahpara yakhana tara pavitra have takhana allahara nirdesa mata tomara tadera nikata gamana kara, niscayai allaha taovahakariderake bhalavasena evam yara pavitra thake taderakeo bhalavasena.

latin_iast: tomādera strīgaṇa tomādera janya kṣetra svarūpa; ataeva tomarā yakhana yebhāve icchā svīẏa jīvanera janya vyavahāra kara evaṃ nijedera āgāmī dinera janya vyavasthā kara evaṃ āllāhake bhaẏa kara o jene rekha, ekadina āllāhara sāthe sākṣāta have. āra viśvāsīderake susaṃvāda jāniẏe dāo.
latin_ascii: tomadera strigana tomadera janya ksetra svarupa; ataeva tomara yakhana yebhave iccha sviya jivanera janya vyavahara kara evam nijedera agami dinera janya vyavastha kara evam allahake bhaya kara o jene rekha, ekadina allahara sathe saksata have. ara visvasiderake susamvada janiye dao.

latin_iast: evaṃ mānavamanḍalīra madhye hita sādhana, paraheyagārī o mīmāṃsā kare deẏāra kṣetre tomarā svīẏa śapathasamūhera janya āllāhara nāmake lakṣyavastu vānio nā. vastutaḥ āllāha sarvaśrotā, sarvajñātā.
latin_ascii: evam manavamandalira madhye hita sadhana, paraheyagari o mimamsa kare deyara ksetre tomara sviya sapathasamuhera janya allahara namake laksyavastu vanio na. vastutah allaha sarvasrota, sarvajnata.

latin_iast: tomādera nirarthaka śapathasamūhera janya tomāderake āllāha pākar̤āo karavenanā, kintu tini tomāderake ai sava śapatha samvandhe dharavena yeguli tomādera manera saṃkalpa anusāre sādhita haẏeche; evaṃ āllāha kṣamāśīla, dhairyaśīla.
latin_ascii: tomadera nirarthaka sapathasamuhera janya tomaderake allaha pakarao karavenana, kintu tini tomaderake ai sava sapatha samvandhe dharavena yeguli tomadera manera samkalpa anusare sadhita hayeche; evam allaha ksamasila, dhairyasila.

latin_iast: yārā svīẏa strīgaṇa hate pṛthaka thākāra śapatha kare tārā cāra māsa pratīkṣā karave, ataḥpara yadi tārā pratyāvartita haẏa tāhale niścaẏai āllāha kṣamāśīla, karuṇāmaẏa.
latin_ascii: yara sviya strigana hate prthaka thakara sapatha kare tara cara masa pratiksa karave, atahpara yadi tara pratyavartita haya tahale niscayai allaha ksamasila, karunamaya.

latin_iast: pakṣāntare yadi tārā tālāka ditei dṛr̤ha pratijña haẏa tāhale niścaẏai āllāha śravaṇakārī, mahājñānī.
latin_ascii: paksantare yadi tara talaka ditei drrha pratijna haya tahale niscayai allaha sravanakari, mahajnani.

latin_iast: evaṃ tālāka prāptāgaṇa tina ṛtu paryanta apekṣā karave; evaṃ yadi tārā āllāha o parakāle viśvāsa kare tāhale āllāha tādera garbhe yā sṛṣṭi karechena tā gopana karā tādera pakṣe vaidha havenā; evaṃ era madhye yadi tārā sandhi kāmanā kare tāhale tādera svāmīi tāderake pratigrahaṇa karate samadhika svatvavāna; āra nārīdera upara tādera svāmīdera yerūpa svatva āche, strīderao tādera puruṣadera (svāmīra) upara tadanurūpa nyāẏasaṅgata adhikāra āche; evaṃ tādera upara puruṣadera śreṣṭhatva raẏeche; āllāha hacchena mahā parākrānta, vijñānamaẏa.
latin_ascii: evam talaka praptagana tina rtu paryanta apeksa karave; evam yadi tara allaha o parakale visvasa kare tahale allaha tadera garbhe ya srsti karechena ta gopana kara tadera pakse vaidha havena; evam era madhye yadi tara sandhi kamana kare tahale tadera svamii taderake pratigrahana karate samadhika svatvavana; ara naridera upara tadera svamidera yerupa svatva ache, striderao tadera purusadera (svamira) upara tadanurupa nyayasangata adhikara ache; evam tadera upara purusadera sresthatva rayeche; allaha hacchena maha parakranta, vijnanamaya.

latin_iast: tālāka duivāra; ataḥpara (strīke) haẏa vihitabhāve rākhate have athavā sadbhāve parityāga karate have; āra nijedera deẏa sampada theke kichu phiriẏe neẏā tomādera janya jāẏeya naẏa strīdera kācha theke, yadi ubhaẏe āśaṃkā kare ye, tārā āllāhara sīmā sthira rākhate pāravenā. anantara tomarā yadi āśaṃkā kara ye, āllāhara nirdeśa ṭhika rākhate pāravenā, sei avasthāẏa strī nijera mukti lābhera janya kichu vinimaẏa dile tāte ubhaẏera kona doṣa nei; eguli hacche āllāhara sīmāsamūha. ataeva tā atikrama karanā evaṃ yārā āllāhara sīmā atikrama kare vastutaḥ tārāi atyācārī.
latin_ascii: talaka duivara; atahpara (strike) haya vihitabhave rakhate have athava sadbhave parityaga karate have; ara nijedera deya sampada theke kichu phiriye neya tomadera janya jayeya naya stridera kacha theke, yadi ubhaye asamka kare ye, tara allahara sima sthira rakhate paravena. anantara tomara yadi asamka kara ye, allahara nirdesa thika rakhate paravena, sei avasthaya stri nijera mukti labhera janya kichu vinimaya dile tate ubhayera kona dosa nei; eguli hacche allahara simasamuha. ataeva ta atikrama karana evam yara allahara sima atikrama kare vastutah tarai atyacari.

latin_iast: ataḥpara yadi se tālāka pradāna kare tāhale erapare anya svāmīra sāthe vivāhitā nā haoẏā paryanta se tāra janya vaidha havenā, ataḥpara se tāke tālāka pradāna karale yadi ubhaẏe paraspara pratyāvartita haẏa tāte ubhaẏera pakṣe konai doṣa nei, yadi āllāhara sīmārekhā vajāẏa rākhāra icchā thāke. evaṃ egulii āllāhara sīmāsamūha, tini jñānī sampradāẏera janya eguli vyakta kare thākena.
latin_ascii: atahpara yadi se talaka pradana kare tahale erapare anya svamira sathe vivahita na haoya paryanta se tara janya vaidha havena, atahpara se take talaka pradana karale yadi ubhaye paraspara pratyavartita haya tate ubhayera pakse konai dosa nei, yadi allahara simarekha vajaya rakhara iccha thake. evam egulii allahara simasamuha, tini jnani sampradayera janya eguli vyakta kare thakena.

latin_iast: evaṃ tomarā yakhana strīderake tālāka dāo, āra tārā tādera nirdhārita samaẏe pau~che yāẏa, takhana tāderake niẏamitabhāve rākhate pāra athavā niẏamitabhāve parityāga karate pāra; evaṃ tāderake yantraṇā deẏāra janya āvaddha kare rekhanā, tāhale sīmā laṃghana karave; āra ye vyakti erūpa kare se niścaẏai nijera prati avicāra kare thāke. evaṃ āllāhara nidarśanāvalīke vidrupācchale grahaṇa karanā, tomādera prati āllāhara anugraha evaṃ tomāderake upadeśa dānera janya grantha o vijñāna hate yā avatīrṇa karechena tā smaraṇa kara, āra āllāhake bhaẏa kara evaṃ jene rekha ye, āllāha sarva viṣaẏe mahājñānī.
latin_ascii: evam tomara yakhana striderake talaka dao, ara tara tadera nirdharita samaye pau~che yaya, takhana taderake niyamitabhave rakhate para athava niyamitabhave parityaga karate para; evam taderake yantrana deyara janya avaddha kare rekhana, tahale sima lamghana karave; ara ye vyakti erupa kare se niscayai nijera prati avicara kare thake. evam allahara nidarsanavalike vidrupacchale grahana karana, tomadera prati allahara anugraha evam tomaderake upadesa danera janya grantha o vijnana hate ya avatirna karechena ta smarana kara, ara allahake bhaya kara evam jene rekha ye, allaha sarva visaye mahajnani.

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana tomarā strīlokaderake tālāka dāo, ataḥpara tārā tādera nirdhārita samaẏe pauche yāẏa, takhana tārā ubhaẏei yadi parasparera prati vihitabhāve sammata haẏe thāke, sei avasthāẏa strīrā nija svāmīderake viẏe karate gele tomarā tāderake vā~dhā pradāna karanā; tomādera madhye ye āllāha o ākhirātera prati viśvāsa sthāpana kareche era dvārā tāderakei upadeśa deẏā hacche; tomādera janya eṭi śuddhatama o pavitratama (vyavasthā) evaṃ āllāha avagata āchena o tomarā avagata nao.
latin_ascii: evam yakhana tomara strilokaderake talaka dao, atahpara tara tadera nirdharita samaye pauche yaya, takhana tara ubhayei yadi parasparera prati vihitabhave sammata haye thake, sei avasthaya strira nija svamiderake viye karate gele tomara taderake va~dha pradana karana; tomadera madhye ye allaha o akhiratera prati visvasa sthapana kareche era dvara taderakei upadesa deya hacche; tomadera janya eti suddhatama o pavitratama (vyavastha) evam allaha avagata achena o tomara avagata nao.

latin_iast: evaṃ yadi keha stanya pānera kāla pūrṇa karate icchā kare tāra janya jananīgaṇa pūrṇa dui vachara svīẏa santānaderake stanya dāna karave; āra santānera janakagaṇa vihitabhāve prasūtidera khorāka o tādera pośāka dite vādhya; kehakeo tāra sādhyera atīta kaṣṭa deẏā yāvenā, nija santānera kāraṇe jananīke kṣatigrasta karā calavenā, evaṃ pitāra janyao ekai vidhāna, kintu yadi tārā paraspara parāmarśa o sammati anusāre stanya tyāga karāte icchā kare tāte ubhaẏera kona doṣa nei; āra tomarā yadi nija santānaderake stanya pānera janya samarpaṇa kare vihitabhāve kichu pradāna kara tāhaleo tomādera kona doṣa nei; evaṃ āllāhake bhaẏa kara o jene rekha ye, tomarā yā karacha āllāha tā pratyakṣakārī.
latin_ascii: evam yadi keha stanya panera kala purna karate iccha kare tara janya jananigana purna dui vachara sviya santanaderake stanya dana karave; ara santanera janakagana vihitabhave prasutidera khoraka o tadera posaka dite vadhya; kehakeo tara sadhyera atita kasta deya yavena, nija santanera karane jananike ksatigrasta kara calavena, evam pitara janyao ekai vidhana, kintu yadi tara paraspara paramarsa o sammati anusare stanya tyaga karate iccha kare tate ubhayera kona dosa nei; ara tomara yadi nija santanaderake stanya panera janya samarpana kare vihitabhave kichu pradana kara tahaleo tomadera kona dosa nei; evam allahake bhaya kara o jene rekha ye, tomara ya karacha allaha ta pratyaksakari.

latin_iast: evaṃ tomādera madhye yārā strīderake rekhe mṛtyumukhe patita haẏa, tārā (vidhavāgaṇa) cāra māsa o daśa dina pratīkṣā karave; ataḥpara yakhana tārā svīẏa nirdhārita samaẏe upanīta haẏa takhana tārā nijedera samvandhe vihitabhāve yā karave tāte tomādera kona doṣa nei; evaṃ tomarā yā karacho tadviṣaẏe āllāha samyaka khavara rākhena.
latin_ascii: evam tomadera madhye yara striderake rekhe mrtyumukhe patita haya, tara (vidhavagana) cara masa o dasa dina pratiksa karave; atahpara yakhana tara sviya nirdharita samaye upanita haya takhana tara nijedera samvandhe vihitabhave ya karave tate tomadera kona dosa nei; evam tomara ya karacho tadvisaye allaha samyaka khavara rakhena.

latin_iast: evaṃ tomarā strīlokadera prastāva samvandhe parokṣabhāve yā vyakta kara athavā nijedera mane gopane yā poṣaṇa kara tāte tomādera kona doṣa nei; āllāha avagata āchena ye, tomarā tādera viṣaẏa ālocanā karave, kintu gopanabhāve tāderake pratiśruti dāna karanā, varaṃ vihitabhāve tādera sāthe kathā vala; evaṃ nirdhārita samaẏa pūrṇa nā haoẏā paryanta vivāha vandhane āvaddha haoẏāra saṃkalpa karanā; evaṃ eṭio jene rekha ye, tomādera antare yā āche āllāha tā avagata. ataeva tomarā tā~ke bhaẏa kara evaṃ jene rekha ye, āllāha kṣamāśīla, sahiṣṇu.
latin_ascii: evam tomara strilokadera prastava samvandhe paroksabhave ya vyakta kara athava nijedera mane gopane ya posana kara tate tomadera kona dosa nei; allaha avagata achena ye, tomara tadera visaya alocana karave, kintu gopanabhave taderake pratisruti dana karana, varam vihitabhave tadera sathe katha vala; evam nirdharita samaya purna na haoya paryanta vivaha vandhane avaddha haoyara samkalpa karana; evam etio jene rekha ye, tomadera antare ya ache allaha ta avagata. ataeva tomara ta~ke bhaya kara evam jene rekha ye, allaha ksamasila, sahisnu.

latin_iast: yadi tomarā strīderake sparśa nā kare athavā tādera prāpya nirdhāraṇa karāra pūrve tālāka pradāna kara tāhale tāte tomādera kona doṣa nei, evaṃ tomarā tāderake kichu saṃsthāna kare dive, avasthāpanna loka nijera avasthānusāre evaṃ abhāvagrasta loka tāra sādhyānusāre vihita saṃsthāna (kare dive); sat karmaśīla lokadera upara ihāi kartavya.
latin_ascii: yadi tomara striderake sparsa na kare athava tadera prapya nirdharana karara purve talaka pradana kara tahale tate tomadera kona dosa nei, evam tomara taderake kichu samsthana kare dive, avasthapanna loka nijera avasthanusare evam abhavagrasta loka tara sadhyanusare vihita samsthana (kare dive); sat karmasila lokadera upara ihai kartavya.

latin_iast: āra tomarā yadi tāderake sparśa karāra pūrvei tālāka pradāna kara evaṃ tādera mohara nirdhāraṇa kare thāka tāhale yā nirdhāraṇa karechile tāra ardheka diẏe dāo; kintu yadi tārā kṣamā kare kiṃvā yāra hāte vivāha vandhana se kṣamā kare tāhale tā svatantra kathā; athavā tomarā puruṣarā yadi kṣamā kara tāhale eṭā parahejagārīra ati nikaṭavartī; evaṃ parasparera upakārake yena bhule yeonā; tomarā yā kara niścaẏai āllāha tā pratyakṣakārī.
latin_ascii: ara tomara yadi taderake sparsa karara purvei talaka pradana kara evam tadera mohara nirdharana kare thaka tahale ya nirdharana karechile tara ardheka diye dao; kintu yadi tara ksama kare kimva yara hate vivaha vandhana se ksama kare tahale ta svatantra katha; athava tomara purusara yadi ksama kara tahale eta parahejagarira ati nikatavarti; evam parasparera upakarake yena bhule yeona; tomara ya kara niscayai allaha ta pratyaksakari.

latin_iast: tomarā sālātera prati yatnavāna have viśeṣataḥ madhyavartī sālātera evaṃ āllāhara uddeśe tomarā vinītabhāve danḍāẏamāna hao.
latin_ascii: tomara salatera prati yatnavana have visesatah madhyavarti salatera evam allahara uddese tomara vinitabhave dandayamana hao.

latin_iast: tave tomarā yadi āśaṃkā kara, sei avasthāẏa padavraje vā yānavāhanera upara sālāta samāpana kare nive, pare yakhana nirāpada hao takhana tomāderake yebhāve śikhiẏe deẏā haẏeche seibhāve āllāhara praśaṃsā kara yā tomarā itopūrve jānatenā.
latin_ascii: tave tomara yadi asamka kara, sei avasthaya padavraje va yanavahanera upara salata samapana kare nive, pare yakhana nirapada hao takhana tomaderake yebhave sikhiye deya hayeche seibhave allahara prasamsa kara ya tomara itopurve janatena.

latin_iast: evaṃ tomādera madhye yārā mṛtyumukhe patita haẏa o strīgaṇake cher̤e yāẏa tārā yena svīẏa strīgaṇake vahiskṛta nā kare eka vachara paryanta tāderake bharaṇa-poṣaṇa pradāna karāra janya asīẏāta kare yāẏa, kintu yadi tārā (svecchāẏa) vera haẏe yāẏa tāhale nijedera samvandhe vihitabhāve tārā ye vyavasthā kare tajjanya tomādera kona doṣa nei, evaṃ āllāha mahāparākrānta, vijñānamaẏa.
latin_ascii: evam tomadera madhye yara mrtyumukhe patita haya o striganake chere yaya tara yena sviya striganake vahiskrta na kare eka vachara paryanta taderake bharana-posana pradana karara janya asiyata kare yaya, kintu yadi tara (svecchaya) vera haye yaya tahale nijedera samvandhe vihitabhave tara ye vyavastha kare tajjanya tomadera kona dosa nei, evam allaha mahaparakranta, vijnanamaya.

latin_iast: āra tālāka prāptadera janya vihitabhāve bharaṇa poṣaṇera vyavasthā karā dharmabhīrugaṇera kartavya.
latin_ascii: ara talaka praptadera janya vihitabhave bharana posanera vyavastha kara dharmabhiruganera kartavya.

latin_iast: ebhāve āllāha svīẏa nidarśanāvalī vivṛta karena, yena tomarā hṛdaẏaṅgama kara.
latin_ascii: ebhave allaha sviya nidarsanavali vivrta karena, yena tomara hrdayangama kara.

latin_iast: tumi ki tādera prati lakṣya karani, mṛtyura vibhīṣikāke er̤ānora janya yārā nijedera gṛha hate vahirgata haẏechila? athaca tārā chila vahu sahasra; takhana āllāha tāderake valalenaḥ tomarā mara; punarāẏa tini tāderake jīvana dāna karalena; niścaẏai mānavagaṇera prati āllāha anugrahaśīla, kintu adhikāṃśa loka kṛtajñatā svīkāra karenā.
latin_ascii: tumi ki tadera prati laksya karani, mrtyura vibhisikake eranora janya yara nijedera grha hate vahirgata hayechilay athaca tara chila vahu sahasra; takhana allaha taderake valalenah tomara mara; punaraya tini taderake jivana dana karalena; niscayai manavaganera prati allaha anugrahasila, kintu adhikamsa loka krtajnata svikara karena.

latin_iast: tomarā āllāhara pathe saṃgrāma kara evaṃ jene rekha ye, niścaẏai āllāha hacchena sarvaśrotā, sarvajñātā.
latin_ascii: tomara allahara pathe samgrama kara evam jene rekha ye, niscayai allaha hacchena sarvasrota, sarvajnata.

latin_iast: ke se, ye āllāhake uttama ṛṇadāna kare? anantara tini tāke dviguṇa, vahuguṇa vardhita karena evaṃ āllāhai (mānuṣera ārthika avasthāke) kṛccha vā svacchala kare thākena evaṃ tā~rai dike pratyāvartana karate have.
latin_ascii: ke se, ye allahake uttama rnadana karey anantara tini take dviguna, vahuguna vardhita karena evam allahai (manusera arthika avasthake) krccha va svacchala kare thakena evam ta~rai dike pratyavartana karate have.

latin_iast: tumi ki mūsāra pare isarāīla vaṃśīẏa pradhānadera prati lakṣya karani? nijedera eka nāvīke yakhana tārā valechilaḥ āmādera janya ekajana rājā niyukta kare dāo (yena) āmarā āllāhara pathe yuddha karate pāri. se valechilaḥ eṭā ki sambhavapara naẏa ye, yakhana tomādera upara yuddha vidhivaddha haẏe yāve takhana tomarā yuddha karavenā? tārā valechilaḥ āmarā yuddha karavanā eṭā kirūpe (sambhava), athaca nijedera āvāsa hate o svajanadera nikaṭa hate āmarā vahiskṛta haẏechi? anantara yakhana tādera upara yuddha vidhivaddha hala takhana tādera alpa saṃkhyaka vyatīta savāi paścātpada haẏe par̤ala evaṃ atyācārīderake āllāha samyaka rūpe avagata āchena.
latin_ascii: tumi ki musara pare isaraila vamsiya pradhanadera prati laksya karaniy nijedera eka navike yakhana tara valechilah amadera janya ekajana raja niyukta kare dao (yena) amara allahara pathe yuddha karate pari. se valechilah eta ki sambhavapara naya ye, yakhana tomadera upara yuddha vidhivaddha haye yave takhana tomara yuddha karavenay tara valechilah amara yuddha karavana eta kirupe (sambhava), athaca nijedera avasa hate o svajanadera nikata hate amara vahiskrta hayechiy anantara yakhana tadera upara yuddha vidhivaddha hala takhana tadera alpa samkhyaka vyatita savai pascatpada haye parala evam atyacariderake allaha samyaka rupe avagata achena.

latin_iast: evaṃ tādera nāvī tāderake valechilaḥ niścaẏai āllāha tālūtake tomādera janya rājā rūpe nirvācita karechena; tārā valalaḥ āmādera upara tālūtera rājatva ki rūpe (saṅgata) hate pāre? rājatve tāra apekṣā āmāderai svatva adhika, pakṣāntare yatheṣṭa ārthika svacchalatāo tāra nei; tini valalenaḥ niścaẏai āllāha tomādera janya tākei manonīta karechena evaṃ tāke pracura jñāna o daihika śakti dāna karechena, āllāha tā~ra rājatva yāke icchā pradāna karena evaṃ āllāha hacchena dānaśīla, sarvajñātā.
latin_ascii: evam tadera navi taderake valechilah niscayai allaha talutake tomadera janya raja rupe nirvacita karechena; tara valalah amadera upara talutera rajatva ki rupe (sangata) hate parey rajatve tara apeksa amaderai svatva adhika, paksantare yathesta arthika svacchalatao tara nei; tini valalenah niscayai allaha tomadera janya takei manonita karechena evam take pracura jnana o daihika sakti dana karechena, allaha ta~ra rajatva yake iccha pradana karena evam allaha hacchena danasila, sarvajnata.

latin_iast: evaṃ tādera nāvī tādera valechilaḥ tāra rājatvera nidarśana ei ye, tomādera nikaṭa sinduka samāgata have, yāte thākave tomādera ravera nikaṭa hate śānti evaṃ mūsā o hārunera parivārera (parityakta) kichu sāmagrī, mālāikā/phereśatā oṭā vahana kare ānave, tomarā yadi viśvāsa sthāpanakārī hao tāhale ora madhye niścaẏai tomādera janya nidarśana raẏeche.
latin_ascii: evam tadera navi tadera valechilah tara rajatvera nidarsana ei ye, tomadera nikata sinduka samagata have, yate thakave tomadera ravera nikata hate santi evam musa o harunera parivarera (parityakta) kichu samagri, malaika/pheresata ota vahana kare anave, tomara yadi visvasa sthapanakari hao tahale ora madhye niscayai tomadera janya nidarsana rayeche.

latin_iast: anantara yakhana tālūta sainyadalasaha vahirgata haẏechila takhana se valechila, niścaẏai āllāha ekaṭi nadī dvārā tomāderake parīkṣā karavena, oṭā hate ye pāna karave se āmāra dalabhukta naẏa evaṃ ye svīẏa hasta dvārā añjali pūrṇa kare nive evaṃ tadvyatīta se āra āsvādana karavenā se niścaẏai āmāra loka; kintu tādera madhye alpa saṃkhyaka vyatīta anya savāi sei nadīra pāni pāna karala, ataḥpara yakhana se o tāra saṅgī viśvāsa sthāpanakārīgaṇa nadī atikrama kare gela takhana tārā valalaḥ jāluta o tāra senāvāhinīra mukāvilā karāra śakti āja āmādera nei; pakṣāntare yārā viśvāsa karata ye, tāderake āllāhara sāthe sākṣāt karate have tārā valalaḥ āllāhara hukume kata kṣudra dala kata vṛhat dalake parājita kareche; vastutaḥ dhairyaśīladera saṅgī hacchena āllāha!
latin_ascii: anantara yakhana taluta sainyadalasaha vahirgata hayechila takhana se valechila, niscayai allaha ekati nadi dvara tomaderake pariksa karavena, ota hate ye pana karave se amara dalabhukta naya evam ye sviya hasta dvara anjali purna kare nive evam tadvyatita se ara asvadana karavena se niscayai amara loka; kintu tadera madhye alpa samkhyaka vyatita anya savai sei nadira pani pana karala, atahpara yakhana se o tara sangi visvasa sthapanakarigana nadi atikrama kare gela takhana tara valalah jaluta o tara senavahinira mukavila karara sakti aja amadera nei; paksantare yara visvasa karata ye, taderake allahara sathe saksat karate have tara valalah allahara hukume kata ksudra dala kata vrhat dalake parajita kareche; vastutah dhairyasiladera sangi hacchena allaha!

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana tārā jāluta o tāra senāvāhinīra sammukhīna hala, valate lāgalaḥ he āmādera rāvva! āmāderake pūrṇa sahiṣṇutā dāna karuna, āra āmādera caraṇaguli aṭala rākhuna evaṃ kāphira jātira upara āmāderake sāhāyya karuna!
latin_ascii: evam yakhana tara jaluta o tara senavahinira sammukhina hala, valate lagalah he amadera ravva! amaderake purna sahisnuta dana karuna, ara amadera caranaguli atala rakhuna evam kaphira jatira upara amaderake sahayya karuna!

latin_iast: takhana tārā āllāhara hukume jālutera sainyaderake parājita karala evaṃ dāūda jālutake hatyā karala. evaṃ āllāha dāudake rājya o prajñā dāna karalena evaṃ tāke icchānuyāẏī śikṣā dāna karalena; āra yadi āllāha eka dalake apara dalera dvārā pradamita nā karatena tāhale niścaẏai pṛthivī aśāntipūrṇa hata, kintu āllāha viśva jagatera prati anugrahakārī.
latin_ascii: takhana tara allahara hukume jalutera sainyaderake parajita karala evam dauda jalutake hatya karala. evam allaha daudake rajya o prajna dana karalena evam take icchanuyayi siksa dana karalena; ara yadi allaha eka dalake apara dalera dvara pradamita na karatena tahale niscayai prthivi asantipurna hata, kintu allaha visva jagatera prati anugrahakari.

latin_iast: egulo āllāhara nidarśana - tomāra nikaṭa eguli satyarūpe upasthāpana karechi evaṃ niścaẏai tumi rāsūlagaṇera antarbhukta.
latin_ascii: egulo allahara nidarsana - tomara nikata eguli satyarupe upasthapana karechi evam niscayai tumi rasulaganera antarbhukta.

latin_iast: ei sakala rāsūla, āmi yādera kārao upara kehake maryādā pradāna karechi, tādera madhye kārao sāthe āllāha kathā valechena evaṃ kehake padamaryādāẏa samunnata karechena, āra māraiẏāma nandana īsāke prakāśya nidarśanāvalī dāna karechi evaṃ tāke pavitra ātmāyoge sāhāyya karechi, āra āllāha icchā karale nāvīgaṇera paravartī lokerā, tādera nikaṭa spaṣṭa pramāṇapuñja samāgata haoẏāra para parasparera sāthe yuddha vigrahe lipta hatanā. kintu tārā paraspara matavirodha karechila; phale tādera kataka hala mu’mina, āra kataka hala kāphira. vasttataḥ āllāha icchā karale tārā paraspara yuddha vigrahe lipta hatanā, kintu āllāha yā icchā karena tā’i sampanna kare thākena.
latin_ascii: ei sakala rasula, ami yadera karao upara kehake maryada pradana karechi, tadera madhye karao sathe allaha katha valechena evam kehake padamaryadaya samunnata karechena, ara maraiyama nandana isake prakasya nidarsanavali dana karechi evam take pavitra atmayoge sahayya karechi, ara allaha iccha karale naviganera paravarti lokera, tadera nikata spasta pramanapunja samagata haoyara para parasparera sathe yuddha vigrahe lipta hatana. kintu tara paraspara matavirodha karechila; phale tadera kataka hala mu’mina, ara kataka hala kaphira. vasttatah allaha iccha karale tara paraspara yuddha vigrahe lipta hatana, kintu allaha ya iccha karena ta’i sampanna kare thakena.

latin_iast: he viśvāsīgaṇa! āmi tomāderake ye jīvanopakaraṇa dāna karechi tā hate sedina samāgata haoẏāra pūrve vyaẏa kara yedina kraẏa-vikraẏa, vandhutva o supāriśa nei, āra aviśvāsīrāi atyācārī.
latin_ascii: he visvasigana! ami tomaderake ye jivanopakarana dana karechi ta hate sedina samagata haoyara purve vyaya kara yedina kraya-vikraya, vandhutva o suparisa nei, ara avisvasirai atyacari.

latin_iast: āllāha, tini chār̤ā kona (satya) ilāha nei, tini cirañjīva, supratiṣṭhita dhāraka. tā~ke tandrā o nidrā sparśa kare nā. tā~ra janyai āsamānasamūhe yā raẏeche tā evaṃ yamīne yā āche tā. ke se, ye tā~ra nikaṭa supāriśa karave tā~ra anumati chār̤ā? tini jānena yā āche tādera sāmane evaṃ yā āche tādera pechane. āra tārā tā~ra jñānera sāmānya parimāṇao āẏatva karate pāre nā, tave tini yā cāna tā chār̤ā. tā~ra kurasī āsamānasamūha o yamīna parivyāpta kare āche evaṃ e du’ṭora saṃrakṣaṇa tā~ra janya vojhā haẏa nā. āra tini suucca, mahāna. (āẏātula kurasī)
latin_ascii: allaha, tini chara kona (satya) ilaha nei, tini ciranjiva, supratisthita dharaka. ta~ke tandra o nidra sparsa kare na. ta~ra janyai asamanasamuhe ya rayeche ta evam yamine ya ache ta. ke se, ye ta~ra nikata suparisa karave ta~ra anumati charay tini janena ya ache tadera samane evam ya ache tadera pechane. ara tara ta~ra jnanera samanya parimanao ayatva karate pare na, tave tini ya cana ta chara. ta~ra kurasi asamanasamuha o yamina parivyapta kare ache evam e du’tora samraksana ta~ra janya vojha haya na. ara tini suucca, mahana. (ayatula kurasi)

latin_iast: dīnera vyāpāre kona javaradasti kiṃvā vādhyavādhakatā nei. niścaẏai bhrānti hate supatha prakāśita haẏeche. ataeva ye tāgutake aviśvāsa kare evaṃ āllāhara prati viśvāsa sthāpana kare se dṛr̤hatara rajjuke ā~kar̤e dharalo yā kakhanao chinna havāra naẏa evaṃ āllāha śravaṇakārī, mahājñānī.
latin_ascii: dinera vyapare kona javaradasti kimva vadhyavadhakata nei. niscayai bhranti hate supatha prakasita hayeche. ataeva ye tagutake avisvasa kare evam allahara prati visvasa sthapana kare se drrhatara rajjuke a~kare dharalo ya kakhanao chinna havara naya evam allaha sravanakari, mahajnani.

latin_iast: āllāhai hacchena mu’minadera abhibhāvaka. tini tāderake andhakāra hate ālora dike niẏe yāna; āra yārā aviśvāsa kareche tāguta tādera pṛṣṭhapoṣaka, se tāderake ālo hate andhakārera dike niẏe yāẏa, tārāi jāhānnāmera adhivāsī, okhāne tārā cirakāla avasthāna karave.
latin_ascii: allahai hacchena mu’minadera abhibhavaka. tini taderake andhakara hate alora dike niye yana; ara yara avisvasa kareche taguta tadera prsthaposaka, se taderake alo hate andhakarera dike niye yaya, tarai jahannamera adhivasi, okhane tara cirakala avasthana karave.

latin_iast: tumi ki tāra prati lakṣya karani ye ivarāhīmera sāthe tāra rāvva samvandhe vitarka karechila, yehetu āllāha tāke rājatva pradāna karechilena. ivarāhīma valechilaḥ āmāra rāvva tinii yini jīvita karena o mṛtyu dāna karena. se valechilaḥ āmii jīvana o mṛtyu dāna kari. ivarāhīma valechilaḥ niścaẏai āllāha sūryake pūrva dika hate ānaẏana karena, kintu tumi oke paścima dika hate ānaẏana kara; ete sei aviśvāsakārī hatavuddhi haẏechila; evaṃ āllāha atyācārī sampradāẏake patha pradarśana karenanā.
latin_ascii: tumi ki tara prati laksya karani ye ivarahimera sathe tara ravva samvandhe vitarka karechila, yehetu allaha take rajatva pradana karechilena. ivarahima valechilah amara ravva tinii yini jivita karena o mrtyu dana karena. se valechilah amii jivana o mrtyu dana kari. ivarahima valechilah niscayai allaha suryake purva dika hate anayana karena, kintu tumi oke pascima dika hate anayana kara; ete sei avisvasakari hatavuddhi hayechila; evam allaha atyacari sampradayake patha pradarsana karenana.

latin_iast: athavā ai vyaktira anurūpa ye kona eka janapada atikrama karachila evaṃ tā chila śūṇya - nija bhittira upara patita. se valalaḥ ei nagarera mṛtyura para āllāha āvāra tāke jīvana dāna karavena kirūpe? anantara āllāha tāke ekaśa vacharera janya mṛtyu dāna karalena, ataḥpara tāke punarjīvita karalena evaṃ valalenaḥ e avasthāẏa tumi katakṣaṇa ativāhita karecha? se valalaḥ ekadina athavā ekadinera kiẏadaṃśa. tini valalenaḥ tā naẏa, varaṃ tumito ebhāve ekaśa vachara chile. tomāra khādya o pānīẏera prati lakṣya kara - oṭā vikṛta haẏani evaṃ tomāra gardabhera prati dṛṣṭipāta kara; evaṃ yehetu āmi tomāke mānavera janya nidarśana vānāte cāi; ārao lakṣya kara asthipuñjera dike, oke kirūpe āmi saṃyukta kari; ataḥpara oke māṃsāvṛta kari. anantara yakhana oṭā tāra nikaṭa spaṣṭa haẏe gela takhana se valalaḥ āmi jāni, āllāha sakala viṣaẏe sarvaśaktimāna.
latin_ascii: athava ai vyaktira anurupa ye kona eka janapada atikrama karachila evam ta chila sunya - nija bhittira upara patita. se valalah ei nagarera mrtyura para allaha avara take jivana dana karavena kirupey anantara allaha take ekasa vacharera janya mrtyu dana karalena, atahpara take punarjivita karalena evam valalenah e avasthaya tumi kataksana ativahita karechay se valalah ekadina athava ekadinera kiyadamsa. tini valalenah ta naya, varam tumito ebhave ekasa vachara chile. tomara khadya o paniyera prati laksya kara - ota vikrta hayani evam tomara gardabhera prati drstipata kara; evam yehetu ami tomake manavera janya nidarsana vanate cai; arao laksya kara asthipunjera dike, oke kirupe ami samyukta kari; atahpara oke mamsavrta kari. anantara yakhana ota tara nikata spasta haye gela takhana se valalah ami jani, allaha sakala visaye sarvasaktimana.

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana ivarāhīma valechilaḥ he āmāra rāvva! āpani kirūpe mṛtake jīvita karena tā āmāke pradarśana karuna. tini valalenaḥ tāhale ki tumi viśvāsa karanā? se valalaḥ hyā~ avaśyai, kintu tāte āmāra antara paritṛpta have. tini valalenaḥ tāhale cāraṭi pākhī grahaṇa kara, tārapara oderake ṭukarā ṭukarā kare miśrita kara, anantara pratyeka pāhār̤era upara odera eka eka khanḍa rekhe dāo, ataḥpara oderake āhavāna kara, orā tomāra nikaṭa daur̤e āsave; evaṃ jene rekha ye, niścaẏai āllāha parākrānta, vijñānamaẏa.
latin_ascii: evam yakhana ivarahima valechilah he amara ravva! apani kirupe mrtake jivita karena ta amake pradarsana karuna. tini valalenah tahale ki tumi visvasa karanay se valalah hya~ avasyai, kintu tate amara antara paritrpta have. tini valalenah tahale carati pakhi grahana kara, tarapara oderake tukara tukara kare misrita kara, anantara pratyeka paharera upara odera eka eka khanda rekhe dao, atahpara oderake ahavana kara, ora tomara nikata daure asave; evam jene rekha ye, niscayai allaha parakranta, vijnanamaya.

latin_iast: yārā āllāhara pathe svīẏa dhana-sampada vyaẏa kare tādera upamā yemana ekaṭi śasyavīja, tā hate utpanna hala sātaṭi śīṣa, pratyeka śīṣe (utpanna hala) eka śata śasya, evaṃ āllāha yāra janya icchā karena vardhita kare dena; vastutaḥ āllāha hacchena ati dānaśīla, sarvajña.
latin_ascii: yara allahara pathe sviya dhana-sampada vyaya kare tadera upama yemana ekati sasyavija, ta hate utpanna hala satati sisa, pratyeka sise (utpanna hala) eka sata sasya, evam allaha yara janya iccha karena vardhita kare dena; vastutah allaha hacchena ati danasila, sarvajna.

latin_iast: yārā āllāhara pathe nijedera dhana sampada vyaẏa kare, evaṃ vyaẏa karāra para anugrahera kathā prakāśa karenā, kaṣṭao deẏanā, tādera janya tādera ravera nikaṭa raẏeche puraskāra; vastutaḥ tādera kona bhaẏa nei evaṃ tārā duścintāgrastao havenā.
latin_ascii: yara allahara pathe nijedera dhana sampada vyaya kare, evam vyaya karara para anugrahera katha prakasa karena, kastao deyana, tadera janya tadera ravera nikata rayeche puraskara; vastutah tadera kona bhaya nei evam tara duscintagrastao havena.

latin_iast: ye dānera paścāte thāke kleśa, sei dāna apekṣā uttama vākya o kṣamāi utkṛṣṭa evaṃ āllāha mahā sampadaśālī, sahiṣṇu.
latin_ascii: ye danera pascate thake klesa, sei dana apeksa uttama vakya o ksamai utkrsta evam allaha maha sampadasali, sahisnu.

latin_iast: he mu’minagaṇa! kṛpā prakāśa o kleśa dāna kare nijedera dānaguli vyartha kare phelanā sei vyaktira nyāẏa ye nijera dhana vyaẏa kare loka dekhānora janya, athaca āllāha o ākhirāte se viśvāsa karenā. phalataḥ tāra upamā, yemana eka vṛhat masṛna prastara khanḍa yāra upara kichu māṭi (jame) āche, e avasthāẏa tāte varṣita hala pravala varṣā, ataḥpara tā pariṣkāra haẏe gela. tārā yā arjana kareche tanmadhya hate kona viṣaẏei tārā suphala pāvenā evaṃ āllāha aviśvāsī sampradāẏake patha pradarśana karenanā.
latin_ascii: he mu’minagana! krpa prakasa o klesa dana kare nijedera danaguli vyartha kare phelana sei vyaktira nyaya ye nijera dhana vyaya kare loka dekhanora janya, athaca allaha o akhirate se visvasa karena. phalatah tara upama, yemana eka vrhat masrna prastara khanda yara upara kichu mati (jame) ache, e avasthaya tate varsita hala pravala varsa, atahpara ta pariskara haye gela. tara ya arjana kareche tanmadhya hate kona visayei tara suphala pavena evam allaha avisvasi sampradayake patha pradarsana karenana.

latin_iast: evaṃ yārā āllāhara santuṣṭi sādhana o svīẏa jīvanera pratiṣṭhāra janya dhana sampada vyaẏa kare tādera upamā - yemana urvara bhūbhāge avasthita ekaṭi udyāna, tāte pravala vṛṣṭidhārā patita haẏa, phale sei udyāna dviguṇa khādyaśasya dāna kare; kintu yadi tāte vṛṣṭipāta nā haẏa tāhale śiśirai yatheṣṭa evaṃ tomarā yā karacha āllāha tā pratyakṣakārī.
latin_ascii: evam yara allahara santusti sadhana o sviya jivanera pratisthara janya dhana sampada vyaya kare tadera upama - yemana urvara bhubhage avasthita ekati udyana, tate pravala vrstidhara patita haya, phale sei udyana dviguna khadyasasya dana kare; kintu yadi tate vrstipata na haya tahale sisirai yathesta evam tomara ya karacha allaha ta pratyaksakari.

latin_iast: tomādera kārao yadi emana ekaṭi khejura o āṅgura udyāna thāke yāra taladeśa diẏe nadī-nālā pravāhita, sekhāne sarva prakāra phalera saṃsthāna tāra raẏeche, āra se vārdhakye upanīta hala, athaca tāra katakaguli durvala (aprāpta vaẏaska) santāna-santati raẏeche, e avasthāẏa sei vāgāne upasthita hala agnisaha eka vātyāvarta, āra tā pur̤e (bhasmībhūta haẏe) gela; tomarā keha eṭā pachanda karave ki? e rūpe āllāha tomādera janya nidarśanāvalī vyakta karena, yena tomarā cintā-bhāvanā kara.
latin_ascii: tomadera karao yadi emana ekati khejura o angura udyana thake yara taladesa diye nadi-nala pravahita, sekhane sarva prakara phalera samsthana tara rayeche, ara se vardhakye upanita hala, athaca tara katakaguli durvala (aprapta vayaska) santana-santati rayeche, e avasthaya sei vagane upasthita hala agnisaha eka vatyavarta, ara ta pure (bhasmibhuta haye) gela; tomara keha eta pachanda karave kiy e rupe allaha tomadera janya nidarsanavali vyakta karena, yena tomara cinta-bhavana kara.

latin_iast: he mu’minagaṇa! tomarā yā upārjana karecha evaṃ āmi yā tomādera janya bhūmi hate utpanna karechi, tā hate utkṛṣṭa vastta kharaca kara evaṃ tā hate erūpa nikṛṣṭa vastta vyaẏa karate manastha karanā yā tomarā mudita cakṣu vyatīta grahaṇa karanā; evaṃ tomarā jene rekha, āllāha mahā sampadaśālī, praśaṃsita.
latin_ascii: he mu’minagana! tomara ya uparjana karecha evam ami ya tomadera janya bhumi hate utpanna karechi, ta hate utkrsta vastta kharaca kara evam ta hate erupa nikrsta vastta vyaya karate manastha karana ya tomara mudita caksu vyatita grahana karana; evam tomara jene rekha, allaha maha sampadasali, prasamsita.

latin_iast: śāitāna tomāderake abhāvera bhīti pradarśana kare evaṃ tomāderake aślīlatāra ādeśa kare evaṃ āllāha tomāderake tā~ra nikaṭa hate kṣamā o daẏāra aṃgīkāra karena. āllāha hacchena vipula dātā, sarvajña.
latin_ascii: saitana tomaderake abhavera bhiti pradarsana kare evam tomaderake aslilatara adesa kare evam allaha tomaderake ta~ra nikata hate ksama o dayara amgikara karena. allaha hacchena vipula data, sarvajna.

latin_iast: tini yāke icchā prajñā dāna karena evaṃ yāke prajñā dāna karā haẏa se niścaẏai pracura kalyāṇa lābha kare; vasttataḥ jñānavāna vyaktigaṇa vyatīta kehai upaladdhi karate pārenā.
latin_ascii: tini yake iccha prajna dana karena evam yake prajna dana kara haya se niscayai pracura kalyana labha kare; vasttatah jnanavana vyaktigana vyatita kehai upaladdhi karate parena.

latin_iast: evaṃ ye kona vastu tomarā vyaẏa karanā kena, athavā ye kona pratijñā (nayara) tomarā grahaṇa karanā kena, āllāha niścaẏai tā avagata hana; āra atyācārīdera konai sāhāyyakārī nei.
latin_ascii: evam ye kona vastu tomara vyaya karana kena, athava ye kona pratijna (nayara) tomara grahana karana kena, allaha niscayai ta avagata hana; ara atyacaridera konai sahayyakari nei.

latin_iast: yadi tomarā prakāśyabhāve dāna kara tāhale tā utkṛṣṭa evaṃ yadi tomarā tā gopana kara o daridraderake pradāna kara tāhale oṭāo tomādera janya uttama, evaṃ era dvārā tomādera kichu pāpa (era kālimā) vidūrita have; vasttataḥ tomādera kāryakalāpa samvandhe āllāha viśeṣa rūpe khavara rākhena.
latin_ascii: yadi tomara prakasyabhave dana kara tahale ta utkrsta evam yadi tomara ta gopana kara o daridraderake pradana kara tahale otao tomadera janya uttama, evam era dvara tomadera kichu papa (era kalima) vidurita have; vasttatah tomadera karyakalapa samvandhe allaha visesa rupe khavara rakhena.

latin_iast: tāderake supathe ānāra dāẏitva tomāra naẏa, varaṃ yāke icchā āllāha tāke sat pathe paricālita karena evaṃ tomarā dhanasampada hate yā vyaẏa kara vastutaḥ tā tomādera nijedera janya, āra ekamātra āllāhara santoṣa lābhera ceṣṭā vyatīta (anya kona uddeśe) artha vyaẏa karanā; evaṃ tomarā hālāla sampada hate yā vyaẏa karave tā sampūrṇabhāve punaḥprāpta have, āra tomādera prati anyāẏa karā havenā.
latin_ascii: taderake supathe anara dayitva tomara naya, varam yake iccha allaha take sat pathe paricalita karena evam tomara dhanasampada hate ya vyaya kara vastutah ta tomadera nijedera janya, ara ekamatra allahara santosa labhera cesta vyatita (anya kona uddese) artha vyaya karana; evam tomara halala sampada hate ya vyaya karave ta sampurnabhave punahprapta have, ara tomadera prati anyaya kara havena.

latin_iast: dāna khaẏarāta ai sava lokadera janya yārā āllāhara kāche āvaddha haẏe geche, jīvikāra sandhāne anyatra ghorāphirā karate sakṣama naẏa. tādera sāvalila calācalera janya ajña lokerā tāderake abhāvahīna mane kare, tumi tāderake tādera lakṣaṇa dvārā cinave. tārā mānuṣera kāche yāñcā karenā. evaṃ tomarā vaidha sampada theke yā vyaẏa kara se viṣaẏe āllāha samyakarūpe avagata.
latin_ascii: dana khayarata ai sava lokadera janya yara allahara kache avaddha haye geche, jivikara sandhane anyatra ghoraphira karate saksama naya. tadera savalila calacalera janya ajna lokera taderake abhavahina mane kare, tumi taderake tadera laksana dvara cinave. tara manusera kache yanca karena. evam tomara vaidha sampada theke ya vyaya kara se visaye allaha samyakarupe avagata.

latin_iast: yārā rāte o dine, gopane o prakāśye nijedera dhana-sampada vyaẏa kare tādera ravera nikaṭa tādera puraskāra raẏeche, tādera kona bhaẏa nei evaṃ tārā duḥkhita havenā.
latin_ascii: yara rate o dine, gopane o prakasye nijedera dhana-sampada vyaya kare tadera ravera nikata tadera puraskara rayeche, tadera kona bhaya nei evam tara duhkhita havena.

latin_ascii: yara suda bhaksana kare tara saitanera sparse mohabhibhuta vyaktira anurupa kiyamata divase dandayamana have; era karana ei ye, tara vale, vyavasa sudera anurupa vai to naya; athaca allaha ta‘ala vyavasake halala karechena evam sudake harama karechena; atahpara yara nikata tara ravera paksa hate upadesa samagata haya, phale se nivrtta haya; sutaram ya atita hayeche tara krtakarma allahara upara nirbhara; evam yara punaraya suda grahana karave tarai hacche jahannamera adhivasi, sekhanei cirakala avasthana karave.

latin_ascii: ara yadi se abhavagrasta haya tahale svacchalatara pratiksa karave evam yadi tomara vujhe thaka tahale tomadera janya dana karai uttama.

latin_iast: āra tomarā sei dinera bhaẏa kara yedina tomarā āllāhara kāche pratyāvartita have, takhana ye yā arjana kareche tā sampūrṇa rūpe pradatta have evaṃ tārā atyācārita havenā.
