latin_iast: he viśvāsa sthāpanakārīgaṇa! yakhana tomarā kona nirdiṣṭa samaẏera janya ṛṇera ādāna pradāna karave takhana tā likhe nive; āra kona ekajana lekhaka yena nyāyyabhāve tomādera madhye (ai ādāna pradānera dalīla) likhe deẏa, āra kona lekhaka yena (dalīla) likhe dite asvīkāra nā kare, āllāha tāke yerūpa śikṣā diẏechena, tāra ucita tā likhe deẏā, evaṃ ṛṇa grahitā yena lekhāra viṣaẏa vale deẏa evaṃ tāra ucita svīẏa rāvva āllāhake bhaẏa karā evaṃ ora madhye kichumātra vyatikrama nā karā; ataḥpara ṛṇa grahītā yadi nirvodha vā ayogya athavā likhiẏe nite asamartha haẏa tāhale tāra abhibhāvakarā nyāẏa saṅgatabhāve likhiẏe nive evaṃ tomādera madhye du’jana puruṣa sākṣīke sākṣī karave; kintu yadi du’jana puruṣa nā pāoẏā yāẏa tāhale sākṣīgaṇera madhye tomarā ekajana puruṣa o du’jana nārī manonīta karave, yadi nārīdvaẏera ekajana bhule yāẏa tāhale ekajana apara janake smaraṇa kariẏe dive; evaṃ yakhana āhavāna karā haẏa takhana sākṣīgaṇera asvīkāra nā karā ucita, evaṃ kṣudra athavā vṛhat viṣaẏera nirdiṣṭa samaẏa likhe dite tomarā avahelā karanā, eṭā āllāhara nikaṭa ati saṅgata evaṃ sākṣyera janya eṭāi dṛr̤hatara o sandehe patita nā haoẏāra nikaṭatara; kintu yadi tomarā kāravāre paraspara hāte hāte ādāna pradāna kara tāhale tā lipivaddha nā karale tomādera pakṣe doṣa nei; kintu vāṇijyika lenadenera janya sākṣī rekha, yena lekhaka kiṃvā sākṣī kṣatigrasta nā haẏa. yadi erūpa kara (kṣatigrasta) tāhale tā tomādera pakṣe pāpera viṣaẏa. āllāhake bhaẏa kara. āllāhai tomāderake śikṣā pradāna karena evaṃ āllāha sarva viṣaẏe mahājñānī.
latin_ascii: he visvasa sthapanakarigana! yakhana tomara kona nirdista samayera janya rnera adana pradana karave takhana ta likhe nive; ara kona ekajana lekhaka yena nyayyabhave tomadera madhye (ai adana pradanera dalila) likhe deya, ara kona lekhaka yena (dalila) likhe dite asvikara na kare, allaha take yerupa siksa diyechena, tara ucita ta likhe deya, evam rna grahita yena lekhara visaya vale deya evam tara ucita sviya ravva allahake bhaya kara evam ora madhye kichumatra vyatikrama na kara; atahpara rna grahita yadi nirvodha va ayogya athava likhiye nite asamartha haya tahale tara abhibhavakara nyaya sangatabhave likhiye nive evam tomadera madhye du’jana purusa saksike saksi karave; kintu yadi du’jana purusa na paoya yaya tahale saksiganera madhye tomara ekajana purusa o du’jana nari manonita karave, yadi naridvayera ekajana bhule yaya tahale ekajana apara janake smarana kariye dive; evam yakhana ahavana kara haya takhana saksiganera asvikara na kara ucita, evam ksudra athava vrhat visayera nirdista samaya likhe dite tomara avahela karana, eta allahara nikata ati sangata evam saksyera janya etai drrhatara o sandehe patita na haoyara nikatatara; kintu yadi tomara karavare paraspara hate hate adana pradana kara tahale ta lipivaddha na karale tomadera pakse dosa nei; kintu vanijyika lenadenera janya saksi rekha, yena lekhaka kimva saksi ksatigrasta na haya. yadi erupa kara (ksatigrasta) tahale ta tomadera pakse papera visaya. allahake bhaya kara. allahai tomaderake siksa pradana karena evam allaha sarva visaye mahajnani.

latin_iast: evaṃ yadi tomarā pravāse thāka o lekhaka nā pāo tāhale vandhakī vastta nijera dakhale rākha. ataḥpara keha yadi kehake viśvāsa kare tāhale yāke viśvāsa karā haẏeche tāra pakṣe gacchita dravya pratyarpaṇa karā ucita evaṃ svīẏa rāvva āllāhake bhaẏa karā ucit. sākṣya gopana karanā; evaṃ ye keha tā gopana karave, niścaẏai tāra mana pāpācārī; vastutaḥ āllāha tomādera kāryakalāpa samvandhe samyaka jñāta.
latin_ascii: evam yadi tomara pravase thaka o lekhaka na pao tahale vandhaki vastta nijera dakhale rakha. atahpara keha yadi kehake visvasa kare tahale yake visvasa kara hayeche tara pakse gacchita dravya pratyarpana kara ucita evam sviya ravva allahake bhaya kara ucit. saksya gopana karana; evam ye keha ta gopana karave, niscayai tara mana papacari; vastutah allaha tomadera karyakalapa samvandhe samyaka jnata.

latin_iast: nabhomanḍala o bhūmanḍale yā kichu raẏeche savai āllāhara evaṃ tomādera antare yā raẏeche tā prakāśa kara athavā gopana rākha, āllāha tāra hisāva tomādera nikaṭa hate grahaṇa karavena; ataḥpara tini yāke icchā kṣamā karavena, yāke icchā śāsti divena; evaṃ āllāha sarva viṣaẏopari śaktimāna.
latin_ascii: nabhomandala o bhumandale ya kichu rayeche savai allahara evam tomadera antare ya rayeche ta prakasa kara athava gopana rakha, allaha tara hisava tomadera nikata hate grahana karavena; atahpara tini yake iccha ksama karavena, yake iccha sasti divena; evam allaha sarva visayopari saktimana.

latin_iast: rāsūla tāra rāvva hate tāra prati yā avatīrṇa haẏeche tā viśvāsa kare evaṃ mu’minagaṇao (viśvāsa kare); tārā savāi āllāhake, tā~ra mālāikāke, tā~ra granthasamūhake evaṃ tā~ra rāsūlagaṇake viśvāsa kare; (tārā vale) āmarā tā~ra rāsūlagaṇera madhye kehakeo pārthakya karinā. evaṃ tārā vale, āmarā śunalāma evaṃ svīkāra karalāma; he āmādera rāvva! āmarā āpanārai nikaṭa kṣamā prārthanā karachi evaṃ āpanārai dike śeṣa pratyāvartana.
latin_ascii: rasula tara ravva hate tara prati ya avatirna hayeche ta visvasa kare evam mu’minaganao (visvasa kare); tara savai allahake, ta~ra malaikake, ta~ra granthasamuhake evam ta~ra rasulaganake visvasa kare; (tara vale) amara ta~ra rasulaganera madhye kehakeo parthakya karina. evam tara vale, amara sunalama evam svikara karalama; he amadera ravva! amara apanarai nikata ksama prarthana karachi evam apanarai dike sesa pratyavartana.

latin_iast: kona vyaktikei āllāha tāra sādhyera atirikta kartavya pālane vādhya karenanā; se yā upārjana kareche tā tārai janya evaṃ yā se arjana kareche tā tārai upara vartāve. he āmādera rāvva! āmarā yadi bhule yāi athavā bhula kari sejanya āmāderake aparādhī karavenanā. he āmādera rāvva! āmādera pūrvavartīgaṇera upara yerūpa gurubhāra arpaṇa karechilena āmādera upara tadrupa bhāra arpaṇa karavenanā. he āmādera rāvva! yā āmādera śaktira vāire airūpa bhāra vahane āmāderake vādhya karavenanā, evaṃ āmādera pāpa mocana karuna o āmāderake kṣamā karuna, āmāderake daẏā karuna, āpanii āmādera āśraẏadātā! ataeva kāphira sampradāẏera viruddhe āmāderake jaẏayukta karuna.
latin_ascii: kona vyaktikei allaha tara sadhyera atirikta kartavya palane vadhya karenana; se ya uparjana kareche ta tarai janya evam ya se arjana kareche ta tarai upara vartave. he amadera ravva! amara yadi bhule yai athava bhula kari sejanya amaderake aparadhi karavenana. he amadera ravva! amadera purvavartiganera upara yerupa gurubhara arpana karechilena amadera upara tadrupa bhara arpana karavenana. he amadera ravva! ya amadera saktira vaire airupa bhara vahane amaderake vadhya karavenana, evam amadera papa mocana karuna o amaderake ksama karuna, amaderake daya karuna, apanii amadera asrayadata! ataeva kaphira sampradayera viruddhe amaderake jayayukta karuna.

latin_ascii: he amadera ravva! niscayai apani sakala manusake samavetakari, ai dine motei sandeha nei, niscayai allaha pratijna bhangakari nana.

latin_iast: phira‘āuna sampradāẏa evaṃ tādera pūrvavartīdera prakṛtira nyāẏa tārā āmāra āẏātasamūhera prati asatyāropa kareche, ei hetu āllāha tādera dhṛta karechena evaṃ āllāha kaṭhora śāstidātā.

latin_iast: yārā aviśvāsa kareche, tumi tāderake valaḥ acirei tomarā parābhūta have evaṃ tomarā jāhānnāmera dike ekatrita have evaṃ oṭā nikṛṣṭatara sthāna.
latin_ascii: yara avisvasa kareche, tumi taderake valah acirei tomara parabhuta have evam tomara jahannamera dike ekatrita have evam ota nikrstatara sthana.

latin_iast: niścaẏai tomādera janya du’ṭi dalera paraspara sammukhīna haoẏāra madhye mahāna namunā raẏeche, tādera ekadala āllāhara pathe saṃgrāma karachila evaṃ apara dala aviśvāsī chila; tārā pratyakṣa dṛṣṭite musalimaderake dviguṇa dekhechila evaṃ āllāha yāke icchā tadvīẏa sāhāyya dāne śaktiśālī karena, niścaẏai era madhye cakṣusmānadera janya upadeśa raẏeche.
latin_ascii: niscayai tomadera janya du’ti dalera paraspara sammukhina haoyara madhye mahana namuna rayeche, tadera ekadala allahara pathe samgrama karachila evam apara dala avisvasi chila; tara pratyaksa drstite musalimaderake dviguna dekhechila evam allaha yake iccha tadviya sahayya dane saktisali karena, niscayai era madhye caksusmanadera janya upadesa rayeche.

latin_iast: mānavamanḍalīke ramaṇī, santāna-santati, puñjīkṛta svarṇa o raupyabhānḍāra, suśikṣita aśva o pālita paśu evaṃ śasya kṣetrera ākarṣaṇīẏa vastta dvārā suśobhita karā haẏeche, eṭā pārthiva jīvanera sampada evaṃ āllāhara nikaṭa raẏeche śreṣṭhatama avasthāna.
latin_ascii: manavamandalike ramani, santana-santati, punjikrta svarna o raupyabhandara, susiksita asva o palita pasu evam sasya ksetrera akarsaniya vastta dvara susobhita kara hayeche, eta parthiva jivanera sampada evam allahara nikata rayeche sresthatama avasthana.

latin_iast: tumi valaḥ āmi ki tomāderake eṭā apekṣāo uttama viṣaẏera saṃvāda diva? yārā dharmabhīru tādera janya tādera ravera nikaṭa jānnāta raẏeche yāra taladeśe srotasvinīsamūha pravāhitā, tanmadhye tārā sadā avasthāna karave evaṃ sekhāne śuddhā sahadharminīgaṇa o āllāhara prasannatā raẏeche evaṃ āllāha vāndādera prati lakṣyakārī.
latin_ascii: tumi valah ami ki tomaderake eta apeksao uttama visayera samvada divay yara dharmabhiru tadera janya tadera ravera nikata jannata rayeche yara taladese srotasvinisamuha pravahita, tanmadhye tara sada avasthana karave evam sekhane suddha sahadharminigana o allahara prasannata rayeche evam allaha vandadera prati laksyakari.

latin_iast: yārā valeḥ he āmādera rāvva! niścaẏai āmarā viśvāsa sthāpana karechi, ataeva āmādera aparādha kṣamā karuna evaṃ jāhānnāmera āgunera śāsti hate āmāderake vā~cāna.
latin_ascii: yara valeh he amadera ravva! niscayai amara visvasa sthapana karechi, ataeva amadera aparadha ksama karuna evam jahannamera agunera sasti hate amaderake va~cana.

latin_iast: yārā sahiṣṇu, satyaparāẏaṇa, sevānugata, dānaśīla evaṃ ūṣākāle kṣamāprārthī.
latin_ascii: yara sahisnu, satyaparayana, sevanugata, danasila evam usakale ksamaprarthi.

latin_iast: āllāha sākṣya pradāna karena ye, niścaẏai tini vyatīta keha ilāha (upāsya) nei evaṃ mālāikā/phereśatā, jñānavānagaṇa o suvicāre āsthā sthāpanakārīgaṇao sākṣya deẏa ye, ei mahā parākrānta vijñānamaẏa vyatīta āra konai upāsya nei.
latin_ascii: allaha saksya pradana karena ye, niscayai tini vyatita keha ilaha (upasya) nei evam malaika/pheresata, jnanavanagana o suvicare astha sthapanakariganao saksya deya ye, ei maha parakranta vijnanamaya vyatita ara konai upasya nei.

latin_iast: niścaẏai isalāmai āllāhara nikaṭa ekamātra dharma. evaṃ yāderake grantha pradatta haẏeche tādera jñāna āsāra parao tārā matavirodhe lipta raẏeche śudhumātra paraspara vidveṣa vaśataḥ; evaṃ ye āllāhara nidarśanasamūha asvīkāra kare niścaẏai āllāha sattvara hisāva grahaṇakārī.
latin_ascii: niscayai isalamai allahara nikata ekamatra dharma. evam yaderake grantha pradatta hayeche tadera jnana asara parao tara matavirodhe lipta rayeche sudhumatra paraspara vidvesa vasatah; evam ye allahara nidarsanasamuha asvikara kare niscayai allaha sattvara hisava grahanakari.

latin_iast: ataḥpara yadi tārā tomāra sāthe kalaha kare tāhale tumi valaḥ āmi o āmāra anusārīgaṇa āllāhara uddeśye ātmasamarpaṇa karechi evaṃ yāderake grantha pradatta haẏeche o yārā nirakṣara tāderake valaḥ tomarāo ki ātmasamarpaṇa karecha? ataḥpara yadi tārā ātmasamarpaṇa kare tāhale niścaẏai tārā supatha peẏe yāve, āra yadi phire yāẏa tāhale tomāra upara dāẏitva hacche pracāra karā mātra evaṃ āllāha vāndādera prati lakṣyakārī.
latin_ascii: atahpara yadi tara tomara sathe kalaha kare tahale tumi valah ami o amara anusarigana allahara uddesye atmasamarpana karechi evam yaderake grantha pradatta hayeche o yara niraksara taderake valah tomarao ki atmasamarpana karechay atahpara yadi tara atmasamarpana kare tahale niscayai tara supatha peye yave, ara yadi phire yaya tahale tomara upara dayitva hacche pracara kara matra evam allaha vandadera prati laksyakari.

latin_iast: niścaẏai yārā āllāhara nidarśanasamūha aviśvāsa kare o anyāẏabhāve nāvīderake hatyā kare evaṃ hatyā kare tādera yārā mānavamanḍalīra madhye nyāẏera ādeśakārī, tāderake yantraṇādāẏaka śāstira susaṃvāda dāo.
latin_ascii: niscayai yara allahara nidarsanasamuha avisvasa kare o anyayabhave naviderake hatya kare evam hatya kare tadera yara manavamandalira madhye nyayera adesakari, taderake yantranadayaka sastira susamvada dao.

latin_iast: edera kṛtakarmasamūha ihakāla o ākhirāte vyartha have evaṃ tādera janya keha sāhāyyakārī nei.
latin_ascii: edera krtakarmasamuha ihakala o akhirate vyartha have evam tadera janya keha sahayyakari nei.

latin_iast: tumi ki tādera prati lakṣya karani yāderake granthera ekāṃśa pradatta haẏeche? tāderake granthera dike āhavāna karā haẏeche yena eṭā tādera madhye mīmāṃsā kare, ataḥpara tādera ekadala pratigamana karala evaṃ tārā pratigamanakārī.
latin_ascii: tumi ki tadera prati laksya karani yaderake granthera ekamsa pradatta hayechey taderake granthera dike ahavana kara hayeche yena eta tadera madhye mimamsa kare, atahpara tadera ekadala pratigamana karala evam tara pratigamanakari.

latin_iast: eṭā e janya ye, tārā valeḥ nirdiṣṭa saṃkhyaka dina vyatīta jāhānnāmera āguna āmāderake sparśa karavenā; evaṃ tārā yā sthira kareche, tādera dharma viṣaẏe oṭā tāderake pratārita kareche.
latin_ascii: eta e janya ye, tara valeh nirdista samkhyaka dina vyatita jahannamera aguna amaderake sparsa karavena; evam tara ya sthira kareche, tadera dharma visaye ota taderake pratarita kareche.

latin_iast: ataḥpara ye dina āmi tāderake ekatrita karava, yāte kona sandeha nei, takhana tādera ki daśā have? evaṃ pratyeka vyakti yā arjana kareche tā samyaka rūpe pradatta have evaṃ tārā atyācārita havenā.
latin_ascii: atahpara ye dina ami taderake ekatrita karava, yate kona sandeha nei, takhana tadera ki dasa havey evam pratyeka vyakti ya arjana kareche ta samyaka rupe pradatta have evam tara atyacarita havena.

latin_iast: tumi valaḥ he rājyādhipati āllāha! āpani yāke icchā rājatva dāna karena evaṃ yāra nikaṭa hate icchā rājatva chiniẏe nena; yāke icchā sammāna dāna karena evaṃ yāke icchā lāñchita karena; āpanārai hāte raẏeche kalyāṇa. niścaẏai āpanii sarva viṣaẏe kṣamatāvāna.
latin_ascii: tumi valah he rajyadhipati allaha! apani yake iccha rajatva dana karena evam yara nikata hate iccha rajatva chiniye nena; yake iccha sammana dana karena evam yake iccha lanchita karena; apanarai hate rayeche kalyana. niscayai apanii sarva visaye ksamatavana.

latin_iast: āpani rātake dine parivartita karena evaṃ dinake rāte pariṇata karena, evaṃ jīvitake mṛta hate nirgata karena o mṛtake jīvita hate vahirgata karena evaṃ āpani yāke icchā aparimita jīvikā dāna karena.
latin_ascii: apani ratake dine parivartita karena evam dinake rate parinata karena, evam jivitake mrta hate nirgata karena o mrtake jivita hate vahirgata karena evam apani yake iccha aparimita jivika dana karena.

latin_iast: mu’minagaṇa yena mu’minagaṇake cher̤e kāphiraderake vandhu rūpe grahaṇa nā kare, evaṃ tādera āśaṃkā hate ātmarakṣā vyatīta ye erūpa kare se āllāhara nikaṭa samparkahīna; āra āllāha tomāderake svīẏa pavitra astitvera bhaẏa pradarśana karachena evaṃ āllāharai dike phire yete have.
latin_ascii: mu’minagana yena mu’minaganake chere kaphiraderake vandhu rupe grahana na kare, evam tadera asamka hate atmaraksa vyatita ye erupa kare se allahara nikata samparkahina; ara allaha tomaderake sviya pavitra astitvera bhaya pradarsana karachena evam allaharai dike phire yete have.

latin_iast: tumi valaḥ tomādera antarasamūhe yā raẏeche tā tomarā gopana kara athavā prakāśa kara āllāha tā avagata āchena evaṃ nabhomanḍale o bhūmanḍale yā kichu raẏeche āllāha tā jñāta āchena; evaṃ āllāha sarva viṣaẏe śaktimāna.
latin_ascii: tumi valah tomadera antarasamuhe ya rayeche ta tomara gopana kara athava prakasa kara allaha ta avagata achena evam nabhomandale o bhumandale ya kichu rayeche allaha ta jnata achena; evam allaha sarva visaye saktimana.

latin_iast: sedina pratyeka vyakti satkāja hate yā kareche o duskarma hate yā kareche tā dekhate pāve; takhana se icchā karave - yadi tāra madhye evaṃ ai duskarmera madhye sudūra vyavadhāna hata! āllāha tomāderake svīẏa pavitra astitvera bhaẏa pradarśana karachena evaṃ āllāha svīẏa vāndādera prati snehaśīla.
latin_ascii: sedina pratyeka vyakti satkaja hate ya kareche o duskarma hate ya kareche ta dekhate pave; takhana se iccha karave - yadi tara madhye evam ai duskarmera madhye sudura vyavadhana hata! allaha tomaderake sviya pavitra astitvera bhaya pradarsana karachena evam allaha sviya vandadera prati snehasila.

latin_iast: tumi valaḥ yadi tomarā āllāhake bhālavāsa tāhale āmāra anusaraṇa kara, yāte āllāha tomāderake bhālavāsena o tomādera aparādhasamūha kṣamā karena; evaṃ āllāha kṣamāśīla, karuṇāmaẏa.
latin_ascii: tumi valah yadi tomara allahake bhalavasa tahale amara anusarana kara, yate allaha tomaderake bhalavasena o tomadera aparadhasamuha ksama karena; evam allaha ksamasila, karunamaya.

latin_iast: tumi valaḥ tomarā āllāha o rāsūlera anusaraṇa kara; kintu yadi tārā phire yāẏa tāhale niścaẏai āllāha aviśvāsīderake bhālavāsena nā.
latin_ascii: tumi valah tomara allaha o rasulera anusarana kara; kintu yadi tara phire yaya tahale niscayai allaha avisvasiderake bhalavasena na.

latin_iast: niścaẏai āllāha ādama o nūhake evaṃ ivarāhīma o imarānera santānagaṇake viśva jagatera upara manonīta karechena.
latin_ascii: niscayai allaha adama o nuhake evam ivarahima o imaranera santanaganake visva jagatera upara manonita karechena.

latin_iast: tārā eke aparera vaṃśadhara evaṃ āllāha śravaṇakārī, mahājñānī.
latin_ascii: tara eke aparera vamsadhara evam allaha sravanakari, mahajnani.

latin_iast: yakhana imarāna-patnī nivedana karala, he āmāra rāvva! niścaẏai āmāra garbhe yā raẏeche tā āmi mukta kare āpanāra uddeśe utsarga karalāma, sutarāṃ āpani āmā hate tā grahaṇa karuna, niścaẏai āpani śravaṇakārī, mahājñānī.
latin_ascii: yakhana imarana-patni nivedana karala, he amara ravva! niscayai amara garbhe ya rayeche ta ami mukta kare apanara uddese utsarga karalama, sutaram apani ama hate ta grahana karuna, niscayai apani sravanakari, mahajnani.

latin_iast: anantara yakhana se tā prasava karala takhana valalaḥ he āmāra rāvva! āmito kanyā prasava karechi; evaṃ se yā prasava kareche tā āllāha samyaka avagata āchena, evaṃ kono putra ei kanyāra samakakṣa naẏa! āra āmi kanyāra nāma rākhalāma ‘māraiẏāma’ evaṃ āmi tāke o tāra santānagaṇake vitār̤ita śāitāna hate āpanāra āśraẏe samarpana karalāma.
latin_ascii: anantara yakhana se ta prasava karala takhana valalah he amara ravva! amito kanya prasava karechi; evam se ya prasava kareche ta allaha samyaka avagata achena, evam kono putra ei kanyara samakaksa naya! ara ami kanyara nama rakhalama ‘maraiyama’ evam ami take o tara santanaganake vitarita saitana hate apanara asraye samarpana karalama.

latin_iast: anantara tāra rāvva tāke uttama rūpe grahaṇa karalena evaṃ tāke uttama pravṛddhi dāna karalena evaṃ yākāriẏāke tāra bhārārpana karalena; yakhanai yākāriẏā tāra nikaṭa ukta prakoṣṭhe praveśa karata takhana tāra nikaṭa khādya sambhāra dekhate peta; se valataḥ he māraiẏāma! eṭā kothā hate prāpta hale? se valataḥ eṭā āllāhara nikaṭa hate, niścaẏai āllāha yāke icchā aparimita jīvikā dāna karena.
latin_ascii: anantara tara ravva take uttama rupe grahana karalena evam take uttama pravrddhi dana karalena evam yakariyake tara bhararpana karalena; yakhanai yakariya tara nikata ukta prakosthe pravesa karata takhana tara nikata khadya sambhara dekhate peta; se valatah he maraiyama! eta kotha hate prapta haley se valatah eta allahara nikata hate, niscayai allaha yake iccha aparimita jivika dana karena.

latin_iast: takhana yākāriẏā tāra ravera nikaṭa prārthanā karechila, se valechilaḥ he āmāra rāvva! āmāke āpanāra nikaṭa hate pavitra santāna pradāna karuna, niścaẏai āpani prārthanā śravaṇakārī.
latin_ascii: takhana yakariya tara ravera nikata prarthana karechila, se valechilah he amara ravva! amake apanara nikata hate pavitra santana pradana karuna, niscayai apani prarthana sravanakari.

latin_iast: ataḥpara yakhana se meharāvera madhye dā~r̤iẏe prārthanā karachila takhana mālāikā/phereśatāgaṇa tāke samvodhana kare valechilaḥ niścaẏai āllāha tomāke iẏāhaiẏā samvandhe susaṃvāda dicchena - tāra avasthā ei have ye, se āllāhara ekaṭi vākyera satyatā prakāśakārī have, netā have, svīẏa pravṛttike damanakārī have evaṃ sat karmaśīlagaṇera madhye nāvī have.
latin_ascii: atahpara yakhana se meharavera madhye da~riye prarthana karachila takhana malaika/pheresatagana take samvodhana kare valechilah niscayai allaha tomake iyahaiya samvandhe susamvada dicchena - tara avastha ei have ye, se allahara ekati vakyera satyata prakasakari have, neta have, sviya pravrttike damanakari have evam sat karmasilaganera madhye navi have.

latin_iast: se valechilaḥ he āmāra rāvva! kirūpe āmāra putra have? niścaẏai āmāra vārdhakya upasthita haẏeche evaṃ āmāra strī vandhyā; tini valalenaḥ eirūpe āllāha yā icchā karena tā’i kare thākena.
latin_ascii: se valechilah he amara ravva! kirupe amara putra havey niscayai amara vardhakya upasthita hayeche evam amara stri vandhya; tini valalenah eirupe allaha ya iccha karena ta’i kare thakena.

latin_iast: se valechilaḥ he āmāra rāvva! āmāra janya kona nidarśana nirdiṣṭa karuna; tini valalenaḥ tomāra nidarśana ei ye, tumi tina dina iṅgita vyatīta lokera sāthe kathā valate pāravenā; evaṃ svīẏa rāvvake veśī veśī smaraṇa kara evaṃ sandhyāẏa o prabhāte tā~ra pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā kara.
latin_ascii: se valechilah he amara ravva! amara janya kona nidarsana nirdista karuna; tini valalenah tomara nidarsana ei ye, tumi tina dina ingita vyatita lokera sathe katha valate paravena; evam sviya ravvake vesi vesi smarana kara evam sandhyaya o prabhate ta~ra pavitrata o mahima ghosana kara.

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana mālāka/phereśatā valechilaḥ ohe māraiẏāma! niścaẏai āllāha tomāke manonīta karechena o tomāke pavitra karechena evaṃ viśva jagatera nārīgaṇera upara tomāke manonīta karechena.
latin_ascii: evam yakhana malaka/pheresata valechilah ohe maraiyama! niscayai allaha tomake manonita karechena o tomake pavitra karechena evam visva jagatera nariganera upara tomake manonita karechena.

latin_iast: he māraiẏāma! tomāra ravera ivādāta kara evaṃ sājadāha kara o rukukārīgaṇera sāthe ruku kara.
latin_ascii: he maraiyama! tomara ravera ivadata kara evam sajadaha kara o rukukariganera sathe ruku kara.

latin_iast: eṭā sei adṛśya viṣaẏaka saṃvāda yā āmi tomāra prati pratyādeśa karachi; evaṃ yakhana tārā svīẏa lekhanīsamūha nikṣepa karachila ye, tādera madhye ke māraiẏāmera pratipālana karave takhana tumi tādera nikaṭa chilenā; evaṃ yakhana tārā kalaha karachila takhanao tumi tādera nikaṭa chilenā.
latin_ascii: eta sei adrsya visayaka samvada ya ami tomara prati pratyadesa karachi; evam yakhana tara sviya lekhanisamuha niksepa karachila ye, tadera madhye ke maraiyamera pratipalana karave takhana tumi tadera nikata chilena; evam yakhana tara kalaha karachila takhanao tumi tadera nikata chilena.

latin_iast: yakhana mālāikā/phereśatārā valechilaḥ he māraiẏāma! niścaẏai āllāha tā~ra nikaṭa hate ekaṭi vākya dvārā tomāke susaṃvāda dicchena nandana īsā masīha - se ihaloka o paraloke sammānita evaṃ sānnidhya prāptagaṇera antarbhukta.
latin_ascii: yakhana malaika/pheresatara valechilah he maraiyama! niscayai allaha ta~ra nikata hate ekati vakya dvara tomake susamvada dicchena nandana isa masiha - se ihaloka o paraloke sammanita evam sannidhya praptaganera antarbhukta.

latin_iast: āra se dolanā hate o pariṇata vaẏase lokera sāthe kathā valave evaṃ se puṇyavānagaṇera antarbhukta have.
latin_ascii: ara se dolana hate o parinata vayase lokera sathe katha valave evam se punyavanaganera antarbhukta have.

latin_iast: se valechilaḥ he āmāra rāvva! kirūpe āmāra putra have? kona puruṣa mānuṣato āmāke sparśa kareni; tini valalenaḥ erūpe āllāha yā icchā karena, sṛṣṭi kare thākena, yakhana tini kona kājera manastha karena takhana tini oke ‘hao’ valena, phalataḥ tātei haẏe yāẏa.
latin_ascii: se valechilah he amara ravva! kirupe amara putra havey kona purusa manusato amake sparsa kareni; tini valalenah erupe allaha ya iccha karena, srsti kare thakena, yakhana tini kona kajera manastha karena takhana tini oke ‘hao’ valena, phalatah tatei haye yaya.

latin_iast: tini tāke grantha, vijñāna evaṃ tāorāta o iñjīla śikṣā divena.
latin_ascii: tini take grantha, vijnana evam taorata o injila siksa divena.

latin_iast: āra tāke isarāīla vaṃśīẏagaṇera janya rāsūla karavena. niścaẏai āmi (īsā) tomādera ravera nikaṭa hate nidarśanasaha tomādera nikaṭa āgamana karechi; niścaẏai āmi tomādera janya māṭi hate pākhira ākāra gaṭhana karava, ataḥpara ora madhye phutkāra diva, anantara āllāhara ādeśe oṭā pākhi haẏe yāve, evaṃ janmāndhake o kuṣṭha rogīke nirāmaẏa kari evaṃ āllāhara ādeśe mṛtake jīvita kari evaṃ tomarā yā āhāra kara o tomarā yā svīẏa gṛhera madhye saṃgraha kare rākha tadviṣaẏe saṃvāda dicchi - yadi tomarā viśvāsī hao tāhale niścaẏai ete tomādera janya nidarśana raẏeche.
latin_ascii: ara take isaraila vamsiyaganera janya rasula karavena. niscayai ami (isa) tomadera ravera nikata hate nidarsanasaha tomadera nikata agamana karechi; niscayai ami tomadera janya mati hate pakhira akara gathana karava, atahpara ora madhye phutkara diva, anantara allahara adese ota pakhi haye yave, evam janmandhake o kustha rogike niramaya kari evam allahara adese mrtake jivita kari evam tomara ya ahara kara o tomara ya sviya grhera madhye samgraha kare rakha tadvisaye samvada dicchi - yadi tomara visvasi hao tahale niscayai ete tomadera janya nidarsana rayeche.

latin_iast: evaṃ āmi esechi āmāra pūrve tāorāte yā chila tāra satyatā pradāna karate evaṃ tomādera janya yā avaidha haẏeche tāra katipaẏa tomādera janya vaidha karate, āra tomādera ravera nikaṭa hate tomādera janya nidarśana niẏe; ataeva āllāhake bhaẏa kara o āmāra anugata hao.
latin_ascii: evam ami esechi amara purve taorate ya chila tara satyata pradana karate evam tomadera janya ya avaidha hayeche tara katipaya tomadera janya vaidha karate, ara tomadera ravera nikata hate tomadera janya nidarsana niye; ataeva allahake bhaya kara o amara anugata hao.

latin_iast: niścaẏai āllāha āmāra rāvva evaṃ tomādera rāvva; ataeva tā~ra ivādāta kara - eṭāi sarala patha.
latin_ascii: niscayai allaha amara ravva evam tomadera ravva; ataeva ta~ra ivadata kara - etai sarala patha.

latin_iast: anantara yakhana īsā tādera madhye pratyākhyāna pratyakṣa karala takhana se valalaḥ āllāhara uddeśe ke āmāra sāhāyyakārī have? hāoẏārigaṇa valalaḥ āmarāi āllāhara sāhāyyakārī, āmarā āllāhara prati viśvāsa sthāpana karechi, evaṃ sākṣī theko ye, āmarā ātmasamarpaṇakārī.
latin_ascii: anantara yakhana isa tadera madhye pratyakhyana pratyaksa karala takhana se valalah allahara uddese ke amara sahayyakari havey haoyarigana valalah amarai allahara sahayyakari, amara allahara prati visvasa sthapana karechi, evam saksi theko ye, amara atmasamarpanakari.

latin_iast: he āmādera rāvva! āpani yā avatīrṇa karechena, āmarā tā viśvāsa kari evaṃ āmarā rāsūlera anusaraṇa karachi, ataeva sākṣīgaṇera sāthe āmāderake lipivaddha karuna.
latin_ascii: he amadera ravva! apani ya avatirna karechena, amara ta visvasa kari evam amara rasulera anusarana karachi, ataeva saksiganera sathe amaderake lipivaddha karuna.

latin_iast: āra tārā (kāphirerā) ṣar̤ayantra karechila o āllāhao kauśala karalena evaṃ āllāha śreṣṭhatama kauśalī.
latin_ascii: ara tara (kaphirera) sarayantra karechila o allahao kausala karalena evam allaha sresthatama kausali.

latin_iast: yakhana āllāha valalenaḥ he īsā! niścaẏai āmi tomāke āmāra dike pratigrahaṇa karava evaṃ tomāke uttolana karava evaṃ aviśvāsakārīdera hate tomāke pavitra karava, āra yārā aviśvāsa kareche tādera upara tomāra anusārīgaṇake utthāna dina paryanta samunnata karava; anantara āmārai dike tomādera pratyāvartana; ataḥpara tomādera madhye ye viṣaẏe matabheda chila tāra mīmāṃsā karava.
latin_ascii: yakhana allaha valalenah he isa! niscayai ami tomake amara dike pratigrahana karava evam tomake uttolana karava evam avisvasakaridera hate tomake pavitra karava, ara yara avisvasa kareche tadera upara tomara anusariganake utthana dina paryanta samunnata karava; anantara amarai dike tomadera pratyavartana; atahpara tomadera madhye ye visaye matabheda chila tara mimamsa karava.

latin_iast: anantara yārā kupharī kareche (aviśvāsī haẏeche), vastutaḥ tāderake ihakāla o ākhirāte kaṭhora śāsti pradāna karava evaṃ tādera janya keha sāhāyyakārī nei.
latin_ascii: anantara yara kuphari kareche (avisvasi hayeche), vastutah taderake ihakala o akhirate kathora sasti pradana karava evam tadera janya keha sahayyakari nei.

latin_iast: āra yārā viśvāsa sthāpana kareche o satkāja kareche phalataḥ tini tāderake pūrṇa pratidāna pradāna karavena evaṃ āllāha atyācārīderake bhālavāsenanā.
latin_ascii: ara yara visvasa sthapana kareche o satkaja kareche phalatah tini taderake purna pratidana pradana karavena evam allaha atyacariderake bhalavasenana.

latin_iast: āmi tomāra prati vijñānamaẏa varṇanā o nidarśanāvalī hate eṭā āvṛtti karachi.
latin_ascii: ami tomara prati vijnanamaya varnana o nidarsanavali hate eta avrtti karachi.

latin_iast: niścaẏai āllāhara nikaṭa īsāra dṛṣṭānta ādamera anurūpa; tini tāke māṭi dvārā sṛṣṭi karalena, ataḥpara valalena hao, phalataḥ tātei haẏe gela.
latin_ascii: niscayai allahara nikata isara drstanta adamera anurupa; tini take mati dvara srsti karalena, atahpara valalena hao, phalatah tatei haye gela.

latin_iast: ei vāstava ghaṭanā tomāra ravera pakṣa hate; sutarāṃ tumi saṃśaẏīdera antarbhukta haẏonā.
latin_ascii: ei vastava ghatana tomara ravera paksa hate; sutaram tumi samsayidera antarbhukta hayona.

latin_iast: ataḥpara tomāra nikaṭa ye jñāna eseche, tārapare tadviṣaẏe ye tomāra sāthe kalaha kare, tumi valaḥ eso, āmarā āmādera santānagaṇa o tomādera santānagaṇake, āmādera nārīgaṇa o tomādera nārīgaṇake evaṃ svaẏaṃ āmādera o tomāderake āhavāna kari. ataḥpara prārthanā kari ye, asatyavādīdera upara āllāhara abhisampāta varṣita hoka.
latin_ascii: atahpara tomara nikata ye jnana eseche, tarapare tadvisaye ye tomara sathe kalaha kare, tumi valah eso, amara amadera santanagana o tomadera santanaganake, amadera narigana o tomadera nariganake evam svayam amadera o tomaderake ahavana kari. atahpara prarthana kari ye, asatyavadidera upara allahara abhisampata varsita hoka.

latin_iast: niścaẏai eṭāi satya vivaraṇa evaṃ āllāha vyatīta anya kona ilāha (upāsya) nei, niścaẏai sei āllāha vijñānamaẏa, mahāparākrānta.
latin_ascii: niscayai etai satya vivarana evam allaha vyatita anya kona ilaha (upasya) nei, niscayai sei allaha vijnanamaya, mahaparakranta.

latin_iast: ataḥpara yadi tārā mukha phiriẏe neẏa tāhale niścaẏai āllāha duskāryakārīdera jñāta āchena.
latin_ascii: atahpara yadi tara mukha phiriye neya tahale niscayai allaha duskaryakaridera jnata achena.

latin_iast: tumi valaḥ he āhale kitāva! āmādera madhye o tomādera madhye ye vākye susādṛśya raẏeche tāra dike eso, yena āmarā āllāha vyatīta kārao ivādāta nā kari evaṃ tā~ra sāthe kona aṃśī sthira nā kari evaṃ āllāhake parityāga kare āmarā paraspara kehake rāvva rūpe grahaṇa nā kari. ataḥpara yadi tārā phire yāẏa tāhale valaḥ sākṣī theko ye, āmarā musalima (āllāhara nikaṭa ātmasamaparnakārī).
latin_ascii: tumi valah he ahale kitava! amadera madhye o tomadera madhye ye vakye susadrsya rayeche tara dike eso, yena amara allaha vyatita karao ivadata na kari evam ta~ra sathe kona amsi sthira na kari evam allahake parityaga kare amara paraspara kehake ravva rupe grahana na kari. atahpara yadi tara phire yaya tahale valah saksi theko ye, amara musalima (allahara nikata atmasamaparnakari).

latin_iast: he āhale kitāva! tomarā ivarāhīma samvandhe kena virtaka karacha? athaca tāra pare vyatīta tāorāta o iñjīla avatīrṇa haẏani - tavuo ki tomarā vujhachanā?
latin_ascii: he ahale kitava! tomara ivarahima samvandhe kena virtaka karachay athaca tara pare vyatita taorata o injila avatirna hayani - tavuo ki tomara vujhachanay

latin_iast: hyā~, tomarā emana ye, ye viṣaẏe tomādera jñāna chila tā niẏeo tomarā kalaha karechile, kintu yadviṣaẏe tomādera konai jñāna nei tā niẏe tomarā kena kalaha karacha evaṃ āllāha jñāta āchena o tomarā avagata nao.
latin_ascii: hya~, tomara emana ye, ye visaye tomadera jnana chila ta niyeo tomara kalaha karechile, kintu yadvisaye tomadera konai jnana nei ta niye tomara kena kalaha karacha evam allaha jnata achena o tomara avagata nao.

latin_iast: ivarāhīma iẏāhudī chilanā evaṃ khṛṣṭānao chilanā, varaṃ se sudṛr̤ha musalima chila evaṃ se muśarikadera (aṃśīvādī) antarbhukta chilanā.
latin_ascii: ivarahima iyahudi chilana evam khrstanao chilana, varam se sudrrha musalima chila evam se musarikadera (amsivadi) antarbhukta chilana.

latin_iast: niḥsandehe ai sava loka ivarāhīmera nikaṭatama yārā tāra anusaraṇa kareche evaṃ ei nāvī evaṃ (tā~ra sāthera) mu’minagaṇa; evaṃ āllāha viśvāsīgaṇera abhibhāvaka.
latin_ascii: nihsandehe ai sava loka ivarahimera nikatatama yara tara anusarana kareche evam ei navi evam (ta~ra sathera) mu’minagana; evam allaha visvasiganera abhibhavaka.

latin_iast: evaṃ kitāvīdera madhye eka dalera vāsanā ye, tomāderake pathabhrānta kare; kintu tārā nijedera vyatīta anya kehake vipathagāmī karenā evaṃ tārā tā vujhachenā.
latin_ascii: evam kitavidera madhye eka dalera vasana ye, tomaderake pathabhranta kare; kintu tara nijedera vyatita anya kehake vipathagami karena evam tara ta vujhachena.

latin_iast: he āhale kitāva! tomarā kena āllāhara nidarśanasamūhera prati aviśvāsa karacho? athaca tomarāi ora sākṣī.
latin_ascii: he ahale kitava! tomara kena allahara nidarsanasamuhera prati avisvasa karachoy athaca tomarai ora saksi.

latin_iast: he kitāvīrā! tomarā kena satyera saṅge mithyāke miliẏe niccha evaṃ satyake gopana karacha? athaca tomarāto avagata ācha.
latin_ascii: he kitavira! tomara kena satyera sange mithyake miliye niccha evam satyake gopana karachay athaca tomarato avagata acha.

latin_iast: āra āhale kitāvera madhye ekadala eṭāi vale ye, viśvāsa sthāpanakārīdera prati yā avatīrṇa haẏeche tatprati pūrvāhne viśvāsa sthāpana kara evaṃ aparāhne tā asvīkāra kara, tāhale tārā phire yāve.
latin_ascii: ara ahale kitavera madhye ekadala etai vale ye, visvasa sthapanakaridera prati ya avatirna hayeche tatprati purvahne visvasa sthapana kara evam aparahne ta asvikara kara, tahale tara phire yave.

latin_iast: āra yārā tomādera dharmera anusaraṇa kare tārā vyatīta anyadera viśvāsa karanā. tumi tāderake valaḥ āllāhara pathai ekamātra supatha. ei āhale kitāvīrā viśvāsa karenā ye, tādera parivarte anya kārao upara ahī avatīrṇa hate pāre. athavā tārā tomāra ravera kāche pau~chā paryanta tarka/vitarka karatei thākave. tumi valaḥ anugraha āllāharai hāte, tini yāke icchā ihā dāna karena evaṃ āllāhai rakṣākārī, mahājñānī.
latin_ascii: ara yara tomadera dharmera anusarana kare tara vyatita anyadera visvasa karana. tumi taderake valah allahara pathai ekamatra supatha. ei ahale kitavira visvasa karena ye, tadera parivarte anya karao upara ahi avatirna hate pare. athava tara tomara ravera kache pau~cha paryanta tarka/vitarka karatei thakave. tumi valah anugraha allaharai hate, tini yake iccha iha dana karena evam allahai raksakari, mahajnani.

latin_iast: tini yāra prati icchā karena svīẏa karunā nirdiṣṭa karena evaṃ āllāha mahāna, anugrahaśīla.
latin_ascii: tini yara prati iccha karena sviya karuna nirdista karena evam allaha mahana, anugrahasila.

latin_iast: kitāvīdera madhye erūpa āche ye, yadi tumi tāra nikaṭa puñjībhūta dhanarāśio gacchita rekhe dāo tavuo se tā tomāra nikaṭa pratyarpaṇa karave evaṃ tādera madhye erūpao āche ye, yadi tumi tāra nikaṭa ekaṭi dīnārao gacchita rākha tāhale se tāo tomāke pratyarpaṇa karavenā ye paryanta tumi tāra śiropari danḍāẏamāna thāka. kāraṇa tārā vale ye, āmādera upara ai aśikṣitadera kona dāẏa dāẏitva nei evaṃ tārā āllāhara prati mithyā āropa kare, yā tārāo jāne.
latin_ascii: kitavidera madhye erupa ache ye, yadi tumi tara nikata punjibhuta dhanarasio gacchita rekhe dao tavuo se ta tomara nikata pratyarpana karave evam tadera madhye erupao ache ye, yadi tumi tara nikata ekati dinarao gacchita rakha tahale se tao tomake pratyarpana karavena ye paryanta tumi tara siropari dandayamana thaka. karana tara vale ye, amadera upara ai asiksitadera kona daya dayitva nei evam tara allahara prati mithya aropa kare, ya tarao jane.

latin_iast: hyā~, yārā svīẏa aṅgīkāra pūrṇa kare o saṃyata haẏa, tāhale niścaẏai āllāha dharmabhīrugaṇake bhālavāsena.
latin_ascii: hya~, yara sviya angikara purna kare o samyata haya, tahale niscayai allaha dharmabhiruganake bhalavasena.

latin_iast: niścaẏai yārā āllāhara prati aṅgīkāra o svīẏa śapatha sāmānya mūlye vikri kare, paraloke tādera konai aṃśa nei evaṃ utthāna dine āllāha tādera sāthe kathā valavenanā evaṃ tādera prati dṛṣṭipātao karavenanā evaṃ pariśuddhao karavenanā. tādera janya yantraṇādāẏaka śāsti raẏeche.
latin_ascii: niscayai yara allahara prati angikara o sviya sapatha samanya mulye vikri kare, paraloke tadera konai amsa nei evam utthana dine allaha tadera sathe katha valavenana evam tadera prati drstipatao karavenana evam parisuddhao karavenana. tadera janya yantranadayaka sasti rayeche.

latin_iast: āra tādera madhye niścaẏai erūpa ekadala āche yārā kuñcita bhāṣāẏa grantha āvṛtti kare, yena tomarā oṭāke granthera aṃśa mane kara, athaca oṭā granthera aṃśa naẏa; evaṃ tārā vale ye, eṭā āllāhara nikaṭa hate samāgata, athaca oṭā āllāhara nikaṭa hate naẏa, evaṃ tārā āllāha samvandhe mithyā vale evaṃ tārāo tā avagata āche.
latin_ascii: ara tadera madhye niscayai erupa ekadala ache yara kuncita bhasaya grantha avrtti kare, yena tomara otake granthera amsa mane kara, athaca ota granthera amsa naya; evam tara vale ye, eta allahara nikata hate samagata, athaca ota allahara nikata hate naya, evam tara allaha samvandhe mithya vale evam tarao ta avagata ache.

latin_iast: eṭā kona mānuṣera pakṣe upayogī naẏa ye, āllāha yāke grantha, vijñāna o navuoẏāta dāna karena, ataḥpara se mānavamanḍalīra madhye vale - tomarā āllāhake parityāga kare āmāra upāsaka hao; varaṃ valaveḥ ravera ivādātakārī hao - kāraṇa tomarāi kuraāna śikṣā dāna kara evaṃ oṭā pāṭha kare thāka.
latin_ascii: eta kona manusera pakse upayogi naya ye, allaha yake grantha, vijnana o navuoyata dana karena, atahpara se manavamandalira madhye vale - tomara allahake parityaga kare amara upasaka hao; varam valaveh ravera ivadatakari hao - karana tomarai kuraana siksa dana kara evam ota patha kare thaka.

latin_iast: āra tini ādeśa karenanā ye, tomarā mālāka/phereśatā o nāvīgaṇake rāvva rūpe grahaṇa kara; tomarā ātmasamarpaṇakārī havāra para tini ki tomāderake punarāẏa kupharīte phire yāvāra ādeśa karavena?
latin_ascii: ara tini adesa karenana ye, tomara malaka/pheresata o naviganake ravva rupe grahana kara; tomara atmasamarpanakari havara para tini ki tomaderake punaraya kupharite phire yavara adesa karavenay

latin_iast: evaṃ āllāha yakhana nāvīgaṇera aṅgīkāra grahaṇa karechilena, āmi tomāderake grantha o vijñāna hate dāna karāra para tomādera saṅge yā āche tāra satyatā pratyāẏanakārī ekajana rāsūla āgamana karave, takhana tomarā avaśyai tāra prati viśvāsa sthāpana karave evaṃ tāra sāhāyyakārī have; tini ārao valechilenaḥ tomarā ki ete svīkṛta hale evaṃ pratiśruti grahaṇa karale? tārā valechila - āmarā svīkāra karalāma. tini valalenaḥ tāhale tomarā sākṣī theka evaṃ āmio tomādera sāthe sākṣīgaṇera antarbhukta railāma.
latin_ascii: evam allaha yakhana naviganera angikara grahana karechilena, ami tomaderake grantha o vijnana hate dana karara para tomadera sange ya ache tara satyata pratyayanakari ekajana rasula agamana karave, takhana tomara avasyai tara prati visvasa sthapana karave evam tara sahayyakari have; tini arao valechilenah tomara ki ete svikrta hale evam pratisruti grahana karaley tara valechila - amara svikara karalama. tini valalenah tahale tomara saksi theka evam amio tomadera sathe saksiganera antarbhukta railama.

latin_iast: ataḥpara era pare yārā phire yāve tārāi duskāryakārī.
latin_ascii: atahpara era pare yara phire yave tarai duskaryakari.

latin_iast: tāhale ki tārā āllāhara dharma vyatīta anya kichu kāmanā kare? athaca nabhomanḍala o bhūmanḍale yā kichu āche, icchā o anicchākrame savāi tā~ra uddeśe ātmasamarpaṇa kareche evaṃ tā~rai dike pratyāvartita have.
latin_ascii: tahale ki tara allahara dharma vyatita anya kichu kamana karey athaca nabhomandala o bhumandale ya kichu ache, iccha o anicchakrame savai ta~ra uddese atmasamarpana kareche evam ta~rai dike pratyavartita have.

latin_iast: tumi valaḥ āmarā āllāhara prati evaṃ yā āmādera prati avatīrṇa haẏeche evaṃ ivarāhīma, isamāīla, isahāka, iẏākūva o tādera vaṃśadharagaṇera prati avatīrṇa haẏeche evaṃ yā mūsā, īsā o anyānya nāvīgaṇake tādera rāvva kartṛka pradatta haẏeche tatprati viśvāsa sthāpana karalāma, āmarā tādera madhye kehakeo pārthakya jñāna karinā evaṃ āmarā tā~rai prati ātmasamarpaṇakārī.
latin_ascii: tumi valah amara allahara prati evam ya amadera prati avatirna hayeche evam ivarahima, isamaila, isahaka, iyakuva o tadera vamsadharaganera prati avatirna hayeche evam ya musa, isa o anyanya naviganake tadera ravva kartrka pradatta hayeche tatprati visvasa sthapana karalama, amara tadera madhye kehakeo parthakya jnana karina evam amara ta~rai prati atmasamarpanakari.

latin_iast: āra ye keha isalāma vyatīta anya dharma anveṣaṇa kare tā kakhanai tāra nikaṭa hate gṛhīta havenā evaṃ paraloke se kṣatigrastadera antarbhukta have.
latin_ascii: ara ye keha isalama vyatita anya dharma anvesana kare ta kakhanai tara nikata hate grhita havena evam paraloke se ksatigrastadera antarbhukta have.

latin_iast: kirūpe āllāha sei sampradāẏake patha pradarśana karavena yārā viśvāsa sthāpanera para, rāsūlera satyatā viṣaẏe sākṣyadānera para evaṃ tādera nikaṭa prakāśya nidarśanasamūha āsāra parao aviśvāsī haẏeche? āra āllāha atyācārī sampradāẏake patha pradarśana karenanā.
latin_ascii: kirupe allaha sei sampradayake patha pradarsana karavena yara visvasa sthapanera para, rasulera satyata visaye saksyadanera para evam tadera nikata prakasya nidarsanasamuha asara parao avisvasi hayechey ara allaha atyacari sampradayake patha pradarsana karenana.

latin_iast: orāi - yādera pratiphala ei ye, niścaẏai tādera upara āllāhara, tā~ra mālāikā/phereśatāra evaṃ samasta mānavera abhisampāta.
latin_ascii: orai - yadera pratiphala ei ye, niscayai tadera upara allahara, ta~ra malaika/pheresatara evam samasta manavera abhisampata.

latin_iast: tārā tanmadhye sadā avasthāna karave - tādera upara hate śāsti praśamita havenā evaṃ tāderake virāma deẏā havenā.
latin_ascii: tara tanmadhye sada avasthana karave - tadera upara hate sasti prasamita havena evam taderake virama deya havena.

latin_iast: kintu yārā erapara kṣamā prārthanā kare o saṃśodhita haẏa, tāhale niścaẏai āllāha kṣamāśīla, karuṇāmaẏa.
latin_ascii: kintu yara erapara ksama prarthana kare o samsodhita haya, tahale niscayai allaha ksamasila, karunamaya.

latin_iast: niścaẏai yārā viśvāsa sthāpanera para aviśvāsī haẏeche, ataḥpara aviśvāsa parivardhita kareche - tādera kṣamā prārthanā kakhanai gṛhīta havenā evaṃ tārāi pathabhrānta.
latin_ascii: niscayai yara visvasa sthapanera para avisvasi hayeche, atahpara avisvasa parivardhita kareche - tadera ksama prarthana kakhanai grhita havena evam tarai pathabhranta.

latin_iast: niścaẏai yārā aviśvāsa kareche o aviśvāsī avasthāẏa mṛtyu varaṇa kareche tādera muktira vinimaẏe yadi pṛthivīpūrṇa svarṇa deẏā haẏa tavuo kakṣano tā grahaṇa karā havenā. oderai janya yantraṇādāẏaka śāsti raẏeche evaṃ odera janya konai sāhāyyakārī nei.
latin_ascii: niscayai yara avisvasa kareche o avisvasi avasthaya mrtyu varana kareche tadera muktira vinimaye yadi prthivipurna svarna deya haya tavuo kaksano ta grahana kara havena. oderai janya yantranadayaka sasti rayeche evam odera janya konai sahayyakari nei.

latin_iast: tomarā yā bhālavāsa tā hate vyaẏa nā karā paryanta tomarā kakhanai kalyāṇa lābha karate pāravenā; evaṃ tomarā yā kichui vyaẏa kara, āllāha tā jñāta āchena.
latin_ascii: tomara ya bhalavasa ta hate vyaya na kara paryanta tomara kakhanai kalyana labha karate paravena; evam tomara ya kichui vyaya kara, allaha ta jnata achena.

latin_iast: pratyeka khādyai vānī isarāīlera janya hālāla chila. ekamātra tāorāta avatīrṇa haoẏāra pūrve vānī isarāīla nijera upara yā hārāma kare niẏechila tāi tādera upara hārāma karā haẏechila. tumi valaḥ yadi tomarā satyavādī hao tāhale tāorāta ānaẏana kara, ataḥpara oṭā pāṭha kara.
latin_ascii: pratyeka khadyai vani isarailera janya halala chila. ekamatra taorata avatirna haoyara purve vani isaraila nijera upara ya harama kare niyechila tai tadera upara harama kara hayechila. tumi valah yadi tomara satyavadi hao tahale taorata anayana kara, atahpara ota patha kara.

latin_iast: sutarāṃ yadi keha erapara āllāhara prati asatyāropa kare tāhale tārāi atyācārī.
latin_ascii: sutaram yadi keha erapara allahara prati asatyaropa kare tahale tarai atyacari.

latin_iast: tumi valaḥ āllāha satya valechena; ataeva tomarā ivarāhīmera sudṛr̤ha dharmera anusaraṇa kara evaṃ se aṃśīvādīdera antargata chilanā.
latin_ascii: tumi valah allaha satya valechena; ataeva tomara ivarahimera sudrrha dharmera anusarana kara evam se amsivadidera antargata chilana.

latin_iast: niścaẏai sarva prathama gṛha, yā mānavamanḍalīra janya nirdiṣṭa karā haẏeche tā ai ghara yā vākkāẏa (mākkāẏa) avisthata; oṭi saubhāgyayukta evaṃ samasta viśvavāsīra janya patha pradarśaka.
latin_ascii: niscayai sarva prathama grha, ya manavamandalira janya nirdista kara hayeche ta ai ghara ya vakkaya (makkaya) avisthata; oti saubhagyayukta evam samasta visvavasira janya patha pradarsaka.

latin_iast: ora madhye prakāśya nidarśanasamūha vidyamāna raẏeche, mākāme ivarāhīma ukta nidarśanasamūhera anyatama. āra ye ora madhye praveśa kare se nirāpattā prāpta haẏa evaṃ āllāhara uddeśe ei gṛhera hājja karā sei sava mānuṣera kartavya yārā saphara karāra ārthika sāmarthya rākhe evaṃ yadi keha asvīkāra kare tāhale niścaẏai āllāha samagra viśvavāsī hate pratyāśāmukta.
latin_ascii: ora madhye prakasya nidarsanasamuha vidyamana rayeche, makame ivarahima ukta nidarsanasamuhera anyatama. ara ye ora madhye pravesa kare se nirapatta prapta haya evam allahara uddese ei grhera hajja kara sei sava manusera kartavya yara saphara karara arthika samarthya rakhe evam yadi keha asvikara kare tahale niscayai allaha samagra visvavasi hate pratyasamukta.

latin_iast: tumi valaḥ he kitāvadhārīrā! tomarā kena āllāhara nidarśanāvalīra prati aviśvāsa karacho? tomarā yā karacho āllāha tadviṣaẏe sākṣī.
latin_ascii: tumi valah he kitavadharira! tomara kena allahara nidarsanavalira prati avisvasa karachoy tomara ya karacho allaha tadvisaye saksi.

latin_iast: he granthaprāptarā! ye vyakti viśvāsa sthāpana kareche tāra madhye kuṭilatāra kāmanāẏa kena tomarā tāke āllāhara pathe rodha karacho, athaca tomarā e pathera satyatā pratyakṣa karacha evaṃ tomarāi sākṣī raẏecha? āra tomarā yā karacho tadviṣaẏe āllāha amanoyogī nana.
latin_ascii: he granthapraptara! ye vyakti visvasa sthapana kareche tara madhye kutilatara kamanaya kena tomara take allahara pathe rodha karacho, athaca tomara e pathera satyata pratyaksa karacha evam tomarai saksi rayechay ara tomara ya karacho tadvisaye allaha amanoyogi nana.

latin_iast: he mu’minagaṇa! yāderake grantha pradatta haẏeche, yadi tomarā tādera eka dalera anusaraṇa kara tāhale tārā tomāderake tomādera īmāna ānaẏanera para kāphira vāniẏe dive.
latin_ascii: he mu’minagana! yaderake grantha pradatta hayeche, yadi tomara tadera eka dalera anusarana kara tahale tara tomaderake tomadera imana anayanera para kaphira vaniye dive.

latin_iast: āra kirūpe tomarā aviśvāsa karate pāra - yakhana āllāhara nidarśanāvalī tomādera sāmane paṭhita haẏa evaṃ tomādera madhye tā~ra rāsūla vidyamāna raẏeche? āra ye āllāhara patha dṛr̤ha rūpe dhāraṇa kare, avaśyai se sarala patha pradarśita have.
latin_ascii: ara kirupe tomara avisvasa karate para - yakhana allahara nidarsanavali tomadera samane pathita haya evam tomadera madhye ta~ra rasula vidyamana rayechey ara ye allahara patha drrha rupe dharana kare, avasyai se sarala patha pradarsita have.

latin_iast: he viśvāsa sthāpanakārīgaṇa! tomarā āllāhake bhaẏa kara yemanabhāve karā ucit evaṃ tomarā musalima nā haẏe mṛtyu varaṇa karanā.
latin_ascii: he visvasa sthapanakarigana! tomara allahake bhaya kara yemanabhave kara ucit evam tomara musalima na haye mrtyu varana karana.

latin_iast: āra tomarā ekayoge āllāhara rajju sudṛr̤ha rūpe dhāraṇa kara o vibhakta haẏe yeonā, evaṃ tomādera prati āllāhara ye dāna raẏeche tā smaraṇa kara. yakhana tomarā paraspara śatru chile takhana tinii tomādera antaḥkaraṇe prīti sthāpana karechilena, ataḥpara tomarā tā~ra anugrahe bhrātṛtve āvaddha hale evaṃ tomarā anala-kunḍera dhāre chile, anantara tinii tomāderake oṭā hate uddhāra karechena; erūpe āllāha tomādera janya svīẏa nidarśanāvalī vyakta karena, yena tomarā supatha prāpta hao.
latin_ascii: ara tomara ekayoge allahara rajju sudrrha rupe dharana kara o vibhakta haye yeona, evam tomadera prati allahara ye dana rayeche ta smarana kara. yakhana tomara paraspara satru chile takhana tinii tomadera antahkarane priti sthapana karechilena, atahpara tomara ta~ra anugrahe bhratrtve avaddha hale evam tomara anala-kundera dhare chile, anantara tinii tomaderake ota hate uddhara karechena; erupe allaha tomadera janya sviya nidarsanavali vyakta karena, yena tomara supatha prapta hao.

latin_iast: evaṃ tomādera madhye erūpa eka sampradāẏa haoẏā ucita yārā kalyāṇera dike āhavāna kare evaṃ sat kāje ādeśa kare o asat kāje niṣedha kare, āra tārāi suphala prāpta have.
latin_ascii: evam tomadera madhye erupa eka sampradaya haoya ucita yara kalyanera dike ahavana kare evam sat kaje adesa kare o asat kaje nisedha kare, ara tarai suphala prapta have.

latin_iast: evaṃ tādera mato haẏonā yādera nikaṭa spaṣṭa pramāṇa āsāra parao vibhinna dale vibhakta haẏeche o paraspara matabhede lipta raẏeche; tādera janya raẏeche kaṭhora śāsti.
latin_ascii: evam tadera mato hayona yadera nikata spasta pramana asara parao vibhinna dale vibhakta hayeche o paraspara matabhede lipta rayeche; tadera janya rayeche kathora sasti.

latin_iast: sedina kataguli mukhamanḍala have śvetavarṇa evaṃ kataka mukhamanḍala have kṛṣṇavarṇa; ataḥpara yādera mukhamanḍala kṛṣṇavarṇa have, (tāderake valā have) tāhale ki tomarā viśvāsa sthāpanera para aviśvāsī haẏecha? ataeva tomarā śāstira āsvāda grahaṇa kara, yehetu tomarā aviśvāsa karechile.
latin_ascii: sedina kataguli mukhamandala have svetavarna evam kataka mukhamandala have krsnavarna; atahpara yadera mukhamandala krsnavarna have, (taderake vala have) tahale ki tomara visvasa sthapanera para avisvasi hayechay ataeva tomara sastira asvada grahana kara, yehetu tomara avisvasa karechile.

latin_iast: āra yādera mukhamanḍala śubhra have, tārā āllāhara karuṇāra antarbhukta, tārā tanmadhye sadā avasthāna karave.
latin_ascii: ara yadera mukhamandala subhra have, tara allahara karunara antarbhukta, tara tanmadhye sada avasthana karave.

latin_iast: eguli hacche āllāhara nidarśana - yā āmi tomāra prati satyasaha āvṛtti karachi evaṃ āllāha viśva jagatera prati atyācārera icchā karenanā.
latin_ascii: eguli hacche allahara nidarsana - ya ami tomara prati satyasaha avrtti karachi evam allaha visva jagatera prati atyacarera iccha karenana.

latin_iast: āra yā nabhomanḍalera madhye āche o yā bhūmanḍalera madhye raẏeche tā āllāhara evaṃ āllāhara kāchei sava kichu pratyāvartanaśīla.
latin_ascii: ara ya nabhomandalera madhye ache o ya bhumandalera madhye rayeche ta allahara evam allahara kachei sava kichu pratyavartanasila.

latin_iast: tomarāi sarvottama ummāta, mānava jātira kalyāṇera janya tomādera udbhava ghaṭāno haẏeche, tomarā sat kāje ādeśa karave o asat kāje niṣedha karave evaṃ āllāhara prati viśvāsa sthāpana karave; āra yadi grantha prāptarā viśvāsa sthāpana karata tāhale avaśyai tādera janya maṅgala hata; tādera madhye keha keha mu’mina evaṃ tādera adhikāṃśai duskāryakārī.
latin_ascii: tomarai sarvottama ummata, manava jatira kalyanera janya tomadera udbhava ghatano hayeche, tomara sat kaje adesa karave o asat kaje nisedha karave evam allahara prati visvasa sthapana karave; ara yadi grantha praptara visvasa sthapana karata tahale avasyai tadera janya mangala hata; tadera madhye keha keha mu’mina evam tadera adhikamsai duskaryakari.

latin_iast: sāmānya duḥkha pradāna vyatīta tārā tomādera kona aniṣṭa karate pāravenā; āra yadi tārā tomādera sāthe lar̤āi kare tāhale tārā tomāderake pṛṣṭha pradarśana karave; ataḥpara tāderake sāhāyya karā havenā.
latin_ascii: samanya duhkha pradana vyatita tara tomadera kona anista karate paravena; ara yadi tara tomadera sathe larai kare tahale tara tomaderake prstha pradarsana karave; atahpara taderake sahayya kara havena.

latin_iast: āllāhara nikaṭa āśraẏa grahaṇa evaṃ manuṣyagaṇera nikaṭa atmasamarpaṇa vyatīta tārā yekhānei avasthāna karuka nā kena, lāñchanāẏa ākrānta haẏeche, āllāhara kope nipatita haẏeche evaṃ galagrahatā odera upara cāpiẏe deẏā haẏeche. eṭā e kāraṇe ye, tārā āllāhara nidarśanāvalīra prati aviśvāsa karechila evaṃ nāvīgaṇake anyāẏabhāve hatyā karechila; yehetu tārā viruddhācaraṇa karechila o sīmā atikrama karechila.
latin_ascii: allahara nikata asraya grahana evam manusyaganera nikata atmasamarpana vyatita tara yekhanei avasthana karuka na kena, lanchanaya akranta hayeche, allahara kope nipatita hayeche evam galagrahata odera upara capiye deya hayeche. eta e karane ye, tara allahara nidarsanavalira prati avisvasa karechila evam naviganake anyayabhave hatya karechila; yehetu tara viruddhacarana karechila o sima atikrama karechila.

latin_iast: tārā sakale samāna naẏa; āhale kitāvera madhye kichu loka raẏeche yārā gabhīra rāta paryanta āllāhara āẏātasamūha pāṭha kare evaṃ sājadāha kare.
latin_ascii: tara sakale samana naya; ahale kitavera madhye kichu loka rayeche yara gabhira rata paryanta allahara ayatasamuha patha kare evam sajadaha kare.

latin_iast: tārā āllāha o ākhirāta viśvāsa kare evaṃ sat kāje ādeśa o asat kāje niṣedha kare evaṃ sat kājasamūhe tatpara thāke, āra tārāi sat karmaśīlagaṇera antarbhukta.
latin_ascii: tara allaha o akhirata visvasa kare evam sat kaje adesa o asat kaje nisedha kare evam sat kajasamuhe tatpara thake, ara tarai sat karmasilaganera antarbhukta.

latin_iast: āra tārā ye sat kāja karave tā kakhanao avajñā karā havenā; evaṃ āllāha dharmabhīrugaṇake avagata āchena.
latin_ascii: ara tara ye sat kaja karave ta kakhanao avajna kara havena; evam allaha dharmabhiruganake avagata achena.

latin_iast: niścaẏai yārā aviśvāsa kareche tādera dhanarāśi o santāna-santati āllāhara nikaṭa kichumātra kāje āsavenā; evaṃ tārāi jāhānnāmera adhivāsī, tanmadhye tārā cirakāla avasthāna karave.
latin_ascii: niscayai yara avisvasa kareche tadera dhanarasi o santana-santati allahara nikata kichumatra kaje asavena; evam tarai jahannamera adhivasi, tanmadhye tara cirakala avasthana karave.

latin_iast: tārā pārthiva jīvane yā vyaẏa kare tāra dṛṣṭānta śaityapūrṇa jhañjhā-vāẏura anurūpa - yārā svīẏa jīvanera prati atyācāra kareche - oṭā sei sakala sampradāẏera śasyakṣete nipatita haẏa evaṃ tā vidhvasta kare. evaṃ āllāha tādera prati atyācāra karenani, varaṃ tārāi svīẏa jīvanera prati atyācāra kareche.
latin_ascii: tara parthiva jivane ya vyaya kare tara drstanta saityapurna jhanjha-vayura anurupa - yara sviya jivanera prati atyacara kareche - ota sei sakala sampradayera sasyaksete nipatita haya evam ta vidhvasta kare. evam allaha tadera prati atyacara karenani, varam tarai sviya jivanera prati atyacara kareche.

latin_iast: he viśvāsa sthāpanakārīgaṇa! tomarā nijedera sampradāẏa vyatireke anya kehake vandhu rūpe grahaṇa karanā, tārā tomāderake kṣatigrasta karate saṃkucita havenā; evaṃ tomarā yāte vipanna hao tārā tā’i kāmanā kare; vastutaḥ tādera mukha hatei śatrutā prakāśita haẏa, evaṃ tādera antara yā gopana kare tā ārao gurutara; niścaẏai āmi tomādera janya nidarśanāvalī vyakta karachi, yena tomarā vujhate pāra.
latin_ascii: he visvasa sthapanakarigana! tomara nijedera sampradaya vyatireke anya kehake vandhu rupe grahana karana, tara tomaderake ksatigrasta karate samkucita havena; evam tomara yate vipanna hao tara ta’i kamana kare; vastutah tadera mukha hatei satruta prakasita haya, evam tadera antara ya gopana kare ta arao gurutara; niscayai ami tomadera janya nidarsanavali vyakta karachi, yena tomara vujhate para.

latin_iast: sāvadhāna hao - tomarāi tāderake bhālavāsa, athaca tārā tomāderake bhālavāsenā; evaṃ tomarā samasta granthai viśvāsa kara; āra tārā yakhana tomādera sāthe milita haẏa takhana valeḥ āmarā viśvāsa sthāpana karechi evaṃ yakhana tomādera hate pṛthaka haẏe yāẏa takhana tomādera prati ākrośe āṅgulera agrabhāgasamūha daṃśana kare. tumi valaḥ tomarā nijedera ākrośe mare yāo! niścaẏai āllāha antarera kathā jñāta āchena.
latin_ascii: savadhana hao - tomarai taderake bhalavasa, athaca tara tomaderake bhalavasena; evam tomara samasta granthai visvasa kara; ara tara yakhana tomadera sathe milita haya takhana valeh amara visvasa sthapana karechi evam yakhana tomadera hate prthaka haye yaya takhana tomadera prati akrose angulera agrabhagasamuha damsana kare. tumi valah tomara nijedera akrose mare yao! niscayai allaha antarera katha jnata achena.

latin_iast: yadi tomāderake kalyāṇa sparśa kare tāhale tārā asantaṣṭa haẏa; āra yadi amaṅgala upasthita haẏa takhana tārā ānandita haẏe thāke, evaṃ yadi tomarā dhairya dhāraṇa kara o saṃyamī hao tāhale tādera cakrānta tomādera konai kṣati karate pāravenā. tārā yā kare - niścaẏai āllāha tāra pariveṣṭanakārī.
latin_ascii: yadi tomaderake kalyana sparsa kare tahale tara asantasta haya; ara yadi amangala upasthita haya takhana tara anandita haye thake, evam yadi tomara dhairya dharana kara o samyami hao tahale tadera cakranta tomadera konai ksati karate paravena. tara ya kare - niscayai allaha tara parivestanakari.

latin_iast: (smaraṇa kara) yakhana tumi viśvāsīderake yuddhārthe yathāsthāne saṃsthāpita karāra janya prabhāte svīẏa parijana hate vera haẏechile evaṃ āllāha sava kichu śravaṇa karena o jānena.
latin_ascii: (smarana kara) yakhana tumi visvasiderake yuddharthe yathasthane samsthapita karara janya prabhate sviya parijana hate vera hayechile evam allaha sava kichu sravana karena o janena.

latin_iast: yakhana tomādera dui dala bhīrutā prakāśera saṃkalpa karechila evaṃ āllāha sei daladvaẏera pṛṣṭhapoṣaka chilena; evaṃ mu’minagaṇai āllāhara upara nirbhara kare thāke.
latin_ascii: yakhana tomadera dui dala bhiruta prakasera samkalpa karechila evam allaha sei daladvayera prsthaposaka chilena; evam mu’minaganai allahara upara nirbhara kare thake.

latin_iast: āra niścaẏai āllāha tomāderake vadare sāhāyya karechilena evaṃ tomarā durvala chile; ataeva tomarā āllāhake bhaẏa kara, yena tomarā kṛtajña hao.
latin_ascii: ara niscayai allaha tomaderake vadare sahayya karechilena evam tomara durvala chile; ataeva tomara allahake bhaya kara, yena tomara krtajna hao.

latin_iast: yakhana mu’minaderake valechilenaḥ eṭā ki tomādera pakṣe yatheṣṭa naẏa ye, tomādera rāvva tina sahasra mālāikā/phereśatā preraṇa kare tomādera sāhāyya karavena?
latin_ascii: yakhana mu’minaderake valechilenah eta ki tomadera pakse yathesta naya ye, tomadera ravva tina sahasra malaika/pheresata prerana kare tomadera sahayya karavenay

latin_iast: varaṃ yadi tomarā dhairya dhāraṇa kara o saṃyamī hao evaṃ tārā yadi svecchāẏa tomādera upara nipatita haẏa tāhale tomādera rāvva pā~ca sahasra viśiṣṭa mālāikā dvārā tomāderake sāhāyya karavena.
latin_ascii: varam yadi tomara dhairya dharana kara o samyami hao evam tara yadi svecchaya tomadera upara nipatita haya tahale tomadera ravva pa~ca sahasra visista malaika dvara tomaderake sahayya karavena.

latin_iast: āra āllāha ei sāhāyya śudhu e janyai karechena yena tomādera janya susaṃvāda haẏa evaṃ tomādera antare śānti āse. āra sāhāyya śudhu āllāhara pakṣa hatei haẏe thāke, yini parākrānta, vijñānamaẏa.
latin_ascii: ara allaha ei sahayya sudhu e janyai karechena yena tomadera janya susamvada haya evam tomadera antare santi ase. ara sahayya sudhu allahara paksa hatei haye thake, yini parakranta, vijnanamaya.

latin_iast: yārā aviśvāsī haẏeche - tini erūpe tādera ekāṃśake kartita karena athavā tāderake durvala karena, yāte tārā akṛtakārya sahakāre phire yāẏa.
latin_ascii: yara avisvasi hayeche - tini erupe tadera ekamsake kartita karena athava taderake durvala karena, yate tara akrtakarya sahakare phire yaya.

latin_iast: e vyāpāre tomāra konai karaṇīẏa nei, tini tāderake kṣamā karena athavā śāsti pradāna karena; niścaẏai tārā atyācārī.
latin_ascii: e vyapare tomara konai karaniya nei, tini taderake ksama karena athava sasti pradana karena; niscayai tara atyacari.

latin_iast: āra nabhoḥmanḍale yā raẏeche o bhūmanḍale yā āche tā āllāharai; tini yāke icchā kṣamā karena evaṃ yāke icchā śāsti pradāna karena evaṃ āllāha kṣamāśīla, parama karuṇāmaẏa.
latin_ascii: ara nabhohmandale ya rayeche o bhumandale ya ache ta allaharai; tini yake iccha ksama karena evam yake iccha sasti pradana karena evam allaha ksamasila, parama karunamaya.

latin_iast: he īmānadāragaṇa! tomarā dviguṇera upara dviguṇa suda bhakṣaṇa karanā evaṃ āllāhake bhaẏa kara yena tomarā suphala prāpta hao.
latin_ascii: he imanadaragana! tomara dvigunera upara dviguna suda bhaksana karana evam allahake bhaya kara yena tomara suphala prapta hao.

latin_iast: āra tomarā sei jāhānnāmera bhaẏa kara, yā aviśvāsīdera janya prastuta rākhā haẏeche.
latin_ascii: ara tomara sei jahannamera bhaya kara, ya avisvasidera janya prastuta rakha hayeche.

latin_iast: āra āllāha o rāsūlera ānugatya svīkāra kara yena tomarā karuṇā prāpta hao.
latin_ascii: ara allaha o rasulera anugatya svikara kara yena tomara karuna prapta hao.

latin_iast: tomarā svīẏa ravera kṣamā o jānnātera dike dhāvita hao, yāra prasāratā nabhomanḍala o bhūmanḍala sadṛśa, oṭā dharmabhīrudera janya nirmita haẏeche.
latin_ascii: tomara sviya ravera ksama o jannatera dike dhavita hao, yara prasarata nabhomandala o bhumandala sadrsa, ota dharmabhirudera janya nirmita hayeche.

latin_iast: yārā svacchalatā o abhāvera madhye vyaẏa kare evaṃ krodha saṃvaraṇa kare o mānavaderake kṣamā kare; evaṃ āllāha satkarmaśīladera bhālavāsena.
latin_ascii: yara svacchalata o abhavera madhye vyaya kare evam krodha samvarana kare o manavaderake ksama kare; evam allaha satkarmasiladera bhalavasena.

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana keha aślīla kāja kare kiṃvā svīẏa jīvanera prati atyācāra kare ataḥpara āllāhake smaraṇa kare evaṃ aparādhasamūhera janya kṣamā prārthanā kare, evaṃ āllāha vyatīta ke aparādhasamūha kṣamā karate pāre? evaṃ tārā yā karache sei vyāpāre jene śune haṭhakāritā karenā.
latin_ascii: evam yakhana keha aslila kaja kare kimva sviya jivanera prati atyacara kare atahpara allahake smarana kare evam aparadhasamuhera janya ksama prarthana kare, evam allaha vyatita ke aparadhasamuha ksama karate parey evam tara ya karache sei vyapare jene sune hathakarita karena.

latin_iast: tādera puraskāra have tādera ravera nikaṭa hate mārjanā evaṃ emana udyānasamūha yegulira taladeśa diẏe srotasvinīsamūha pravāhita thākave, tanmadhye tārā sadā avasthāna karave, evaṃ karmīdera janya ki sundara pratidāna!
latin_ascii: tadera puraskara have tadera ravera nikata hate marjana evam emana udyanasamuha yegulira taladesa diye srotasvinisamuha pravahita thakave, tanmadhye tara sada avasthana karave, evam karmidera janya ki sundara pratidana!

latin_iast: niścaẏai tomādera pūrve vahu jīvanācaraṇa atikrānta haẏeche, pṛthivīte vicaraṇa kara, evaṃ lakṣya kara ye, aviśvāsīdera pariṇāma kirūpa haẏeche.
latin_ascii: niscayai tomadera purve vahu jivanacarana atikranta hayeche, prthivite vicarana kara, evam laksya kara ye, avisvasidera parinama kirupa hayeche.

latin_iast: eṭā mānavamanḍalīra janya vivaraṇa evaṃ āllāhabhīrugaṇera janya patha pradarśana o upadeśa.
latin_ascii: eta manavamandalira janya vivarana evam allahabhiruganera janya patha pradarsana o upadesa.

latin_iast: āra tomarā nirāśa haẏonā o viṣanna haẏonā evaṃ yadi tomarā viśvāsī hao tāhale tomarāi vijaẏī have.
latin_ascii: ara tomara nirasa hayona o visanna hayona evam yadi tomara visvasi hao tahale tomarai vijayi have.

latin_iast: yadi tomādera āghāta lege thāke tāhale niścaẏai sei sampradāẏerao tadrupa āghāta legeche, evaṃ ei dinasamūhake āmi mānavagaṇera madhye parikramaṇa karāi; evaṃ yārā viśvāsa sthāpana kareche tāderake āllāha ei rūpe prakāśa karena; evaṃ tomādera madhya hate katakake śahīda rūpe grahaṇa karavena, āra āllāha atyācārīderake bhālavāsenanā.
latin_ascii: yadi tomadera aghata lege thake tahale niscayai sei sampradayerao tadrupa aghata legeche, evam ei dinasamuhake ami manavaganera madhye parikramana karai; evam yara visvasa sthapana kareche taderake allaha ei rupe prakasa karena; evam tomadera madhya hate katakake sahida rupe grahana karavena, ara allaha atyacariderake bhalavasenana.

latin_iast: āra yārā viśvāsa sthāpana kareche tāderake āllāha eirūpe pavitra karena evaṃ aviśvāsīderake dhvaṃsa karena.
latin_ascii: ara yara visvasa sthapana kareche taderake allaha eirupe pavitra karena evam avisvasiderake dhvamsa karena.

latin_iast: tomarā ki dhāraṇā karacha ye, tomarāi jānnāte praveśa karave? athaca kārā jihāda kare o kārā dhairyaśīla āllāha tomādera madhya hate tāderake ekhanao parīkṣā karenani?
latin_ascii: tomara ki dharana karacha ye, tomarai jannate pravesa karavey athaca kara jihada kare o kara dhairyasila allaha tomadera madhya hate taderake ekhanao pariksa karenaniy

latin_iast: evaṃ niścaẏai tomarā mṛtyura pūrvei ora sākṣāt kāmanā karachile, anantara niścaẏai tomarā ekhana tā pratyakṣa karacha tomādera nijedera cokhe.
latin_ascii: evam niscayai tomara mrtyura purvei ora saksat kamana karachile, anantara niscayai tomara ekhana ta pratyaksa karacha tomadera nijedera cokhe.

latin_iast: evaṃ muhāmmāda rāsūla vyatīta kichui naẏa, niścaẏai tāra pūrve rāsūlagaṇa vigata haẏeche, anantara yadi tāra mṛtyu haẏa athavā se nihata haẏa tāhale ki tomarā paścādapade phire yāve? evaṃ ye keha paścādapade phire yāẏa tāte se āllāhara konai aniṣṭa karavenā evaṃ āllāha kṛtajñagaṇake puraskāra pradāna karena.
latin_ascii: evam muhammada rasula vyatita kichui naya, niscayai tara purve rasulagana vigata hayeche, anantara yadi tara mrtyu haya athava se nihata haya tahale ki tomara pascadapade phire yavey evam ye keha pascadapade phire yaya tate se allahara konai anista karavena evam allaha krtajnaganake puraskara pradana karena.

latin_iast: āra āllāhara ādeśe lipivaddha nirdiṣṭa samaẏa vyatīta kehai mṛtyumukhe patita haẏanā; evaṃ ye keha ihalokera pratidāna kāmanā kare, āmi tāke tā duniẏāẏa pradāna kare thāki; pakṣāntare ye loka ākhirāte vinimaẏa kāmanā kare āmi tāke tā pradāna karava evaṃ āmi kṛtajñagaṇake acirei puraskāra pradāna karava.
latin_ascii: ara allahara adese lipivaddha nirdista samaya vyatita kehai mrtyumukhe patita hayana; evam ye keha ihalokera pratidana kamana kare, ami take ta duniyaya pradana kare thaki; paksantare ye loka akhirate vinimaya kamana kare ami take ta pradana karava evam ami krtajnaganake acirei puraskara pradana karava.

latin_iast: āra emana aneka nāvī chila yārā saṅgīsahayoge anuvartī haẏe yuddha karechila; paranta āllāhara pathe yā saṃghaṭita haẏechila tāte tārā nirutsāha haẏani o śaktihīna haẏani evaṃ vicalita haẏani. evaṃ āllāha dhairyaśīlagaṇake bhālavāsena.
latin_ascii: ara emana aneka navi chila yara sangisahayoge anuvarti haye yuddha karechila; paranta allahara pathe ya samghatita hayechila tate tara nirutsaha hayani o saktihina hayani evam vicalita hayani. evam allaha dhairyasilaganake bhalavasena.

latin_iast: āra etadvyatīta tādera kathā chilanā ye, tārā valataḥ he āmādera rāvva! āmādera aparādha o āmādera kājera vār̤āvār̤i hetu kṛta anyāẏasamūha kṣamā karuna, āmāderake dṛr̤ha rākhuna evaṃ aviśvāsīdera viruddhe āmāderake sāhāyya karuna.
latin_ascii: ara etadvyatita tadera katha chilana ye, tara valatah he amadera ravva! amadera aparadha o amadera kajera varavari hetu krta anyayasamuha ksama karuna, amaderake drrha rakhuna evam avisvasidera viruddhe amaderake sahayya karuna.

latin_iast: anantara āllāha tāderake pārthiva puraskāra pradāna karalena evaṃ paralokera puraskāra śreṣṭhatara; evaṃ āllāha satkarmaśīlagaṇake bhālavāsena.
latin_ascii: anantara allaha taderake parthiva puraskara pradana karalena evam paralokera puraskara sresthatara; evam allaha satkarmasilaganake bhalavasena.

latin_iast: he mu’minagaṇa! yārā aviśvāsa kareche, yadi tomarā tādera ājñāvaha hao tāhale tārā tomāderake paścādapade phiriẏe nive, tāte tomarā kṣatigrasta have.
latin_ascii: he mu’minagana! yara avisvasa kareche, yadi tomara tadera ajnavaha hao tahale tara tomaderake pascadapade phiriye nive, tate tomara ksatigrasta have.

latin_iast: varaṃ āllāha tomādera abhibhāvaka evaṃ tinii śreṣṭhatara sāhāyyakārī.
latin_ascii: varam allaha tomadera abhibhavaka evam tinii sresthatara sahayyakari.

latin_iast: yārā aviśvāsa kareche, āmi sattvara tādera antare bhīti sañcāra karava, yehetu tārā āllāhara sāthe sei viṣaẏe aṃśī sthāpana kareche yadviṣaẏe tini kona pramāṇa avatīrṇa karenani evaṃ jāhānnāma tādera avasthāna sthala evaṃ oṭā atyācārīdera janya nikṛṣṭa vāsasthāna!
latin_ascii: yara avisvasa kareche, ami sattvara tadera antare bhiti sancara karava, yehetu tara allahara sathe sei visaye amsi sthapana kareche yadvisaye tini kona pramana avatirna karenani evam jahannama tadera avasthana sthala evam ota atyacaridera janya nikrsta vasasthana!

latin_iast: āra niścaẏai āllāha tomādera prati deẏā tā~ra aṅgīkāra pūrṇa karechena yakhana tomarā tā~ra anumatikrame tomādera śatrudera vināśa karachile tomarā sāhasahārā haẏe yāoẏā paryanta evaṃ nirdeśa samparke vivāda karachile o avādhya haẏechile. ataḥpara tomarā yā pachanda kara (vijaẏa) tā tomādera pratyakṣa karālena. tomādera madhye emana kichu loka āche yārā pārthiva vastta kāmanā kare evaṃ kichu loka parakāla pachanda kare. ataḥpara tini tomādera parīkṣā karāra janya śatrudera theke phiriẏe dilena evaṃ niścaẏai tini tomāderake kṣamā karalena. āllāha viśvāsīdera prati anugrahaśīla.
latin_ascii: ara niscayai allaha tomadera prati deya ta~ra angikara purna karechena yakhana tomara ta~ra anumatikrame tomadera satrudera vinasa karachile tomara sahasahara haye yaoya paryanta evam nirdesa samparke vivada karachile o avadhya hayechile. atahpara tomara ya pachanda kara (vijaya) ta tomadera pratyaksa karalena. tomadera madhye emana kichu loka ache yara parthiva vastta kamana kare evam kichu loka parakala pachanda kare. atahpara tini tomadera pariksa karara janya satrudera theke phiriye dilena evam niscayai tini tomaderake ksama karalena. allaha visvasidera prati anugrahasila.

latin_iast: āra yakhana tomarā ārohaṇa kare yācchile evaṃ kārao dike phireo dekhachilenā evaṃ rāsūla tomāderake paścāda hate āhavāna karachila; anantara tini tomāderake duḥkhera upara duḥkha pradāna karalena. kintu yā atikrānta haẏeche evaṃ tomādera upara yā upanīta haẏani, tomarā tajjanya duḥkha karanā; evaṃ tomarā yā karacha āllāha tadviṣaẏe abhijña.
latin_ascii: ara yakhana tomara arohana kare yacchile evam karao dike phireo dekhachilena evam rasula tomaderake pascada hate ahavana karachila; anantara tini tomaderake duhkhera upara duhkha pradana karalena. kintu ya atikranta hayeche evam tomadera upara ya upanita hayani, tomara tajjanya duhkha karana; evam tomara ya karacha allaha tadvisaye abhijna.

latin_iast: anantara tini duḥkhera pare tomādera upara śānti avataraṇa karalena, tā chila tandrā, yā tomādera eka dalake tandrācchanna karechila, āra ekadala nijedera jīvanera janya cintā karachila; tārā āllāha samvandhe ajñatāra anurūpa dhāraṇā poṣaṇa karachila. tārā valechilaḥ e viṣaẏe ki āmādera kona adhikāra nei? tumi valaḥ sakala viṣaẏe āllāhara adhikāra. tārā nijedera antare yā gopana rākhe tā tomāra nikaṭa prakāśa karenā; tārā valeḥ yadi e viṣaẏe āmādera kona adhikāra thākato tāhale ekhāne āmarā nihata hatāmanā. tumi valaḥ yadi tomarā tomādera gṛhera madhyeo thākate tavuo yādera prati mṛtyu vidhivaddha haẏeche tārā niścaẏai svīẏa mṛtyu sthāne ese upasthita hata; tomādera antarera madhye yā āche, āllāha tā parīkṣā kare thākena; evaṃ āllāha manera antarnihita bhāva jñāta āchena.
latin_ascii: anantara tini duhkhera pare tomadera upara santi avatarana karalena, ta chila tandra, ya tomadera eka dalake tandracchanna karechila, ara ekadala nijedera jivanera janya cinta karachila; tara allaha samvandhe ajnatara anurupa dharana posana karachila. tara valechilah e visaye ki amadera kona adhikara neiy tumi valah sakala visaye allahara adhikara. tara nijedera antare ya gopana rakhe ta tomara nikata prakasa karena; tara valeh yadi e visaye amadera kona adhikara thakato tahale ekhane amara nihata hatamana. tumi valah yadi tomara tomadera grhera madhyeo thakate tavuo yadera prati mrtyu vidhivaddha hayeche tara niscayai sviya mrtyu sthane ese upasthita hata; tomadera antarera madhye ya ache, allaha ta pariksa kare thakena; evam allaha manera antarnihita bhava jnata achena.

latin_iast: niścaẏai tomādera madhye yārā du’dalera sammukhīna haoẏāra dina paścādavartīta haẏechila tāra kāraṇa śāitāna tāderake pratārita karechila tāderai kono pāpera kāraṇe. kintu āllāha tāderake kṣamā karechena; niścaẏai āllāha kṣamāśīla, sahiṣṇu.
latin_ascii: niscayai tomadera madhye yara du’dalera sammukhina haoyara dina pascadavartita hayechila tara karana saitana taderake pratarita karechila taderai kono papera karane. kintu allaha taderake ksama karechena; niscayai allaha ksamasila, sahisnu.

latin_iast: he mu’minagaṇa! yārā aviśvāsa kareche tomarā tādera mata haẏonā; evaṃ yakhana tādera bhrātṛgaṇa pṛthivīte kona abhiyāne vera haẏa athavā yuddhe nihata haẏa takhana tārā valeḥ yadi orā āmādera nikaṭa thākato tāhale mṛtyumukhe patita hatanā athavā nihata hatanā; āllāha erūpe tādera antare duḥkha o anutāpa sañcāra karena, āllāhai jīvana dāna karena o mṛtyu dena evaṃ tomarā yā karacha tatprati āllāha lakṣyakārī.
latin_ascii: he mu’minagana! yara avisvasa kareche tomara tadera mata hayona; evam yakhana tadera bhratrgana prthivite kona abhiyane vera haya athava yuddhe nihata haya takhana tara valeh yadi ora amadera nikata thakato tahale mrtyumukhe patita hatana athava nihata hatana; allaha erupe tadera antare duhkha o anutapa sancara karena, allahai jivana dana karena o mrtyu dena evam tomara ya karacha tatprati allaha laksyakari.

latin_iast: āra yadi tomarā āllāhara pathe nihata athavā mṛtyumukhe patita hao tāhale āllāhara nikaṭa hatei kṣamā raẏeche evaṃ tārā yā sañcaẏa kareche tadapekṣā tā~ra karuṇā śreṣṭhatara.
latin_ascii: ara yadi tomara allahara pathe nihata athava mrtyumukhe patita hao tahale allahara nikata hatei ksama rayeche evam tara ya sancaya kareche tadapeksa ta~ra karuna sresthatara.

latin_iast: āra yadi tomarā mṛtyuvaraṇa kara kiṃvā nihata hao tāhale tomāderake avaśyai āllāhara dike ekatrita karā have.
latin_ascii: ara yadi tomara mrtyuvarana kara kimva nihata hao tahale tomaderake avasyai allahara dike ekatrita kara have.

latin_iast: ataeva āllāhara anugraha ei ye, tumi tādera prati komala citta; evaṃ tumi yadi karkaśabhāṣī, kaṭhora hṛdaẏa hate tāhale niścaẏai tārā tomāra saṃsarga hate antarhita hata. ataeva tumi tāderake kṣamā kara o tādera janya kṣamā prārthanā kara evaṃ kārya samvandhe tādera sāthe parāmarśa kara; ataḥpara tumi yakhana saṃkalpa kara takhana āllāhara prati nirbhara kara; evaṃ niścaẏai āllāha tā~ra upara bharasākārīgaṇake bhālavāsena.
latin_ascii: ataeva allahara anugraha ei ye, tumi tadera prati komala citta; evam tumi yadi karkasabhasi, kathora hrdaya hate tahale niscayai tara tomara samsarga hate antarhita hata. ataeva tumi taderake ksama kara o tadera janya ksama prarthana kara evam karya samvandhe tadera sathe paramarsa kara; atahpara tumi yakhana samkalpa kara takhana allahara prati nirbhara kara; evam niscayai allaha ta~ra upara bharasakariganake bhalavasena.

latin_iast: yadi āllāha tomāderake sāhāyya karena tāhale kehai tomādera upara jaẏayukta havenā; evaṃ yadi tini tomāderake parityāga karena tāhale tā~ra pare āra ke āche ye tomāderake sāhāyya karate pāre? evaṃ viśvāsīgaṇa āllāhara uparei nirbhara kare thāke.
latin_ascii: yadi allaha tomaderake sahayya karena tahale kehai tomadera upara jayayukta havena; evam yadi tini tomaderake parityaga karena tahale ta~ra pare ara ke ache ye tomaderake sahayya karate parey evam visvasigana allahara uparei nirbhara kare thake.

latin_iast: āra kona nāvīra pakṣe kona viṣaẏa gopana karā śobhanīẏa naẏa; evaṃ ye keha gopana karave tāhale se yā gopana kareche tā utthāna dine ānaẏana karā have; anantara pratyeka vyakti yā arjana kareche tā pūrṇarūpe pradatta have evaṃ tārā niryātita havenā.
latin_ascii: ara kona navira pakse kona visaya gopana kara sobhaniya naya; evam ye keha gopana karave tahale se ya gopana kareche ta utthana dine anayana kara have; anantara pratyeka vyakti ya arjana kareche ta purnarupe pradatta have evam tara niryatita havena.

latin_iast: ye āllāhara santuṣṭira anusaraṇa kareche se ki tāra mata hate pāre, ye āllāhara ākrośe patita haẏeche? evaṃ tāra vāsasthāna jāhānnāma evaṃ oṭā nikṛṣṭa gantavya sthāna.
latin_ascii: ye allahara santustira anusarana kareche se ki tara mata hate pare, ye allahara akrose patita hayechey evam tara vasasthana jahannama evam ota nikrsta gantavya sthana.

latin_iast: āllāhara nikaṭa mānuṣera vibhinna padamaryādā raẏeche evaṃ tomarā yā karacha tadviṣaẏe āllāha lakṣyakārī.
latin_ascii: allahara nikata manusera vibhinna padamaryada rayeche evam tomara ya karacha tadvisaye allaha laksyakari.

latin_iast: niścaẏai āllāha mu’minadera prati anugraha karechena, tini tādera nijederai madhya hate rāsūla preraṇa karechena, ye tādera nikaṭa tā~ra nidarśanāvalī pāṭha kare o tāderake pavitra kare evaṃ tāderake grantha o vijñāna śikṣā dāna kare evaṃ niścaẏai tārā era pūrve prakāśya bhrāntira madhye chila.
latin_ascii: niscayai allaha mu’minadera prati anugraha karechena, tini tadera nijederai madhya hate rasula prerana karechena, ye tadera nikata ta~ra nidarsanavali patha kare o taderake pavitra kare evam taderake grantha o vijnana siksa dana kare evam niscayai tara era purve prakasya bhrantira madhye chila.

latin_iast: hyā~, yakhana tomādera upara vipada upasthita hala, vastutaḥ tomarāo tādera prati tadanurūpa du’vāra vipada upasthita karechile, tomarā valechileḥ eṭā kothā hate hala? tumi valaḥ oṭā tomādera nijederai nikaṭa hate; niścaẏai āllāha sarva viṣaẏopari śaktimāna.
latin_ascii: hya~, yakhana tomadera upara vipada upasthita hala, vastutah tomarao tadera prati tadanurupa du’vara vipada upasthita karechile, tomara valechileh eta kotha hate halay tumi valah ota tomadera nijederai nikata hate; niscayai allaha sarva visayopari saktimana.

latin_iast: ei dui dalera sammukhīna haoẏāra dine tomādera upara yā āpatita haẏechila tā āllāharai icchākrame; evaṃ taddārā āllāha viśvāsīderake parīkṣā karena.
latin_ascii: ei dui dalera sammukhina haoyara dine tomadera upara ya apatita hayechila ta allaharai icchakrame; evam taddara allaha visvasiderake pariksa karena.

latin_iast: āra taddārā tini munāphikaderake paricita karena; evaṃ tāderake valā haẏechilaḥ eso, āllāhara pathe saṃgrāma kara athavā śatruderake pratihata kara; tārā valechilaḥ yadi āmarā jānatāma ye, lar̤āi have tāhale avaśyai āmarā tomādera anugamana karatāma. tārā sedina viśvāsa apekṣā aviśvāsera nikaṭavartī chila; tādera antare yā nei tā’i tārā mukhe vale thāke; tārā ye viṣaẏa gopana kare āllāha tā jñāta āchena.
latin_ascii: ara taddara tini munaphikaderake paricita karena; evam taderake vala hayechilah eso, allahara pathe samgrama kara athava satruderake pratihata kara; tara valechilah yadi amara janatama ye, larai have tahale avasyai amara tomadera anugamana karatama. tara sedina visvasa apeksa avisvasera nikatavarti chila; tadera antare ya nei ta’i tara mukhe vale thake; tara ye visaya gopana kare allaha ta jnata achena.

latin_iast: orā tārā, yārā gṛhe vase svīẏa nihata bhāidera samvandhe valeḥ yadi tārā āmādera kathā mānya karata tāhale nihata hatanā; tumi valaḥ yadi tomarā satyavādī hao tāhale nijederake mṛtyu hate rakṣā kara.
latin_ascii: ora tara, yara grhe vase sviya nihata bhaidera samvandhe valeh yadi tara amadera katha manya karata tahale nihata hatana; tumi valah yadi tomara satyavadi hao tahale nijederake mrtyu hate raksa kara.

latin_iast: yārā āllāhara pathe nihata haẏeche tāderake kakhanao mṛta mane karanā; varaṃ tārā jīvita, tārā tādera rāvva hate jīvikā prāpta.
