latin_ascii: yara allahara pathe nihata hayeche taderake kakhanao mrta mane karana; varam tara jivita, tara tadera ravva hate jivika prapta.

latin_iast: āllāha tāderake svīẏa anugraha hate yā dāna karechena tātei tārā parituṣṭa; evaṃ tādera bhāiẏerā yārā ekhano tādera sāthe sammilita haẏani tādera ei avasthāra pratio tārā santuṣṭa haẏa ye, tādera kona bhaẏa nei evaṃ tārā duḥkhita havenā.
latin_ascii: allaha taderake sviya anugraha hate ya dana karechena tatei tara paritusta; evam tadera bhaiyera yara ekhano tadera sathe sammilita hayani tadera ei avasthara pratio tara santusta haya ye, tadera kona bhaya nei evam tara duhkhita havena.

latin_iast: tārā āllāhara nikaṭa hate anugraha o ni‘āmāta lābha karāra kāraṇe ānandita haẏa; āra e janya ye, niścaẏai āllāha viśvāsīgaṇera pratidāna vinaṣṭa karenanā.
latin_ascii: tara allahara nikata hate anugraha o ni‘amata labha karara karane anandita haya; ara e janya ye, niscayai allaha visvasiganera pratidana vinasta karenana.

latin_iast: yārā āghāta pāoẏāra pareo āllāha o rāsūlera nirdeśake mānya kareche tādera madhye yārā sat kāja kareche o saṃyata haẏeche tādera janya raẏeche mahāna pratidāna.
latin_ascii: yara aghata paoyara pareo allaha o rasulera nirdesake manya kareche tadera madhye yara sat kaja kareche o samyata hayeche tadera janya rayeche mahana pratidana.

latin_iast: yāderake lokerā valechilaḥ niścaẏai tomādera viruddhe sei sava loka samaveta haẏeche; ataeva tomarā tāderake bhaẏa kara; kintu ete tādera viśvāsa parivardhita haẏechila evaṃ tārā valechilaḥ āllāhai āmādera janya yatheṣṭa evaṃ tini maṅgalamaẏa, karmavidhāẏaka.
latin_ascii: yaderake lokera valechilah niscayai tomadera viruddhe sei sava loka samaveta hayeche; ataeva tomara taderake bhaya kara; kintu ete tadera visvasa parivardhita hayechila evam tara valechilah allahai amadera janya yathesta evam tini mangalamaya, karmavidhayaka.

latin_iast: anantara tārā āllāhara anugraha sampadasaha pratyāvartīta haẏechila, tāderake amaṅgala sparśa kareni evaṃ tārā āllāhara santuṣṭira anusaraṇa karechila; āra āllāhara anugraha ati vyāpaka.
latin_ascii: anantara tara allahara anugraha sampadasaha pratyavartita hayechila, taderake amangala sparsa kareni evam tara allahara santustira anusarana karechila; ara allahara anugraha ati vyapaka.

latin_iast: niścaẏai śāitāna śudhumātra tāra alī hate tomāderake bhaẏa pradarśana kare; kintu yadi tomarā viśvāsī hao tāhale tāderake bhaẏa karanā; evaṃ āmākei bhaẏa kara.
latin_ascii: niscayai saitana sudhumatra tara ali hate tomaderake bhaya pradarsana kare; kintu yadi tomara visvasi hao tahale taderake bhaya karana; evam amakei bhaya kara.

latin_iast: āra yārā aviśvāse tatpara, tumi tādera janya viṣanna haẏonā; vastutaḥ tārā āllāhara kona aniṣṭa karate pāravenā; āllāha tādera janya ākhirāte kona kalyāṇa icchā karenanā evaṃ tāderai janya kaṭhora śāsti raẏeche.
latin_ascii: ara yara avisvase tatpara, tumi tadera janya visanna hayona; vastutah tara allahara kona anista karate paravena; allaha tadera janya akhirate kona kalyana iccha karenana evam taderai janya kathora sasti rayeche.

latin_iast: niścaẏai yārā viśvāsera parivarte aviśvāsa kraẏa kareche tārā āllāhara konai aniṣṭa karate pāravenā evaṃ tādera janya raẏeche yantranādāẏaka śāsti.
latin_ascii: niscayai yara visvasera parivarte avisvasa kraya kareche tara allahara konai anista karate paravena evam tadera janya rayeche yantranadayaka sasti.

latin_iast: aviśvāsīrā yena e dhāraṇā nā kare ye, āmi tāderake ye avakāśa diẏechi tā tādera jīvanera janya kalyāṇakara; tārā svīẏa pāpa vardhita karave e janyai āmi tāderake avakāśa pradāna kari; evaṃ tādera janya apamānakara śāsti raẏeche.
latin_ascii: avisvasira yena e dharana na kare ye, ami taderake ye avakasa diyechi ta tadera jivanera janya kalyanakara; tara sviya papa vardhita karave e janyai ami taderake avakasa pradana kari; evam tadera janya apamanakara sasti rayeche.

latin_iast: satke asat (munāphika) hate pṛthaka nā karā paryanta āllāha mu’minaderake, tārā ye avasthāẏa āche ai avasthāẏa rekhe dite pārenanā, āra gāivera khavarao tāderake avahita karavenanā, tave tā~ra rāsūladera madhya theke yāke icchā grahaṇa karena. sutarāṃ tomarā āllāhake o tā~ra rāsūlake viśvāsa kara. evaṃ yadi viśvāsa kara o bhāla ‘āmala kara tāhale tomādera janya raẏeche mahā puraskāra.
latin_ascii: satke asat (munaphika) hate prthaka na kara paryanta allaha mu’minaderake, tara ye avasthaya ache ai avasthaya rekhe dite parenana, ara gaivera khavarao taderake avahita karavenana, tave ta~ra rasuladera madhya theke yake iccha grahana karena. sutaram tomara allahake o ta~ra rasulake visvasa kara. evam yadi visvasa kara o bhala ‘amala kara tahale tomadera janya rayeche maha puraskara.

latin_iast: āra āllāha yāderake svīẏa anugrahe kichu dāna karechena tadviṣaẏe yārā kārpaṇya kare tārā yena erūpa dhāraṇā nā kare ye, oṭā tādera janya kalyāṇakara; varaṃ oṭā tādera janya kṣatikara; tārā ye viṣaẏe kṛpaṇatā kareche utthāna dine oṭāi tādera kanṭha-nigar̤a have; evaṃ āllāha nabhomanḍala o bhūmanḍalera svatvādhikārī evaṃ yā tomarā karacha āllāha tadviṣaẏe pūrṇa khavara rākhena.
latin_ascii: ara allaha yaderake sviya anugrahe kichu dana karechena tadvisaye yara karpanya kare tara yena erupa dharana na kare ye, ota tadera janya kalyanakara; varam ota tadera janya ksatikara; tara ye visaye krpanata kareche utthana dine otai tadera kantha-nigara have; evam allaha nabhomandala o bhumandalera svatvadhikari evam ya tomara karacha allaha tadvisaye purna khavara rakhena.

latin_iast: avaśyai āllāha tādera kathā śravaṇa karechena yārā vale thāke ye, āllāha daridra o tārā dhanavāna; tārā yā valache evaṃ tādera anyāẏabhāve nāvīgaṇake hatyā karā āmi lipivaddha karava; evaṃ tāderake valavaḥ tomarā jvalanta āgunera śāstira āsvāda grahaṇa kara.
latin_ascii: avasyai allaha tadera katha sravana karechena yara vale thake ye, allaha daridra o tara dhanavana; tara ya valache evam tadera anyayabhave naviganake hatya kara ami lipivaddha karava; evam taderake valavah tomara jvalanta agunera sastira asvada grahana kara.

latin_iast: eṭā tā’i yā tomādera hastasamūha pūrve preraṇa kareche evaṃ niścaẏai āllāha atyācārī nana, yārā tā~ke sevā kare tādera prati.
latin_ascii: eta ta’i ya tomadera hastasamuha purve prerana kareche evam niscayai allaha atyacari nana, yara ta~ke seva kare tadera prati.

latin_iast: yārā vale thāke, avaśyai āllāha āmādera theke aṅgīkāra niẏechena ye, agni yā grāsa kare, āmādera janya emana kuravānī ānaẏana nā karā paryanta āmarā yena kona nāvīra prati viśvāsa sthāpana nā kari; tumi valaḥ niścaẏai āmāra pūrve samujjvala nidarśanāvalī evaṃ tomarā yā vala tatsaha rāsūlagaṇa āgamana karechila; yadi tomarā satyavādī hao tāhale kena tomarā tāderake hatyā karechile?
latin_ascii: yara vale thake, avasyai allaha amadera theke angikara niyechena ye, agni ya grasa kare, amadera janya emana kuravani anayana na kara paryanta amara yena kona navira prati visvasa sthapana na kari; tumi valah niscayai amara purve samujjvala nidarsanavali evam tomara ya vala tatsaha rasulagana agamana karechila; yadi tomara satyavadi hao tahale kena tomara taderake hatya karechiley

latin_iast: ataḥpara yadi tārā tomāra prati asatyāropa kare tāhale tomāra pūrveo rāsūlagaṇake aviśvāsa karā haẏechila, yārā prakāśya nidarśanāvalī o kṣudra pustikā evaṃ ujjvala granthasaha āgamana karechila.
latin_ascii: atahpara yadi tara tomara prati asatyaropa kare tahale tomara purveo rasulaganake avisvasa kara hayechila, yara prakasya nidarsanavali o ksudra pustika evam ujjvala granthasaha agamana karechila.

latin_iast: samasta jīvai mṛtyura āsvāda grahaṇa karave; evaṃ niścaẏai utthāna dine tomāderake pūrṇa pratidāna deẏā have; ataeva ye keha jāhānnāma hate vimukta haẏa evaṃ jānnāte praviṣṭa haẏa - phalataḥ niścaẏai se saphalakāma; āra pārthiva jīvana chalanāmaẏa bhoga vyatīta āra kichui naẏa.
latin_ascii: samasta jivai mrtyura asvada grahana karave; evam niscayai utthana dine tomaderake purna pratidana deya have; ataeva ye keha jahannama hate vimukta haya evam jannate pravista haya - phalatah niscayai se saphalakama; ara parthiva jivana chalanamaya bhoga vyatita ara kichui naya.

latin_iast: avaśyai tomarā tomādera dhana-sampada o jīvana samparke parīkṣita have. tomādera pūrve yāderake grantha pradatta haẏeche o yārā aṃśī sthāpana kareche tādera nikaṭa hate tomāderake vahu duḥkhajanaka vākya śunate have; evaṃ yadi tomarā dhairya dhāraṇa kara o saṃyamī hao tāhale avaśyai eṭā sudṛr̤ha kāryāvalīra antargata.
latin_ascii: avasyai tomara tomadera dhana-sampada o jivana samparke pariksita have. tomadera purve yaderake grantha pradatta hayeche o yara amsi sthapana kareche tadera nikata hate tomaderake vahu duhkhajanaka vakya sunate have; evam yadi tomara dhairya dharana kara o samyami hao tahale avasyai eta sudrrha karyavalira antargata.

latin_iast: āra āllāha yakhana yāderake grantha pradāna karā haẏeche tādera kācha theke aṅgīkāra grahaṇa karechilena ye, tārā niścaẏai eṭi lokadera madhye vyakta karave evaṃ tā gopana karavenā; kintu tārā oṭā tādera paścāte nikṣepa karala evaṃ oṭā alpa mūlye vikri karala. ataeva tārā yā kraẏa karechila tā nikṛṣṭatara.
latin_ascii: ara allaha yakhana yaderake grantha pradana kara hayeche tadera kacha theke angikara grahana karechilena ye, tara niscayai eti lokadera madhye vyakta karave evam ta gopana karavena; kintu tara ota tadera pascate niksepa karala evam ota alpa mulye vikri karala. ataeva tara ya kraya karechila ta nikrstatara.

latin_iast: yārā svīẏa kṛtakarme santaṣṭa evaṃ tārā yā kareni tajjanya praśaṃsā prārthī erūpa lokadera samvandhe dhāraṇā karanā ye, tārā śāsti hate vimukta, tādera janya raẏeche yantraṇādāẏaka śāsti.
latin_ascii: yara sviya krtakarme santasta evam tara ya kareni tajjanya prasamsa prarthi erupa lokadera samvandhe dharana karana ye, tara sasti hate vimukta, tadera janya rayeche yantranadayaka sasti.

latin_iast: āllāharai janya nabhomanḍala o bhūmanḍalera ādhipatya evaṃ āllāha sarva viṣaẏopari śaktimāna.
latin_ascii: allaharai janya nabhomandala o bhumandalera adhipatya evam allaha sarva visayopari saktimana.

latin_iast: niścaẏai nabhomanḍala o bhūmanḍala sṛṣṭite evaṃ dina o rātera parivartane jñānavānadera janya spaṣṭa nidarśanāvalī raẏeche.
latin_ascii: niscayai nabhomandala o bhumandala srstite evam dina o ratera parivartane jnanavanadera janya spasta nidarsanavali rayeche.

latin_iast: yārā danḍāẏamāna, upaveśana o elāẏita avasthāẏa āllāhake smaraṇa kare evaṃ nabhomanḍala o bhūmanḍalera sṛṣṭi viṣaẏe cintā-gaveṣanā kare evaṃ valeḥ he āmādera rāvva! āpani esava vṛthā sṛṣṭi karenani; āpanii pavitratama! ataeva āmāderake jāhānnāma hate rakṣā karuna!
latin_ascii: yara dandayamana, upavesana o elayita avasthaya allahake smarana kare evam nabhomandala o bhumandalera srsti visaye cinta-gavesana kare evam valeh he amadera ravva! apani esava vrtha srsti karenani; apanii pavitratama! ataeva amaderake jahannama hate raksa karuna!

latin_iast: he āmādera rāvva! āpani yāke jāhānnāme praviṣṭa karāna, phalataḥ niścaẏai tāke lāñchita karā haẏeche; evaṃ atyācārīdera janya kehai sāhāyyakārī nei.
latin_ascii: he amadera ravva! apani yake jahanname pravista karana, phalatah niscayai take lanchita kara hayeche; evam atyacaridera janya kehai sahayyakari nei.

latin_iast: he āmādera rāvva! niścaẏai āmarā eka āhavānakārīke īmānera prati āhavāna karate śunechilāma ye, tomarā svīẏa ravera prati viśvāsa sthāpana kara; āmarā viśvāsa sthāpana karechi; he āmādera rāvva! ataeva āmādera aparādhasamūha kṣamā karuna o āmādera sakala doṣakraṭi dūra karuna evaṃ punyavānadera sāthe āmādera mṛtyu dāna karuna.
latin_ascii: he amadera ravva! niscayai amara eka ahavanakarike imanera prati ahavana karate sunechilama ye, tomara sviya ravera prati visvasa sthapana kara; amara visvasa sthapana karechi; he amadera ravva! ataeva amadera aparadhasamuha ksama karuna o amadera sakala dosakrati dura karuna evam punyavanadera sathe amadera mrtyu dana karuna.

latin_iast: he āmādera rāvva! āpani svīẏa rāsūlagaṇera mādhyame āmādera sāthe ye aṅgīkāra karechilena tā dāna karuna evaṃ utthāna divase āmāderake lāñchita karavenanā. niścaẏai āpani aṅgīkāra bhaṅga karenanā.
latin_ascii: he amadera ravva! apani sviya rasulaganera madhyame amadera sathe ye angikara karechilena ta dana karuna evam utthana divase amaderake lanchita karavenana. niscayai apani angikara bhanga karenana.

latin_iast: anantara tādera rāvva tādera janya oṭā svīkāra karalena evaṃ valalenaḥ āmi tomādera puruṣa athavā nārīra madhya hate kona karmīra kṛtakarma vyartha karavanā, tomarā paraspara eka, ataeva yārā deśa tyāga kareche athavā svīẏa gṛhasamūha hate vitār̤ita haẏeche o āmāra pathe niryātita haẏeche evaṃ saṃgrāma kareche o nihata haẏeche - niścaẏai tādera janya āmi tādera amaṅgalasamūha apasāraṇa karāva evaṃ niścaẏai āmi tāderake jānnāte praveśa karāva, yāra nimne srotasvinī nadīsamūha pravāhita; eṭā āllāhara nikaṭa hate pratidāna evaṃ āllāhara nikaṭai uttama pratidāna raẏeche.
latin_ascii: anantara tadera ravva tadera janya ota svikara karalena evam valalenah ami tomadera purusa athava narira madhya hate kona karmira krtakarma vyartha karavana, tomara paraspara eka, ataeva yara desa tyaga kareche athava sviya grhasamuha hate vitarita hayeche o amara pathe niryatita hayeche evam samgrama kareche o nihata hayeche - niscayai tadera janya ami tadera amangalasamuha apasarana karava evam niscayai ami taderake jannate pravesa karava, yara nimne srotasvini nadisamuha pravahita; eta allahara nikata hate pratidana evam allahara nikatai uttama pratidana rayeche.

latin_iast: yārā aviśvāsī haẏeche tādera nagarasamūhe pratyāgamana yena tomāderake pratārita nā kare.
latin_ascii: yara avisvasi hayeche tadera nagarasamuhe pratyagamana yena tomaderake pratarita na kare.

latin_iast: eṭā mātra kaẏekadinera sambhoga; anantara tādera avasthāna jāhānnāma evaṃ oṭā nikṛṣṭa sthāna.
latin_ascii: eta matra kayekadinera sambhoga; anantara tadera avasthana jahannama evam ota nikrsta sthana.

latin_iast: kintu yārā svīẏa rāvvake bhaẏa kare tādera janya raẏeche jānnāta-yāra nimne srotasvinīsamūha pravāhita, tammadhye tārā sadā avasthāna karave, eṭā āllāhara nikaṭa raẏeche, tā satkarmaśīladera janya vahuguṇe uttama.

latin_iast: evaṃ niścaẏai āhale kitāvera madhye erūpa lokao raẏeche yārā āllāhara prati īmāna āne evaṃ tomādera prati yā avatīrṇa haẏeche evaṃ yā tādera prati avatīrṇa haẏechila tadviṣaẏe viśvāsa sthāpana kare evaṃ āllāhara sammukhe vinaẏāvanata thāke. yārā alpa mūlye āllāhara nidarśanāvalī vikri karenā tāderai janya tādera ravera nikaṭa pratidāna raẏeche; niścaẏai āllāha sattvara hisāva grahaṇakārī.
latin_ascii: evam niscayai ahale kitavera madhye erupa lokao rayeche yara allahara prati imana ane evam tomadera prati ya avatirna hayeche evam ya tadera prati avatirna hayechila tadvisaye visvasa sthapana kare evam allahara sammukhe vinayavanata thake. yara alpa mulye allahara nidarsanavali vikri karena taderai janya tadera ravera nikata pratidana rayeche; niscayai allaha sattvara hisava grahanakari.

latin_iast: he viśvāsa sthāpanakārīgaṇa! tomarā dhairya avalamvana kara evaṃ sahiṣṇu o supratiṣṭhita hao; evaṃ āllāhake bhaẏa kara yena tomarā suphala prāpta hao.
latin_ascii: he visvasa sthapanakarigana! tomara dhairya avalamvana kara evam sahisnu o supratisthita hao; evam allahake bhaya kara yena tomara suphala prapta hao.

latin_iast: he mānavamanḍalī! tomarā tomādera rāvvake bhaẏa kara, yini tomāderake ekai vyakti hate sṛṣṭi karechena evaṃ tā hate tadīẏa sahadharminī sṛṣṭi karechena evaṃ tādera ubhaẏa hate vahu nara o nārī char̤iẏe diẏechena evaṃ sei āllāhake bhaẏa kara yā~ra nāmera dohāi diẏe tomarā eke aparake yāñcā kara, evaṃ ātmīẏa-jñātidera vyāpāre satarkatā avalamvana kara. niścaẏai āllāhai tattvāvadhānakārī.
latin_ascii: he manavamandali! tomara tomadera ravvake bhaya kara, yini tomaderake ekai vyakti hate srsti karechena evam ta hate tadiya sahadharmini srsti karechena evam tadera ubhaya hate vahu nara o nari chariye diyechena evam sei allahake bhaya kara ya~ra namera dohai diye tomara eke aparake yanca kara, evam atmiya-jnatidera vyapare satarkata avalamvana kara. niscayai allahai tattvavadhanakari.

latin_iast: āra iẏātīmaderake tādera dhana sampatti vujhiẏe dāo evaṃ pavitratāra sāthe apavitratāra vinimaẏa karanā o tomādera dhana sampattira sāthe tādera dhana sampatti miśrita kare bhoga karanā; niścaẏai eṭā gurutara aparādha.
latin_ascii: ara iyatimaderake tadera dhana sampatti vujhiye dao evam pavitratara sathe apavitratara vinimaya karana o tomadera dhana sampattira sathe tadera dhana sampatti misrita kare bhoga karana; niscayai eta gurutara aparadha.

latin_iast: āra yadi tomarā āśaṃkā kara ye, iẏātīmadera prati suvicāra karate pāravenā tāhale nārīdera madhya hate tomādera pachanda mata du’ṭi, tinaṭi kiṃvā cāraṭike viẏe kare nāo; kintu yadi tomarā āśaṃkā kara ye, tādera sāthe nyāẏa saṅgata ācaraṇa karate pāravenā tāhale mātra ekaṭi athavā tomādera ḍāna hāta yāra adhikārī (krītadāsī); eṭā ārao uttama; eṭā avicāra nā karāra nikaṭavartī.
latin_ascii: ara yadi tomara asamka kara ye, iyatimadera prati suvicara karate paravena tahale naridera madhya hate tomadera pachanda mata du’ti, tinati kimva caratike viye kare nao; kintu yadi tomara asamka kara ye, tadera sathe nyaya sangata acarana karate paravena tahale matra ekati athava tomadera dana hata yara adhikari (kritadasi); eta arao uttama; eta avicara na karara nikatavarti.

latin_iast: āra santuṣṭa citte nārīderake tādera deẏa mohara pradāna kara, kintu yadi tārā svecchāẏa kiẏadaṃśa pradāna kare tāhale saṭhika vivecanā mata tṛptira sāthe bhoga kara.
latin_ascii: ara santusta citte nariderake tadera deya mohara pradana kara, kintu yadi tara svecchaya kiyadamsa pradana kare tahale sathika vivecana mata trptira sathe bhoga kara.

latin_iast: āllāha tomādera janya ye dhana-sampatti nirdhāraṇa karechena tā avodhaderake pradāna karanā; varaṃ tā hate tāderake bhakṣaṇa karāte thāka, paridhāna karāte thāka evaṃ tādera sāthe sadbhāve kathā vala.
latin_ascii: allaha tomadera janya ye dhana-sampatti nirdharana karechena ta avodhaderake pradana karana; varam ta hate taderake bhaksana karate thaka, paridhana karate thaka evam tadera sathe sadbhave katha vala.

latin_iast: āra iẏātīmarā viẏera yogya nā haoẏā paryanta tāderake parīkṣā kare nāo; ataḥpara yadi tādera madhye viveka-vuddhi paridṛṣṭa haẏa tāhale tādera dhana-sampatti tāderake samarpaṇa kara; iẏātīmera dhana-sampada apavyaẏa karanā athavā tārā vaẏaḥprāpta have vale oṭā sattvaratā sahakāre ātmasāt karanā; evaṃ dekhāśonākārī yadi abhāvamukta haẏa tāhale iẏātīmera māla kharaca karā hate se nijake sampūrṇa virata rākhave, āra ye vyakti abhāvagrasta se saṅgata parimāṇa bhoga karave, anantara yakhana tādera sampatti tāderake samarpaṇa karate cāo takhana tādera janya sākṣī rekha evaṃ āllāhai hisāva grahaṇe yatheṣṭa.
latin_ascii: ara iyatimara viyera yogya na haoya paryanta taderake pariksa kare nao; atahpara yadi tadera madhye viveka-vuddhi paridrsta haya tahale tadera dhana-sampatti taderake samarpana kara; iyatimera dhana-sampada apavyaya karana athava tara vayahprapta have vale ota sattvarata sahakare atmasat karana; evam dekhasonakari yadi abhavamukta haya tahale iyatimera mala kharaca kara hate se nijake sampurna virata rakhave, ara ye vyakti abhavagrasta se sangata parimana bhoga karave, anantara yakhana tadera sampatti taderake samarpana karate cao takhana tadera janya saksi rekha evam allahai hisava grahane yathesta.

latin_iast: puruṣadera janya mātā-pitā o ātmīẏa svajanera parityakta viṣaẏe aṃśa raẏeche- alpa vā adhika, tā nirdiṣṭa parimāṇa.
latin_ascii: purusadera janya mata-pita o atmiya svajanera parityakta visaye amsa rayeche- alpa va adhika, ta nirdista parimana.

latin_iast: vanṭanera samaẏe yakhana svajanagaṇa, iẏātīmagaṇa evaṃ daridragaṇa upasthita haẏa takhana tā hate tāderakeo jīvikā dāna kara evaṃ tādera sāthe sadbhāve kathā vala.
latin_ascii: vantanera samaye yakhana svajanagana, iyatimagana evam daridragana upasthita haya takhana ta hate taderakeo jivika dana kara evam tadera sathe sadbhave katha vala.

latin_iast: tādera mane ei bheve śaṃkā thākā ucit ye, yadi tārā mṛtyukāle tādera paścāte asahāẏa parivāra rekhe yāẏa tāhale tāderao ekai avasthā ghaṭate pāre. sutarāṃ tārā yena āllāhake bhaẏa kare evaṃ saṅgata kathā vale.
latin_ascii: tadera mane ei bheve samka thaka ucit ye, yadi tara mrtyukale tadera pascate asahaya parivara rekhe yaya tahale taderao ekai avastha ghatate pare. sutaram tara yena allahake bhaya kare evam sangata katha vale.

latin_iast: yārā anyāẏabhāve pitṛhīnadera dhana sampatti grāsa kare, niścaẏai tā svīẏa udare agni vyatīta kichui bhakṣaṇa karenā evaṃ sattvarai tārā agni śikhāẏa praveśa karave.
latin_ascii: yara anyayabhave pitrhinadera dhana sampatti grasa kare, niscayai ta sviya udare agni vyatita kichui bhaksana karena evam sattvarai tara agni sikhaya pravesa karave.

latin_iast: āllāha tomādera santānadera samvandhe tomāderake nirdeśa dicchenaḥ eka putrera janya dui kanyāra aṃśera tulya; āra yadi śudhu kanyāgaṇa dui janera adhika haẏa tāhale tārā mṛta vyaktira parityakta sampatti hate dui tṛtīẏāṃśa prāpta have. āra yadi ekaṭi mātra kanyā haẏa tāhale se ardhekāṃśa prāpta have; evaṃ yadi mṛta vyaktira kona santāna thāke tāhale mātā-pitāra janya arthāt ubhaẏera pratyekerai janya tāra parityakta sampatti hate eka ṣaṣṭhāṃśa raẏeche, āra yadi tāra kona santāna nā thāke evaṃ śudhu mātā-pitāi tāra uttarādhikārī haẏa tāhale tāra mātāra janya raẏeche eka tṛtīẏāṃśa evaṃ yadi tāra bhāi thāke tāhale se yā nirdeśa kare geche sei nirdeśa o ṛṇa ante tāra jananīra janya eka ṣaṣṭhāṃśa; tomādera pitā o tomādera putrera madhye ke tomādera adhikatara upakārī tā tomarā avagata nao, eṭāi āllāhara nirdeśa. niścaẏai āllāha mahājñānī o vijñānamaẏa.
latin_ascii: allaha tomadera santanadera samvandhe tomaderake nirdesa dicchenah eka putrera janya dui kanyara amsera tulya; ara yadi sudhu kanyagana dui janera adhika haya tahale tara mrta vyaktira parityakta sampatti hate dui trtiyamsa prapta have. ara yadi ekati matra kanya haya tahale se ardhekamsa prapta have; evam yadi mrta vyaktira kona santana thake tahale mata-pitara janya arthat ubhayera pratyekerai janya tara parityakta sampatti hate eka sasthamsa rayeche, ara yadi tara kona santana na thake evam sudhu mata-pitai tara uttaradhikari haya tahale tara matara janya rayeche eka trtiyamsa evam yadi tara bhai thake tahale se ya nirdesa kare geche sei nirdesa o rna ante tara jananira janya eka sasthamsa; tomadera pita o tomadera putrera madhye ke tomadera adhikatara upakari ta tomara avagata nao, etai allahara nirdesa. niscayai allaha mahajnani o vijnanamaya.

latin_iast: āra tomādera patnīgaṇera yadi santāna-santati nā thāke tāhale tārā yā parityāga kare yāẏa tā theke tomādera janya uhāra ardhāṃśa; kintu yadi tādera santāna-santati thāke tāhale tārā yā asīẏāta kareche sei asīẏāta o ṛṇa pariśodhera para tādera parityakta sampatti hate tomādera janya eka caturthāṃśa; evaṃ yadi tomādera strīdera kona santāna-santati nā thāke tāhale tomarā yā parityāga kare yāve, tādera janya tāra eka caturthāṃśa; kintu yadi tomādera santuāna-santati thāke tāhale tomarā yā asīẏāta karave sei asīẏāta o ṛṇa pariśodhera para tomādera parityakta sampatti hate tādera janya eka aṣṭamāṃśa; yadi kona mūla o śākhāvihīna puruṣa kiṃvā strī mārā yāẏa evaṃ tāra eka bhāi athavā eka bhagnī thāke tāhale etadubhaẏera madhya hate pratyekei eka ṣaṣṭhāṃśa pāve, āra yadi tārā tadapekṣā adhika haẏa tāhale kṛta asīẏāta pūraṇa karāra para athavā ṛṇa śodhera para, kārao aniṣṭa nā kare tārā uhāra eka tṛtīẏāṃśa prāpta have; eṭāi āllāhara nirdeśa evaṃ āllāha mahājñānī, sahiṣṇu.
latin_ascii: ara tomadera patniganera yadi santana-santati na thake tahale tara ya parityaga kare yaya ta theke tomadera janya uhara ardhamsa; kintu yadi tadera santana-santati thake tahale tara ya asiyata kareche sei asiyata o rna parisodhera para tadera parityakta sampatti hate tomadera janya eka caturthamsa; evam yadi tomadera stridera kona santana-santati na thake tahale tomara ya parityaga kare yave, tadera janya tara eka caturthamsa; kintu yadi tomadera santuana-santati thake tahale tomara ya asiyata karave sei asiyata o rna parisodhera para tomadera parityakta sampatti hate tadera janya eka astamamsa; yadi kona mula o sakhavihina purusa kimva stri mara yaya evam tara eka bhai athava eka bhagni thake tahale etadubhayera madhya hate pratyekei eka sasthamsa pave, ara yadi tara tadapeksa adhika haya tahale krta asiyata purana karara para athava rna sodhera para, karao anista na kare tara uhara eka trtiyamsa prapta have; etai allahara nirdesa evam allaha mahajnani, sahisnu.

latin_iast: eṭāi āllāhara nirdiṣṭa sīmāsamūha; evaṃ ye keha āllāha o tadīẏa rāsūlera anugata haẏa tini tāke erūpa jānnāte praviṣṭa karāvena yāra nimne srotasvinīsamūha pravāhitā, tammadhye tārā sadā avasthāna karave; evaṃ eṭāi var̤a saphalatā.
latin_ascii: etai allahara nirdista simasamuha; evam ye keha allaha o tadiya rasulera anugata haya tini take erupa jannate pravista karavena yara nimne srotasvinisamuha pravahita, tammadhye tara sada avasthana karave; evam etai vara saphalata.

latin_iast: āra ye keha āllāha o tadīẏa rāsūlake amānya kare evaṃ tā~ra nirdiṣṭa sīmāsamūha atikrama kare tini tāke jāhānnāme praveśa karāvena. tanmadhye se sadā avasthāna karave evaṃ tāra janya lāñchanādāẏaka śāsti raẏeche.
latin_ascii: ara ye keha allaha o tadiya rasulake amanya kare evam ta~ra nirdista simasamuha atikrama kare tini take jahanname pravesa karavena. tanmadhye se sada avasthana karave evam tara janya lanchanadayaka sasti rayeche.

latin_iast: āra tomādera nārīdera madhye yārā nirlajja kāja kare, tomarā tādera viruddhe tomādera madhya hate cāra jana sākṣī upasthita kara; anantara yadi tārā sākṣya pradāna kare tāhale tāderake tomarā gṛhasamūhera madhye āvaddha kare rākha ye paryanta mṛtyu tāderake uṭhiẏe nā neẏa kiṃvā āllāha tādera janya kona patha nirdeśa nā karena.
latin_ascii: ara tomadera naridera madhye yara nirlajja kaja kare, tomara tadera viruddhe tomadera madhya hate cara jana saksi upasthita kara; anantara yadi tara saksya pradana kare tahale taderake tomara grhasamuhera madhye avaddha kare rakha ye paryanta mrtyu taderake uthiye na neya kimva allaha tadera janya kona patha nirdesa na karena.

latin_iast: āra tomādera madhya hate ye kona duijana ei nirlajjatāra kāja karave, tādera ubhaẏakei śāsti pradāna kara; kintu tārā yadi tāovāha kare evaṃ sadācārī haẏa tāhale etadubhaẏa hate pratyāvartita hao. niścaẏai āllāha tāovāha grahaṇakārī, karuṇāmaẏa.
latin_ascii: ara tomadera madhya hate ye kona duijana ei nirlajjatara kaja karave, tadera ubhayakei sasti pradana kara; kintu tara yadi taovaha kare evam sadacari haya tahale etadubhaya hate pratyavartita hao. niscayai allaha taovaha grahanakari, karunamaya.

latin_iast: tāovāha kavūla karāra dāẏitva ye āllāhara upara raẏeche tāto śudhu tāderai janya yārā ajñatā vaśataḥ pāpa kare thāke, ataḥpara avilamve kṣamā prārthanā kare; sutarāṃ āllāha tāderakei kṣamā karavena; āllāha mahājñānī, vijñānamaẏa.
latin_ascii: taovaha kavula karara dayitva ye allahara upara rayeche tato sudhu taderai janya yara ajnata vasatah papa kare thake, atahpara avilamve ksama prarthana kare; sutaram allaha taderakei ksama karavena; allaha mahajnani, vijnanamaya.

latin_iast: āra tādera janya kona kṣamā nei yārā ai paryanta pāpa karate thāke yakhana tādera kārao nikaṭa mṛtyu upasthita haẏa takhana vale, niścaẏai āmi ekhana kṣamā prārthanā karachi evaṃ tādera janyao kṣamā naẏa yārā aviśvāsī avasthāẏa mṛtyumukhe patita haẏeche; tāderai janya āmi vedanādāẏaka śāsti prastuta kare rekhechi.
latin_ascii: ara tadera janya kona ksama nei yara ai paryanta papa karate thake yakhana tadera karao nikata mrtyu upasthita haya takhana vale, niscayai ami ekhana ksama prarthana karachi evam tadera janyao ksama naya yara avisvasi avasthaya mrtyumukhe patita hayeche; taderai janya ami vedanadayaka sasti prastuta kare rekhechi.

latin_iast: he mu’minagaṇa! eṭā tomādera janya vaidha naẏa ye, tomarā valapūrvaka nārīdera uttarādhikārī hao; evaṃ prakāśya aślīlatā vyatīta tomarā tāderake yā pradāna karecha uhāra kiẏadaṃśa grahaṇera janya tāderake vādhya karanā evaṃ tādera sāthe sadbhāve sama maryādāẏa avasthāna kara; kintu yadi apachanda kara tāhale tomarā ye viṣaẏa apachanda kara āllāha seṭāke pracura kalyāṇakara karate pārena.
latin_ascii: he mu’minagana! eta tomadera janya vaidha naya ye, tomara valapurvaka naridera uttaradhikari hao; evam prakasya aslilata vyatita tomara taderake ya pradana karecha uhara kiyadamsa grahanera janya taderake vadhya karana evam tadera sathe sadbhave sama maryadaya avasthana kara; kintu yadi apachanda kara tahale tomara ye visaya apachanda kara allaha setake pracura kalyanakara karate parena.

latin_iast: āra yadi tomarā eka strīra sthale anya strī parivartana karate icchā kara evaṃ tādera ekajanake pracura dhana-sampada pradāna kare thāka tāhale tomarā tanmadhya hate kichui pratigrahaṇa karanā; tāhale ki tomarā apavāda praẏoga evaṃ prakāśya pāpa kare seṭā grahaṇa karave?
latin_ascii: ara yadi tomara eka strira sthale anya stri parivartana karate iccha kara evam tadera ekajanake pracura dhana-sampada pradana kare thaka tahale tomara tanmadhya hate kichui pratigrahana karana; tahale ki tomara apavada prayoga evam prakasya papa kare seta grahana karavey

latin_iast: evaṃ kirūpe tomarā tā grahaṇa karave? vastutaḥ tomarā paraspara eke anyera nikaṭa gamana karechile evaṃ tārā tomādera nikaṭa hate sudṛr̤ha aṅgīkāra grahaṇa karechila.
latin_ascii: evam kirupe tomara ta grahana karavey vastutah tomara paraspara eke anyera nikata gamana karechile evam tara tomadera nikata hate sudrrha angikara grahana karechila.

latin_iast: tomādera pitṛgaṇa nārīkūlera madhye yāderake viẏe kareche tomarā tāderake viẏe karanā, kintu yā vigata haẏeche. niścaẏai eṭi aślīla, arucikara evaṃ nikṛṣṭa ācaraṇa.
latin_ascii: tomadera pitrgana narikulera madhye yaderake viye kareche tomara taderake viye karana, kintu ya vigata hayeche. niscayai eti aslila, arucikara evam nikrsta acarana.

latin_iast: tomādera janya avaidha karā haẏeche - tomādera mātṛgaṇa, kanyāgaṇa, bhagnigaṇa, phuphugaṇa, khālāgaṇa, bhrātṛkanyāgaṇa, bhagnira kanyāgaṇa, tomādera sei mātṛgaṇa yārā tomāderake stanya dāna kareche, tomādera dugdha bhagnigaṇa, tomādera strīdera mātṛgaṇa, tomarā yādera abhyantare upanīta haẏecha sei strīdera ye sakala kanyā tomādera kror̤e avasthita; kintu yadi tomarā tādera madhye upanīta nā haẏe thāka tāhale tomādera janya kona aparādha nei; evaṃ aurasajāta putradera patnīgaṇa; evaṃ yā atīta haẏe geche, tadvyatīta dui bhagnike ekatre viẏe karā; niścaẏai āllāha kṣamāśīla, karuṇāmaẏa.
latin_ascii: tomadera janya avaidha kara hayeche - tomadera matrgana, kanyagana, bhagnigana, phuphugana, khalagana, bhratrkanyagana, bhagnira kanyagana, tomadera sei matrgana yara tomaderake stanya dana kareche, tomadera dugdha bhagnigana, tomadera stridera matrgana, tomara yadera abhyantare upanita hayecha sei stridera ye sakala kanya tomadera krore avasthita; kintu yadi tomara tadera madhye upanita na haye thaka tahale tomadera janya kona aparadha nei; evam aurasajata putradera patnigana; evam ya atita haye geche, tadvyatita dui bhagnike ekatre viye kara; niscayai allaha ksamasila, karunamaya.

latin_iast: evaṃ nārīdera madhye vivāhitagaṇa tomādera janya niṣiddha karā haẏeche; kintu tomādera ḍāna hāta yādera adhikārī - āllāha tomādera janya tāderake vidhivaddha karechena, etadvyatīta tomādera janya vaidha karā haẏeche anyānya nārīdera; tomarā svīẏa dhanera dvārā vyabhicārera uddeśya vyatīta vivāha karāra janya tādera anusandhāna kara; anantara tādera dvārā ye phala bhoga karave tajjanya tāderake tādera nirdhārita deẏa pradāna kara evaṃ kona aparādha havenā yadi nirdhāraṇera para tomarā paraspara sammata hao, niścaẏai āllāha mahājñānī, vijñānamaẏa.
latin_ascii: evam naridera madhye vivahitagana tomadera janya nisiddha kara hayeche; kintu tomadera dana hata yadera adhikari - allaha tomadera janya taderake vidhivaddha karechena, etadvyatita tomadera janya vaidha kara hayeche anyanya naridera; tomara sviya dhanera dvara vyabhicarera uddesya vyatita vivaha karara janya tadera anusandhana kara; anantara tadera dvara ye phala bhoga karave tajjanya taderake tadera nirdharita deya pradana kara evam kona aparadha havena yadi nirdharanera para tomara paraspara sammata hao, niscayai allaha mahajnani, vijnanamaya.

latin_iast: āra tomādera madhye ye vyakti svādhīnā o musalima nārīke viẏe karāra sāmarthya rākhenā tāhale tomādera ḍāna hāta adhikārī sei viśvāsinī dāsīke viẏe kare. āllāha tomādera viśvāsa viṣaẏe jñāta āchena, tomarā eke apara hate samudbhuta. ataeva tādera manivadera anumatikrame tāderake viẏe kara evaṃ niẏama anuyāẏī tāderake tādera prāpya (moharānā) pradāna kara ematāvasthāẏa ye, tārā vyabhicāriṇī kiṃvā upa-pati grahaṇakāriṇī havenā. ataḥpara yakhana tārā vivāhavaddha haẏa, tatpara yadi tārā vyabhicāra kare tāhale tādera prati svādhīnā nārīdera śāstira ardheka, eṭā tāderai janya tomādera madhye yārā duskāryake bhaẏa kare. evaṃ yadi virata thāka tāhale eṭā tomādera janya kalyāṇakara evaṃ āllāha kṣamāśīla, karuṇāmaẏa.
latin_ascii: ara tomadera madhye ye vyakti svadhina o musalima narike viye karara samarthya rakhena tahale tomadera dana hata adhikari sei visvasini dasike viye kare. allaha tomadera visvasa visaye jnata achena, tomara eke apara hate samudbhuta. ataeva tadera manivadera anumatikrame taderake viye kara evam niyama anuyayi taderake tadera prapya (moharana) pradana kara ematavasthaya ye, tara vyabhicarini kimva upa-pati grahanakarini havena. atahpara yakhana tara vivahavaddha haya, tatpara yadi tara vyabhicara kare tahale tadera prati svadhina naridera sastira ardheka, eta taderai janya tomadera madhye yara duskaryake bhaya kare. evam yadi virata thaka tahale eta tomadera janya kalyanakara evam allaha ksamasila, karunamaya.

latin_iast: āllāha tomādera janya savakichu pariskāra varṇanā karate evaṃ tomāderake tomādera pūrvavartīgaṇera ādarśasamūha pradarśana karate o tomāderake kṣamā karate icchā karena evaṃ āllāha mahājñānī, vijñānamaẏa.
latin_ascii: allaha tomadera janya savakichu pariskara varnana karate evam tomaderake tomadera purvavartiganera adarsasamuha pradarsana karate o tomaderake ksama karate iccha karena evam allaha mahajnani, vijnanamaya.

latin_iast: āra āllāha tomāderake kṣamā karate icchā karena evaṃ yārā pravṛttira pūjārī tārā icchā kare ye, tomarā ghora adhaḥpatane patita hao.
latin_ascii: ara allaha tomaderake ksama karate iccha karena evam yara pravrttira pujari tara iccha kare ye, tomara ghora adhahpatane patita hao.

latin_iast: āllāha tomādera vojhā laghu karate cāna yehetu mānuṣa durvala (rūpe) sṛṣṭa haẏeche.
latin_ascii: allaha tomadera vojha laghu karate cana yehetu manusa durvala (rupe) srsta hayeche.

latin_iast: he mu’minagaṇa! tomarā anyāẏabhāve parasparera dhana-sampada grāsa karanā; kevalamātra paraspara sammatikrame ye vyavasā kara tā vaidha evaṃ tomarā nijedera hatyā karanā; niścaẏai āllāha tomādera prati kṣamāśīla.
latin_ascii: he mu’minagana! tomara anyayabhave parasparera dhana-sampada grasa karana; kevalamatra paraspara sammatikrame ye vyavasa kara ta vaidha evam tomara nijedera hatya karana; niscayai allaha tomadera prati ksamasila.

latin_iast: āra ye keha sīmā atikrama kare athavā yalamera vaśavartī haẏe e kāja kare, phalataḥ niścaẏai āmi tāke jāhānnāme nikṣepa karava evaṃ āllāhara pakṣe eṭā khuvai sahajasādhya.
latin_ascii: ara ye keha sima atikrama kare athava yalamera vasavarti haye e kaja kare, phalatah niscayai ami take jahanname niksepa karava evam allahara pakse eta khuvai sahajasadhya.

latin_iast: tomarā yadi sei var̤a var̤a pāpasamūha hate virata hao yā tomāderake niṣedha karā haẏeche, tāhalei āmi tomādera kraṭi vicyutiguli kṣamā kare diva evaṃ tomāderake sammānajanaka sthāne praviṣṭa karāva.
latin_ascii: tomara yadi sei vara vara papasamuha hate virata hao ya tomaderake nisedha kara hayeche, tahalei ami tomadera krati vicyutiguli ksama kare diva evam tomaderake sammanajanaka sthane pravista karava.

latin_iast: evaṃ tomarā ora ākāṃkhā karanā yadvārā āllāha ekera upara aparake śreṣṭhatva dāna karechena; puruṣerā yā upārjana kareche tāte tādera aṃśa raẏeche evaṃ nārīrā yā upārjana kareche tāte tādera aṃśa raẏeche evaṃ tomarā āllāharai nikaṭa anugraha prārthanā kara, niścaẏai āllāha sarva viṣaẏe mahājñānī.
latin_ascii: evam tomara ora akamkha karana yadvara allaha ekera upara aparake sresthatva dana karechena; purusera ya uparjana kareche tate tadera amsa rayeche evam narira ya uparjana kareche tate tadera amsa rayeche evam tomara allaharai nikata anugraha prarthana kara, niscayai allaha sarva visaye mahajnani.

latin_iast: āmi savāikei uttarādhikārī karechi yā tādera mātā-pitā o ātmīẏa-svajana parityāga kare yāẏa evaṃ dakṣiṇa hasta yādera sāthe pratijñāvaddha; ataeva tomarā tāderake tādera aṃśa pradāna kara; niścaẏai āllāha sava viṣaẏe sākṣī.
latin_ascii: ami savaikei uttaradhikari karechi ya tadera mata-pita o atmiya-svajana parityaga kare yaya evam daksina hasta yadera sathe pratijnavaddha; ataeva tomara taderake tadera amsa pradana kara; niscayai allaha sava visaye saksi.

latin_iast: puruṣerā nārīdera upara tattvāvadhānakārī o bharaṇapoṣaṇakārī, yehetu āllāha tādera madhye ekera upara aparake vaiśiṣṭya dāna karechena evaṃ ei hetu ye, tārā svīẏa dhana sampada hate tādera janya vyaẏa kare thāke; sutarāṃ ye samasta nārī puṇyavatī tārā ānugatya kare, āllāhara saṃrakṣita pracchanna viṣaẏa saṃrakṣaṇa kare; yadi nārīdera avādhyatāra āśaṃkā haẏa tāhale tāderake sadupadeśa pradāna kara, tāderake śayyā hate pṛthaka kara evaṃ tāderake prahāra kara; anantara yadi tārā tomādera anugata haẏa tāhale tādera janya anya panthā avalamvana karanā; niścaẏai āllāha samunnata, mahā mahīẏāna.
latin_ascii: purusera naridera upara tattvavadhanakari o bharanaposanakari, yehetu allaha tadera madhye ekera upara aparake vaisistya dana karechena evam ei hetu ye, tara sviya dhana sampada hate tadera janya vyaya kare thake; sutaram ye samasta nari punyavati tara anugatya kare, allahara samraksita pracchanna visaya samraksana kare; yadi naridera avadhyatara asamka haya tahale taderake sadupadesa pradana kara, taderake sayya hate prthaka kara evam taderake prahara kara; anantara yadi tara tomadera anugata haya tahale tadera janya anya pantha avalamvana karana; niscayai allaha samunnata, maha mahiyana.

latin_iast: āra yadi tomarā ubhaẏera madhye vicchedera āśaṃkā kara tāhale tomādera vaṃśa hate ekajana vicāraka evaṃ tomādera strīdera vaṃśa hate ekajana vicāraka nirdiṣṭa kara; yadi tārā mīmāṃsāra ākāṃkhā kare tāhale āllāha tādera madhye samprīti sañcāra karavena; niścaẏai āllāha mahājñānī, abhijña.
latin_ascii: ara yadi tomara ubhayera madhye vicchedera asamka kara tahale tomadera vamsa hate ekajana vicaraka evam tomadera stridera vamsa hate ekajana vicaraka nirdista kara; yadi tara mimamsara akamkha kare tahale allaha tadera madhye sampriti sancara karavena; niscayai allaha mahajnani, abhijna.

latin_iast: evaṃ tomarā āllāharai ivādāta kara evaṃ tā~ra sāthe kona viṣaẏe aṃśī sthāpana karanā; evaṃ mātā-pitāra sāthe sadvyavahāra kara evaṃ ātmīẏa-svajana, pitṛhīna, daridra, samparkavihīna prativeśī, pārśvavatī sahacara o pathika evaṃ tomādera dāsa-dāsīdera sātheo sadvyavahāra kara; niścaẏai āllāha ahaṃkārī ātmābhimānīke bhālavāsenanā.
latin_ascii: evam tomara allaharai ivadata kara evam ta~ra sathe kona visaye amsi sthapana karana; evam mata-pitara sathe sadvyavahara kara evam atmiya-svajana, pitrhina, daridra, samparkavihina prativesi, parsvavati sahacara o pathika evam tomadera dasa-dasidera satheo sadvyavahara kara; niscayai allaha ahamkari atmabhimanike bhalavasenana.

latin_iast: yārā kṛpaṇatā kare o lokadera kārpaṇya śikṣā deẏa evaṃ āllāha svīẏa anugrahe yā dāna karechena tā gopana kare, vastutaḥ āmi sei aviśvāsīdera janya apamānajanaka śāsti prastuta kare rekhechi.
latin_ascii: yara krpanata kare o lokadera karpanya siksa deya evam allaha sviya anugrahe ya dana karechena ta gopana kare, vastutah ami sei avisvasidera janya apamanajanaka sasti prastuta kare rekhechi.

latin_iast: evaṃ yārā lokadera dekhānora janya svīẏa dhana sampada vyaẏa kare evaṃ āllāhara prati o ākhirātera prati viśvāsa sthāpana karenā, āra yādera sahacara śāitāna - se nikṛṣṭa saṅgīi vaṭe.
latin_ascii: evam yara lokadera dekhanora janya sviya dhana sampada vyaya kare evam allahara prati o akhiratera prati visvasa sthapana karena, ara yadera sahacara saitana - se nikrsta sangii vate.

latin_iast: āra ete tādera ki kṣati hata - yadi tārā āllāha o ākhirātera prati viśvāsa sthāpana karata evaṃ āllāha tāderake yā dāna karechena tā hate vyaẏa karata? evaṃ āllāha tādera viṣaẏe yathārthai avagata.
latin_ascii: ara ete tadera ki ksati hata - yadi tara allaha o akhiratera prati visvasa sthapana karata evam allaha taderake ya dana karechena ta hate vyaya karatay evam allaha tadera visaye yatharthai avagata.

latin_iast: niścaẏai āllāha aṇu parimāṇao atyācāra karenanā evaṃ yadi keha kona sat kāja kare tāhale tini oṭā dviguṇa kare dena evaṃ svīẏa pakṣa hate ora mahāna pratidāna pradāna karena.
latin_ascii: niscayai allaha anu parimanao atyacara karenana evam yadi keha kona sat kaja kare tahale tini ota dviguna kare dena evam sviya paksa hate ora mahana pratidana pradana karena.

latin_iast: anantara takhana ki daśā have yakhana āmi pratyeka dharma/sampradāẏa hate sākṣī ānaẏana karava evaṃ tomākei tādera prati sākṣī karava?
latin_ascii: anantara takhana ki dasa have yakhana ami pratyeka dharma/sampradaya hate saksi anayana karava evam tomakei tadera prati saksi karavay

latin_iast: yārā aviśvāsī haẏeche o rāsūlera viruddhācaraṇa kareche tārā sedina kāmanā karave - yena bhūmanḍalera sāthe tārā miśe yāẏa evaṃ āllāhara nikaṭa tārā kona kathāi gopana karate pāravenā.
latin_ascii: yara avisvasi hayeche o rasulera viruddhacarana kareche tara sedina kamana karave - yena bhumandalera sathe tara mise yaya evam allahara nikata tara kona kathai gopana karate paravena.

latin_iast: he mu’minagaṇa! neśāgrasta avasthāẏa sālātera kācheo yeonā, yakhana nijera uccārita vākyera artha nijei vujhate sakṣama nao - e avasthāẏa athavā gosala yarurī hale tā samāpta nā kare sālātera janya dānḍāẏamāna haẏonā. kintu musāphira avasthāra kathā svatantra. yadi tomarā pīr̤ita hao, kiṃvā pravāse avasthāna kara athavā tomādera madhye keha pāẏakhānā hate pratyāgata haẏa kiṃvā ramaṇī sparśa kare evaṃ pāni nā pāoẏā yāẏa tāhale viśuddha māṭira amveṣaṇa kara, tadvārā tomādera mukhamanḍala o hastasamūha muche phela; niścaẏai āllāha mārjanākārī, kṣamāśīla.
latin_ascii: he mu’minagana! nesagrasta avasthaya salatera kacheo yeona, yakhana nijera uccarita vakyera artha nijei vujhate saksama nao - e avasthaya athava gosala yaruri hale ta samapta na kare salatera janya dandayamana hayona. kintu musaphira avasthara katha svatantra. yadi tomara pirita hao, kimva pravase avasthana kara athava tomadera madhye keha payakhana hate pratyagata haya kimva ramani sparsa kare evam pani na paoya yaya tahale visuddha matira amvesana kara, tadvara tomadera mukhamandala o hastasamuha muche phela; niscayai allaha marjanakari, ksamasila.

latin_iast: tomarā ki tādera prati lakṣya karani yāderake granthera eka aṃśa pradatta haẏeche? tārā pathabhraṣṭatā kraẏa kareche evaṃ icchā kare ye, tomarāo saṭhika patha hate dūre sare yāo.
latin_ascii: tomara ki tadera prati laksya karani yaderake granthera eka amsa pradatta hayechey tara pathabhrastata kraya kareche evam iccha kare ye, tomarao sathika patha hate dure sare yao.

latin_iast: evaṃ āllāha tomādera śatruderake samyaka avagata āchena; pṛṣṭhapoṣaka evaṃ sāhāyyakārī hisāve āllāhai yatheṣṭa.
latin_ascii: evam allaha tomadera satruderake samyaka avagata achena; prsthaposaka evam sahayyakari hisave allahai yathesta.

latin_iast: iẏāhudīdera madhye keha keha yathāsthāna hate vākyāvalī parivatirta kare evaṃ valeḥ āmarā śravaṇa karalāma o āgrahya karalāma; evaṃ vale, śona - nā śonāra mata; evaṃ tārā svīẏa jihavā vikṛta kare o dharmera prati doṣāropa kare vale ‘rāinā’; evaṃ yadi tārā valata, ‘āmarā śunalāma o mene nilāma; evaṃ āmāderake vujhāra śakti dāo’ tāhale eṭā tādera pakṣe uttama o saṭhika hata; kintu āllāha tādera aviśvāsa hetu tāderake abhisampāta karechena; ataeva alpa saṃkhyaka vyatīta tārā viśvāsa karenā.
latin_ascii: iyahudidera madhye keha keha yathasthana hate vakyavali parivatirta kare evam valeh amara sravana karalama o agrahya karalama; evam vale, sona - na sonara mata; evam tara sviya jihava vikrta kare o dharmera prati dosaropa kare vale ‘raina’; evam yadi tara valata, ‘amara sunalama o mene nilama; evam amaderake vujhara sakti dao’ tahale eta tadera pakse uttama o sathika hata; kintu allaha tadera avisvasa hetu taderake abhisampata karechena; ataeva alpa samkhyaka vyatita tara visvasa karena.

latin_iast: he grantha prāptarā! tomādera saṅge yā āche tāra satyatā pratipādanakārī yā avatīrṇa karechi tatprati viśvāsa sthāpana kara ai samaẏa āsāra pūrve, yakhana āmi aneka mukhamanḍala vikṛta kare diva. ataḥpara tāderake pṛṣṭhera dike ulṭiẏe diva athavā āsahāve sāvatera prati yerūpa abhisampāta karechilāma tadrupa tādera pratio abhisampāta kari; evaṃ āllāhara ādeśa kāryakarī haẏei thāke.
latin_ascii: he grantha praptara! tomadera sange ya ache tara satyata pratipadanakari ya avatirna karechi tatprati visvasa sthapana kara ai samaya asara purve, yakhana ami aneka mukhamandala vikrta kare diva. atahpara taderake prsthera dike ultiye diva athava asahave savatera prati yerupa abhisampata karechilama tadrupa tadera pratio abhisampata kari; evam allahara adesa karyakari hayei thake.

latin_iast: niścaẏai āllāha tā~ra sāthe aṃśī sthāpanakārīke kṣamā karavenanā evaṃ tadvyatīta yāke icchā kṣamā karavena evaṃ ye keha āllāhara aṃśī sthira kare se mahāpāpe āvaddha hala.
latin_ascii: niscayai allaha ta~ra sathe amsi sthapanakarike ksama karavenana evam tadvyatita yake iccha ksama karavena evam ye keha allahara amsi sthira kare se mahapape avaddha hala.

latin_iast: tumi ki tādera prati lakṣya karani yārā svīẏa pavitratā prakāśa kare? varaṃ āllāha yāke icchā pavitra karena evaṃ tārā eka sūtā parimāṇao atyācārita havenā.
latin_ascii: tumi ki tadera prati laksya karani yara sviya pavitrata prakasa karey varam allaha yake iccha pavitra karena evam tara eka suta parimanao atyacarita havena.

latin_iast: lakṣya karaḥ tārā kirūpe āllāhara prati mithyā apavāda dicche! spaṣṭa aparādhī haoẏāra janya eṭāi yatheṣṭa.
latin_ascii: laksya karah tara kirupe allahara prati mithya apavada dicche! spasta aparadhi haoyara janya etai yathesta.

latin_iast: tumi ki tādera prati lakṣya karani yāderake granthera ekāṃśa pradatta haẏeche? tārā mūrti o śāitānera prati viśvāsa sthāpana kare evaṃ kāphiraderake vale, musalimadera apekṣā tārāi adhikatara supathagāmī.
latin_ascii: tumi ki tadera prati laksya karani yaderake granthera ekamsa pradatta hayechey tara murti o saitanera prati visvasa sthapana kare evam kaphiraderake vale, musalimadera apeksa tarai adhikatara supathagami.

latin_iast: ederai prati āllāha abhisampāta karechena; evaṃ āllāha yāke abhisampāta karena, tumi tāra janya konai sāhāyyakārī khu~je pāvenā.
latin_ascii: ederai prati allaha abhisampata karechena; evam allaha yake abhisampata karena, tumi tara janya konai sahayyakari khu~je pavena.

latin_iast: tāhale ki rājatve tādera kona aṃśa raẏeche? vastutaḥ takhana tārā lokaderake kaṇā parimāṇao pradāna karavenā.
latin_ascii: tahale ki rajatve tadera kona amsa rayechey vastutah takhana tara lokaderake kana parimanao pradana karavena.

latin_iast: tāhale ki tārā lokadera prati e janya hiṃsā kare ye, āllāha tāderake svīẏa sampada hate kichu dāna karechena? phalataḥ niścaẏai āmi ivarāhīma vaṃśīẏagaṇake grantha o vijñāna dāna karechi evaṃ tāderake viśāla sāmrājya pradāna karechi.
latin_ascii: tahale ki tara lokadera prati e janya himsa kare ye, allaha taderake sviya sampada hate kichu dana karechenay phalatah niscayai ami ivarahima vamsiyaganake grantha o vijnana dana karechi evam taderake visala samrajya pradana karechi.

latin_iast: anantara tādera madhye aneke ora prati viśvāsa sthāpana kareche evaṃ anekei oṭā hate virata raẏeche; evaṃ (tādera janya) śikhā viśiṣṭa jāhānnāmai yatheṣṭa.
latin_ascii: anantara tadera madhye aneke ora prati visvasa sthapana kareche evam anekei ota hate virata rayeche; evam (tadera janya) sikha visista jahannamai yathesta.

latin_iast: yārā āmāra nidarśanasamūhera prati aviśvāsī haẏeche tāderake avaśyai āmi jāhānnāmera āgune praveśa karāva. yakhana tāra carma vidagdha have, āmi tatparivarte tādera carma parivartana kare diva, yena tārā śāstira āsvāda grahaṇa kare, niścaẏai āllāha parākrānta, hikamātera adhikārī.
latin_ascii: yara amara nidarsanasamuhera prati avisvasi hayeche taderake avasyai ami jahannamera agune pravesa karava. yakhana tara carma vidagdha have, ami tatparivarte tadera carma parivartana kare diva, yena tara sastira asvada grahana kare, niscayai allaha parakranta, hikamatera adhikari.

latin_iast: āra yārā viśvāsa sthāpana kare sat kāryāvalī sampādana kareche, niścaẏai āmi tāderake jānnāte praveśa karāva, yāra nimne srotasvinīsamūha pravāhitā, tanmadhye tārā cirakāla avasthāna karave; sekhāne tādera janya pavitrā sahadharmiṇīgaṇa raẏeche evaṃ āmi tāderake suvistṛta chāẏā śītala sthāne praveśa karāva.
latin_ascii: ara yara visvasa sthapana kare sat karyavali sampadana kareche, niscayai ami taderake jannate pravesa karava, yara nimne srotasvinisamuha pravahita, tanmadhye tara cirakala avasthana karave; sekhane tadera janya pavitra sahadharminigana rayeche evam ami taderake suvistrta chaya sitala sthane pravesa karava.

latin_iast: niścaẏai āllāha tomāderake ādeśa karachena, gacchita viṣaẏa ora adhikārīke arpaṇa kara; evaṃ yakhana tomarā lokadera madhye vicāra mīmāṃsā kara takhana nyāẏa vicāra kara; avaśyai āllāha tomāderake uttama upadeśa dāna karachena; niścaẏai āllāha śravaṇakārī, paridarśaka.
latin_ascii: niscayai allaha tomaderake adesa karachena, gacchita visaya ora adhikarike arpana kara; evam yakhana tomara lokadera madhye vicara mimamsa kara takhana nyaya vicara kara; avasyai allaha tomaderake uttama upadesa dana karachena; niscayai allaha sravanakari, paridarsaka.

latin_iast: he mu’minagaṇa! tomarā āllāhara o rāsūlera anugata hao evaṃ tomādera janya yārā vicāraka tādera; ataḥpara yadi tomādera madhye kona viṣaẏe kona matavirodha haẏa tāhale āllāha o rāsūlera dike pratyāvartita hao, yadi tomarā āllāha o parakālera prati viśvāsa kare thāka; eṭāi kalyāṇakara o śreṣṭhatara parisamāpti.
latin_ascii: he mu’minagana! tomara allahara o rasulera anugata hao evam tomadera janya yara vicaraka tadera; atahpara yadi tomadera madhye kona visaye kona matavirodha haya tahale allaha o rasulera dike pratyavartita hao, yadi tomara allaha o parakalera prati visvasa kare thaka; etai kalyanakara o sresthatara parisamapti.

latin_iast: tumi ki tādera prati lakṣya karani yārā dāvī kare ye, tomāra prati yā avatīrṇa haẏeche evaṃ tomāra pūrve yā avatīrṇa haẏechila tatprati tārā viśvāsa kare? athaca tārā nijedera mukāddāmā tāgutera nikaṭa niẏe yete cāẏa, yadio tāderake ādeśa karā haẏechila yena tāke aviśvāsa kare; pakṣāntare śāitāna tāderake pratārita kare pathabhraṣṭa karate cāẏa.
latin_ascii: tumi ki tadera prati laksya karani yara davi kare ye, tomara prati ya avatirna hayeche evam tomara purve ya avatirna hayechila tatprati tara visvasa karey athaca tara nijedera mukaddama tagutera nikata niye yete caya, yadio taderake adesa kara hayechila yena take avisvasa kare; paksantare saitana taderake pratarita kare pathabhrasta karate caya.

latin_iast: āra yakhana tāderake valā haẏa ye, āllāha yā avatīrṇa karechena sei dike evaṃ rāsūlera dike eso takhana tumi munāphikaderake dekhave, tārā tomā hate mukha phiriẏe vicchinna hacche.
latin_ascii: ara yakhana taderake vala haya ye, allaha ya avatirna karechena sei dike evam rasulera dike eso takhana tumi munaphikaderake dekhave, tara toma hate mukha phiriye vicchinna hacche.

latin_iast: anantara takhana kirūpa have, yakhana tādera hastasamūha yā pūrve preraṇa kareche, tajjanya tādera upara vipada upanīta haẏa? takhana tārā āllāhara śapatha karate karate tomāra kāche ese valave - kalyāṇa o samprīti vyatīta āmarā kichui kāmanā karini.
latin_ascii: anantara takhana kirupa have, yakhana tadera hastasamuha ya purve prerana kareche, tajjanya tadera upara vipada upanita hayay takhana tara allahara sapatha karate karate tomara kache ese valave - kalyana o sampriti vyatita amara kichui kamana karini.

latin_iast: tādera antarasamūhe yā āche āllāha tā jñāta āchena. ataeva tumi tādera dika hate nirlipta hao evaṃ tāderake sadupadeśa pradāna kara evaṃ tāderake tādera samvandhe hṛdaẏasparśī kathā vala.
latin_ascii: tadera antarasamuhe ya ache allaha ta jnata achena. ataeva tumi tadera dika hate nirlipta hao evam taderake sadupadesa pradana kara evam taderake tadera samvandhe hrdayasparsi katha vala.

latin_iast: āmi etadvyatīta konai rāsūla preraṇa karini ye, āllāhara ādeśe tā~ra ānugatya svīkāra karave, evaṃ yadi tārā svīẏa jīvanera upara atyācāra karāra para tomāra nikaṭa āgamana karata, ataḥpara āllāhara nikaṭa kṣamā prārthanā karata āra rāsūlao tādera janya āllāhara nikaṭa kṣamā cāita tāhale niścaẏai tārā āllāhake tāovāha kavūlakārī, karuṇāmaẏa dekhate peta.
latin_ascii: ami etadvyatita konai rasula prerana karini ye, allahara adese ta~ra anugatya svikara karave, evam yadi tara sviya jivanera upara atyacara karara para tomara nikata agamana karata, atahpara allahara nikata ksama prarthana karata ara rasulao tadera janya allahara nikata ksama caita tahale niscayai tara allahake taovaha kavulakari, karunamaya dekhate peta.

latin_iast: ataeva tomāra ravera śapatha! tārā kakhanai viśvāsa sthāpanakārī hate pāravenā, ye paryanta tomāke tādera sṛṣṭa virodhera vicāraka nā kare, ataḥpara tumi ye vicāra karave tā dvidhāhīna antare grahaṇa nā kare evaṃ oṭā santaṣṭa citte kavūla nā kare.
latin_ascii: ataeva tomara ravera sapatha! tara kakhanai visvasa sthapanakari hate paravena, ye paryanta tomake tadera srsta virodhera vicaraka na kare, atahpara tumi ye vicara karave ta dvidhahina antare grahana na kare evam ota santasta citte kavula na kare.

latin_iast: āra āmi yadi tādera upara vidhivaddha karatāma ye, tomarā nijederake hatyā kara athavā svīẏa gṛha prācīra hate niskrānta hao tāhale tādera alpa saṃkhyaka vyatīta oṭā karatanā evaṃ yadviṣaẏe tāderake upadeśa deẏā haẏechila tā yadi tārā karata tāhale niścaẏai oṭā hata tādera janya kalyāṇakara evaṃ dharmera upara sudṛr̤ha thākāra janyao.
latin_ascii: ara ami yadi tadera upara vidhivaddha karatama ye, tomara nijederake hatya kara athava sviya grha pracira hate niskranta hao tahale tadera alpa samkhyaka vyatita ota karatana evam yadvisaye taderake upadesa deya hayechila ta yadi tara karata tahale niscayai ota hata tadera janya kalyanakara evam dharmera upara sudrrha thakara janyao.

latin_iast: evaṃ takhana āmi tāderake avaśyai svīẏa sannidhāna hate vṛhattara pratidāna pradāna karatāma.
latin_ascii: evam takhana ami taderake avasyai sviya sannidhana hate vrhattara pratidana pradana karatama.

latin_iast: evaṃ niścaẏai tāderake sarala patha pradarśana karatāma.
latin_ascii: evam niscayai taderake sarala patha pradarsana karatama.

latin_iast: āra ye keha āllāha o rāsūlera anugata haẏa, tārā ai vyaktidera saṅgī have yādera prati āllāha anugraha karechena; arthāt nāvīgaṇa, satya sādhakagaṇa, śahīdagaṇa o sat karmaśīlagaṇa; evaṃ erāi sarvottama saṅgī.
latin_ascii: ara ye keha allaha o rasulera anugata haya, tara ai vyaktidera sangi have yadera prati allaha anugraha karechena; arthat navigana, satya sadhakagana, sahidagana o sat karmasilagana; evam erai sarvottama sangi.

latin_iast: eṭāi āllāhara anugraha evaṃ āllāhara jñānai yatheṣṭa.
latin_ascii: etai allahara anugraha evam allahara jnanai yathesta.

latin_iast: he mu’minagaṇa! tomarā svīẏa ātmarakṣāra sarañjāma tule nāo, ataḥpara pṛthakabhāve vahirgata hao athavā sammilitabhāve abhiyāna kara.
latin_ascii: he mu’minagana! tomara sviya atmaraksara saranjama tule nao, atahpara prthakabhave vahirgata hao athava sammilitabhave abhiyana kara.

latin_iast: āra tomādera madhye erūpa lokao raẏeche ye śaithilya kare; anantara yadi tomādera upara vipada nipatita haẏa tāhale valeḥ āmāra prati āllāhara anugraha chila ye, āmi takhana tādera sāthe upasthita chilāmanā.
latin_ascii: ara tomadera madhye erupa lokao rayeche ye saithilya kare; anantara yadi tomadera upara vipada nipatita haya tahale valeh amara prati allahara anugraha chila ye, ami takhana tadera sathe upasthita chilamana.

latin_iast: pakṣāntare yadi āllāhara sannidhāna hate tomādera upara anugraha, sampada avatīrṇa haẏa tāhale erūpabhāve vale yena tomādera o tādera madhye konai samvandha chilanā - hāẏa! yadi āmio tādera saṅgī hatāma tāhale mahāna phalaprada suphala lābha karatāma!
latin_ascii: paksantare yadi allahara sannidhana hate tomadera upara anugraha, sampada avatirna haya tahale erupabhave vale yena tomadera o tadera madhye konai samvandha chilana - haya! yadi amio tadera sangi hatama tahale mahana phalaprada suphala labha karatama!

latin_iast: ataeva yārā duniẏāra vinimaẏe ākhirāta kraẏa kare tārā yena āllāhara pathe saṃgrāma kare; evaṃ ye āllāhara pathe yuddha kare, ataḥpara nihata athavā vijaẏī haẏa, tāhale āmi tāke mahāna pratidāna pradāna karava.
latin_ascii: ataeva yara duniyara vinimaye akhirata kraya kare tara yena allahara pathe samgrama kare; evam ye allahara pathe yuddha kare, atahpara nihata athava vijayi haya, tahale ami take mahana pratidana pradana karava.

latin_iast: tomādera ki haẏeche ye, tomarā āllāhara pathe yuddha karachanā? athaca nārī, puruṣa evaṃ śiśudera madhye yārā durvala tārā valeḥ he āmādera rāvva! āmāderake atyācārī ei nagara hate niskṛti dina evaṃ svīẏa sannidhāna hate āmādera pṛṣṭhapoṣaka o nijera nikaṭa hate āmādera janya sāhāyyakārī preraṇa karuna.
latin_ascii: tomadera ki hayeche ye, tomara allahara pathe yuddha karachanay athaca nari, purusa evam sisudera madhye yara durvala tara valeh he amadera ravva! amaderake atyacari ei nagara hate niskrti dina evam sviya sannidhana hate amadera prsthaposaka o nijera nikata hate amadera janya sahayyakari prerana karuna.

latin_iast: yārā viśvāsa sthāpana kareche tārā āllāhara pathe saṃgrāma kare evaṃ yārā kāphira tārā śāitānera pakṣe yuddha kare; sutarāṃ tomarā śāitānera vandhudera viruddhe yuddha kara; niścaẏai śāitānera kauśala durvala.
latin_ascii: yara visvasa sthapana kareche tara allahara pathe samgrama kare evam yara kaphira tara saitanera pakse yuddha kare; sutaram tomara saitanera vandhudera viruddhe yuddha kara; niscayai saitanera kausala durvala.

latin_iast: tumi ki tādera prati lakṣya karani yāderake valā haẏechila ye, tomādera hastasamūha saṃyata rākha evaṃ sālāta pratiṣṭhita kara o yākāta pradāna kara. anantara yakhana tādera prati jihāda pharaya kare deẏā hala takhana tādera ekadala āllāhake yerūpa bhaẏa karave tadrupa mānuṣake bhaẏa karate lāgala, varaṃ tadapekṣāo adhika; evaṃ tārā valalaḥ he āmādera rāvva! āpani kena āmādera upara yuddha pharaya karalena? kena āmāderake āra kichukālera janya avasara dilenanā? tumi valaḥ pārthiva ānanda khuvai sīmita evaṃ dharmabhīrugaṇera janya parakālai kalyāṇakara; evaṃ tomarā khejura vīja parimāṇao atyācārita havenā.
latin_ascii: tumi ki tadera prati laksya karani yaderake vala hayechila ye, tomadera hastasamuha samyata rakha evam salata pratisthita kara o yakata pradana kara. anantara yakhana tadera prati jihada pharaya kare deya hala takhana tadera ekadala allahake yerupa bhaya karave tadrupa manusake bhaya karate lagala, varam tadapeksao adhika; evam tara valalah he amadera ravva! apani kena amadera upara yuddha pharaya karalenay kena amaderake ara kichukalera janya avasara dilenanay tumi valah parthiva ananda khuvai simita evam dharmabhiruganera janya parakalai kalyanakara; evam tomara khejura vija parimanao atyacarita havena.

latin_iast: tomarā yekhānei thāka nā kena, mṛtyu tomāderake peẏe yāve, yadio tomarā sudṛr̤ha durge avasthāna kara; evaṃ yadi tādera upara kona kalyāṇa avatīrṇa haẏa tāhale tārā valeḥ eṭā āllāhara nikaṭa hate evaṃ yadi tādera prati amaṅgala nipatita haẏa tāhale vale ye, eṭā tomāra nikaṭa hate haẏeche. tumi valaḥ samastai āllāhara nikaṭa hate haẏa; ataeva ai sampradāẏera ki haẏeche ye, tārā kona kathā vujhate ceṣṭā karenā!
latin_ascii: tomara yekhanei thaka na kena, mrtyu tomaderake peye yave, yadio tomara sudrrha durge avasthana kara; evam yadi tadera upara kona kalyana avatirna haya tahale tara valeh eta allahara nikata hate evam yadi tadera prati amangala nipatita haya tahale vale ye, eta tomara nikata hate hayeche. tumi valah samastai allahara nikata hate haya; ataeva ai sampradayera ki hayeche ye, tara kona katha vujhate cesta karena!

latin_iast: tomāra nikaṭa ye kalyāṇa upasthita haẏa tā āllāhara sannidhāna hate evaṃ tomāra upara ye akalyāṇa nipatita haẏa tā tomāra nija hate haẏe thāke, evaṃ āmi tomāke mānavamanḍalīra janya rāsūla rūpe preraṇa karechi; evaṃ āllāhara sākṣīi yatheṣṭa.
latin_ascii: tomara nikata ye kalyana upasthita haya ta allahara sannidhana hate evam tomara upara ye akalyana nipatita haya ta tomara nija hate haye thake, evam ami tomake manavamandalira janya rasula rupe prerana karechi; evam allahara saksii yathesta.

latin_iast: ye keha rāsūlera anugata haẏa niścaẏai se āllāharai anugata haẏe thāke, evaṃ ye phire yāẏa āmi tāra janya tomāke rakṣaka rūpe preraṇa karini.
latin_ascii: ye keha rasulera anugata haya niscayai se allaharai anugata haye thake, evam ye phire yaya ami tara janya tomake raksaka rupe prerana karini.

latin_iast: āra tārā valeḥ āmarā anugata. kintu yakhana tārā tomāra nikaṭa hate vera haẏe yāẏa takhana tādera ekadala, tumi yā vala tāra viruddhe parāmarśa kare; evaṃ tārā yā parāmarśa kare āllāha tā lipivaddha karena; ataeva tādera prati nispṛha hao evaṃ āllāhara upara nirbhara kara; evaṃ āllāhai kārya sampādane yatheṣṭa.
latin_ascii: ara tara valeh amara anugata. kintu yakhana tara tomara nikata hate vera haye yaya takhana tadera ekadala, tumi ya vala tara viruddhe paramarsa kare; evam tara ya paramarsa kare allaha ta lipivaddha karena; ataeva tadera prati nisprha hao evam allahara upara nirbhara kara; evam allahai karya sampadane yathesta.

latin_iast: tārā kena kuraāna samvandhe gaveṣanā karenā? āra yadi oṭā āllāha vyatīta anya kārao nikaṭa hate hata tāhale tārā ote vahu vaiparitya dekhate peta.
latin_ascii: tara kena kuraana samvandhe gavesana karenay ara yadi ota allaha vyatita anya karao nikata hate hata tahale tara ote vahu vaiparitya dekhate peta.

latin_iast: āra yakhana tādera nikaṭa kona śāsti athavā bhītijanaka viṣaẏa upasthita haẏa takhana tārā oṭā raṭanā karate thāke evaṃ yadi tārā oṭā rāsūlera kiṃvā tādera ādeśa dātādera prati samarpana karata tāhale tādera madhye saṭhika tathya peẏe yeta evaṃ yadi tomādera prati āllāhara anugraha o karuṇā nā hata tāhale alpa saṃkhyaka vyatīta tomarā śāitānera anusaraṇa karate.
latin_ascii: ara yakhana tadera nikata kona sasti athava bhitijanaka visaya upasthita haya takhana tara ota ratana karate thake evam yadi tara ota rasulera kimva tadera adesa datadera prati samarpana karata tahale tadera madhye sathika tathya peye yeta evam yadi tomadera prati allahara anugraha o karuna na hata tahale alpa samkhyaka vyatita tomara saitanera anusarana karate.

latin_iast: ataeva āllāhara pathe yuddha kara; tomāra nijera chār̤ā tomāra upara anya kārao bhāra arpaṇa karā haẏani evaṃ viśvāsīderake uddhuddha kara; acirei āllāha aviśvāsīdera saṃgrāma pratirodha karavena; evaṃ āllāha saṃgrāme sudṛr̤ha o śāsti dāne kaṭhora.
latin_ascii: ataeva allahara pathe yuddha kara; tomara nijera chara tomara upara anya karao bhara arpana kara hayani evam visvasiderake uddhuddha kara; acirei allaha avisvasidera samgrama pratirodha karavena; evam allaha samgrame sudrrha o sasti dane kathora.

latin_iast: ye keha sat supāriśa karave se ora aṃśa pāve evaṃ ye keha asat supāriśa karave seo ora aṃśa prāpta have; evaṃ āllāha sarvaśaktimāna.
latin_ascii: ye keha sat suparisa karave se ora amsa pave evam ye keha asat suparisa karave seo ora amsa prapta have; evam allaha sarvasaktimana.

latin_iast: āra yakhana tomarā śubhāśīṣe sambhāṣita hao takhana tomarāo tā hate śreṣṭhatara śubha sambhāṣaṇa kara athavā oṭāi pratyarpaṇa kara; niścaẏai āllāha sarva viṣaẏe hisāva grahaṇakārī.
latin_ascii: ara yakhana tomara subhasise sambhasita hao takhana tomarao ta hate sresthatara subha sambhasana kara athava otai pratyarpana kara; niscayai allaha sarva visaye hisava grahanakari.

latin_iast: āllāha, tini vyatīta keha upāsya nei; niścaẏai ete sandeha nei ye, tini tomāderake ekatrita karavena; evaṃ vākye āllāha apekṣā ke veśi satyaparāẏana?
latin_ascii: allaha, tini vyatita keha upasya nei; niscayai ete sandeha nei ye, tini tomaderake ekatrita karavena; evam vakye allaha apeksa ke vesi satyaparayanay

latin_iast: anantara tomādera ki haẏeche ye, tomarā munāphikadera samvandhe dui dala hale? evaṃ tārā yā arjana kareche tajjanya āllāha tāderake pratyākhyāna karechena; āllāha yāke pathabhraṣṭa karena tumi ki tāke patha pradarśana karate cāo? evaṃ āllāha yāke pathabhraṣṭa karechena vastutaḥ tumi tāra janya konai patha pāvenā.
latin_ascii: anantara tomadera ki hayeche ye, tomara munaphikadera samvandhe dui dala haley evam tara ya arjana kareche tajjanya allaha taderake pratyakhyana karechena; allaha yake pathabhrasta karena tumi ki take patha pradarsana karate caoy evam allaha yake pathabhrasta karechena vastutah tumi tara janya konai patha pavena.

latin_iast: tārā icchā kare ye, tārā yerūpa kāphira tomarāo yena tadrupa kāphira haẏe yāo, yāte tomarāo tādera sadṛśa hao. ataeva tādera madhya hate vandhu grahaṇa karanā, ye paryanta nā tārā āllāhara pathe deśa tyāga kare; ataḥpara yadi tārā pratigamana kare tāhale tāderake dhara evaṃ yekhāne pāo tāderake saṃhāra kara; evaṃ tādera madhya hate vandhu athavā sāhāyyakārī grahaṇa karanā.
latin_ascii: tara iccha kare ye, tara yerupa kaphira tomarao yena tadrupa kaphira haye yao, yate tomarao tadera sadrsa hao. ataeva tadera madhya hate vandhu grahana karana, ye paryanta na tara allahara pathe desa tyaga kare; atahpara yadi tara pratigamana kare tahale taderake dhara evam yekhane pao taderake samhara kara; evam tadera madhya hate vandhu athava sahayyakari grahana karana.

latin_iast: kintu tomādera madhye o tādera madhye sandhivaddha sampradāẏera sāthe yārā sammilita haẏa, athavā tomādera sāthe yuddha karate saṃkucita citta haẏe yārā tomādera nikaṭa upasthita haẏa. yadi āllāha icchā karatena tāhale tomādera upara tāderake śaktiśālī karatena. tāhale niścaẏai tārā tomādera sāthe yuddha karata. ataḥpara yadi tārā tomādera dika hate sandhi prārthanā kare tāhale āllāha tādera pratikūle tomādera janya kona panthā rākhenani.
latin_ascii: kintu tomadera madhye o tadera madhye sandhivaddha sampradayera sathe yara sammilita haya, athava tomadera sathe yuddha karate samkucita citta haye yara tomadera nikata upasthita haya. yadi allaha iccha karatena tahale tomadera upara taderake saktisali karatena. tahale niscayai tara tomadera sathe yuddha karata. atahpara yadi tara tomadera dika hate sandhi prarthana kare tahale allaha tadera pratikule tomadera janya kona pantha rakhenani.

latin_iast: acirei tumi erūpao prāpta have, yārā tomādera dika hate o svīẏa sampradāẏa hate śāntira sāthe thākate icchā kare, yakhana tādera virodhera prati praluvdha karāno haẏa takhana tātei nipatita haẏa; anantara yadi tomādera dika hate nivṛtta nā haẏa o sandhi prārthanā nā kare evaṃ tādera hastasamūha saṃyata nā kare tāhale tāderake pākar̤āo kara evaṃ yekhāne pāo tāderake saṃhāra kara; ederai janya āllāha tomāderake prakāśya yukti pramāṇa dāna karechena.
latin_ascii: acirei tumi erupao prapta have, yara tomadera dika hate o sviya sampradaya hate santira sathe thakate iccha kare, yakhana tadera virodhera prati praluvdha karano haya takhana tatei nipatita haya; anantara yadi tomadera dika hate nivrtta na haya o sandhi prarthana na kare evam tadera hastasamuha samyata na kare tahale taderake pakarao kara evam yekhane pao taderake samhara kara; ederai janya allaha tomaderake prakasya yukti pramana dana karechena.

latin_iast: kona mu’minera ucita naẏa ye, bhrama vyatīta kona mu’minake hatyā kare; ye keha bhrama vaśataḥ kona mu’minake hatyā kare tāhale se janaika mu’mina dāsake mukta kare dive evaṃ tāra ātmīẏa svajanake hatyāra vinimaẏa samarpaṇa karave; kintu yadi tārā kṣamā kare deẏa evaṃ yadi se tomādera śatru sampradāẏera antargata o mu’mina haẏa tāhale janaika mu’mina dāsake mukti dāna karave; evaṃ yadi se tomādera madhye o tādera madhye sandhivaddha sampradāẏera antargata haẏa tāhale tāra svajanaderake hatyāra vinimaẏa arpaṇa karave evaṃ janaika mu’mina dāsake mukta karave; kintu yadi se oṭāẏa akṣama haẏa tāhale āllāhara nikaṭa hate kṣamā prāptira janya ekādikrame dui māsa siẏāma pālana karave. āllāha mahājñānī, vijñānamaẏa.
latin_ascii: kona mu’minera ucita naya ye, bhrama vyatita kona mu’minake hatya kare; ye keha bhrama vasatah kona mu’minake hatya kare tahale se janaika mu’mina dasake mukta kare dive evam tara atmiya svajanake hatyara vinimaya samarpana karave; kintu yadi tara ksama kare deya evam yadi se tomadera satru sampradayera antargata o mu’mina haya tahale janaika mu’mina dasake mukti dana karave; evam yadi se tomadera madhye o tadera madhye sandhivaddha sampradayera antargata haya tahale tara svajanaderake hatyara vinimaya arpana karave evam janaika mu’mina dasake mukta karave; kintu yadi se otaya aksama haya tahale allahara nikata hate ksama praptira janya ekadikrame dui masa siyama palana karave. allaha mahajnani, vijnanamaya.

latin_iast: āra ye keha icchā kare kona mu’minake hatyā kare tāhale tāra śāsti jāhānnāma, tanmadhye se sadā avasthāna karave evaṃ āllāha tāra prati kruddha haẏechena o tāke abhiśapta karechena evaṃ tāra janya bhīṣaṇa śāsti prastuta rekhechena.
latin_ascii: ara ye keha iccha kare kona mu’minake hatya kare tahale tara sasti jahannama, tanmadhye se sada avasthana karave evam allaha tara prati kruddha hayechena o take abhisapta karechena evam tara janya bhisana sasti prastuta rekhechena.

latin_iast: he mu’minagaṇa! yakhana tomarā āllāhara pathe vahirgata hao takhana pratyeka kāja yācāi kare nāo, evaṃ keha tomāderake ‘sālāma’ karale tāke valanā ye, ‘tumi mu’mina nao’; tomarā ki pārthiva jīvanera sampada anusandhāna karacho? tāhale āllāhara nikaṭa pracura sampada raẏeche; prathame tomarā airūpai chile, ataḥpara āllāha tomādera upara anugraha karechena. ataeva tomarā sthira kare nāo ye, tomarā yā karacha niścaẏai āllāha tadviṣaẏe abhijña.
latin_ascii: he mu’minagana! yakhana tomara allahara pathe vahirgata hao takhana pratyeka kaja yacai kare nao, evam keha tomaderake ‘salama’ karale take valana ye, ‘tumi mu’mina nao’; tomara ki parthiva jivanera sampada anusandhana karachoy tahale allahara nikata pracura sampada rayeche; prathame tomara airupai chile, atahpara allaha tomadera upara anugraha karechena. ataeva tomara sthira kare nao ye, tomara ya karacha niscayai allaha tadvisaye abhijna.

latin_iast: mu’minadera madhye yārā kona duḥkha pīr̤ā vyatītai gṛhe vase thāke, āra yārā svīẏa dhana o prāṇa dvārā āllāhara pathe jihāda kare tārā samāna naẏa; yārā dhana-prāṇa dvārā jihāda kare āllāha tāderake gṛhe avasthānakārīdera upara ucca maryādā diẏechena; evaṃ sakalakei āllāha kalyāṇaprada pratiśruti dāna karechena. evaṃ upaviṣṭadera upara dharmayoddhāgaṇake mahāna pratidāne gauravānvita karechena.
latin_ascii: mu’minadera madhye yara kona duhkha pira vyatitai grhe vase thake, ara yara sviya dhana o prana dvara allahara pathe jihada kare tara samana naya; yara dhana-prana dvara jihada kare allaha taderake grhe avasthanakaridera upara ucca maryada diyechena; evam sakalakei allaha kalyanaprada pratisruti dana karechena. evam upavistadera upara dharmayoddhaganake mahana pratidane gauravanvita karechena.

latin_iast: svīẏa sannidhāna hate padamaryādā, kṣamā o karunā (dvārā gauravānvita karechena) evaṃ āllāha kṣamāśīla, karuṇāmaẏa.
latin_ascii: sviya sannidhana hate padamaryada, ksama o karuna (dvara gauravanvita karechena) evam allaha ksamasila, karunamaya.

latin_iast: yārā svīẏa jīvanera prati atyācāra karechila, mālāka/phereśatā tādera prāṇa haraṇa kare vale, tomarā ki avasthāẏa chile? tārā vale, āmarā duniẏāẏa asahāẏa chilāma; tārā vale, āllāhara pṛthivī ki praśasta chilanā ye, tanmadhye tomarā hijarāta karate? ataeva oderai vāsasthāna jāhānnāma evaṃ kata nikṛṣṭa ai jāẏagā!
latin_ascii: yara sviya jivanera prati atyacara karechila, malaka/pheresata tadera prana harana kare vale, tomara ki avasthaya chiley tara vale, amara duniyaya asahaya chilama; tara vale, allahara prthivi ki prasasta chilana ye, tanmadhye tomara hijarata karatey ataeva oderai vasasthana jahannama evam kata nikrsta ai jayaga!

latin_iast: kintu puruṣa, nārī evaṃ śiśudera madhye asahāẏatā vaśataḥ yārā kona upāẏa karate pārenā athavā kona patha prāpta haẏanā.
latin_ascii: kintu purusa, nari evam sisudera madhye asahayata vasatah yara kona upaya karate parena athava kona patha prapta hayana.

latin_iast: phalataḥ tāderai āśā āche ye, āllāha tāderake kṣamā karavena evaṃ āllāha mārjanākārī, kṣamāśīla.
latin_ascii: phalatah taderai asa ache ye, allaha taderake ksama karavena evam allaha marjanakari, ksamasila.

latin_iast: āra ye keha āllāhara pathe deśa tyāga kare se pṛthivīte vahu praśasta sthāna o svacchalatā prāpta have. evaṃ ye keha gṛha hate vahirgata haẏe āllāha o rāsūlera uddeśe deśa tyāga kare, ataḥpara se mṛtyumukhe patita haẏa, tāhale niścaẏai era pratidāna āllāhara upara nyasta raẏeche; evaṃ āllāha kṣamāśīla, karuṇāmaẏa.
latin_ascii: ara ye keha allahara pathe desa tyaga kare se prthivite vahu prasasta sthana o svacchalata prapta have. evam ye keha grha hate vahirgata haye allaha o rasulera uddese desa tyaga kare, atahpara se mrtyumukhe patita haya, tahale niscayai era pratidana allahara upara nyasta rayeche; evam allaha ksamasila, karunamaya.

latin_iast: āra yakhana tomarā bhūpṛṣṭhe bhramaṇa kara takhana sālāta saṃkṣepa karale tomādera kona aparādha nei, yadi tomarā āśaṃkā kara ye, yārā aviśvāsī tārā tomāderake vivrata karave; niścaẏai kāphirerā tomādera prakāśya śatru.
latin_ascii: ara yakhana tomara bhuprsthe bhramana kara takhana salata samksepa karale tomadera kona aparadha nei, yadi tomara asamka kara ye, yara avisvasi tara tomaderake vivrata karave; niscayai kaphirera tomadera prakasya satru.

latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana tumi tādera (sainyadera) madhye thāka, ataḥpara sālāte danḍāẏamāna hao takhana yena tādera ekadala tomāra sāthe danḍāẏamāna haẏa evaṃ sva sva astra grahaṇa kare; ataḥpara yakhana sājadāh sampanna kare takhana yena tārā tomāra paścādvartī haẏa; evaṃ anya dala yārā sālāta ādāẏa kareni tārā yena agrasara haẏe tomāra sāthe sālāta ādāẏa kare evaṃ sva sva ātmarakṣikā o astra grahaṇa kare. aviśvāsīrā icchā kare ye, tomarā svīẏa astraśastra o dravya sambhāra samvandhe asatarka halei tārā ekayoge tomādera upara nipatita haẏa; evaṃ ete tomādera aparādha nei yadi tomarā vṛṣṭipāte vivrata haẏe athavā pīr̤ita avasthāẏa sva sva astra parityāga kara evaṃ svīẏa ātmarakṣikā saṅge grahaṇa kara; niścaẏai āllāha aviśvāsīdera janya avamānanākara śāsti prastuta kare rekhechena.
latin_ascii: evam yakhana tumi tadera (sainyadera) madhye thaka, atahpara salate dandayamana hao takhana yena tadera ekadala tomara sathe dandayamana haya evam sva sva astra grahana kare; atahpara yakhana sajadah sampanna kare takhana yena tara tomara pascadvarti haya; evam anya dala yara salata adaya kareni tara yena agrasara haye tomara sathe salata adaya kare evam sva sva atmaraksika o astra grahana kare. avisvasira iccha kare ye, tomara sviya astrasastra o dravya sambhara samvandhe asatarka halei tara ekayoge tomadera upara nipatita haya; evam ete tomadera aparadha nei yadi tomara vrstipate vivrata haye athava pirita avasthaya sva sva astra parityaga kara evam sviya atmaraksika sange grahana kara; niscayai allaha avisvasidera janya avamananakara sasti prastuta kare rekhechena.

latin_iast: ataḥpara yakhana tomarā sālāta sampanna kara takhana danḍāẏamāna, upaviṣṭa evaṃ śāẏita avasthāẏa āllāhake smaraṇa kara; ataḥpara yakhana tomarā nirāpada hao takhana sālāta pratiṣṭhita kara; niścaẏai sālāta viśvāsīgaṇera upara nirdiṣṭa samaẏera janya nirdhārita.
latin_ascii: atahpara yakhana tomara salata sampanna kara takhana dandayamana, upavista evam sayita avasthaya allahake smarana kara; atahpara yakhana tomara nirapada hao takhana salata pratisthita kara; niscayai salata visvasiganera upara nirdista samayera janya nirdharita.

latin_iast: evaṃ sei sampradāẏera paścāddhāvane śaithilya karanā; yadi tomarā kaṣṭa peẏe thāka tāhale tārāo tomādera anurūpa kaṣṭa bhoga kareche; evaṃ tatsaha āllāha hate tomādera ye bharasā āche tādera sei bharasā nei; evaṃ āllāha mahājñānī, prajñāmaẏa.
latin_ascii: evam sei sampradayera pascaddhavane saithilya karana; yadi tomara kasta peye thaka tahale tarao tomadera anurupa kasta bhoga kareche; evam tatsaha allaha hate tomadera ye bharasa ache tadera sei bharasa nei; evam allaha mahajnani, prajnamaya.

latin_iast: niścaẏai āmi tomāra prati satyasaha grantha avatīrṇa karechi - yena tumi tadanuyāẏī mānavaderake ādeśa pradāna kara, yā āllāha tomāke śikṣā dāna karechena evaṃ tumi viśvāsaghātakadera pakṣe vitarkakārī haẏonā.
latin_ascii: niscayai ami tomara prati satyasaha grantha avatirna karechi - yena tumi tadanuyayi manavaderake adesa pradana kara, ya allaha tomake siksa dana karechena evam tumi visvasaghatakadera pakse vitarkakari hayona.

latin_iast: evaṃ āllāhara nikaṭa kṣamā prārthanā kara; niścaẏai āllāha kṣamāśīla, karuṇāmaẏa.
latin_ascii: evam allahara nikata ksama prarthana kara; niscayai allaha ksamasila, karunamaya.

latin_iast: evaṃ yārā svīẏa jīvanera prati viśvāsaghātakatā kare, tumi tādera pakṣe virtaka karanā; niścaẏai āllāha viśvāsaghātaka pāpīke bhālavāsenanā.
latin_ascii: evam yara sviya jivanera prati visvasaghatakata kare, tumi tadera pakse virtaka karana; niscayai allaha visvasaghataka papike bhalavasenana.

latin_iast: tārā mānava hate gopana karate cāẏa, kintu āllāha hate gopana karate pārenā; evaṃ tini tādera saṅge raẏechena yakhana tārā rajanīte emana viṣaẏe parāmarśa kare yāte tini sammata nana; evaṃ tārā yā karache āllāha tāra pariveṣṭanakārī.
latin_ascii: tara manava hate gopana karate caya, kintu allaha hate gopana karate parena; evam tini tadera sange rayechena yakhana tara rajanite emana visaye paramarsa kare yate tini sammata nana; evam tara ya karache allaha tara parivestanakari.

latin_iast: sāvadhāna! tomarāi ai loka yārā odera pakṣa hate pārthiva jīvana samvandhe vitarka karacha; kintu kiẏāmāta divase tādera pakṣa hate ke āllāhara sāthe vitarka karave evaṃ ke tādera kārya sampādanakārī have?
latin_ascii: savadhana! tomarai ai loka yara odera paksa hate parthiva jivana samvandhe vitarka karacha; kintu kiyamata divase tadera paksa hate ke allahara sathe vitarka karave evam ke tadera karya sampadanakari havey

latin_iast: evaṃ ye keha duskārya kare athavā svīẏa jīvanera prati atyācāra kare, ataḥpara āllāhara nikaṭa kṣamā prārthī haẏa, se āllāhake kṣamāśīla, karuṇāmaẏa dekhate pāve.
latin_ascii: evam ye keha duskarya kare athava sviya jivanera prati atyacara kare, atahpara allahara nikata ksama prarthi haya, se allahake ksamasila, karunamaya dekhate pave.

latin_iast: evaṃ ye keha pāpa arjana kare, vastutaḥ se svīẏa ātmāra pratii era pratikriẏā pau~chiẏe thāke evaṃ āllāha mahājñānī, vijñānamaẏa.
latin_ascii: evam ye keha papa arjana kare, vastutah se sviya atmara pratii era pratikriya pau~chiye thake evam allaha mahajnani, vijnanamaya.

latin_iast: āra ye keha aparādha athavā pāpa arjana kare, ataḥpara oṭā niraparādhīra prati āropa kare, tāhale se nijei sei aparādha o prakāśya pāpa vahana karave.
latin_ascii: ara ye keha aparadha athava papa arjana kare, atahpara ota niraparadhira prati aropa kare, tahale se nijei sei aparadha o prakasya papa vahana karave.

latin_iast: āra yadi tomāra prati āllāhara anugraha o karuṇā nā hata tāhale tādera ekadala tomāke pathabhraṣṭa karate icchuka haẏechila, evaṃ tārā nijederake chār̤ā vipadagāmī kareni o tārā tomāke kona viṣaẏe kleśa dite pāravenā; evaṃ āllāha tomāra prati grantha o prajñā avatīrṇa karechena evaṃ tumi yā jānatenā tini tā tomāke śikṣā diẏechena; evaṃ tomāra prati āllāhara asīma karuṇā raẏeche.
