latin_iast: he āmāra putragaṇa! tomarā yāo, iusupha o tāra sahodarera anusandhāna kara evaṃ āllāhara karuṇā hate tomarā nirāśa haẏonā, kāraṇa kāphira vyatīta kehai āllāhara karuṇā hate nirāśa haẏanā.
latin_ascii: he amara putragana! tomara yao, iusupha o tara sahodarera anusandhana kara evam allahara karuna hate tomara nirasa hayona, karana kaphira vyatita kehai allahara karuna hate nirasa hayana.

latin_iast: yakhana tārā tāra nikaṭa upasthita hala takhana valalaḥ he āyīya! āmarā o āmādera parivāra parijana vipanna haẏe par̤echi evaṃ āmarā tuccha paṇya niẏe esechi; āpani āmādera rasada pūrṇa mātrāẏa dina evaṃ āmāderake dāna karuna; āllāha dātāderake puraskṛta karena.
latin_ascii: yakhana tara tara nikata upasthita hala takhana valalah he ayiya! amara o amadera parivara parijana vipanna haye parechi evam amara tuccha panya niye esechi; apani amadera rasada purna matraya dina evam amaderake dana karuna; allaha dataderake puraskrta karena.

latin_iast: se valalaḥ tomarā ki jāna, tomarā iusupha o tāra sahodarera prati kirūpa ācaraṇa karechile, yakhana tomarā chile ajña?
latin_ascii: se valalah tomara ki jana, tomara iusupha o tara sahodarera prati kirupa acarana karechile, yakhana tomara chile ajnay

latin_iast: tārā valalaḥ tāhale ki tumii iusupha? se valalaḥ āmii iusupha evaṃ ei āmāra sahodara; āllāha āmādera prati anugraha karechena. ye vyakti muttākī o dhairyaśīla, āllāha seirūpa satkarmaparāẏaṇadera śramaphala naṣṭa karenanā.
latin_ascii: tara valalah tahale ki tumii iusuphay se valalah amii iusupha evam ei amara sahodara; allaha amadera prati anugraha karechena. ye vyakti muttaki o dhairyasila, allaha seirupa satkarmaparayanadera sramaphala nasta karenana.

latin_iast: tārā valalaḥ āllāhara śapatha! āllāha niścaẏai tomāke āmādera upara prādhānya diẏechena evaṃ āmarā niścaẏai aparādhī chilāma.
latin_ascii: tara valalah allahara sapatha! allaha niscayai tomake amadera upara pradhanya diyechena evam amara niscayai aparadhi chilama.

latin_iast: se valalaḥ āja tomādera viruddhe kona abhiyoga nei, āllāha tomāderake kṣamā karuna, evaṃ tini daẏāludera madhye śreṣṭha daẏālu.
latin_ascii: se valalah aja tomadera viruddhe kona abhiyoga nei, allaha tomaderake ksama karuna, evam tini dayaludera madhye srestha dayalu.

latin_iast: tomarā āmāra e jāmāṭi niẏe yāo evaṃ eṭā āmāra pitāra mukhamanḍalera upara rekha, tini dṛṣṭiśakti phire pāvena, āra tomarā tomādera parivārera sakalakei āmāra nikaṭa niẏe eso.
latin_ascii: tomara amara e jamati niye yao evam eta amara pitara mukhamandalera upara rekha, tini drstisakti phire pavena, ara tomara tomadera parivarera sakalakei amara nikata niye eso.

latin_iast: ataḥpara yātrīdala yakhana vera haẏe par̤ala takhana tādera pitā valalaḥ tomarā yadi āmāke aprakṛtistha mane nā kara tāhale valiḥ āmi iusuphera ghrāṇa pācchi.
latin_ascii: atahpara yatridala yakhana vera haye parala takhana tadera pita valalah tomara yadi amake aprakrtistha mane na kara tahale valih ami iusuphera ghrana pacchi.

latin_iast: tārā valalaḥ āllāhara śapatha! āpanito āpanāra pūrva vibhrāntitei raẏechena.
latin_ascii: tara valalah allahara sapatha! apanito apanara purva vibhrantitei rayechena.

latin_iast: ataḥpara yakhana susaṃvāda vāhaka upasthita hala evaṃ tāra mukhamanḍalera upara jāmāṭi rākhala takhana se dṛṣṭiśakti phire pela. se valalaḥ āmi ki tomāderake valini ye, āmi āllāhara nikaṭa hate yā jāni tomarā tā jānanā.
latin_ascii: atahpara yakhana susamvada vahaka upasthita hala evam tara mukhamandalera upara jamati rakhala takhana se drstisakti phire pela. se valalah ami ki tomaderake valini ye, ami allahara nikata hate ya jani tomara ta janana.

latin_iast: tārā valalaḥ he āmādera pitā! āmādera pāpera janya kṣamā prārthanā karuna; āmarāto aparādhī.
latin_ascii: tara valalah he amadera pita! amadera papera janya ksama prarthana karuna; amarato aparadhi.

latin_iast: se valalaḥ āmi āmāra ravera nikaṭa tomādera janya kṣamā prārthanā karava, tinito ati kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.
latin_ascii: se valalah ami amara ravera nikata tomadera janya ksama prarthana karava, tinito ati ksamasila, parama dayalu.

latin_iast: ataḥpara tārā yakhana iusuphera nikaṭa upasthita hala takhana se tāra mātā-pitāke āliṅgana karala evaṃ valalaḥ āpanārā āllāhara icchāẏa nirāpade misare praveśa karuna!
latin_ascii: atahpara tara yakhana iusuphera nikata upasthita hala takhana se tara mata-pitake alingana karala evam valalah apanara allahara icchaya nirapade misare pravesa karuna!

latin_iast: āra iusupha tāra mātā-pitāke uccāsane vasāla evaṃ tārā savāi tāra sāmane sājadāhaẏa luṭiẏe par̤ala. se valalaḥ he āmāra pitā! eṭāi āmāra pūrvekāra svapnera vyākhyā; āmāra rāvva oṭā satye pariṇata karechena evaṃ tini āmāke kārāgāra hate mukta karechena evaṃ śāitāna āmāra o āmāra bhāidera samparka naṣṭa karāra parao āpanāderake maru añcala hate ekhāne ene diẏe āmāra prati anugraha karechena, āmāra rāvva yā icchā tā nipuṇatāra sāthe kare thākena, tinito sarvajña, prajñāmaẏa.
latin_ascii: ara iusupha tara mata-pitake uccasane vasala evam tara savai tara samane sajadahaya lutiye parala. se valalah he amara pita! etai amara purvekara svapnera vyakhya; amara ravva ota satye parinata karechena evam tini amake karagara hate mukta karechena evam saitana amara o amara bhaidera samparka nasta karara parao apanaderake maru ancala hate ekhane ene diye amara prati anugraha karechena, amara ravva ya iccha ta nipunatara sathe kare thakena, tinito sarvajna, prajnamaya.

latin_iast: he āmāra rāvva! āpani āmāke rājya dāna karechena evaṃ svapnera vyākhyā śikṣā diẏechena. he ākāśamanḍalī o pṛthivīra sṛṣṭikartā! āpanii ihaloka o paraloke āmāra abhibhāvaka, āpani āmāke musalima hisāve mṛtyu dāna karuna evaṃ āmāke satkarmaparāẏaṇadera antarbhukta karuna!
latin_ascii: he amara ravva! apani amake rajya dana karechena evam svapnera vyakhya siksa diyechena. he akasamandali o prthivira srstikarta! apanii ihaloka o paraloke amara abhibhavaka, apani amake musalima hisave mrtyu dana karuna evam amake satkarmaparayanadera antarbhukta karuna!

latin_iast: eṭā adṛśyalokera saṃvāda yā tomāke āmi ahī dvārā avahita karachi, ṣar̤ayantrakāle yakhana tārā mataikye pau~chechila takhana tumi tādera sāthe chilenā.
latin_ascii: eta adrsyalokera samvada ya tomake ami ahi dvara avahita karachi, sarayantrakale yakhana tara mataikye pau~chechila takhana tumi tadera sathe chilena.

latin_iast: tumi yatai cāo nā kena, adhikāṃśa lokai īmāna ānāra naẏa.
latin_ascii: tumi yatai cao na kena, adhikamsa lokai imana anara naya.

latin_iast: āra tumito tādera kāche kona pāriśramika dāvī karachonā, eṭāto viśvajagatera janya upadeśa chār̤ā kichu naẏa.
latin_ascii: ara tumito tadera kache kona parisramika davi karachona, etato visvajagatera janya upadesa chara kichu naya.

latin_iast: ākāśamanḍalī o pṛthivīte aneka nidarśana raẏeche, tārā e samasta pratyakṣa kare, kintu tārā e savera prati udāsīna.
latin_ascii: akasamandali o prthivite aneka nidarsana rayeche, tara e samasta pratyaksa kare, kintu tara e savera prati udasina.

latin_iast: tādera adhikāṃśa āllāhake viśvāsa kare, kintu tā~ra sāthe śarīka kare.
latin_ascii: tadera adhikamsa allahake visvasa kare, kintu ta~ra sathe sarika kare.

latin_iast: tāhale ki tārā āllāhara sarvagrāsī śāsti hate athavā tādera ajñātasāre kiẏāmātera ākasmika upasthiti hate nirāpada?
latin_ascii: tahale ki tara allahara sarvagrasi sasti hate athava tadera ajnatasare kiyamatera akasmika upasthiti hate nirapaday

latin_iast: tumi valaḥ eṭāi āmāra (āllāhara) patha; pratiṭi mānuṣake āmi āhavāna kari sajñāne, āmi evaṃ āmāra anusārīgaṇao; āllāha mahimānvita evaṃ yārā āllāhara sāthe śarīka sthāpana kare āmi tādera antabhurkta nai.
latin_ascii: tumi valah etai amara (allahara) patha; pratiti manusake ami ahavana kari sajnane, ami evam amara anusariganao; allaha mahimanvita evam yara allahara sathe sarika sthapana kare ami tadera antabhurkta nai.

latin_iast: tomāra pūrveo janapadavāsīdera madhya hate puruṣaderakei pāṭhiẏechilāma, yādera nikaṭa ahī pāṭhātāma; tārā ki pṛthivīte bhramaṇa kareni evaṃ tādera pūrvavartīdera ki pariṇāma haẏechila tā ki dekheni? yārā muttākī tādera janya parakālai śreẏa; tomarā ki vujhanā?
latin_ascii: tomara purveo janapadavasidera madhya hate purusaderakei pathiyechilama, yadera nikata ahi pathatama; tara ki prthivite bhramana kareni evam tadera purvavartidera ki parinama hayechila ta ki dekheniy yara muttaki tadera janya parakalai sreya; tomara ki vujhanay

latin_iast: avaśeṣe yakhana rāsūlagaṇa nirāśa hala evaṃ loke bhāvala ye, rāsūladerake mithyā āśvāsa deẏā haẏeche takhana tādera kāche āmāra sāhāyya elo. ebhāve āmi yāke icchā kari se uddhāra pāẏa, āra aparādhī sampradāẏa hate āmāra śāsti rada karā haẏanā.
latin_ascii: avasese yakhana rasulagana nirasa hala evam loke bhavala ye, rasuladerake mithya asvasa deya hayeche takhana tadera kache amara sahayya elo. ebhave ami yake iccha kari se uddhara paya, ara aparadhi sampradaya hate amara sasti rada kara hayana.

latin_iast: tādera vṛttānte vodhaśakti sampanna vyaktidera janya āche śikṣā, ihā emana vāṇī yā mithyā pravandha naẏa, kintu mu’minadera janya eṭā pūrva granthe yā āche uhāra samarthana evaṃ samasta kichura viśada vivaraṇa, hidāẏāta o rāhamāta.
latin_ascii: tadera vrttante vodhasakti sampanna vyaktidera janya ache siksa, iha emana vani ya mithya pravandha naya, kintu mu’minadera janya eta purva granthe ya ache uhara samarthana evam samasta kichura visada vivarana, hidayata o rahamata.

latin_iast: ālima lāma mīma rā, eguli kuraānera āẏāta; yā tomāra rāvva hate tomāra prati avatīrṇa haẏeche tā’i satya; kintu adhikāṃśa ete viśvāsa karenā.
latin_ascii: alima lama mima ra, eguli kuraanera ayata; ya tomara ravva hate tomara prati avatirna hayeche ta’i satya; kintu adhikamsa ete visvasa karena.

latin_iast: āllāhai urdhvadeśe ākāśamanḍalī sthāpana karechena stambha vyatīta, tomarā eṭā dekhacha. ataḥpara tini āraśe samāsīna halena evaṃ sūrya o cā~dake niẏamādhīna karalena; pratyeke nirdiṣṭakāla paryanta āvartana kare, tini sakala viṣaẏa niẏantraṇa karena evaṃ nidarśanasamūha viśadabhāve varṇanā karena yāte tomarā tomādera ravera sāthe sākṣāt samvandhe niścita viśvāsa karate pāra.
latin_ascii: allahai urdhvadese akasamandali sthapana karechena stambha vyatita, tomara eta dekhacha. atahpara tini arase samasina halena evam surya o ca~dake niyamadhina karalena; pratyeke nirdistakala paryanta avartana kare, tini sakala visaya niyantrana karena evam nidarsanasamuha visadabhave varnana karena yate tomara tomadera ravera sathe saksat samvandhe niscita visvasa karate para.

latin_iast: tinii bhūtalake vistṛta karechena evaṃ ote parvata o nadī sṛṣṭi karechena evaṃ pratyeka prakārera phala sṛṣṭi karechena jor̤āẏa jor̤āẏa; tini dinake rāta dvārā ācchādita karena; ete avaśyai nidarśana raẏeche cintāśīla sampradāẏera janya.
latin_ascii: tinii bhutalake vistrta karechena evam ote parvata o nadi srsti karechena evam pratyeka prakarera phala srsti karechena joraya joraya; tini dinake rata dvara acchadita karena; ete avasyai nidarsana rayeche cintasila sampradayera janya.

latin_iast: pṛthivīte raẏeche paraspara saṃlagna bhūkhanḍa; ote āche āṅgura-kānana, śaṣyakṣeta, ekādhika śira viśiṣṭa athavā eka śira viśiṣṭa khejura-vṛkṣa, siñcita ekai pānite; evaṃ phala hisāve ogulira katakake katakera upara āmi śreṣṭhatva diẏe thāki, avaśyai vodhaśakti sampanna sampradāẏera janya ete raẏeche nidarśana.
latin_ascii: prthivite rayeche paraspara samlagna bhukhanda; ote ache angura-kanana, sasyakseta, ekadhika sira visista athava eka sira visista khejura-vrksa, sincita ekai panite; evam phala hisave ogulira katakake katakera upara ami sresthatva diye thaki, avasyai vodhasakti sampanna sampradayera janya ete rayeche nidarsana.

latin_iast: yadi tumi vismita hao tāhale vismaẏera viṣaẏa tādera vaktavyaḥ māṭite pariṇata haoẏāra parao ki āmarā natuna jīvana lābha karava? orāi odera rāvvake asvīkāra kare evaṃ oderai galadeśe thākave lauha-śṛṃkhala, orāi jāhānnāmī evaṃ sekhāne orā cirasthāẏībhāve avasthānakārī.
latin_ascii: yadi tumi vismita hao tahale vismayera visaya tadera vaktavyah matite parinata haoyara parao ki amara natuna jivana labha karavay orai odera ravvake asvikara kare evam oderai galadese thakave lauha-srmkhala, orai jahannami evam sekhane ora cirasthayibhave avasthanakari.

latin_iast: maṅgalera pūrve tārā tomāke śāsti tvarānvita karate vale, yadio tādera pūrve era vahu dṛṣṭānta gata haẏeche. vastutaḥ mānuṣera sīmālaṃghana sattveo tomāra rāvva mānuṣera prati kṣamāśīla evaṃ tomāra rāvva śāsti dāneo kaṭhora.
latin_ascii: mangalera purve tara tomake sasti tvaranvita karate vale, yadio tadera purve era vahu drstanta gata hayeche. vastutah manusera simalamghana sattveo tomara ravva manusera prati ksamasila evam tomara ravva sasti daneo kathora.

latin_iast: yārā kupharī kareche tārā valeḥ tāra ravera nikaṭa hate tāra nikaṭa kona nidarśana avatīrṇa haẏanā kena? he nāvī! kathā ei ye, tumito śudhumātra bhaẏa pradarśanakārī evaṃ pratyeka sampradāẏera janya raẏeche patha pradarśaka.
latin_ascii: yara kuphari kareche tara valeh tara ravera nikata hate tara nikata kona nidarsana avatirna hayana kenay he navi! katha ei ye, tumito sudhumatra bhaya pradarsanakari evam pratyeka sampradayera janya rayeche patha pradarsaka.

latin_iast: pratyeka nārī yā garbhe dhāraṇa kare evaṃ jarāẏute yā kichu kame o vār̤e āllāha tā jānena. evaṃ tā~ra vidhāne pratyeka vasturai eka nirdiṣṭa parimāṇa āche.
latin_ascii: pratyeka nari ya garbhe dharana kare evam jarayute ya kichu kame o vare allaha ta janena. evam ta~ra vidhane pratyeka vasturai eka nirdista parimana ache.

latin_iast: yā adṛśya o yā dṛśyamāna tini tā avagata; tini mahāna, sarvocca maryādāvāna.
latin_ascii: ya adrsya o ya drsyamana tini ta avagata; tini mahana, sarvocca maryadavana.

latin_iast: tomādera madhye ye kathā gopana rākhe evaṃ ye tā prakāśa kare, rāte ye ātmagopana kare evaṃ dine ye prakāśye vicaraṇa kare, tārā samabhāve tā~ra (āllāhara) jñānagocara.
latin_ascii: tomadera madhye ye katha gopana rakhe evam ye ta prakasa kare, rate ye atmagopana kare evam dine ye prakasye vicarana kare, tara samabhave ta~ra (allahara) jnanagocara.

latin_iast: mānuṣera janya tāra sāmane o pichane ekera para eka praharī thāke; tārā āllāhara ādeśe tāra rakṣaṇāvekṣaṇa kare; niścaẏai āllāha kona sampradāẏera avasthā parivartana karenanā yatakṣaṇa nā tārā nijedera avasthā nijerā parivartana kare. kona sampradāẏa samparke yadi āllāha aśubha kichu icchā karena tāhale tā rada karāra keha nei evaṃ tini chār̤ā tādera kona abhibhāvaka (oẏālī) nei.
latin_ascii: manusera janya tara samane o pichane ekera para eka prahari thake; tara allahara adese tara raksanaveksana kare; niscayai allaha kona sampradayera avastha parivartana karenana yataksana na tara nijedera avastha nijera parivartana kare. kona sampradaya samparke yadi allaha asubha kichu iccha karena tahale ta rada karara keha nei evam tini chara tadera kona abhibhavaka (oyali) nei.

latin_iast: tinii tomāderake dekhāna vijalī, yā bhaẏa o bharasā sañcāra kare evaṃ tinii sṛṣṭi karena ghana megha.
latin_ascii: tinii tomaderake dekhana vijali, ya bhaya o bharasa sancara kare evam tinii srsti karena ghana megha.

latin_iast: vajra dhvani o mālāikā sabhaẏe tā~ra sapraśaṃsa mahimā o pavitratā ghoṣaṇā kare. tini vajrapāta ghaṭāna evaṃ yāke icchā oṭā dvārā āghāta karena. tathāpi orā āllāha samvandhe vitanḍā kare; yadio tini mahā śaktiśālī .
latin_ascii: vajra dhvani o malaika sabhaye ta~ra saprasamsa mahima o pavitrata ghosana kare. tini vajrapata ghatana evam yake iccha ota dvara aghata karena. tathapi ora allaha samvandhe vitanda kare; yadio tini maha saktisali .

latin_iast: satyera āhavāna tā~rai. yārā tā~ke chār̤ā āhavāna kare aparake tārā (aparerā) tāderake konai sār̤ā deẏanā; tādera dṛṣṭānta sei vyaktira mata ye tāra mukhe pāni pau~chave ei āśāẏa tāra hastadvaẏa prasārita kare emana pānira dike yā tāra mukhe pau~chāra naẏa, kāphiradera āhavāna niṣphala.
latin_ascii: satyera ahavana ta~rai. yara ta~ke chara ahavana kare aparake tara (aparera) taderake konai sara deyana; tadera drstanta sei vyaktira mata ye tara mukhe pani pau~chave ei asaya tara hastadvaya prasarita kare emana panira dike ya tara mukhe pau~chara naya, kaphiradera ahavana nisphala.

latin_iast: āllāhara prati sājadāhavanata haẏa ākāśamanḍalī o pṛthivīte yā kichu āche, icchāẏa athavā anicchāẏa evaṃ tādera chāẏāgulio sakāla-sandhyāẏa. [sājadāha]
latin_ascii: allahara prati sajadahavanata haya akasamandali o prthivite ya kichu ache, icchaya athava anicchaya evam tadera chayagulio sakala-sandhyaya. [sajadaha]

latin_iast: valaḥ ke ākāśamanḍalī o pṛthivīra rāvva? valaḥ tini āllāha! valaḥ tāhale ki tomarā abhibhāvaka rūpe grahaṇa karecha āllāhara parivarte aparake, yārā nijedera lābha vā kṣati sādhane sakṣama naẏa? valaḥ andha o cakṣusmāna ki samāna athavā andhakāra o ālo ki eka? tāhale ki tārā āllāhara emana śarīka sthāpana karache yārā (āllāhara sṛṣṭira mata) sṛṣṭi kareche, ye kāraṇe sṛṣṭi tādera madhye vibhrāṭa ghaṭiẏeche? valaḥ āllāha sakala kichura sraṣṭā, tini eka, parākramaśālī.
latin_ascii: valah ke akasamandali o prthivira ravvay valah tini allaha! valah tahale ki tomara abhibhavaka rupe grahana karecha allahara parivarte aparake, yara nijedera labha va ksati sadhane saksama nayay valah andha o caksusmana ki samana athava andhakara o alo ki ekay tahale ki tara allahara emana sarika sthapana karache yara (allahara srstira mata) srsti kareche, ye karane srsti tadera madhye vibhrata ghatiyechey valah allaha sakala kichura srasta, tini eka, parakramasali.

latin_iast: tini ākāśa hate vṛṣṭi varṣaṇa karena, phale nadīsamūha odera parimāṇa anuyāẏī plāvita haẏa evaṃ plāvana tāra uparisthita āvarjanā vahana kare. ebhāve āvarjanā upari bhāge āse yakhana alaṃkāra athavā taijasapatra nirmānera uddeśe kichu agnite uttapta karā haẏa tāra. ebhāve āllāha satya o asatyera dṛṣṭānta diẏe thākena; yā āvarjanā tā phele deẏā haẏa evaṃ yā mānuṣera upakāre āse tā yamīne theke yāẏa, ebhāve āllāha upamā diẏe thākena.
latin_ascii: tini akasa hate vrsti varsana karena, phale nadisamuha odera parimana anuyayi plavita haya evam plavana tara uparisthita avarjana vahana kare. ebhave avarjana upari bhage ase yakhana alamkara athava taijasapatra nirmanera uddese kichu agnite uttapta kara haya tara. ebhave allaha satya o asatyera drstanta diye thakena; ya avarjana ta phele deya haya evam ya manusera upakare ase ta yamine theke yaya, ebhave allaha upama diye thakena.

latin_iast: maṅgala tādera, yārā tādera ravera āhavāne sār̤ā deẏa. evaṃ yārā tā~ra ḍāke sār̤ā deẏanā tādera yadi pṛthivīte yā kichu āche tā samastai thākata evaṃ uhāra sāthe sama parimāṇa ārao thākata tāhale avaśyai tārā muktipaṇa svarūpa tā pradāna karata; tādera hisāva have kaṭhora evaṃ jāhānnāma have tādera āvāsa; oṭā kata nikṛṣṭa āśraẏasthala!
latin_ascii: mangala tadera, yara tadera ravera ahavane sara deya. evam yara ta~ra dake sara deyana tadera yadi prthivite ya kichu ache ta samastai thakata evam uhara sathe sama parimana arao thakata tahale avasyai tara muktipana svarupa ta pradana karata; tadera hisava have kathora evam jahannama have tadera avasa; ota kata nikrsta asrayasthala!

latin_iast: tomāra rāvva hate tomāra prati yā avatīrṇa haẏeche tā ye vyakti satya vale jāne se, āra andha ki samāna? upadeśa grahaṇa kare śudhu vivekavuddhi sampanna vyaktirāi.
latin_ascii: tomara ravva hate tomara prati ya avatirna hayeche ta ye vyakti satya vale jane se, ara andha ki samanay upadesa grahana kare sudhu vivekavuddhi sampanna vyaktirai.

latin_iast: yārā āllāhake pradatta aṅgīkāra rakṣā kare evaṃ pratijñā bhaṅga karenā .
latin_ascii: yara allahake pradatta angikara raksa kare evam pratijna bhanga karena .

latin_iast: āra āllāha ye samparka akṣuṇṇa rākhate ādeśa karechena yārā tā akṣuṇṇa rākhe, bhaẏa kare tādera rāvvake evaṃ bhaẏa kare kaṭhora hisāvake .
latin_ascii: ara allaha ye samparka aksunna rakhate adesa karechena yara ta aksunna rakhe, bhaya kare tadera ravvake evam bhaya kare kathora hisavake .

latin_iast: āra yārā tādera ravera santuṣṭi lābhera janya dhairya dhāraṇa kare, sālāta supratiṣṭhita kare, āmi tāderake ye jīvanopakaraṇa diẏechi tā hate gopane o prakāśye vyaẏa kare evaṃ yārā bhāla dvārā manda dūra kare tādera janya śubha pariṇāma .
latin_ascii: ara yara tadera ravera santusti labhera janya dhairya dharana kare, salata supratisthita kare, ami taderake ye jivanopakarana diyechi ta hate gopane o prakasye vyaya kare evam yara bhala dvara manda dura kare tadera janya subha parinama .

latin_iast: sthāẏī jānnāta, tāte tārā praveśa karave evaṃ tādera mātā-pitā, pati-patnī o santāna-santatidera madhye yārā sat kāja kareche tārāo evaṃ mālāikā/phereśatārā tādera kāche hāyira have pratyeka darajā diẏe.
latin_ascii: sthayi jannata, tate tara pravesa karave evam tadera mata-pita, pati-patni o santana-santatidera madhye yara sat kaja kareche tarao evam malaika/pheresatara tadera kache hayira have pratyeka daraja diye.

latin_iast: (tārā valaveḥ) tomarā dhairya dhāraṇa karecha vale tomādera prati śānti (sālāma)! katai nā bhāla ei pariṇāma!
latin_ascii: (tara valaveh) tomara dhairya dharana karecha vale tomadera prati santi (salama)! katai na bhala ei parinama!

latin_iast: yārā āllāhara sāthe dṛr̤ha aṅgīkāre āvaddha haoẏāra para tā bhaṅga kare, ye samparka akṣunna rākhate āllāha ādeśa karechena tā chinna kare evaṃ pṛthivīte aśānti sṛṣṭi kare ver̤āẏa, tādera janya āche abhisampāta evaṃ āche manda āvāsa.
latin_ascii: yara allahara sathe drrha angikare avaddha haoyara para ta bhanga kare, ye samparka aksunna rakhate allaha adesa karechena ta chinna kare evam prthivite asanti srsti kare veraya, tadera janya ache abhisampata evam ache manda avasa.

latin_iast: āllāha yāra janya icchā karena tāra jīvanopakaraṇa vardhita karena kiṃvā saṃkucita karena; kintu tārā pāthirva jīvana niẏei ullasita, athaca ihajīvanato parajīvanera tulanāẏa kṣaṇasthāẏī bhoga mātra.
latin_ascii: allaha yara janya iccha karena tara jivanopakarana vardhita karena kimva samkucita karena; kintu tara pathirva jivana niyei ullasita, athaca ihajivanato parajivanera tulanaya ksanasthayi bhoga matra.

latin_iast: yārā kupharī kareche tārā valeḥ tāra ravera nikaṭa hate tāra nikaṭa kona nidarśana avatīrṇa haẏanā kena? tumi valaḥ āllāha yāke icchā vibhrānta karena evaṃ tini tāderake tā~ra patha dekhāna yārā tā~ra abhimukhī.
latin_ascii: yara kuphari kareche tara valeh tara ravera nikata hate tara nikata kona nidarsana avatirna hayana kenay tumi valah allaha yake iccha vibhranta karena evam tini taderake ta~ra patha dekhana yara ta~ra abhimukhi.

latin_iast: yārā īmāna āne evaṃ āllāhara smaraṇe yādera citta praśānta haẏa; jene rekha, āllāhara smaraṇei citta praśānta haẏa.
latin_ascii: yara imana ane evam allahara smarane yadera citta prasanta haya; jene rekha, allahara smaranei citta prasanta haya.

latin_iast: yārā īmāna āne o sat kāja kare, kalyāṇa o śubha pariṇāma tāderai.
latin_ascii: yara imana ane o sat kaja kare, kalyana o subha parinama taderai.

latin_iast: ebhāve āmi tomāke pāṭhiẏechi eka jātira prati, yāra pūrve vahu jāti gata haẏeche, tādera nikaṭa āvṛtti karāra janya, yā āmi tomāra prati pratyādeśa karechi; tathāpi tārā daẏāmaẏake asvīkāra kare. tumi valaḥ tinii āmāra rāvva! tini chār̤ā anya kona mā‘vūda nei, tā~rai upara āmi nirbhara kari evaṃ āmāra pratyāvartana tā~rai kāche.
latin_ascii: ebhave ami tomake pathiyechi eka jatira prati, yara purve vahu jati gata hayeche, tadera nikata avrtti karara janya, ya ami tomara prati pratyadesa karechi; tathapi tara dayamayake asvikara kare. tumi valah tinii amara ravva! tini chara anya kona ma‘vuda nei, ta~rai upara ami nirbhara kari evam amara pratyavartana ta~rai kache.

latin_iast: yadi kona kuraāna emana hata yadvārā parvatake gatiśīla karā yeta athavā pṛthivīke vidīrṇa karā yeta athavā mṛtera sāthe kathā valā yeta, tavuo tārā tāte viśvāsa karatanā; kintu samasta viṣaẏai āllāhara ekhatiẏārabhukta; tāhale ki yārā īmāna eneche tādera pratyaẏa haẏani ye, āllāha icchā karale niścaẏai sakalake sat pathe paricālita karate pāratena? yārā kupharī kareche tādera karmaphalera janya tādera viparyaẏa ghaṭatei thākave, athavā viparyaẏa tādera āśepāśe āpatita hatei thākave, yatakṣaṇa paryanta nā āllāhara pratiśruti ghaṭave, niścaẏai āllāha pratiśruti pālane akṣama nana.
latin_ascii: yadi kona kuraana emana hata yadvara parvatake gatisila kara yeta athava prthivike vidirna kara yeta athava mrtera sathe katha vala yeta, tavuo tara tate visvasa karatana; kintu samasta visayai allahara ekhatiyarabhukta; tahale ki yara imana eneche tadera pratyaya hayani ye, allaha iccha karale niscayai sakalake sat pathe paricalita karate paratenay yara kuphari kareche tadera karmaphalera janya tadera viparyaya ghatatei thakave, athava viparyaya tadera asepase apatita hatei thakave, yataksana paryanta na allahara pratisruti ghatave, niscayai allaha pratisruti palane aksama nana.

latin_iast: tomāra pūrveo aneka rāsūlake ṭhāṭṭā-vidrupa karā haẏeche evaṃ yārā kupharī kareche tāderake kichu avakāśa diẏechilāma, ataḥpara tāderake pākar̤āo karechilāma; kemana chila āmāra pākar̤āo!
latin_ascii: tomara purveo aneka rasulake thatta-vidrupa kara hayeche evam yara kuphari kareche taderake kichu avakasa diyechilama, atahpara taderake pakarao karechilama; kemana chila amara pakarao!

latin_iast: tāhale ki pratyeka mānuṣa yā kare, tāra yini paryavekṣaka tini akṣama edera upāsyagulira mata? athaca tārā āllāhara vahu śarīka kareche. tumi valaḥ tomarā tādera paricaẏa dāo; tomarā ki pṛthivīra emana kichura saṃvāda tā~ke dite cāo yā tini jānenanā? nā varaṃ odera chalanā odera nikaṭa śobhana pratīẏamāna haẏa evaṃ tārā sat patha hate nivṛtta haẏa; āllāha yāke vibhrānta karena tāra kona patha pradarśaka nei.
latin_ascii: tahale ki pratyeka manusa ya kare, tara yini paryaveksaka tini aksama edera upasyagulira matay athaca tara allahara vahu sarika kareche. tumi valah tomara tadera paricaya dao; tomara ki prthivira emana kichura samvada ta~ke dite cao ya tini janenanay na varam odera chalana odera nikata sobhana pratiyamana haya evam tara sat patha hate nivrtta haya; allaha yake vibhranta karena tara kona patha pradarsaka nei.

latin_iast: tādera janya pārthiva jīvane āche śāsti evaṃ parakālera śāstito ārao kaṭhora! evaṃ āllāhara śāsti hate rakṣā karāra tādera keha nei.
latin_ascii: tadera janya parthiva jivane ache sasti evam parakalera sastito arao kathora! evam allahara sasti hate raksa karara tadera keha nei.

latin_iast: muttākīderake ye jānnātera pratiśruti deẏā haẏeche tāra upamā eirūpaḥ ora pādadeśe nadī pravāhita, ora phalasamūha evaṃ ora chāẏā cirasthāẏī; yārā muttākī eṭā tādera karmaphala, evaṃ kāphiradera karmaphala āguna.
latin_ascii: muttakiderake ye jannatera pratisruti deya hayeche tara upama eirupah ora padadese nadi pravahita, ora phalasamuha evam ora chaya cirasthayi; yara muttaki eta tadera karmaphala, evam kaphiradera karmaphala aguna.

latin_iast: āmi yāderake kitāva diẏechi tārā yā tomāra prati avatīrṇa haẏeche tāte ānanda pāẏa, kintu kona kona dala ora kataka aṃśa asvīkāra kare. tumi valaḥ āmito āllāharai ivādāta karate o tā~ra kona śarīka nā karate ādiṣṭa haẏechi; āmi tā~rai prati āhavāna kari evaṃ tā~rai nikaṭa āmāra pratyāvartana.
latin_ascii: ami yaderake kitava diyechi tara ya tomara prati avatirna hayeche tate ananda paya, kintu kona kona dala ora kataka amsa asvikara kare. tumi valah amito allaharai ivadata karate o ta~ra kona sarika na karate adista hayechi; ami ta~rai prati ahavana kari evam ta~rai nikata amara pratyavartana.

latin_iast: āra ebhāve āmi ihā (kuraāna) avatīrṇa karechi eka vidhāna, ārāvī bhāṣāẏa. jñāna prāptira para tumi yadi tādera kheẏāla khuśīra anusaraṇa kara tāhale āllāhara viruddhe tomāra kona abhibhāvaka o rakṣaka thākavenā.
latin_ascii: ara ebhave ami iha (kuraana) avatirna karechi eka vidhana, aravi bhasaya. jnana praptira para tumi yadi tadera kheyala khusira anusarana kara tahale allahara viruddhe tomara kona abhibhavaka o raksaka thakavena.

latin_iast: tomāra pūrveo āmi aneka rāsūla preraṇa karechilāma evaṃ tāderake strī o santāna-santati diẏechilāma. āllāhara anumati chār̤ā kona nidarśana upasthita karā kona rāsūlera kāja naẏa; pratyeka viṣaẏera nirdhārita kāla lipivaddha.
latin_ascii: tomara purveo ami aneka rasula prerana karechilama evam taderake stri o santana-santati diyechilama. allahara anumati chara kona nidarsana upasthita kara kona rasulera kaja naya; pratyeka visayera nirdharita kala lipivaddha.

latin_iast: āllāhara yā icchā tā niścihna karena evaṃ yā icchā tā pratiṣṭhita rākhena evaṃ tā~rai nikaṭa āche kitāvera mūla.
latin_ascii: allahara ya iccha ta niscihna karena evam ya iccha ta pratisthita rakhena evam ta~rai nikata ache kitavera mula.

latin_iast: āmi tāderake ye śāstira kathā vali, tāra kichu yadi tomāke dekhiẏei dii athavā yadi era pūrve tomāra mṛtyu ghaṭiẏei dii - tomāra kartavyato śudhu pracāra karā; āra hisāva grahaṇera dāẏitva āmāra.
latin_ascii: ami taderake ye sastira katha vali, tara kichu yadi tomake dekhiyei dii athava yadi era purve tomara mrtyu ghatiyei dii - tomara kartavyato sudhu pracara kara; ara hisava grahanera dayitva amara.

latin_iast: tārā ki dekhenā ye, āmi tādera deśake cāradika hate saṃkucita kare ānachi? āllāha ādeśa karena, tā~ra ādeśa rada karāra keha nei evaṃ tini hisāva grahaṇe tatpara.
latin_ascii: tara ki dekhena ye, ami tadera desake caradika hate samkucita kare anachiy allaha adesa karena, ta~ra adesa rada karara keha nei evam tini hisava grahane tatpara.

latin_iast: tādera pūrve yārā chila tārāo cakrānta karechila, kintu samasta cakrānta āllāhara ekhatiẏāre; pratyeka vyakti yā kare tā tini jānena evaṃ kāphirerā śīghrai jānave śubha pariṇāma kādera janya.
latin_ascii: tadera purve yara chila tarao cakranta karechila, kintu samasta cakranta allahara ekhatiyare; pratyeka vyakti ya kare ta tini janena evam kaphirera sighrai janave subha parinama kadera janya.

latin_iast: yārā kupharī kareche tārā valeḥ tumi (āllāhara) prerita nao; tumi valaḥ āllāha evaṃ yādera nikaṭa kitāvera jñāna āche tārā āmāra o tomādera madhye sākṣī hisāve yatheṣṭa.
latin_ascii: yara kuphari kareche tara valeh tumi (allahara) prerita nao; tumi valah allaha evam yadera nikata kitavera jnana ache tara amara o tomadera madhye saksi hisave yathesta.

latin_iast: ālipha lāma rā. ei kitāva āmi tomāra prati avatīrṇa karechi yāte tumi mānava jātike vera kare ānate pāra andhakāra hate ālora dike; tā~ra pathe, yini parākramaśālī, praśaṃsā .
latin_ascii: alipha lama ra. ei kitava ami tomara prati avatirna karechi yate tumi manava jatike vera kare anate para andhakara hate alora dike; ta~ra pathe, yini parakramasali, prasamsa .

latin_iast: āllāha, āsamānasamūha o yamīne yā kichu āche tā tā~rai; kaṭhina śāstira durbhoga kāphiradera janya.
latin_ascii: allaha, asamanasamuha o yamine ya kichu ache ta ta~rai; kathina sastira durbhoga kaphiradera janya.

latin_iast: yārā pārthiva jīvanake parakālina jīvanera upara prādhānya deẏa, mānuṣake nivṛtta kare āllāhara patha hate evaṃ tā (āllāhara patha) vakra karate cāẏa; tārāito ghora vibhrāntite raẏeche.
latin_ascii: yara parthiva jivanake parakalina jivanera upara pradhanya deya, manusake nivrtta kare allahara patha hate evam ta (allahara patha) vakra karate caya; taraito ghora vibhrantite rayeche.

latin_iast: āmi pratyeka rāsūlakei tāra svajātira bhāṣābhāṣī kare pāṭhiẏechi tādera nikaṭa pariskārabhāve vyākhyā karāra janya, āllāha yāke icchā vibhrānta karena evaṃ yāke icchā sat pathe paricālita karena evaṃ tini parākramaśālī, prajñāmaẏa.
latin_ascii: ami pratyeka rasulakei tara svajatira bhasabhasi kare pathiyechi tadera nikata pariskarabhave vyakhya karara janya, allaha yake iccha vibhranta karena evam yake iccha sat pathe paricalita karena evam tini parakramasali, prajnamaya.

latin_iast: mūsāke āmi āmāra nidarśanasaha preraṇa karechilāma evaṃ valechilāmaḥ tomāra sampradāẏake andhakāra hate ālote ānaẏana kara, evaṃ tāderake āllāhara dinaguli dvārā upadeśa dāo, eteto nidarśana raẏeche parama dhairyaśīla o parama kṛtajña vyaktira janya.
latin_ascii: musake ami amara nidarsanasaha prerana karechilama evam valechilamah tomara sampradayake andhakara hate alote anayana kara, evam taderake allahara dinaguli dvara upadesa dao, eteto nidarsana rayeche parama dhairyasila o parama krtajna vyaktira janya.

latin_iast: yakhana mūsā tāra sampradāẏake valechilaḥ tomarā āllāhara anugraha smaraṇa kara yakhana tini tomāderake rakṣā karechilena phira‘āuna sampradāẏera kavala hate yārā tomāderake nikṛṣṭa śāsti dita, tomādera putraderake yavāha karata o tomādera nārīderake jīvita rākhata; evaṃ ete chila tomādera ravera pakṣa hate eka mahā parīkṣā.
latin_ascii: yakhana musa tara sampradayake valechilah tomara allahara anugraha smarana kara yakhana tini tomaderake raksa karechilena phira‘auna sampradayera kavala hate yara tomaderake nikrsta sasti dita, tomadera putraderake yavaha karata o tomadera nariderake jivita rakhata; evam ete chila tomadera ravera paksa hate eka maha pariksa.

latin_iast: yakhana tomādera rāvva ghoṣaṇā karenaḥ tomarā kṛtajña hale tomāderake avaśyai adhika diva, āra akṛtajña hale avaśyai āmāra śāsti have kaṭhora.
latin_ascii: yakhana tomadera ravva ghosana karenah tomara krtajna hale tomaderake avasyai adhika diva, ara akrtajna hale avasyai amara sasti have kathora.

latin_iast: mūsā valechilaḥ tomarā evaṃ pṛthivīra sakaleo yadi akṛtajña hao tathāpi āllāha abhāvamukta evaṃ praśaṃsā .
latin_ascii: musa valechilah tomara evam prthivira sakaleo yadi akrtajna hao tathapi allaha abhavamukta evam prasamsa .

latin_iast: tomādera kāche ki saṃvāda āseni tomādera pūrvavartīdera; nūhera sampradāẏera, ‘āda o chāmūdera evaṃ tādera pūrvavartīdera? tādera viṣaẏa āllāha chār̤ā anya keha jānenā; tādera kāche spaṣṭa nidarśanasaha tādera rāsūla esechila; tārā tādera hāta tādera mukhe sthāpana karata evaṃ valataḥ yā niẏe tomarā prerita haẏecha tā āmarā pratyākhyāna kari evaṃ āmarā avaśyai vibhrāntikara sandeha poṣaṇa kari sei viṣaẏe, yāra prati tomarā āmāderake āhavāna karacha.
latin_ascii: tomadera kache ki samvada aseni tomadera purvavartidera; nuhera sampradayera, ‘ada o chamudera evam tadera purvavartideray tadera visaya allaha chara anya keha janena; tadera kache spasta nidarsanasaha tadera rasula esechila; tara tadera hata tadera mukhe sthapana karata evam valatah ya niye tomara prerita hayecha ta amara pratyakhyana kari evam amara avasyai vibhrantikara sandeha posana kari sei visaye, yara prati tomara amaderake ahavana karacha.

latin_iast: tādera rāsūlagaṇa valechilaḥ āllāha samvandhe ki kona sandeha āche, yini ākāśasamūha o pṛthivīra sṛṣṭikartā? tini tomāderake āhavāna karena tomādera pāpa kṣamā karāra janya evaṃ nirdiṣṭakāla paryanta tomāderake avakāśa deẏāra janya. tārā valataḥ tomarāto āmādera matai mānuṣa; āmādera pitṛ puruṣagaṇa yādera ivādāta karata tomarā tādera ivādāta hate āmāderake virata rākhate cāo; ataeva tomarā āmādera kāche kona akāṭya pramāṇa upasthita kara.
latin_ascii: tadera rasulagana valechilah allaha samvandhe ki kona sandeha ache, yini akasasamuha o prthivira srstikartay tini tomaderake ahavana karena tomadera papa ksama karara janya evam nirdistakala paryanta tomaderake avakasa deyara janya. tara valatah tomarato amadera matai manusa; amadera pitr purusagana yadera ivadata karata tomara tadera ivadata hate amaderake virata rakhate cao; ataeva tomara amadera kache kona akatya pramana upasthita kara.

latin_iast: tādera rāsūlagaṇa tāderake valataḥ satya vaṭe āmarā tomādera mata mānuṣa, kintu āllāha tā~ra vāndādera madhye yāke icchā anugraha karena; āllāhara anumati chār̤ā tomādera nikaṭa pramāṇa upasthita karā āmādera kāja naẏa; mu’minadera āllāhara uparai nirbhara karā ucita.
latin_ascii: tadera rasulagana taderake valatah satya vate amara tomadera mata manusa, kintu allaha ta~ra vandadera madhye yake iccha anugraha karena; allahara anumati chara tomadera nikata pramana upasthita kara amadera kaja naya; mu’minadera allahara uparai nirbhara kara ucita.

latin_iast: āmarā āllāhara upara nirbhara karavanā kena? tiniito āmāderake patha pradarśana karechena; tomarā āmāderake ye kleśa diccha, āmarā avaśyai tā dhairyera sāthe sahya karava evaṃ nirbharakārīdera āllāharai upara nirbhara karā ucita.
latin_ascii: amara allahara upara nirbhara karavana kenay tiniito amaderake patha pradarsana karechena; tomara amaderake ye klesa diccha, amara avasyai ta dhairyera sathe sahya karava evam nirbharakaridera allaharai upara nirbhara kara ucita.

latin_iast: kāphirerā tādera rāsūladerake valechilaḥ āmarā tomāderake avaśyai āmādera deśa hate vahiskāra karava, athavā tomāderake āmādera dharmādarśe phire āsatei have. ataḥpara rāsūladerake tādera rāvva ahī preraṇa karalena; yālimaderake āmi avaśyai vināśa karava.
latin_ascii: kaphirera tadera rasuladerake valechilah amara tomaderake avasyai amadera desa hate vahiskara karava, athava tomaderake amadera dharmadarse phire asatei have. atahpara rasuladerake tadera ravva ahi prerana karalena; yalimaderake ami avasyai vinasa karava.

latin_iast: tādera pare āmi tomāderake deśe pratiṣṭhita karavai; eṭā tādera janya yārā bhaẏa rākhe āmāra sammukhe upasthita haoẏāra evaṃ bhaẏa rākhe āmāra śāstira.
latin_ascii: tadera pare ami tomaderake dese pratisthita karavai; eta tadera janya yara bhaya rakhe amara sammukhe upasthita haoyara evam bhaya rakhe amara sastira.

latin_iast: tārā vicāra kāmanā karala evaṃ pratyeka uddhata svairācārī vyartha manoratha hala.
latin_ascii: tara vicara kamana karala evam pratyeka uddhata svairacari vyartha manoratha hala.

latin_iast: tādera pratyekera janya pariṇāme jāhānnāma raẏeche evaṃ pratyekake pāna karāno have galita pu~ja .
latin_ascii: tadera pratyekera janya pariname jahannama rayeche evam pratyekake pana karano have galita pu~ja .

latin_iast: yā se ati kaṣṭe galadhaḥkaraṇa karave evaṃ tā galadhaḥkaraṇa karā prāẏa asambhava haẏe par̤ave. sarva dika hate tāra nikaṭa āsave mṛtyu yantraṇā, kintu tāra mṛtyu ghaṭavenā evaṃ se kaṭhora śāsti bhoga karatei thākave.
latin_ascii: ya se ati kaste galadhahkarana karave evam ta galadhahkarana kara praya asambhava haye parave. sarva dika hate tara nikata asave mrtyu yantrana, kintu tara mrtyu ghatavena evam se kathora sasti bhoga karatei thakave.

latin_iast: yārā tādera rāvvake asvīkāra kare tādera upamā - tādera kājasamūha chāi sadṛśa yā jhar̤era dine vātāsa pracanḍa vege ur̤iẏe niẏe yāẏa; yā tārā upārjana kare tāra kichui tārā tādera kāje lāgāte pārenā; eṭāto ghora vibhrānti.
latin_ascii: yara tadera ravvake asvikara kare tadera upama - tadera kajasamuha chai sadrsa ya jharera dine vatasa pracanda vege uriye niye yaya; ya tara uparjana kare tara kichui tara tadera kaje lagate parena; etato ghora vibhranti.

latin_iast: tumi ki lakṣya karanā ye, āllāha ākāśamanḍalī o pṛthivī yathāvidhi sṛṣṭi karechena? tini icchā karale tomādera astitva vilopa karate pārena evaṃ eka natuna sṛṣṭi astitve ānate pārena.
latin_ascii: tumi ki laksya karana ye, allaha akasamandali o prthivi yathavidhi srsti karechenay tini iccha karale tomadera astitva vilopa karate parena evam eka natuna srsti astitve anate parena.

latin_iast: āra eṭā āllāhara janya ādau kaṭhina naẏa.
latin_ascii: ara eta allahara janya adau kathina naya.

latin_iast: savāi āllāhara nikaṭa upasthita havei. yārā ahaṃkāra karata, durvalerā tāderake valaveḥ āmarāto tomādera anusārī chilāma; ekhana tomarā āllāhara śāsti hate ki āmāderake kichu mātra rakṣā karate pārave? tārā valaveḥ āllāha āmāderake sat pathe paricālita karale āmarāo tomāderake sat pathe paricālita karatāma; ekhana āmādera dhairyacyūta haoẏā athavā dhairyaśīla haoẏā ekai kathā; āmādera kona niskṛti nei.
latin_ascii: savai allahara nikata upasthita havei. yara ahamkara karata, durvalera taderake valaveh amarato tomadera anusari chilama; ekhana tomara allahara sasti hate ki amaderake kichu matra raksa karate paravey tara valaveh allaha amaderake sat pathe paricalita karale amarao tomaderake sat pathe paricalita karatama; ekhana amadera dhairyacyuta haoya athava dhairyasila haoya ekai katha; amadera kona niskrti nei.

latin_iast: yakhana sava kichura mīmāṃsā haẏe yāve takhana śāitāna valaveḥ āllāha tomāderake diẏechilena satya pratiśruti, āmio tomāderake pratiśruti diẏechilāma, kintu āmi tomāderake pradatta pratiśruti rakṣā karini; āmārato tomādera upara kona ādhipatya chilanā, āmi śudhu tomāderake āhavāna karechilāma evaṃ tomarā āmāra āhavāne sār̤ā diẏechile; sutarāṃ tomarā āmāra prati doṣāropa karanā, tomarā tomādera pratii doṣāropa kara; āmi tomādera uddhāre sāhāyya karate sakṣama nai evaṃ tomarāo āmāra uddhāre sāhāyya karate sakṣama nao; tomarā ye pūrve āmāke (āllāhara) śarīka karechile tāra sāthe āmāra konai samparka nei; yālimadera janyato vedanādāẏaka śāsti āchei.
latin_ascii: yakhana sava kichura mimamsa haye yave takhana saitana valaveh allaha tomaderake diyechilena satya pratisruti, amio tomaderake pratisruti diyechilama, kintu ami tomaderake pradatta pratisruti raksa karini; amarato tomadera upara kona adhipatya chilana, ami sudhu tomaderake ahavana karechilama evam tomara amara ahavane sara diyechile; sutaram tomara amara prati dosaropa karana, tomara tomadera pratii dosaropa kara; ami tomadera uddhare sahayya karate saksama nai evam tomarao amara uddhare sahayya karate saksama nao; tomara ye purve amake (allahara) sarika karechile tara sathe amara konai samparka nei; yalimadera janyato vedanadayaka sasti achei.

latin_iast: yārā īmāna āne o sat kāja kare tāderake dākhila karā have jānnāte yāra pādadeśe nadī pravāhita. sekhāne tārā cirasthāẏībhāve avasthānakārī have tādera ravera anumatikrame. sekhāne tādera abhivādana have ‘sālāma’.
latin_ascii: yara imana ane o sat kaja kare taderake dakhila kara have jannate yara padadese nadi pravahita. sekhane tara cirasthayibhave avasthanakari have tadera ravera anumatikrame. sekhane tadera abhivadana have ‘salama’.

latin_iast: tumi ki lakṣya karanā āllāha kibhāve upamā diẏe thākena? sat vākyera tulanā utkṛṣṭa vṛkṣa yāra mūla sudṛr̤ha evaṃ yāra praśākhā urdhve vistṛta .
latin_ascii: tumi ki laksya karana allaha kibhave upama diye thakenay sat vakyera tulana utkrsta vrksa yara mula sudrrha evam yara prasakha urdhve vistrta .

latin_iast: yā pratyeka maosume phala dāna kare tāra ravera anumatikrame, evaṃ āllāha mānuṣera janya upamā diẏe thākena yāte tārā śikṣā grahaṇa kare.
latin_ascii: ya pratyeka maosume phala dana kare tara ravera anumatikrame, evam allaha manusera janya upama diye thakena yate tara siksa grahana kare.

latin_iast: ku-vākyera tulanā eka manda vṛkṣa yāra mūla bhū-pṛṣṭha hate vicchinna, yāra kona sthāẏitva nei.
latin_ascii: ku-vakyera tulana eka manda vrksa yara mula bhu-prstha hate vicchinna, yara kona sthayitva nei.

latin_iast: yārā śāśvata vāṇīte viśvāsī tāderake ihajīvane o parajīvane āllāha supratiṣṭhita rākhavena evaṃ yārā yālima, āllāha tāderake vibhrāntite rākhavena; āllāha yā icchā tā karena.
latin_ascii: yara sasvata vanite visvasi taderake ihajivane o parajivane allaha supratisthita rakhavena evam yara yalima, allaha taderake vibhrantite rakhavena; allaha ya iccha ta karena.

latin_iast: tumi ki tādera prati lakṣya karanā yārā āllāhara anugrahera parivarte akṛtajñatā prakāśa kare evaṃ tādera sampradāẏake nāmiẏe āne dhvaṃsera ālaẏe .
latin_ascii: tumi ki tadera prati laksya karana yara allahara anugrahera parivarte akrtajnata prakasa kare evam tadera sampradayake namiye ane dhvamsera alaye .

latin_iast: jāhānnāma, yāra madhye tārā praveśa karave, kata nikṛṣṭa ai āvāsasthala!
latin_ascii: jahannama, yara madhye tara pravesa karave, kata nikrsta ai avasasthala!

latin_iast: āra tārā āllāhara samakakṣa udbhāvana kare tā~ra patha hate vibhrānta karāra janya; tumi valaḥ bhoga kare nāo, pariṇāme āgunai tomādera pratyāvartana sthala.
latin_ascii: ara tara allahara samakaksa udbhavana kare ta~ra patha hate vibhranta karara janya; tumi valah bhoga kare nao, pariname agunai tomadera pratyavartana sthala.

latin_iast: āmāra vāndādera madhye yārā mu’mina tāderake vala sālāta kāẏema karate evaṃ āmi tāderake yā diẏechi tā hate gopane o prakāśye vyaẏa karate, sei dina āsāra pūrve yedina kraẏa-vikraẏa o vandhutva thākavenā.
latin_ascii: amara vandadera madhye yara mu’mina taderake vala salata kayema karate evam ami taderake ya diyechi ta hate gopane o prakasye vyaya karate, sei dina asara purve yedina kraya-vikraya o vandhutva thakavena.

latin_iast: tinii āllāha yini ākāśamanḍalī o pṛthivī sṛṣṭi karechena, yini ākāśa hate pāni varṣaṇa kare tadvārā tomādera jīvikāra janya phala-mūla utpādana karena, yini nauyānake tomādera adhīna kare diẏechena yāte tā~ra vidhāne oṭā samudre vicaraṇa kare evaṃ yini tomādera kalyāṇe niẏojita karechena nadīsamūhake.
latin_ascii: tinii allaha yini akasamandali o prthivi srsti karechena, yini akasa hate pani varsana kare tadvara tomadera jivikara janya phala-mula utpadana karena, yini nauyanake tomadera adhina kare diyechena yate ta~ra vidhane ota samudre vicarana kare evam yini tomadera kalyane niyojita karechena nadisamuhake.

latin_iast: tini tomādera kalyāṇe niẏojita karechena sūrya o cā~dake, yārā avirāma ekai niẏamera anuvartī evaṃ tomādera kalyāṇe niẏojita karechena rāta o dinake .
latin_ascii: tini tomadera kalyane niyojita karechena surya o ca~dake, yara avirama ekai niyamera anuvarti evam tomadera kalyane niyojita karechena rata o dinake .

latin_iast: āra tini tomāderake diẏechena tomarā tā~ra nikaṭa yā kichu ceẏecha; tomarā āllāhara anugraha gaṇanā karale ora saṃkhyā nirṇaẏa karate pāravenā; mānuṣa avaśyai atimātrāẏa yālima, akṛtajña.
latin_ascii: ara tini tomaderake diyechena tomara ta~ra nikata ya kichu ceyecha; tomara allahara anugraha ganana karale ora samkhya nirnaya karate paravena; manusa avasyai atimatraya yalima, akrtajna.

latin_iast: smaraṇa kara, ivarāhīma valechilaḥ he āmāra rāvva! ei śaharake nirāpada karuna evaṃ āmāke o āmāra putraderake mūrti pūjā hate dūre rākhuna.
latin_ascii: smarana kara, ivarahima valechilah he amara ravva! ei saharake nirapada karuna evam amake o amara putraderake murti puja hate dure rakhuna.

latin_iast: he āmāra rāvva! ei sava mūrti vahu mānuṣake vibhrānta kareche; sutarāṃ ye āmāra anusaraṇa karave se’i āmāra dalabhukta, kintu keha āmāra avādhya hale āpanito kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.
latin_ascii: he amara ravva! ei sava murti vahu manusake vibhranta kareche; sutaram ye amara anusarana karave se’i amara dalabhukta, kintu keha amara avadhya hale apanito ksamasila, parama dayalu.

latin_iast: he āmādera rāvva! āmi āmāra vaṃśadharadera katakake vasavāsa karālāma anurvara upatyakāẏa āpanāra pavitra gṛhera nikaṭa. he āmādera rāvva! e janya ye, tārā yena sālāta kāẏema kare; sutarāṃ āpani kichu lokera antara odera prati anurāgī kare dina evaṃ phalaphalādi dvārā tādera riykera vyavasthā karuna yāte tārā kṛtajñatā prakāśa kare.
latin_ascii: he amadera ravva! ami amara vamsadharadera katakake vasavasa karalama anurvara upatyakaya apanara pavitra grhera nikata. he amadera ravva! e janya ye, tara yena salata kayema kare; sutaram apani kichu lokera antara odera prati anuragi kare dina evam phalaphaladi dvara tadera riykera vyavastha karuna yate tara krtajnata prakasa kare.

latin_iast: he āmādera rāvva! āpanito jānena yā āmarā gopana kari evaṃ yā āmarā prakāśa kari; ākāśamanḍalī o pṛthivīra kona kichui āllāhara nikaṭa gopana thākenā.
latin_ascii: he amadera ravva! apanito janena ya amara gopana kari evam ya amara prakasa kari; akasamandali o prthivira kona kichui allahara nikata gopana thakena.

latin_iast: samasta praśaṃsā āllāharai prāpya yini āmāke āmāra vārdhakye isamāīla o isahākake dāna karechena; āmāra rāvva avaśyai prārthanā śune thākena.
latin_ascii: samasta prasamsa allaharai prapya yini amake amara vardhakye isamaila o isahakake dana karechena; amara ravva avasyai prarthana sune thakena.

latin_iast: he āmāra rāvva! āmāke sālāta kāẏemakārī karuna evaṃ āmāra vaṃśadharadera madhya hateo; he āmādera rāvva! āmāra prārthanā kavūla karuna.
latin_ascii: he amara ravva! amake salata kayemakari karuna evam amara vamsadharadera madhya hateo; he amadera ravva! amara prarthana kavula karuna.

latin_iast: he āmāra rāvva! yedina hisāva have sedina āmāke, āmāra mātāpitāke evaṃ mu’minaderake kṣamā karuna.
latin_ascii: he amara ravva! yedina hisava have sedina amake, amara matapitake evam mu’minaderake ksama karuna.

latin_iast: tumi kakhanao mane karanā ye, yālimarā yā kare se viṣaẏe āllāha udāsīna. tave tini sedina paryanta tāderake avakāśa dena yedina tādera cakṣu have sthira.
latin_ascii: tumi kakhanao mane karana ye, yalimara ya kare se visaye allaha udasina. tave tini sedina paryanta taderake avakasa dena yedina tadera caksu have sthira.

latin_iast: bhīti vihavala citte (ākāśera dike ceẏe) chuṭāchuṭi karave. nijedera prati tādera dṛṣṭi phiravenā evaṃ tādera antara have śūnya.
latin_ascii: bhiti vihavala citte (akasera dike ceye) chutachuti karave. nijedera prati tadera drsti phiravena evam tadera antara have sunya.

latin_iast: yedina tādera śāsti āsave sedina samparke tumi mānuṣake satarka kara. takhana yālimarā valaveḥ he āmādera rāvva! āmādera kichukālera janya avakāśa dina, āmarā āpanāra āhavāne sār̤ā diva evaṃ rāsūladera anusaraṇa karavai. tomarā ki pūrve śapatha kare valate nā ye, tomādera patana nei?
latin_ascii: yedina tadera sasti asave sedina samparke tumi manusake satarka kara. takhana yalimara valaveh he amadera ravva! amadera kichukalera janya avakasa dina, amara apanara ahavane sara diva evam rasuladera anusarana karavai. tomara ki purve sapatha kare valate na ye, tomadera patana neiy

latin_iast: athaca tomarā vāsa karate tādera vāsabhūmite yārā nijedera prati yulama karechila evaṃ tādera prati āmi ki karechilāma tāo tomādera nikaṭa suvidita chila evaṃ tomādera nikaṭa āmi tādera dṛṣṭāntao upasthita karechilāma.
latin_ascii: athaca tomara vasa karate tadera vasabhumite yara nijedera prati yulama karechila evam tadera prati ami ki karechilama tao tomadera nikata suvidita chila evam tomadera nikata ami tadera drstantao upasthita karechilama.

latin_iast: tārā bhīṣaṇa cakrānta karechila, kintu āllāhara nikaṭa tādera cakrānta rakṣita raẏeche. tādera cakrānta emana chilanā yāte parvata ṭale yeta.
latin_ascii: tara bhisana cakranta karechila, kintu allahara nikata tadera cakranta raksita rayeche. tadera cakranta emana chilana yate parvata tale yeta.

latin_iast: tumi kakhanao mane karanā ye, āllāha tā~ra rāsūladera prati pradatta pratiśruti bhaṅga karena; āllāha parākramaśālī, danḍa vidhāẏaka.
latin_ascii: tumi kakhanao mane karana ye, allaha ta~ra rasuladera prati pradatta pratisruti bhanga karena; allaha parakramasali, danda vidhayaka.

latin_iast: yedina ei pṛthivī parivartita haẏe anya pṛthivī have evaṃ ākāśamanḍalīo evaṃ mānuṣa upasthita have ālalāhara sāmane, yini eka, parākramaśālī.
latin_ascii: yedina ei prthivi parivartita haye anya prthivi have evam akasamandalio evam manusa upasthita have alalahara samane, yini eka, parakramasali.

latin_iast: sedina tumi aparādhīderake dekhave śṛṃkhalita avasthāẏa.
latin_ascii: sedina tumi aparadhiderake dekhave srmkhalita avasthaya.

latin_iast: tādera pośāka have ālakātarāra evaṃ āguna ācchanna karave tādera mukhamanḍala.
latin_ascii: tadera posaka have alakatarara evam aguna acchanna karave tadera mukhamandala.

latin_iast: yāte āllāha pratidāna dena pratyeka nāphasake yā se arjana kareche. niścaẏa āllāha druta hisāva grahaṇakārī.
latin_ascii: yate allaha pratidana dena pratyeka naphasake ya se arjana kareche. niscaya allaha druta hisava grahanakari.

latin_iast: ihā mānuṣera janya eka vārtā yāte era dvārā tārā satarka haẏa evaṃ jānate pāre ye, tini ekamātra upāsya evaṃ yāte vodhaśakti sampannarā upadeśa grahaṇa kare.
latin_ascii: iha manusera janya eka varta yate era dvara tara satarka haya evam janate pare ye, tini ekamatra upasya evam yate vodhasakti sampannara upadesa grahana kare.

latin_iast: ālipha lāma rā. eguli āẏāta, mahāgranthera, suspaṣṭa kuraānera.
latin_ascii: alipha lama ra. eguli ayata, mahagranthera, suspasta kuraanera.

latin_iast: yārā kupharī kareche, tārā ekasamaẏa kāmanā karave yadi tārā musalima hata!
latin_ascii: yara kuphari kareche, tara ekasamaya kamana karave yadi tara musalima hata!

latin_iast: tādera cher̤e dāo, tārā khete thākuka, bhoga karate thākuka evaṃ mithyā āśā oderake mohācchanna kare rākhuka, pariṇāme tārā vujhave.
latin_ascii: tadera chere dao, tara khete thakuka, bhoga karate thakuka evam mithya asa oderake mohacchanna kare rakhuka, pariname tara vujhave.

latin_iast: āmi kona janapadake tāra nirdiṣṭa kāla pūrṇa nā haoẏā paryanta dhvaṃsa karini.
latin_ascii: ami kona janapadake tara nirdista kala purna na haoya paryanta dhvamsa karini.

latin_iast: kona jāti tāra nirdiṣṭa kālake tvarānvita karate pārenā evaṃ vilamvitao karate pārenā.
latin_ascii: kona jati tara nirdista kalake tvaranvita karate parena evam vilamvitao karate parena.

latin_iast: tārā valeḥ ohe, yāra prati kuraāna avatīrṇa haẏeche! tumito niścaẏai ummāda.
latin_ascii: tara valeh ohe, yara prati kuraana avatirna hayeche! tumito niscayai ummada.

latin_iast: tumi satyavādī hale āmādera nikaṭa mālāikā/phereśatāderake hāyira karachanā kena?
latin_ascii: tumi satyavadi hale amadera nikata malaika/pheresataderake hayira karachana kenay

latin_iast: āmi mālāikā/phereśatāderake yathārtha kāraṇa vyatīta preraṇa karinā; mālāikā/phereśatārā hāyira hale tārā avakāśa pāvenā.
latin_ascii: ami malaika/pheresataderake yathartha karana vyatita prerana karina; malaika/pheresatara hayira hale tara avakasa pavena.

latin_iast: āmii jikara (kuraāna) avatīrṇa karechi evaṃ āmii uhāra saṃrakṣaka.
latin_ascii: amii jikara (kuraana) avatirna karechi evam amii uhara samraksaka.

latin_iast: tomāra pūrve āmi pūrvera aneka sampradāẏera nikaṭa rāsūla pāṭhiẏechi.
latin_ascii: tomara purve ami purvera aneka sampradayera nikata rasula pathiyechi.

latin_iast: tādera nikaṭa emana kona rāsūla āseni yāke tārā ṭhāṭṭā vidrupa karatanā.
latin_ascii: tadera nikata emana kona rasula aseni yake tara thatta vidrupa karatana.

latin_iast: ebhāve āmi aparādhīdera antare tā sañcāra kari.
latin_ascii: ebhave ami aparadhidera antare ta sancara kari.

latin_iast: tārā kuraāne viśvāsa karavenā evaṃ atīte pūrvavartīderao ei ācaraṇa chila.
latin_ascii: tara kuraane visvasa karavena evam atite purvavartiderao ei acarana chila.

latin_iast: yadi tādera janya āmi ākāśera darayā khule dii evaṃ tārā sārādina tāte ārohaṇa karate thāke .
latin_ascii: yadi tadera janya ami akasera daraya khule dii evam tara saradina tate arohana karate thake .

latin_iast: tavuo tārā valaveḥ āmādera dṛṣṭi sammohita karā haẏeche; nā, varaṃ āmarā eka yādugrasta sampradāẏa.
latin_ascii: tavuo tara valaveh amadera drsti sammohita kara hayeche; na, varam amara eka yadugrasta sampradaya.

latin_iast: ākāśe āmi graha nakṣatra sṛṣṭi karechi evaṃ oke karechi suśobhita, darśakadera janya.
latin_ascii: akase ami graha naksatra srsti karechi evam oke karechi susobhita, darsakadera janya.

latin_iast: pratyeka abhiśapta śāitāna hate āmi oke rakṣā kari.
latin_ascii: pratyeka abhisapta saitana hate ami oke raksa kari.

latin_iast: āra keha curi kare saṃvāda śunate cāile ora paścāddhāvana kare pradīpta śikhā.
latin_ascii: ara keha curi kare samvada sunate caile ora pascaddhavana kare pradipta sikha.

latin_iast: pṛthivīke āmi vistṛta karechi evaṃ ote parvatamālā sthāpana karechi; āmi ote pratyeka vastu utpanna karechi suparimitabhāve.
latin_ascii: prthivike ami vistrta karechi evam ote parvatamala sthapana karechi; ami ote pratyeka vastu utpanna karechi suparimitabhave.

latin_iast: āra āmi ote jīvikāra vyavasthā karechi tomādera janya, āra tomarā yādera jīvikādātā nao tādera janyao.
latin_ascii: ara ami ote jivikara vyavastha karechi tomadera janya, ara tomara yadera jivikadata nao tadera janyao.

latin_iast: āmārai kāche āche pratyeka vastura bhānḍāra evaṃ āmi tā susama parimāṇei saravarāha kare thāki.
latin_ascii: amarai kache ache pratyeka vastura bhandara evam ami ta susama parimanei saravaraha kare thaki.

latin_iast: āmi vṛṣṭigarbha vāẏu preraṇa kari, ataḥpara ākāśa hate vṛṣṭi varṣaṇa kari evaṃ tā tomāderake pāna karate dii; ora bhānḍāra tomādera kāche nei.
latin_ascii: ami vrstigarbha vayu prerana kari, atahpara akasa hate vrsti varsana kari evam ta tomaderake pana karate dii; ora bhandara tomadera kache nei.

latin_iast: āmii jīvana dāna kari o mṛtyu ghaṭāi evaṃ āmii cūr̤ānta mālikānāra adhikārī.
latin_ascii: amii jivana dana kari o mrtyu ghatai evam amii curanta malikanara adhikari.

latin_iast: tomādera pūrve yārā gata haẏeche āmi tāderake jāni evaṃ pare yārā āsave tāderakeo jāni.
latin_ascii: tomadera purve yara gata hayeche ami taderake jani evam pare yara asave taderakeo jani.

latin_iast: tomāra rāvvai tāderake samaveta karavena; tini prajñāmaẏa, sarvajña.
latin_ascii: tomara ravvai taderake samaveta karavena; tini prajnamaya, sarvajna.

latin_iast: āmito mānuṣake sṛṣṭi karechi chā~ce ḍhālā śuṣka ṭhanaṭhane māṭi hate.
latin_ascii: amito manusake srsti karechi cha~ce dhala suska thanathane mati hate.

latin_iast: era pūrve sṛṣṭi karechi jinake, prakhara śikhāyukta agni hate.
latin_ascii: era purve srsti karechi jinake, prakhara sikhayukta agni hate.

latin_iast: smaraṇa kara, yakhana tomāra rāvva mālāikā/phereśatāderake valalenaḥ āmi chā~ce ḍhālā śuṣka ṭhanaṭhane māṭi hate mānuṣa sṛṣṭi karava.
latin_ascii: smarana kara, yakhana tomara ravva malaika/pheresataderake valalenah ami cha~ce dhala suska thanathane mati hate manusa srsti karava.

latin_iast: yakhana āmi tāke suṭhāma karava evaṃ tāte āmāra rūha sañcāra karava takhana tomarā tāra prati sājadāhavanata hao.
latin_ascii: yakhana ami take suthama karava evam tate amara ruha sancara karava takhana tomara tara prati sajadahavanata hao.

latin_iast: mālāikā/phereśatāgaṇa savāi ekatre sājadāha karala.
latin_ascii: malaika/pheresatagana savai ekatre sajadaha karala.

latin_iast: kintu ivalīsa karalanā, se sājadāhakārīdera antarbhukta hate asvīkāra karala.
latin_ascii: kintu ivalisa karalana, se sajadahakaridera antarbhukta hate asvikara karala.

latin_iast: (āllāha) valalenaḥ he ivalīsa! tora ki hala, tui kena sājadāhakārīdera antarbhukta halinā?
latin_ascii: (allaha) valalenah he ivalisa! tora ki hala, tui kena sajadahakaridera antarbhukta halinay

latin_iast: se uttare valalaḥ chā~ce ḍhālā śuṣka ṭhanaṭhane mṛttikā hate ye mānuṣa āpani sṛṣṭi karechena, āmi tāke sājadāha karāra nai.
latin_ascii: se uttare valalah cha~ce dhala suska thanathane mrttika hate ye manusa apani srsti karechena, ami take sajadaha karara nai.

latin_iast: (āllāha) valalenaḥ tāhale tui ekhāna hate vera haẏe yā, kāraṇa tui abhiśapta.
latin_ascii: (allaha) valalenah tahale tui ekhana hate vera haye ya, karana tui abhisapta.

latin_iast: karmaphala dina paryanta tora prati raila lā’nata.
latin_ascii: karmaphala dina paryanta tora prati raila la’nata.

latin_iast: ivalīsa valalaḥ he āmāra rāvva! punarutthāna dina paryanta āmāke avakāśa dina.
latin_ascii: ivalisa valalah he amara ravva! punarutthana dina paryanta amake avakasa dina.

latin_iast: āllāha valalenaḥ toke avakāśa deẏā hala .
latin_ascii: allaha valalenah toke avakasa deya hala .

latin_iast: avadhārita samaẏa upasthita haoẏāra dina paryanta.
latin_ascii: avadharita samaya upasthita haoyara dina paryanta.

latin_iast: se valalaḥ he āmāra rāvva! āpani ye āmāke vipathagāmī karalena tajjanya āmi pṛthivīte mānuṣera nikaṭa pāpa kājake śobhanīẏa kare tulava evaṃ āmi tādera sakalake vipathagāmī karava.
latin_ascii: se valalah he amara ravva! apani ye amake vipathagami karalena tajjanya ami prthivite manusera nikata papa kajake sobhaniya kare tulava evam ami tadera sakalake vipathagami karava.

latin_iast: tave tādera madhya hate āpanāra nirvācita vāndāgaṇa vyatīta.
latin_ascii: tave tadera madhya hate apanara nirvacita vandagana vyatita.

latin_iast: tini valalenaḥ eṭāi āmāra nikaṭa pau~chāra sarala patha.
latin_ascii: tini valalenah etai amara nikata pau~chara sarala patha.

latin_iast: vibhrāntadera madhye yārā tora anusaraṇa karave tārā chār̤ā āmāra vāndādera upara tora kona kṣamatā thākavenā.
latin_ascii: vibhrantadera madhye yara tora anusarana karave tara chara amara vandadera upara tora kona ksamata thakavena.

latin_iast: avaśyai tora anusārīdera savārai nirdhārita sthāna have jāhānnāma.
latin_ascii: avasyai tora anusaridera savarai nirdharita sthana have jahannama.

latin_iast: ora sātaṭi darayā āche, pratyeka darayāra janya pṛthaka pṛthaka dala āche.
latin_ascii: ora satati daraya ache, pratyeka darayara janya prthaka prthaka dala ache.

latin_iast: niścaẏai muttākīrā thākave prasravana vahula jānnāte.
latin_ascii: niscayai muttakira thakave prasravana vahula jannate.

latin_iast: (tāderake valā have) tomarā śānti o nirāpattāra sāthe ekhāne praveśa kara.
latin_ascii: (taderake vala have) tomara santi o nirapattara sathe ekhane pravesa kara.

latin_iast: āmi tādera antara hate īrṣā dūra karava; tārā bhrātṛbhāve paraspara mukhomukhi haẏe avasthāna karave.
latin_ascii: ami tadera antara hate irsa dura karava; tara bhratrbhave paraspara mukhomukhi haye avasthana karave.

latin_iast: sekhāne tāderake avasāda sparśa karavenā evaṃ tārā sekhāna hate vahiskṛtao havenā.
latin_ascii: sekhane taderake avasada sparsa karavena evam tara sekhana hate vahiskrtao havena.

latin_iast: āmāra vāndāderake vale dāoḥ niścaẏai āmi kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.
latin_ascii: amara vandaderake vale daoh niscayai ami ksamasila, parama dayalu.

latin_iast: āra āmāra śāsti! tā ati marmantada śāsti.
latin_ascii: ara amara sasti! ta ati marmantada sasti.

latin_iast: āra tumi tāderake ivarāhīmera mehamānadera saṃvāda dāo.
latin_ascii: ara tumi taderake ivarahimera mehamanadera samvada dao.

latin_iast: yakhana tārā tāra nikaṭa upasthita haẏe valalaḥ ‘sālāma’ takhana se valechilaḥ āmarā tomādera āgamane ātaṃkita.
latin_ascii: yakhana tara tara nikata upasthita haye valalah ‘salama’ takhana se valechilah amara tomadera agamane atamkita.

latin_iast: tārā valalaḥ bhaẏa karanā, āmarā tomāke eka jñānī putrera susaṃvāda dicchi.
latin_ascii: tara valalah bhaya karana, amara tomake eka jnani putrera susamvada dicchi.

latin_iast: se valalaḥ tomarā ki āmāke susaṃvāda diccha āmi vārdhakyagrasta haoẏā sattveo? tomarā ki viṣaẏe susaṃvāda diccha?
latin_ascii: se valalah tomara ki amake susamvada diccha ami vardhakyagrasta haoya sattveoy tomara ki visaye susamvada dicchay

latin_iast: tārā valalaḥ āmarā satya saṃvāda dicchi; sutarāṃ tumi nirāśa haẏonā.
latin_ascii: tara valalah amara satya samvada dicchi; sutaram tumi nirasa hayona.

latin_iast: se valalaḥ yārā pathabhraṣṭa tārā vyatīta āra ke tāra ravera anugraha hate nirāśa haẏa?
latin_ascii: se valalah yara pathabhrasta tara vyatita ara ke tara ravera anugraha hate nirasa hayay

latin_iast: se valalaḥ he preritagaṇa! ataḥpara tomarā ki viśeṣa kāja niẏe esecha?
latin_ascii: se valalah he preritagana! atahpara tomara ki visesa kaja niye esechay

latin_iast: tārā valalaḥ āmāderake eka aparādhī sampradāẏera viruddhe preraṇa karā haẏeche.
latin_ascii: tara valalah amaderake eka aparadhi sampradayera viruddhe prerana kara hayeche.

latin_iast: tave lūtera parivāravargera viruddhe naẏa, āmarā avaśyai tādera sakalake rakṣā karava.
latin_ascii: tave lutera parivaravargera viruddhe naya, amara avasyai tadera sakalake raksa karava.

latin_iast: kintu tāra strīke naẏa; āmarā sthira karechi ye, se avaśyai paścāte avasthānakārīdera antarbhukta.
latin_ascii: kintu tara strike naya; amara sthira karechi ye, se avasyai pascate avasthanakaridera antarbhukta.

latin_iast: mālāikā/phereśatāgaṇa yakhana lūta parivārera nikaṭa elo –
latin_ascii: malaika/pheresatagana yakhana luta parivarera nikata elo –

latin_iast: takhana lūta valalaḥ tomarāto aparicita loka.
latin_ascii: takhana luta valalah tomarato aparicita loka.

latin_iast: tārā valalaḥ nā, tārā ye viṣaẏe sandigdha chila āmarā tomāra nikaṭa tā niẏe esechi.
latin_ascii: tara valalah na, tara ye visaye sandigdha chila amara tomara nikata ta niye esechi.

latin_iast: āmarā tomāra nikaṭa satya saṃvāda niẏe esechi evaṃ avaśyai āmarā satyavādī.
latin_ascii: amara tomara nikata satya samvada niye esechi evam avasyai amara satyavadi.

latin_iast: sutarāṃ tumi rātera śeṣa prahare tomāra parivāravargasaha vera haẏe par̤a evaṃ tumi tādera paścādanusaraṇa kara evaṃ tomādera madhye keha yena pichana phire nā tākāẏa, tomāderake yekhāne yete valā haẏeche sekhāne cale yāo.
latin_ascii: sutaram tumi ratera sesa prahare tomara parivaravargasaha vera haye para evam tumi tadera pascadanusarana kara evam tomadera madhye keha yena pichana phire na takaya, tomaderake yekhane yete vala hayeche sekhane cale yao.

latin_iast: āmi tāke e viṣaẏe pratyādeśa dilāma ye, pratyuṣe tāderake samūle vināśa karā have.
latin_ascii: ami take e visaye pratyadesa dilama ye, pratyuse taderake samule vinasa kara have.

latin_iast: nagaravāsīrā ānandommāda haẏe upasthita hala.
latin_ascii: nagaravasira anandommada haye upasthita hala.

latin_iast: se valalaḥ niścaẏai erā āmāra atithi; sutarāṃ tomarā āmāke veiyyāta karanā.
latin_ascii: se valalah niscayai era amara atithi; sutaram tomara amake veiyyata karana.

latin_iast: tomarā āllāhake bhaẏa kara o āmāke lajjita karanā.
latin_ascii: tomara allahake bhaya kara o amake lajjita karana.

latin_iast: tārā valalaḥ āmarā ki duniẏāvāsī lokake āśraẏa dite āpanāke niṣedha karini?
latin_ascii: tara valalah amara ki duniyavasi lokake asraya dite apanake nisedha kariniy

latin_iast: lūta valalaḥ ekāntai yadi tomarā kichu karate cāo tāhale āmāra ei kanyāgaṇa raẏeche.
latin_ascii: luta valalah ekantai yadi tomara kichu karate cao tahale amara ei kanyagana rayeche.

latin_iast: tomāra jīvanera śapatha! orāto āpana neśāẏa matta chila.
latin_ascii: tomara jivanera sapatha! orato apana nesaya matta chila.

latin_iast: ataḥpara sūryodaẏera samaẏe mahānāda tāderake āghāta karala.
latin_ascii: atahpara suryodayera samaye mahanada taderake aghata karala.

latin_iast: sutarāṃ āmi janapadake ulṭe dilāma evaṃ tādera upara prastara kaṃkara nikṣepa karalāma.
latin_ascii: sutaram ami janapadake ulte dilama evam tadera upara prastara kamkara niksepa karalama.

latin_iast: avaśyai ete nidarśana raẏeche vodhaśakti sampanna vyaktidera janya.
latin_ascii: avasyai ete nidarsana rayeche vodhasakti sampanna vyaktidera janya.

latin_iast: oṭā loka calācalera pathapārśve ekhanao vidyamāna.
latin_ascii: ota loka calacalera pathaparsve ekhanao vidyamana.

latin_iast: avaśyai ete mu’minadera janya raẏeche nidarśana.
latin_ascii: avasyai ete mu’minadera janya rayeche nidarsana.

latin_iast: āra ‘āẏakā’vāsīrāoto chila sīmā laṃghanakārī.
latin_ascii: ara ‘ayaka’vasiraoto chila sima lamghanakari.

latin_iast: sutarāṃ āmi tāderake śāsti diẏechi, odera ubhaẏai prakāśya pathapārśve avasthita.
latin_ascii: sutaram ami taderake sasti diyechi, odera ubhayai prakasya pathaparsve avasthita.

latin_iast: hijaravāsīrā rāsūladera prati mithyā āropa karechila.
latin_ascii: hijaravasira rasuladera prati mithya aropa karechila.

latin_iast: āmi tāderake āmāra nidarśana dekhiẏechilāma, kintu tārā tā upekṣā karechila.
latin_ascii: ami taderake amara nidarsana dekhiyechilama, kintu tara ta upeksa karechila.

latin_iast: tārā pāhār̤a keṭe gṛha nirmāṇa karata nirāpada vasavāsera janya.
latin_ascii: tara pahara kete grha nirmana karata nirapada vasavasera janya.

latin_iast: ataḥpara prabhātakāle mahānāda tāderake āghāta karala.
latin_ascii: atahpara prabhatakale mahanada taderake aghata karala.

latin_iast: sutarāṃ tārā yā arjana karechila tā tādera kona kāje āseni.
latin_ascii: sutaram tara ya arjana karechila ta tadera kona kaje aseni.

latin_iast: ākāśasamūha o pṛthivī evaṃ e du’ẏera antavartī kona kichui āmi ayathā sṛṣṭi karini; evaṃ kiẏāmāta avaśyambhāvī; sutarāṃ tumi parama saujanyera sāthe tāderake kṣamā kara.
latin_ascii: akasasamuha o prthivi evam e du’yera antavarti kona kichui ami ayatha srsti karini; evam kiyamata avasyambhavi; sutaram tumi parama saujanyera sathe taderake ksama kara.

latin_iast: niścaẏai tomāra rāvvai mahāna sraṣṭā, mahājñānī.
latin_ascii: niscayai tomara ravvai mahana srasta, mahajnani.

latin_iast: āmito tomāke diẏechi sāta āẏāta yā punaḥ punaḥ āvṛtti karā haẏa evaṃ diẏechi mahāna kuraāna.
latin_ascii: amito tomake diyechi sata ayata ya punah punah avrtti kara haya evam diyechi mahana kuraana.

latin_iast: āmi tādera vibhinna śreṇīke bhoga vilāsera ye upakaraṇa diẏechi tāra prati tumi kakhanao tomāra cakṣudvaẏa prasārita karanā; tāderake yā deẏā haẏeche sei janya tumi kṣobha karanā; tumi mu’minadera janya tomāra vāhu avanamita kara.
latin_ascii: ami tadera vibhinna srenike bhoga vilasera ye upakarana diyechi tara prati tumi kakhanao tomara caksudvaya prasarita karana; taderake ya deya hayeche sei janya tumi ksobha karana; tumi mu’minadera janya tomara vahu avanamita kara.

latin_iast: āra valaḥ āmito ekajana bhaẏa pradarśanakārī mātra.
latin_ascii: ara valah amito ekajana bhaya pradarsanakari matra.

latin_iast: yebhāve āmi avatīrṇa karechilāma vibhaktakārīdera upara,
latin_ascii: yebhave ami avatirna karechilama vibhaktakaridera upara,

latin_iast: yārā kuraānake vibhinnabhāve vibhakta kareche.
latin_ascii: yara kuraanake vibhinnabhave vibhakta kareche.

latin_iast: sutarāṃ tomāra ravera śapatha! āmi tādera sakalake praśna karavai,
latin_ascii: sutaram tomara ravera sapatha! ami tadera sakalake prasna karavai,

latin_iast: sei viṣaẏe, yā tārā kare.
latin_ascii: sei visaye, ya tara kare.

latin_iast: ataeva tumi ye viṣaẏe ādiṣṭa haẏecha tā prakāśye pracāra kara evaṃ muśarikadera upekṣā kara.
latin_ascii: ataeva tumi ye visaye adista hayecha ta prakasye pracara kara evam musarikadera upeksa kara.

latin_iast: āmii yatheṣṭa tomāra janya, vidrupakārīdera viruddhe.
latin_ascii: amii yathesta tomara janya, vidrupakaridera viruddhe.

latin_iast: yārā āllāhara sāthe apara mā‘vūda pratiṣṭhā kareche. evaṃ śīghrai tārā jānate pārave!
latin_ascii: yara allahara sathe apara ma‘vuda pratistha kareche. evam sighrai tara janate parave!

latin_iast: āmito jāni ye, tārā yā vale tāte tomāra antara saṃkucita haẏa.
latin_ascii: amito jani ye, tara ya vale tate tomara antara samkucita haya.

latin_iast: sutarāṃ tumi tomāra ravera praśaṃsā dvārā tā~ra pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā kara evaṃ sājadāhakārīdera antarbhukta hao.
latin_ascii: sutaram tumi tomara ravera prasamsa dvara ta~ra pavitrata o mahima ghosana kara evam sajadahakaridera antarbhukta hao.

latin_iast: āra tomāra mṛtyu upasthita nā haoẏā paryanta tumi tomāra ravera ivādāta kara.
latin_ascii: ara tomara mrtyu upasthita na haoya paryanta tumi tomara ravera ivadata kara.

latin_iast: āllāhara ādeśa āsavei; sutarāṃ oṭā tvarānvita karate ceonā; tini mahimānvita evaṃ tārā yāke śarīka kare tini tāra urdhve.
latin_ascii: allahara adesa asavei; sutaram ota tvaranvita karate ceona; tini mahimanvita evam tara yake sarika kare tini tara urdhve.

latin_iast: tini tā~ra vāndādera madhye yāra prati icchā nirdeśa samvalita ohīsaha mālāka/phereśatā preraṇa karena, ei marme satarka karāra janya, āmi chār̤ā kona ilāha nei; sutarāṃ āmāke bhaẏa kara.
latin_ascii: tini ta~ra vandadera madhye yara prati iccha nirdesa samvalita ohisaha malaka/pheresata prerana karena, ei marme satarka karara janya, ami chara kona ilaha nei; sutaram amake bhaya kara.

latin_iast: tini yathāyathabhāve ākāśamanḍalī o pṛthivī sṛṣṭi karechena; tārā yāke śarīka kare tini tāra urdhve.
latin_ascii: tini yathayathabhave akasamandali o prthivi srsti karechena; tara yake sarika kare tini tara urdhve.

latin_iast: tini śukra hate mānuṣa sṛṣṭi karechena. athaca dekha, se prakāśya vitanḍākārī.
latin_ascii: tini sukra hate manusa srsti karechena. athaca dekha, se prakasya vitandakari.

latin_iast: tini catuspada jantu sṛṣṭi karechena; tomādera janya ote śīta nivāraka upakaraṇa evaṃ ārao vahu upakāra raẏeche; evaṃ oṭā hate tomarā āhārya peẏe thāka.
latin_ascii: tini catuspada jantu srsti karechena; tomadera janya ote sita nivaraka upakarana evam arao vahu upakara rayeche; evam ota hate tomara aharya peye thaka.

latin_iast: āra yakhana tomarā godhūli lagne oderake cāraṇabhūmi hate gṛhe niẏe āso evaṃ prabhāte yakhana oderake cāraṇabhūmite niẏe yāo takhana tomarā ora saundarya upabhoga kara evaṃ gaurava anubhava kara.
latin_ascii: ara yakhana tomara godhuli lagne oderake caranabhumi hate grhe niye aso evam prabhate yakhana oderake caranabhumite niye yao takhana tomara ora saundarya upabhoga kara evam gaurava anubhava kara.

latin_iast: āra orā tomādera bhāra vahana kare niẏe yāẏa dūradeśe yekhāne prāṇānta kleśa vyatīta tomarā pau~chate pāratenā; tomādera rāvva avaśyai daẏārdra, parama daẏālu.
latin_ascii: ara ora tomadera bhara vahana kare niye yaya duradese yekhane prananta klesa vyatita tomara pau~chate paratena; tomadera ravva avasyai dayardra, parama dayalu.

latin_iast: tomādera ārohanera janya o śobhāra janya tini sṛṣṭi karechena aśva, khaccara, gardabha evaṃ tini sṛṣṭi karena emana aneka kichu yā tomarā avagata nao.
latin_ascii: tomadera arohanera janya o sobhara janya tini srsti karechena asva, khaccara, gardabha evam tini srsti karena emana aneka kichu ya tomara avagata nao.

latin_iast: sarala patha āllāhara kāche pau~chāẏa, kintu pathagulira madhye vakra pathao raẏeche. tini icchā karale tomādera sakalakei sat pathe paricālita karatena.
latin_ascii: sarala patha allahara kache pau~chaya, kintu pathagulira madhye vakra pathao rayeche. tini iccha karale tomadera sakalakei sat pathe paricalita karatena.

latin_iast: tinii ākāśa hate vāri varṣaṇa karena. ote tomādera janya raẏeche pānīẏa evaṃ tā hate janmāẏa udbhida yāte tomarā paśu cāraṇa kare thāka.
latin_ascii: tinii akasa hate vari varsana karena. ote tomadera janya rayeche paniya evam ta hate janmaya udbhida yate tomara pasu carana kare thaka.

latin_iast: tini tomādera janya ora dvārā utpanna karena śasya, yāitūna, khejura vṛkṣa, āṅgura evaṃ sarvaprakāra phala; avaśyai ete cintāśīla sampradāẏera janya raẏeche nidarśana.
latin_ascii: tini tomadera janya ora dvara utpanna karena sasya, yaituna, khejura vrksa, angura evam sarvaprakara phala; avasyai ete cintasila sampradayera janya rayeche nidarsana.

latin_iast: tinii tomādera kalyāṇe niẏojita karechena rātrī, dina, sūrya evaṃ cā~dake. āra nakṣatrarājio adhīna haẏeche tā~rai ādeśe; avaśyai ete vodhaśaktisampanna sampradāẏera janya raẏeche nidarśana.
latin_ascii: tinii tomadera kalyane niyojita karechena ratri, dina, surya evam ca~dake. ara naksatrarajio adhina hayeche ta~rai adese; avasyai ete vodhasaktisampanna sampradayera janya rayeche nidarsana.

latin_iast: āra vividha prakāśya vastuo, yā tomādera janya pṛthivīte sṛṣṭi karechena. ete raẏeche nidarśana sei sampradāẏera janya yārā upadeśa grahaṇa kare.
latin_ascii: ara vividha prakasya vastuo, ya tomadera janya prthivite srsti karechena. ete rayeche nidarsana sei sampradayera janya yara upadesa grahana kare.

latin_iast: tinii samudrake adhīna karechena yāte tomarā tā hate tājā gośata āhāra karate pāra evaṃ yāte tā hate āharaṇa karate pāra ratnāvalī yā tomarā bhūṣaṇa rūpe paridhāna kara; evaṃ tomarā dekhate pāo, ora vuka cire nauyāna calācala kare evaṃ tā e janya ye, tomarā yena tā~ra anugraha sandhāna karate pāra evaṃ tomarā yena kṛtajñatā prakāśa kara.
latin_ascii: tinii samudrake adhina karechena yate tomara ta hate taja gosata ahara karate para evam yate ta hate aharana karate para ratnavali ya tomara bhusana rupe paridhana kara; evam tomara dekhate pao, ora vuka cire nauyana calacala kare evam ta e janya ye, tomara yena ta~ra anugraha sandhana karate para evam tomara yena krtajnata prakasa kara.

latin_iast: āra tini pṛthivīte sudṛr̤ha parvata sthāpana karechena, yāte pṛthivī tomāderake niẏe āndolita nā haẏa evaṃ sthāpana karechena nada-nadī o patha, yāte tomarā tomādera gantavyasthale pau~chate pāra.
latin_ascii: ara tini prthivite sudrrha parvata sthapana karechena, yate prthivi tomaderake niye andolita na haya evam sthapana karechena nada-nadi o patha, yate tomara tomadera gantavyasthale pau~chate para.

latin_iast: āra patha nirṇāẏaka cihnasamūhao; evaṃ nakṣatrera sāhāyyeo mānuṣa pathera nirdeśa pāẏa.
latin_ascii: ara patha nirnayaka cihnasamuhao; evam naksatrera sahayyeo manusa pathera nirdesa paya.

latin_iast: tave ki yini sṛṣṭi karena tini tārai mata ye sṛṣṭi karenā? tavuo ki tomarā śikṣā grahaṇa karavenā?
latin_ascii: tave ki yini srsti karena tini tarai mata ye srsti karenay tavuo ki tomara siksa grahana karavenay

latin_iast: tomarā āllāhara anugraha gaṇanā karale ora saṃkhyā nirṇaẏa karate pāravenā; āllāha avaśyai kṣamā parāẏaṇa, parama daẏālu.
latin_ascii: tomara allahara anugraha ganana karale ora samkhya nirnaya karate paravena; allaha avasyai ksama parayana, parama dayalu.

latin_iast: tomarā yā gopana rākha evaṃ yā prakāśa kara, āllāha tā jānena.
latin_ascii: tomara ya gopana rakha evam ya prakasa kara, allaha ta janena.

latin_iast: tārā āllāha chār̤ā apara yāderake āhavāna kare tārā kichui sṛṣṭi karenā, tāderakei sṛṣṭi karā haẏa.
latin_ascii: tara allaha chara apara yaderake ahavana kare tara kichui srsti karena, taderakei srsti kara haya.

latin_iast: tārā nisprāṇa nirjīva evaṃ punarutthāna kave have se viṣaẏe tādera kona jñāna nei.
latin_ascii: tara nisprana nirjiva evam punarutthana kave have se visaye tadera kona jnana nei.

latin_iast: tomādera mā‘vūda ekai mā‘vūda. sutarāṃ yārā ākhirāte viśvāsa karenā tādera antara satyavimukha evaṃ tārā ahaṃkārī.
latin_ascii: tomadera ma‘vuda ekai ma‘vuda. sutaram yara akhirate visvasa karena tadera antara satyavimukha evam tara ahamkari.

latin_iast: eṭā niḥsandeha ye, āllāha jānena yā tārā gopana kare evaṃ yā tārā prakāśa kare; tini ahaṃkārīke pachanda karenanā.
latin_ascii: eta nihsandeha ye, allaha janena ya tara gopana kare evam ya tara prakasa kare; tini ahamkarike pachanda karenana.

latin_iast: yakhana tāderake valā haẏaḥ tomādera rāvva ki avatīrṇa karechena? uttare tārā valeḥ pūrvavartīdera kissā-kāhinī.
latin_ascii: yakhana taderake vala hayah tomadera ravva ki avatirna karechenay uttare tara valeh purvavartidera kissa-kahini.

latin_iast: phale kiẏāmāta divase tārā vahana karave tādera pāpabhāra pūrṇamātrāẏa evaṃ pāpabhāra tāderao yāderake tārā ajñatā vaśataḥ vibhrānta kareche; hāẏa! tārā yā vahana karave tā katai nā nikṛṣṭa!
latin_ascii: phale kiyamata divase tara vahana karave tadera papabhara purnamatraya evam papabhara taderao yaderake tara ajnata vasatah vibhranta kareche; haya! tara ya vahana karave ta katai na nikrsta!

latin_iast: tādera pūrvavartīrāo cakrānta karechila. āllāha tādera imārātera bhittimūle āghāta karechilena; phale imārātera chāda tādera upara dhvase par̤ala evaṃ tādera prati śāsti neme elo emana dika hate yā chila tādera dhāranāra vāhira.
latin_ascii: tadera purvavartirao cakranta karechila. allaha tadera imaratera bhittimule aghata karechilena; phale imaratera chada tadera upara dhvase parala evam tadera prati sasti neme elo emana dika hate ya chila tadera dharanara vahira.

latin_iast: pare kiẏāmāta divase tini tādera lāñchita karavena evaṃ valavenaḥ kothāẏa āmāra sei sava śarīka yādera samvandhe tomarā vitanḍā karate? yāderake jñāna dāna karā haẏechila tārā valaveḥ niścaẏai āja lāñchanā o amaṅgala kāphiradera janya.
latin_ascii: pare kiyamata divase tini tadera lanchita karavena evam valavenah kothaya amara sei sava sarika yadera samvandhe tomara vitanda karatey yaderake jnana dana kara hayechila tara valaveh niscayai aja lanchana o amangala kaphiradera janya.

latin_iast: mālāikā/phereśatāgaṇa tādera mṛtyu ghaṭāẏa tādera nijedera prati yulama karate thākā avasthāẏa; ataḥpara tārā ātmasamarpaṇa kare valaveḥ āmarā kona manda kāja karatāmanā. hyā~, tomarā yā karate se viṣaẏe āllāha saviśeṣa avahita.
latin_ascii: malaika/pheresatagana tadera mrtyu ghataya tadera nijedera prati yulama karate thaka avasthaya; atahpara tara atmasamarpana kare valaveh amara kona manda kaja karatamana. hya~, tomara ya karate se visaye allaha savisesa avahita.

latin_iast: sutarāṃ tomarā dvāraguli diẏe jāhānnāme praveśa kara, sekhāne sthāẏī haoẏāra janya. dekha, ahaṃkārīdera āvāsasthala kata nikṛṣṭa!
latin_ascii: sutaram tomara dvaraguli diye jahanname pravesa kara, sekhane sthayi haoyara janya. dekha, ahamkaridera avasasthala kata nikrsta!

latin_iast: āra yārā muttākī tāderake valā haveḥ tomādera rāvva ki avatīrṇa karechilena? tārā valaveḥ mahā kalyāṇa. yārā satkāja kare tādera janya raẏeche ei duniẏāra maṅgala evaṃ ākhirātera āvāsa ārao utkṛṣṭa; āra muttākīdera āvāsasthala kata uttama!
