latin_ascii: ara yara muttaki taderake vala haveh tomadera ravva ki avatirna karechilenay tara valaveh maha kalyana. yara satkaja kare tadera janya rayeche ei duniyara mangala evam akhiratera avasa arao utkrsta; ara muttakidera avasasthala kata uttama!

latin_iast: oṭā sthāẏī jānnāta, yāte tārā praveśa karave; ora pādadeśe srotasvinī nadī pravāhita; tārā yā kichu kāmanā karave tāte tādera janya tā’i thākave; ebhāvei āllāha puraskṛta karena muttākīderake.
latin_ascii: ota sthayi jannata, yate tara pravesa karave; ora padadese srotasvini nadi pravahita; tara ya kichu kamana karave tate tadera janya ta’i thakave; ebhavei allaha puraskrta karena muttakiderake.

latin_iast: mālāikā/phereśatāgaṇa yādera mṛtyu ghaṭāẏa pavitra thākā avasthāẏa, (tāderake) valaveḥ tomādera prati śānti! tomarā yā karate tāra pratidāne jānnāte praveśa kara.
latin_ascii: malaika/pheresatagana yadera mrtyu ghataya pavitra thaka avasthaya, (taderake) valaveh tomadera prati santi! tomara ya karate tara pratidane jannate pravesa kara.

latin_iast: tārā śudhu pratīkṣā kare tādera kāche mālāka/phereśatā āgamanera athavā tomāra ravera śāsti āgamanera; āllāha tādera prati kona yulama karenani, kintu tārāi nijedera prati yulama karata.
latin_ascii: tara sudhu pratiksa kare tadera kache malaka/pheresata agamanera athava tomara ravera sasti agamanera; allaha tadera prati kona yulama karenani, kintu tarai nijedera prati yulama karata.

latin_iast: sutarāṃ tādera prati āpatita haẏechila tāderai manda karmera śāsti evaṃ tāderake pariveṣṭana karechila oṭāi yā niẏe tārā ṭhāṭṭā vidrupa karata.
latin_ascii: sutaram tadera prati apatita hayechila taderai manda karmera sasti evam taderake parivestana karechila otai ya niye tara thatta vidrupa karata.

latin_iast: muśarikarā valeḥ āllāha icchā karale āmādera pitṛ-puruṣarā o āmarā tini vyatīta apara kona kichura ivādāta karatāma nā evaṃ tā~ra anumati vyatīta āmarā kona kichu niṣiddha karatāma nā. tādera pūrvavartīrāo ei rūpai karata; rāsūladera kartavya to śudhu suspaṣṭa vāṇī pracāra karā.
latin_ascii: musarikara valeh allaha iccha karale amadera pitr-purusara o amara tini vyatita apara kona kichura ivadata karatama na evam ta~ra anumati vyatita amara kona kichu nisiddha karatama na. tadera purvavartirao ei rupai karata; rasuladera kartavya to sudhu suspasta vani pracara kara.

latin_iast: āllāhara ivādāta karāra o tāgutake varjana karāra nirdeśa deẏāra janya āmi pratyeka jātira madhyei rāsūla pāṭhiẏechi; ataḥpara tādera katakake āllāha sat pathe paricālita karena evaṃ tādera katakera upara pathabhrānti sāvyasta haẏechila. sutarāṃ pṛthivīte bhramaṇa kara evaṃ dekha, yārā satyake mithyā valeche tādera parināma ki haẏeche!
latin_ascii: allahara ivadata karara o tagutake varjana karara nirdesa deyara janya ami pratyeka jatira madhyei rasula pathiyechi; atahpara tadera katakake allaha sat pathe paricalita karena evam tadera katakera upara pathabhranti savyasta hayechila. sutaram prthivite bhramana kara evam dekha, yara satyake mithya valeche tadera parinama ki hayeche!

latin_iast: tumi tāderake patha pradarśana karate āgrahī haleo āllāha yāke vibhrānta karechena tāke tini sat pathe paricālita karavenanā evaṃ tādera kona sāhāyyakārīo nei.
latin_ascii: tumi taderake patha pradarsana karate agrahi haleo allaha yake vibhranta karechena take tini sat pathe paricalita karavenana evam tadera kona sahayyakario nei.

latin_iast: tārā dṛr̤hatāra sāthe āllāhara śapatha kare valeḥ yāra mṛtyu haẏa āllāha tāke punarujjīvita karavenanā. kena naẏa? tini tā~ra pratiśruti pūrṇa karavenai; kintu adhikāṃśa mānuṣa eṭā avagata naẏa.
latin_ascii: tara drrhatara sathe allahara sapatha kare valeh yara mrtyu haya allaha take punarujjivita karavenana. kena nayay tini ta~ra pratisruti purna karavenai; kintu adhikamsa manusa eta avagata naya.

latin_iast: tini punarutthita karavena, ye viṣaẏe tādera matānaikya chila tā tāderake spaṣṭabhāve dekhānora janya evaṃ yāte kāphirerā jānate pāre ye, tārāi chila mithyāvādī.
latin_ascii: tini punarutthita karavena, ye visaye tadera matanaikya chila ta taderake spastabhave dekhanora janya evam yate kaphirera janate pare ye, tarai chila mithyavadi.

latin_iast: āmi kona kichu icchā karale sei viṣaẏe āmāra kathā śudhu ei ye, āmi vali ‘hao,’ phale tā haẏe yāẏa.
latin_ascii: ami kona kichu iccha karale sei visaye amara katha sudhu ei ye, ami vali ‘hao,’ phale ta haye yaya.

latin_iast: yārā atyācārita haoẏāra para āllāhara pathe hijarāta kareche āmi avaśyai tāderake duniẏāẏa uttama āvāsa pradāna karava evaṃ ākhirātera puraṣkāraito śreṣṭha. hāẏa! tārā yadi oṭā jānata!
latin_ascii: yara atyacarita haoyara para allahara pathe hijarata kareche ami avasyai taderake duniyaya uttama avasa pradana karava evam akhiratera puraskaraito srestha. haya! tara yadi ota janata!

latin_iast: tārā dhairya dhāraṇa kare evaṃ tādera ravera upara nirbhara kare.
latin_ascii: tara dhairya dharana kare evam tadera ravera upara nirbhara kare.

latin_iast: tomāra pūrve āmi ahīsaha (puruṣa) mānuṣai preraṇa karechilāma, tomarā yadi nā jāna tāhale jñānīderake jijñesa kara.
latin_ascii: tomara purve ami ahisaha (purusa) manusai prerana karechilama, tomara yadi na jana tahale jnaniderake jijnesa kara.

latin_iast: tādera preraṇa karechilāma spaṣṭa nidarśana o granthasaha evaṃ tomāra prati kuraāna avatīrṇa karechi mānuṣake spaṣṭabhāve vujhiẏe deẏāra janya, yā tādera prati avatīrṇa karā haẏechila, yāte tārā cintā bhāvanā kare.
latin_ascii: tadera prerana karechilama spasta nidarsana o granthasaha evam tomara prati kuraana avatirna karechi manusake spastabhave vujhiye deyara janya, ya tadera prati avatirna kara hayechila, yate tara cinta bhavana kare.

latin_iast: yārā duskarmera ṣar̤ayantra kare tārā ki e viṣaẏe niścita ye, āllāha tāderake bhū-garbhe vilīna karavena nā, athavā emana dika hate śāsti āsave nā yā tādera dhāraṇātīta?
latin_ascii: yara duskarmera sarayantra kare tara ki e visaye niscita ye, allaha taderake bhu-garbhe vilina karavena na, athava emana dika hate sasti asave na ya tadera dharanatitay

latin_iast: athavā calāphirā karate thākākāle tini tāderake dhṛta karavenanā? tārāto eṭā vyartha karate pāravenā.
latin_ascii: athava calaphira karate thakakale tini taderake dhrta karavenanay tarato eta vyartha karate paravena.

latin_iast: athavā tāderake tini bhīta santrasta avasthāẏa pākar̤āo karavenanā? tomādera rāvvato avaśyai kṣamākārī, parama daẏālu.
latin_ascii: athava taderake tini bhita santrasta avasthaya pakarao karavenanay tomadera ravvato avasyai ksamakari, parama dayalu.

latin_iast: tārā ki lakṣya karenā āllāhara sṛṣṭa vastura prati, yāra chāẏā ḍāne o vāme ḍhale par̤e āllāhara prati sājadāhaẏa nata haẏa?
latin_ascii: tara ki laksya karena allahara srsta vastura prati, yara chaya dane o vame dhale pare allahara prati sajadahaya nata hayay

latin_iast: āllāhakei sājadāha kare yā kichu sṛṣṭi raẏeche ākāśamanḍalīte evaṃ pṛthivīte evaṃ mālāikāgaṇao; tārā ahaṃkāra karenā.
latin_ascii: allahakei sajadaha kare ya kichu srsti rayeche akasamandalite evam prthivite evam malaikaganao; tara ahamkara karena.

latin_iast: tārā bhaẏa kare, tādera upara parākramaśālī tādera rāvvake evaṃ tāderake yā ādeśa karā haẏa tārā tā pālana kare. [sājadāha]
latin_ascii: tara bhaya kare, tadera upara parakramasali tadera ravvake evam taderake ya adesa kara haya tara ta palana kare. [sajadaha]

latin_iast: āllāha valenaḥ tomarā dui ilāha grahaṇa karanā; tinii ekamātra ilāha, sutarāṃ tomarā āmākei bhaẏa kara.
latin_ascii: allaha valenah tomara dui ilaha grahana karana; tinii ekamatra ilaha, sutaram tomara amakei bhaya kara.

latin_iast: ākāśamanḍalī o pṛthivīte yā kichu āche tā tā~rai; evaṃ niravacchinna ānugatya tā~rai prāpya; tomarā ki āllāha vyatīta anyake bhaẏa karave?
latin_ascii: akasamandali o prthivite ya kichu ache ta ta~rai; evam niravacchinna anugatya ta~rai prapya; tomara ki allaha vyatita anyake bhaya karavey

latin_iast: tomarā ye sava anugraha bhoga kara tāto āllāharai nikaṭa hate. adhikanta yakhana duḥkha dainya tomāderake sparśa kare takhana tomarā tā~kei vyākulabhāve āhavāna kara.
latin_ascii: tomara ye sava anugraha bhoga kara tato allaharai nikata hate. adhikanta yakhana duhkha dainya tomaderake sparsa kare takhana tomara ta~kei vyakulabhave ahavana kara.

latin_iast: āvāra yakhana (āllāha) tomādera duḥkha-dainya dūra karena takhana tomādera eka dala tādera ravera sāthe śarīka kare .
latin_ascii: avara yakhana (allaha) tomadera duhkha-dainya dura karena takhana tomadera eka dala tadera ravera sathe sarika kare .

latin_iast: āmi tāderake yā dāna karechi tā asvīkāra karāra janya, sutarāṃ tomarā bhoga kare nāo, acirei jānate pārave.
latin_ascii: ami taderake ya dana karechi ta asvikara karara janya, sutaram tomara bhoga kare nao, acirei janate parave.

latin_iast: āmi tāderake ye riyka dāna kari tārā tāra eka aṃśa nirdhārita kare tādera janya yādera samvandhe tārā kichui jānenā. śapatha āllāhara! tomarā ye mithyā udbhāvana kara sei samvandhe tomāderake praśna karā havei.
latin_ascii: ami taderake ye riyka dana kari tara tara eka amsa nirdharita kare tadera janya yadera samvandhe tara kichui janena. sapatha allahara! tomara ye mithya udbhavana kara sei samvandhe tomaderake prasna kara havei.

latin_iast: tārā nirdhāraṇa kare āllāhara janya kanyā santāna. tini pavitra mahimānvita, evaṃ tādera janya oṭāi yā tārā kāmanā kare.
latin_ascii: tara nirdharana kare allahara janya kanya santana. tini pavitra mahimanvita, evam tadera janya otai ya tara kamana kare.

latin_iast: tādera kehake yakhana kanyā santānera susaṃvāda deẏā haẏa takhana tāra mukhamanḍala kālo haẏe yāẏa evaṃ se asahanīẏa manastāpe kliṣṭa haẏa.
latin_ascii: tadera kehake yakhana kanya santanera susamvada deya haya takhana tara mukhamandala kalo haye yaya evam se asahaniya manastape klista haya.

latin_iast: tāke ye saṃvāda deẏā haẏa, tāra glāni hetu se nija sampradāẏa hate ātmagopana kare. se cintā kare ye, hīnatā sattveo se tāke rekhe dive, nāki māṭite pu~te phelave. sāvadhāna! tārā yā siddhānta neẏa tā katai nā nikṛṣṭa!
latin_ascii: take ye samvada deya haya, tara glani hetu se nija sampradaya hate atmagopana kare. se cinta kare ye, hinata sattveo se take rekhe dive, naki matite pu~te phelave. savadhana! tara ya siddhanta neya ta katai na nikrsta!

latin_iast: yārā ākhirāte viśvāsa karenā tārā nikṛṣṭa prakṛtira sadṛśa. āra āllāhato mahattama prakṛtira adhikārī; evaṃ tini parākramaśālī, prajñāmaẏa.
latin_ascii: yara akhirate visvasa karena tara nikrsta prakrtira sadrsa. ara allahato mahattama prakrtira adhikari; evam tini parakramasali, prajnamaya.

latin_iast: āllāha yadi mānuṣake tādera sīmā laṃghanera janya śāsti ditena tāhale bhūpṛṣṭhe kona jīva jantukei rehāi ditenanā; kintu tini eka nirdiṣṭa kāla paryanta tāderake avakāśa diẏe thākena. ataḥpara yakhana tādera samaẏa āse takhana tārā muhurtakāla vilamva athavā tvarā karate pāravenā.
latin_ascii: allaha yadi manusake tadera sima lamghanera janya sasti ditena tahale bhuprsthe kona jiva jantukei rehai ditenana; kintu tini eka nirdista kala paryanta taderake avakasa diye thakena. atahpara yakhana tadera samaya ase takhana tara muhurtakala vilamva athava tvara karate paravena.

latin_iast: yā tārā apachanda kare tāi tārā āllāhara prati āropa kare. tādera jihavā mithyā varṇanā kare ye, maṅgala tāderai janya. niścaẏai tādera janya raẏeche jāhānnāma evaṃ tāderakei sarvāgre tāte nikṣepa karā have.
latin_ascii: ya tara apachanda kare tai tara allahara prati aropa kare. tadera jihava mithya varnana kare ye, mangala taderai janya. niscayai tadera janya rayeche jahannama evam taderakei sarvagre tate niksepa kara have.

latin_iast: śapatha āllāhara! āmi tomāra pūrveo vahu jātira nikaṭa rāsūla preraṇa karechi; kintu śāitāna ai sava jātira kāryakalāpa tādera dṛṣṭite śobhana karechila; sutarāṃ se’i āja tādera abhibhāvaka evaṃ tāderai janya raẏeche yantraṇādāẏaka śāsti.
latin_ascii: sapatha allahara! ami tomara purveo vahu jatira nikata rasula prerana karechi; kintu saitana ai sava jatira karyakalapa tadera drstite sobhana karechila; sutaram se’i aja tadera abhibhavaka evam taderai janya rayeche yantranadayaka sasti.

latin_iast: āmito tomāra prati ei kitāva avatīrṇa karechi yārā e viṣaẏe matabheda kare tāderake suspaṣṭabhāve vujhiẏe deẏāra janya evaṃ mu’minadera janya patha-nirdeśa o daẏā svarūpa.
latin_ascii: amito tomara prati ei kitava avatirna karechi yara e visaye matabheda kare taderake suspastabhave vujhiye deyara janya evam mu’minadera janya patha-nirdesa o daya svarupa.

latin_iast: āra āllāha āsamāna theke vṛṣṭi varṣaṇa karechena. ataḥpara tā diẏe yamīnake tāra mṛtyura para sajīva karechena. niścaẏa ete nidarśana raẏeche sei kaomera janyā yārā śune.
latin_ascii: ara allaha asamana theke vrsti varsana karechena. atahpara ta diye yaminake tara mrtyura para sajiva karechena. niscaya ete nidarsana rayeche sei kaomera janya yara sune.

latin_iast: avaśyai (gṛhapālita) catuspada jantura madhye tomādera janya śikṣā raẏeche; ogulira udarasthita govara o raktera madhya hate tomāderake āmi pāna karāi viśuddha dugdha, yā pānakārīdera janya susvādu.
latin_ascii: avasyai (grhapalita) catuspada jantura madhye tomadera janya siksa rayeche; ogulira udarasthita govara o raktera madhya hate tomaderake ami pana karai visuddha dugdha, ya panakaridera janya susvadu.

latin_iast: āra khejura gāchera phala o āṅgura hate tomarā mādaka o uttama khādya grahaṇa kare thāka, ete avaśyai vodhaśakti sampanna sampradāẏera janya raẏeche nidarśana.
latin_ascii: ara khejura gachera phala o angura hate tomara madaka o uttama khadya grahana kare thaka, ete avasyai vodhasakti sampanna sampradayera janya rayeche nidarsana.

latin_iast: tomāra rāvva maumāchira antare iṅgita dvārā nirdeśa diẏechenaḥ tumi gṛha nirmāṇa kara pāhār̤a, vṛkṣa evaṃ mānuṣa ye gṛha nirmāṇa kare tāte.
latin_ascii: tomara ravva maumachira antare ingita dvara nirdesa diyechenah tumi grha nirmana kara pahara, vrksa evam manusa ye grha nirmana kare tate.

latin_iast: era para pratyeka phala hate kichu kichu āhāra kara, ataḥpara tomāra ravera sahaja patha anusaraṇa kara. ora udara hate nirgata haẏa vividha varṇera pānīẏa, yāte mānuṣera janya raẏeche rogera pratiṣedhaka. avaśyai ete raẏeche nidarśana cintāśīla sampradāẏera janya.
latin_ascii: era para pratyeka phala hate kichu kichu ahara kara, atahpara tomara ravera sahaja patha anusarana kara. ora udara hate nirgata haya vividha varnera paniya, yate manusera janya rayeche rogera pratisedhaka. avasyai ete rayeche nidarsana cintasila sampradayera janya.

latin_iast: āllāhai tomāderake sṛṣṭi karechena. ataḥpara tini tomādera mṛtyu ghaṭāvena evaṃ tomādera madhye kehake kehake upanīta karā haẏa jarājīrṇa vaẏase. phale tārā yā kichu jānata se samvandhe tārā sajñāna thākenā; āllāha sarvajña, sarvaśaktimāna.
latin_ascii: allahai tomaderake srsti karechena. atahpara tini tomadera mrtyu ghatavena evam tomadera madhye kehake kehake upanita kara haya jarajirna vayase. phale tara ya kichu janata se samvandhe tara sajnana thakena; allaha sarvajna, sarvasaktimana.

latin_iast: āllāha jīvanopakaraṇe tomādera ekajanake anyajanera upara śreṣṭhatva diẏechena. yāderake śreṣṭhatva deẏā haẏeche tārā tādera adhīnastha dāsa dāsīderake nijedera jīvanopakaraṇa hate emana kichu deẏanā yāte tārā e viṣaẏe samāna haẏe yāẏa; tāhale ki tārā āllāhara anugraha asvīkāra kare?
latin_ascii: allaha jivanopakarane tomadera ekajanake anyajanera upara sresthatva diyechena. yaderake sresthatva deya hayeche tara tadera adhinastha dasa dasiderake nijedera jivanopakarana hate emana kichu deyana yate tara e visaye samana haye yaya; tahale ki tara allahara anugraha asvikara karey

latin_iast: āra āllāha tomādera hatei tomādera jor̤ā sṛṣṭi karechena evaṃ tomādera yugala hate tomādera janya putra-pautrādi sṛṣṭi karechena evaṃ uttama jīvanopakaraṇa dāna karechena. tavuo ki tārā mithyā viṣaẏe viśvāsa karave evaṃ āllāhara anugraha asvīkāra karave?
latin_ascii: ara allaha tomadera hatei tomadera jora srsti karechena evam tomadera yugala hate tomadera janya putra-pautradi srsti karechena evam uttama jivanopakarana dana karechena. tavuo ki tara mithya visaye visvasa karave evam allahara anugraha asvikara karavey

latin_iast: evaṃ tārā ki ivādāta karave āllāha chār̤ā aparera yādera ākāśamanḍalī athavā pṛthivī hate kona jīvanopakaraṇa saravarāha karāra śakti nei? evaṃ tārā kichui karate sakṣama naẏa .
latin_ascii: evam tara ki ivadata karave allaha chara aparera yadera akasamandali athava prthivi hate kona jivanopakarana saravaraha karara sakti neiy evam tara kichui karate saksama naya .

latin_iast: sutarāṃ tomarā āllāhara kona sadṛśa sthira karanā; niścaẏai āllāha jānena evaṃ tomarā jānanā.
latin_ascii: sutaram tomara allahara kona sadrsa sthira karana; niscayai allaha janena evam tomara janana.

latin_iast: āllāha upamā dicchena aparera adhikārabhukta eka dāsera, ye kona kichura upara śakti rākhenā. evaṃ apara eka vyakti yāke tini nija hate uttama riyka dāna karechena evaṃ se tā hate gopane o prakāśye vyaẏa kare; tārā ki ubhaẏe eke aparera samāna? sakala praśaṃsā āllāharai prāpya; athaca tādera adhikāṃśa eṭā jānenā.
latin_ascii: allaha upama dicchena aparera adhikarabhukta eka dasera, ye kona kichura upara sakti rakhena. evam apara eka vyakti yake tini nija hate uttama riyka dana karechena evam se ta hate gopane o prakasye vyaya kare; tara ki ubhaye eke aparera samanay sakala prasamsa allaharai prapya; athaca tadera adhikamsa eta janena.

latin_iast: āllāha ārao upamā dicchena du’ vyaktira. odera ekajana mūka, kona kichurai śakti rākhenā evaṃ se tāra mālikera janya vojhā svarūpa. tāke yekhānei pāṭhāno hoka nā kena se bhāla kichui kare āsate pārenā; se ki ai vyaktira mata samāna have ye nyāẏera nirdeśa deẏa evaṃ ye āche sarala pathe?
latin_ascii: allaha arao upama dicchena du’ vyaktira. odera ekajana muka, kona kichurai sakti rakhena evam se tara malikera janya vojha svarupa. take yekhanei pathano hoka na kena se bhala kichui kare asate parena; se ki ai vyaktira mata samana have ye nyayera nirdesa deya evam ye ache sarala pathey

latin_iast: ākāśamanḍalī o pṛthivīra adṛśya viṣaẏera jñāna āllāharai evaṃ kiẏāmātera vyāpārato cokhera palakera nyāẏa, varaṃ ora ceẏeo sattvara; āllāha sarva viṣaẏe sarvaśaktimāna.
latin_ascii: akasamandali o prthivira adrsya visayera jnana allaharai evam kiyamatera vyaparato cokhera palakera nyaya, varam ora ceyeo sattvara; allaha sarva visaye sarvasaktimana.

latin_iast: āra āllāha tomāderake nirgata karechena tomādera mātṛgarbha hate emana avasthāẏa ye, tomarā kichui jānatenā, evaṃ tini tomāderake diẏechena śravaṇaśakti, dṛṣṭiśakti evaṃ hṛdaẏa, yāte tomarā kṛtajñatā prakāśa kara.
latin_ascii: ara allaha tomaderake nirgata karechena tomadera matrgarbha hate emana avasthaya ye, tomara kichui janatena, evam tini tomaderake diyechena sravanasakti, drstisakti evam hrdaya, yate tomara krtajnata prakasa kara.

latin_iast: tārā ki lakṣya karenā ākāśera śūnya garbhe niẏantraṇādhīna vihaṃgera prati? āllāhai oderake sthira rākhena; avaśyai ete nidarśana raẏeche mu’mina sampradāẏera janya.
latin_ascii: tara ki laksya karena akasera sunya garbhe niyantranadhina vihamgera pratiy allahai oderake sthira rakhena; avasyai ete nidarsana rayeche mu’mina sampradayera janya.

latin_iast: evaṃ āllāha tomādera gṛhake karena tomādera āvāsasthala, āra tini tomādera janya paśucarmera tāvura vyavasthā karena; oṭā vahanakāle (tomādera bhramaṇakāle) evaṃ ote avasthānakāle tomarā tā sahaje vahana karate pāra. tini tomādera janya vyavasthā karena odera paśama, loma o keśa hate kichu kālera janya gṛha sāmagrī o vyavahāra upakaraṇa.
latin_ascii: evam allaha tomadera grhake karena tomadera avasasthala, ara tini tomadera janya pasucarmera tavura vyavastha karena; ota vahanakale (tomadera bhramanakale) evam ote avasthanakale tomara ta sahaje vahana karate para. tini tomadera janya vyavastha karena odera pasama, loma o kesa hate kichu kalera janya grha samagri o vyavahara upakarana.

latin_iast: āra āllāha yā kichu sṛṣṭi karechena tāte tomādera janya chāẏāra vyavasthā karena evaṃ tini tomādera janya pāhār̤e āśraẏera vyavasthā karena evaṃ tomādera janya vyavasthā karena paridheẏa vastrera; oṭā tomāderake tāpa hate rakṣā kare evaṃ tini vyavasthā karena tomādera janya varmera, oṭā tomāderake yuddhe rakṣā kare; ebhāve tini tomādera prati tā~ra anugraha pūrṇa karena yāte tomarā ātmasamarpaṇa kara.
latin_ascii: ara allaha ya kichu srsti karechena tate tomadera janya chayara vyavastha karena evam tini tomadera janya pahare asrayera vyavastha karena evam tomadera janya vyavastha karena paridheya vastrera; ota tomaderake tapa hate raksa kare evam tini vyavastha karena tomadera janya varmera, ota tomaderake yuddhe raksa kare; ebhave tini tomadera prati ta~ra anugraha purna karena yate tomara atmasamarpana kara.

latin_iast: ataḥpara tārā yadi mukha phiriẏe neẏa tāhale tomāra kartavyato śudhu spaṣṭabhāve vāṇī pau~che deẏā.
latin_ascii: atahpara tara yadi mukha phiriye neya tahale tomara kartavyato sudhu spastabhave vani pau~che deya.

latin_iast: tārā āllāhara anugraha jñāta āche; kintu seguli tārā asvīkāra kare evaṃ tādera adhikāṃśai kāphira.
latin_ascii: tara allahara anugraha jnata ache; kintu seguli tara asvikara kare evam tadera adhikamsai kaphira.

latin_iast: yedina āmi pratyeka sampradāẏa hate eka ekajana sākṣī utthita karava sedina kāphiraderake anumati deẏā havenā evaṃ tāderake (āllāhara) santuṣṭi lābhera suyoga deẏā havenā.
latin_ascii: yedina ami pratyeka sampradaya hate eka ekajana saksi utthita karava sedina kaphiraderake anumati deya havena evam taderake (allahara) santusti labhera suyoga deya havena.

latin_iast: yakhana yālimarā śāsti pratyakṣa karave takhana tādera śāsti laghu karā havenā evaṃ tāderake kona virāma deẏā havenā.
latin_ascii: yakhana yalimara sasti pratyaksa karave takhana tadera sasti laghu kara havena evam taderake kona virama deya havena.

latin_iast: muśarikarā yāderake (āllāhara) śarīka karechila tāderake dekhe valaveḥ he āmādera rāvva! erāi tārā yāderake āmarā āpanāra śarīka karechilāma, yāderake āmarā āhavāna karatāma āpanāra parivarte; ataḥpara taduttare tārā valaveḥ tomarā avaśyai mithyāvādī.
latin_ascii: musarikara yaderake (allahara) sarika karechila taderake dekhe valaveh he amadera ravva! erai tara yaderake amara apanara sarika karechilama, yaderake amara ahavana karatama apanara parivarte; atahpara taduttare tara valaveh tomara avasyai mithyavadi.

latin_iast: sedina tārā āllāhara kāche ātmasamarpaṇa karave evaṃ tārā ye mithyā udbhāvana karata tā tādera janya niṣphala have.
latin_ascii: sedina tara allahara kache atmasamarpana karave evam tara ye mithya udbhavana karata ta tadera janya nisphala have.

latin_iast: yārā kupharī kareche o āllāhara patha hate vādhā diẏeche, āmi tādera śāstira upara śāsti vṛddhi karava.
latin_ascii: yara kuphari kareche o allahara patha hate vadha diyeche, ami tadera sastira upara sasti vrddhi karava.

latin_iast: sedina āmi utthita karava pratyeka sampradāẏa hate tādera viṣaẏe eka ekajana sākṣī evaṃ tomāke āmi ānava sākṣī rūpe edera viṣaẏe; āmi ātmasamarpaṇakārīdera (musalima) janya pratyeka viṣaẏe spaṣṭa vyākhyāsvarūpa, patha nirdeśa, daẏā o susaṃvāda svarūpa tomāra prati kitāva avatīrṇa karechi.
latin_ascii: sedina ami utthita karava pratyeka sampradaya hate tadera visaye eka ekajana saksi evam tomake ami anava saksi rupe edera visaye; ami atmasamarpanakaridera (musalima) janya pratyeka visaye spasta vyakhyasvarupa, patha nirdesa, daya o susamvada svarupa tomara prati kitava avatirna karechi.

latin_iast: niścaẏai āllāha nyāẏa parāẏaṇatā, sadācaraṇa o ātmīẏa svajanake dānera nirdeśa dena evaṃ tini niṣedha karena aślīlatā, asat kāja o sīmā laṃghana karate. tini tomāderake upadeśa dena yāte tomarā śikṣā grahaṇa kara.
latin_ascii: niscayai allaha nyaya parayanata, sadacarana o atmiya svajanake danera nirdesa dena evam tini nisedha karena aslilata, asat kaja o sima lamghana karate. tini tomaderake upadesa dena yate tomara siksa grahana kara.

latin_iast: tomarā āllāhara aṅgīkāra pūrṇa kara yakhana paraspara aṅgīkāra kara evaṃ tomarā śapatha dṛr̤ha karāra para tā bhaṅga karanā; tomarā yā kara āllāha tā jānena.
latin_ascii: tomara allahara angikara purna kara yakhana paraspara angikara kara evam tomara sapatha drrha karara para ta bhanga karana; tomara ya kara allaha ta janena.

latin_iast: tomarā sei nārīra mata haẏonā, ye tāra sūtā māyavūta kare pākānora para ora pāka khule naṣṭa kare deẏa. tomādera śapatha tomarā parasparake pravañcanā karāra janya vyavahāra kare thāko, yāte ekadala anyadala apekṣā adhika lābhavāna hao; āllāhato eṭā dvārā śudhu tomāderake parīkṣā karena; tomādera ye viṣaẏe matabheda raẏeche, kiẏāmāta divase tini tā niścaẏai spaṣṭabhāve prakāśa kare divena.
latin_ascii: tomara sei narira mata hayona, ye tara suta mayavuta kare pakanora para ora paka khule nasta kare deya. tomadera sapatha tomara parasparake pravancana karara janya vyavahara kare thako, yate ekadala anyadala apeksa adhika labhavana hao; allahato eta dvara sudhu tomaderake pariksa karena; tomadera ye visaye matabheda rayeche, kiyamata divase tini ta niscayai spastabhave prakasa kare divena.

latin_iast: yadi āllāha icchā karatena tāhale tomāderake eka jāti karate pāratena, kintu tini yāke icchā vibhrānta karena evaṃ yāke icchā sat pathe paricālita karena; tomarā yā kara se viṣaẏe avaśyai tomāderake praśna karā have.
latin_ascii: yadi allaha iccha karatena tahale tomaderake eka jati karate paratena, kintu tini yake iccha vibhranta karena evam yake iccha sat pathe paricalita karena; tomara ya kara se visaye avasyai tomaderake prasna kara have.

latin_iast: paraspara pravañcanā karāra janya tomarā tomādera śapathake vyavahāra karanā; tāhale pā sthira haoẏāra para pichale yāve evaṃ āllāhara pathe vādhā deẏāra kāraṇe tomarā śāstira āsvāda grahaṇa karave. tomādera janya raẏeche kaṭhora śāsti.
latin_ascii: paraspara pravancana karara janya tomara tomadera sapathake vyavahara karana; tahale pa sthira haoyara para pichale yave evam allahara pathe vadha deyara karane tomara sastira asvada grahana karave. tomadera janya rayeche kathora sasti.

latin_iast: tomarā āllāhara saṅge kṛta aṃgīkāra tuccha mūlye vikri karanā; āllāhara kāche yā āche śudhu tā’i tomādera janya uttama, yadi tomarā jānate.
latin_ascii: tomara allahara sange krta amgikara tuccha mulye vikri karana; allahara kache ya ache sudhu ta’i tomadera janya uttama, yadi tomara janate.

latin_iast: tomādera kāche yā āche tā niḥśeṣa have evaṃ āllāhara kāche yā āche tā sthāẏī; yārā dhairya dhāraṇa kare āmi niścaẏai tāderake tārā ye uttama kāja kare tā apekṣā śreṣṭha puraskāra dāna karava.
latin_ascii: tomadera kache ya ache ta nihsesa have evam allahara kache ya ache ta sthayi; yara dhairya dharana kare ami niscayai taderake tara ye uttama kaja kare ta apeksa srestha puraskara dana karava.

latin_iast: mu’mina puruṣa o nārīra madhye ye keha satkāja karave tāke āmi niścaẏai ānandamaẏa jīvana dāna karava evaṃ tāderake tādera karmera śreṣṭha puraskāra pradāna karava.
latin_ascii: mu’mina purusa o narira madhye ye keha satkaja karave take ami niscayai anandamaya jivana dana karava evam taderake tadera karmera srestha puraskara pradana karava.

latin_iast: yakhana tumi kuraāna pāṭha karave takhana abhiśapta śāitāna hate āllāhara āśraẏa grahaṇa karave.
latin_ascii: yakhana tumi kuraana patha karave takhana abhisapta saitana hate allahara asraya grahana karave.

latin_iast: tāra kona ādhipatya nei tādera upara yārā īmāna āne o tādera ravera uparai nirbhara kare.
latin_ascii: tara kona adhipatya nei tadera upara yara imana ane o tadera ravera uparai nirbhara kare.

latin_iast: tāra ādhipatya śudhu tāderai upara yārā tāke abhibhāvaka rūpe grahaṇa kare evaṃ yārā (āllāhara) sāthe śarīka kare.
latin_ascii: tara adhipatya sudhu taderai upara yara take abhibhavaka rupe grahana kare evam yara (allahara) sathe sarika kare.

latin_iast: āmi yakhana eka āẏātera parivarte anya eka āẏāta upasthita kari, āra āllāha yā avatīrṇa karena tā tinii bhāla jānena, takhana tārā valeḥ tumito śudhu mithyā udbhāvanakārī, kintu tādera adhikāṃśai jānenā.
latin_ascii: ami yakhana eka ayatera parivarte anya eka ayata upasthita kari, ara allaha ya avatirna karena ta tinii bhala janena, takhana tara valeh tumito sudhu mithya udbhavanakari, kintu tadera adhikamsai janena.

latin_iast: tumi valaḥ tomāra ravera nikaṭa hate rūhula kudusa (jivarāīla) satyasaha kuraāna avatīrṇa karechena yārā mu’mina tāderake dṛr̤ha pratiṣṭhita karāra janya evaṃ hidāẏāta o susaṃvāda svarūpa ātmasamarpanakārīdera janya.
latin_ascii: tumi valah tomara ravera nikata hate ruhula kudusa (jivaraila) satyasaha kuraana avatirna karechena yara mu’mina taderake drrha pratisthita karara janya evam hidayata o susamvada svarupa atmasamarpanakaridera janya.

latin_iast: āmito jānii tārā valeḥ tāke śikṣā deẏa janaika vyakti. tārā yāra prati eṭā āropa kare tāra bhāṣāto ārāvī naẏa; kintu kuraānera bhāṣā spaṣṭa ārāvī bhāṣā.
latin_ascii: amito janii tara valeh take siksa deya janaika vyakti. tara yara prati eta aropa kare tara bhasato aravi naya; kintu kuraanera bhasa spasta aravi bhasa.

latin_iast: yārā āllāhara āẏāta viśvāsa karenā tāderake āllāha hidāẏāta karenanā evaṃ tādera janya raẏeche vedanādāẏaka śāsti.
latin_ascii: yara allahara ayata visvasa karena taderake allaha hidayata karenana evam tadera janya rayeche vedanadayaka sasti.

latin_iast: yārā āllāhara nidarśane viśvāsa karenā tārāto śudhu mithyā udbhāvaka evaṃ tārāi mithyāvādī.
latin_ascii: yara allahara nidarsane visvasa karena tarato sudhu mithya udbhavaka evam tarai mithyavadi.

latin_iast: keha īmāna ānāra para āllāhake asvīkāra karale evaṃ kupharīra janya hṛdaẏa unmukta rākhale tāra upara āpatita have āllāhara gayava evaṃ tāra janya āche mahā śāsti; tave tāra janya naẏa, yāke kupharīra janya vādhya karā haẏa, kintu tāra citta īmāne avicala.
latin_ascii: keha imana anara para allahake asvikara karale evam kupharira janya hrdaya unmukta rakhale tara upara apatita have allahara gayava evam tara janya ache maha sasti; tave tara janya naya, yake kupharira janya vadhya kara haya, kintu tara citta imane avicala.

latin_iast: eṭā e janya ye, tārā duniẏāra jīvanake ākhirātera upara prādhānya deẏa evaṃ e janya ye, āllāha kāphira sampradāẏake hidāẏāta karenanā.
latin_ascii: eta e janya ye, tara duniyara jivanake akhiratera upara pradhanya deya evam e janya ye, allaha kaphira sampradayake hidayata karenana.

latin_iast: orāi tārā, āllāha yādera antara, karṇa o cakṣura upara mohara kare diẏechena evaṃ tārāi gāphila.
latin_ascii: orai tara, allaha yadera antara, karna o caksura upara mohara kare diyechena evam tarai gaphila.

latin_iast: niścaẏai tārā ākhirāte have kṣatigrasta.
latin_ascii: niscayai tara akhirate have ksatigrasta.

latin_iast: (tomāra ravera pathe theke) yārā niryātita havāra para hijarāta kare evaṃ pare jihāda kare evaṃ dhairya dhāraṇa kare; tomāra rāvva esava kichura para, tādera prati avaśyai kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.
latin_ascii: (tomara ravera pathe theke) yara niryatita havara para hijarata kare evam pare jihada kare evam dhairya dharana kare; tomara ravva esava kichura para, tadera prati avasyai ksamasila, parama dayalu.

latin_iast: smaraṇa kara sei dinake yedina ātmapakṣa samarthane yukti upasthita karate āsave pratyeka vyakti evaṃ pratyekake tāra kṛtakarmera pūrṇa phala deẏā have evaṃ tādera prati yulama karā havenā.
latin_ascii: smarana kara sei dinake yedina atmapaksa samarthane yukti upasthita karate asave pratyeka vyakti evam pratyekake tara krtakarmera purna phala deya have evam tadera prati yulama kara havena.

latin_iast: āllāha dṛṣṭānta dicchena eka janapadera yā chila nirāpada o niścinta, yekhāne āsata sava dika hate pracura jīvanopakaraṇa; ataḥpara orā āllāhara anugraha asvīkāra karala. phale tādera kṛtakarmera kāraṇe āllāha tāderake āsvāda grahaṇa karālena kṣudhā o bhītira.
latin_ascii: allaha drstanta dicchena eka janapadera ya chila nirapada o niscinta, yekhane asata sava dika hate pracura jivanopakarana; atahpara ora allahara anugraha asvikara karala. phale tadera krtakarmera karane allaha taderake asvada grahana karalena ksudha o bhitira.

latin_iast: tādera nikaṭa esechila eka rāsūla tāderai madhya hate, kintu tārā tāke asvīkāra karechila; phale sīmā laṃghana karā avasthāẏa śāsti tāderake grāsa karala.
latin_ascii: tadera nikata esechila eka rasula taderai madhya hate, kintu tara take asvikara karechila; phale sima lamghana kara avasthaya sasti taderake grasa karala.

latin_iast: āllāha tomāderake yā diẏechena tammadhye yā vaidha o pavitra tā tomarā āhāra kara evaṃ tomarā yadi śudhu āllāharai ivādāta kara tāhale tā~ra anugrahera janya kṛtajñatā prakāśa kara.
latin_ascii: allaha tomaderake ya diyechena tammadhye ya vaidha o pavitra ta tomara ahara kara evam tomara yadi sudhu allaharai ivadata kara tahale ta~ra anugrahera janya krtajnata prakasa kara.

latin_iast: tini (āllāha) śudhumātra mṛta, rakta, śūkarera māṃsa evaṃ yā yavāhakāle āllāhara parivarte anyera nāma neẏā haẏeche tā’i tomādera janya avaidha karechena, kintu keha ananyopāẏa kiṃvā sīmā laṃghanakārī nā haẏe ananyopāẏī hale āllāhato kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.
latin_ascii: tini (allaha) sudhumatra mrta, rakta, sukarera mamsa evam ya yavahakale allahara parivarte anyera nama neya hayeche ta’i tomadera janya avaidha karechena, kintu keha ananyopaya kimva sima lamghanakari na haye ananyopayi hale allahato ksamasila, parama dayalu.

latin_iast: tomādera jihavā theke sādhāraṇataḥ ye sava mithyā kathā vera haẏe āse serūpa tomarā āllāhara viruddhe mithyā apavāda āropa kare valanā - eṭā hālāla evaṃ oṭā hārāma. yārā āllāha samvandhe mithyā udbhāvana karave tārā saphalakāma havenā.
latin_ascii: tomadera jihava theke sadharanatah ye sava mithya katha vera haye ase serupa tomara allahara viruddhe mithya apavada aropa kare valana - eta halala evam ota harama. yara allaha samvandhe mithya udbhavana karave tara saphalakama havena.

latin_iast: tādera sukha sambhoga sāmānya evaṃ tādera janya raẏeche vedanādāẏaka śāsti.
latin_ascii: tadera sukha sambhoga samanya evam tadera janya rayeche vedanadayaka sasti.

latin_iast: iẏāhudīdera janya āmi śudhu tā’i nirdhāraṇa karechilāma yā tomāra nikaṭa āmi pūrve ullekha karechi evaṃ āmi tādera upara kona yulama karini, kintu tārāi yulama karata tādera nijedera prati.
latin_ascii: iyahudidera janya ami sudhu ta’i nirdharana karechilama ya tomara nikata ami purve ullekha karechi evam ami tadera upara kona yulama karini, kintu tarai yulama karata tadera nijedera prati.

latin_iast: yārā ajñatā vaśataḥ khārāpa kāja kare tārā pare tāovāha karale evaṃ nijederake saṃśodhana karale tādera janya tomāra rāvva avaśyai ati kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.
latin_ascii: yara ajnata vasatah kharapa kaja kare tara pare taovaha karale evam nijederake samsodhana karale tadera janya tomara ravva avasyai ati ksamasila, parama dayalu.

latin_iast: niścaẏai ivarāhīma chila eka ummāta āllāhara anugata, ekaniṣṭha evaṃ se chilanā muśarikadera antarbhukta.
latin_ascii: niscayai ivarahima chila eka ummata allahara anugata, ekanistha evam se chilana musarikadera antarbhukta.

latin_iast: se chila āllāhara anugrahera janya kṛtajña; āllāha tāke manonīta karechilena evaṃ tāke paricālita karechilena sarala pathe.
latin_ascii: se chila allahara anugrahera janya krtajna; allaha take manonita karechilena evam take paricalita karechilena sarala pathe.

latin_iast: āmi tāke duniẏāẏa diẏechilāma maṅgala evaṃ ākhirāteo niścaẏai se satkarmaparāẏaṇadera anyatama.
latin_ascii: ami take duniyaya diyechilama mangala evam akhirateo niscayai se satkarmaparayanadera anyatama.

latin_iast: ekhana āmi tomāra prati pratyādeśa karalāma, tumi ekaniṣṭha ivarāhīmera dharmādarśa anusaraṇa kara; evaṃ se muśarikadera antarbhukta chilanā.
latin_ascii: ekhana ami tomara prati pratyadesa karalama, tumi ekanistha ivarahimera dharmadarsa anusarana kara; evam se musarikadera antarbhukta chilana.

latin_iast: śanivāra pālanato śudhu tādera janya vādhyatāmūlaka karā haẏechila yārā e samvandhe matabheda karata. ye viṣaẏe tārā matabheda karata tomāra rāvva avaśyai kiẏāmāta divase sei viṣaẏe tādera mīmāṃsā kare divena.
latin_ascii: sanivara palanato sudhu tadera janya vadhyatamulaka kara hayechila yara e samvandhe matabheda karata. ye visaye tara matabheda karata tomara ravva avasyai kiyamata divase sei visaye tadera mimamsa kare divena.

latin_iast: tumi mānuṣake tomāra ravera pathe āhavāna kara hikamāta o sadupadeśa dvārā evaṃ tādera sāthe ālocanā kara sundarabhāve. tomāra rāvva bhāla karei jānena ke tā~ra patha cher̤e vipathagāmī evaṃ ke sat pathe āche.
latin_ascii: tumi manusake tomara ravera pathe ahavana kara hikamata o sadupadesa dvara evam tadera sathe alocana kara sundarabhave. tomara ravva bhala karei janena ke ta~ra patha chere vipathagami evam ke sat pathe ache.

latin_iast: yadi tomarā pratiśodha grahaṇa kara tāhale ṭhika tatakhāni karave yatakhāni anyāẏa tomādera prati karā haẏeche; tave tomarā dhairya dhāraṇa karale dhairyaśīladera janya oṭāi uttama.
latin_ascii: yadi tomara pratisodha grahana kara tahale thika tatakhani karave yatakhani anyaya tomadera prati kara hayeche; tave tomara dhairya dharana karale dhairyasiladera janya otai uttama.

latin_iast: tumi dhairya dhāraṇa kara; tomāra dhairya have āllāharai sāhāyye; tādera janya duḥkha karanā evaṃ tādera ṣar̤ayantre tumi manaḥkṣunna haẏonā.
latin_ascii: tumi dhairya dharana kara; tomara dhairya have allaharai sahayye; tadera janya duhkha karana evam tadera sarayantre tumi manahksunna hayona.

latin_iast: niścaẏai āllāha tāderai saṅge āchena yārā tākaoẏā avalamvana kare evaṃ yārā sat karmaparāẏaṇa.
latin_ascii: niscayai allaha taderai sange achena yara takaoya avalamvana kare evam yara sat karmaparayana.

latin_iast: pavitra o mahimāmaẏa tini yini tā~ra vāndāke rāte bhramaṇa kariẏechilena māsajidula hārāma hate māsajidula ākasāẏa, yāra pariveśa āmi karechilāma vārākātamaẏa, tāke āmāra nidarśana dekhānora janya; tinii sarvaśrotā, sarvadraṣṭā.
latin_ascii: pavitra o mahimamaya tini yini ta~ra vandake rate bhramana kariyechilena masajidula harama hate masajidula akasaya, yara parivesa ami karechilama varakatamaya, take amara nidarsana dekhanora janya; tinii sarvasrota, sarvadrasta.

latin_iast: āmi mūsāke kitāva diẏechilāma evaṃ tāke karechilāma vānī isarāīlera janya patha nirdeśaka. āmi ādeśa karechilāma, tomarā āmi vyatīta apara kehakeo karma vidhāẏakarūpe grahaṇa karanā.
latin_ascii: ami musake kitava diyechilama evam take karechilama vani isarailera janya patha nirdesaka. ami adesa karechilama, tomara ami vyatita apara kehakeo karma vidhayakarupe grahana karana.

latin_iast: tomarāito tādera vaṃśadhara yāderake āmi nūhera sāthe naukāẏa ārohaṇa kariẏechilāma, se chila parama kṛtajña dāsa.
latin_ascii: tomaraito tadera vamsadhara yaderake ami nuhera sathe naukaya arohana kariyechilama, se chila parama krtajna dasa.

latin_iast: evaṃ āmi kitāve (tāorāte) pratyādeśa dvārā vānī isarāīlake jāniẏechilāma, niścaẏai tomarā pṛthivīte du’vāra viparyaẏa sṛṣṭi karave evaṃ tomarā atiśaẏa uddhatyakārī have.
latin_ascii: evam ami kitave (taorate) pratyadesa dvara vani isarailake janiyechilama, niscayai tomara prthivite du’vara viparyaya srsti karave evam tomara atisaya uddhatyakari have.

latin_iast: ataḥpara ei du’era prathamaṭira nirdhārita kāla yakhana upasthita hala takhana āmi tomādera viruddhe preraṇa karechilāma āmāra dāsaderake, yuddhe atiśaẏa śaktiśālī; tārā ghare ghare praveśa kare samasta kichu dhvaṃsa karechila; śāstira pratijñā kāryakarī haẏei thāke.
latin_ascii: atahpara ei du’era prathamatira nirdharita kala yakhana upasthita hala takhana ami tomadera viruddhe prerana karechilama amara dasaderake, yuddhe atisaya saktisali; tara ghare ghare pravesa kare samasta kichu dhvamsa karechila; sastira pratijna karyakari hayei thake.

latin_iast: ataḥpara āmi tomādera punarāẏa tādera upara pratiṣṭhita karalāma, tomāderake dhana-sampada o santāna-santati dvārā sāhāyya karalāma o saṃkhyāgariṣṭha karalāma.
latin_ascii: atahpara ami tomadera punaraya tadera upara pratisthita karalama, tomaderake dhana-sampada o santana-santati dvara sahayya karalama o samkhyagaristha karalama.

latin_iast: tomarā sat kāja karale tā nijederai janya karave evaṃ manda kāja karale tāo karave nijedera janya; ataḥpara paravartī nirdhārita samaẏa upasthita hale āmi āmāra dāsaderake preraṇa karalāma tomādera mukhamanḍala kālimācchanna karāra janya, prathamavāra tārā yebhāve māsajide praveśa karechila punarāẏa sebhāvei tāte praveśa karāra janya evaṃ tārā yā adhikāra karechila tā sampūrṇa rūpe dhvaṃsa karāra janya.
latin_ascii: tomara sat kaja karale ta nijederai janya karave evam manda kaja karale tao karave nijedera janya; atahpara paravarti nirdharita samaya upasthita hale ami amara dasaderake prerana karalama tomadera mukhamandala kalimacchanna karara janya, prathamavara tara yebhave masajide pravesa karechila punaraya sebhavei tate pravesa karara janya evam tara ya adhikara karechila ta sampurna rupe dhvamsa karara janya.

latin_iast: sambhavataḥ tomādera rāvva tomādera prati daẏā karavena. kintu tomarā yadi tomādera pūrva ācaraṇera punarāvṛtti kara tāhale tinio tā~ra ācaraṇera punarāvṛtti karavena; jāhānnāmake āmi karechi satya pratyākhyānakārīdera janya kārāgāra.
latin_ascii: sambhavatah tomadera ravva tomadera prati daya karavena. kintu tomara yadi tomadera purva acaranera punaravrtti kara tahale tinio ta~ra acaranera punaravrtti karavena; jahannamake ami karechi satya pratyakhyanakaridera janya karagara.

latin_iast: ei kuraāna sarvaśreṣṭha patha nirdeśa kare evaṃ sat karmaparāẏaṇa viśvāsīderake susaṃvāda deẏa ye, tādera janya raẏeche mahā puraskāra.
latin_ascii: ei kuraana sarvasrestha patha nirdesa kare evam sat karmaparayana visvasiderake susamvada deya ye, tadera janya rayeche maha puraskara.

latin_iast: āra yārā parakāla viśvāsa karenā tādera janya āmi prastuta kare rekhechi marmantuda śāsti.
latin_ascii: ara yara parakala visvasa karena tadera janya ami prastuta kare rekhechi marmantuda sasti.

latin_iast: mānuṣa yebhāve kalyāṇa kāmanā kare sebhāvei akalyāṇa kāmanā kare. mānuṣato ati tvarāpravaṇa.
latin_ascii: manusa yebhave kalyana kamana kare sebhavei akalyana kamana kare. manusato ati tvarapravana.

latin_iast: āmi rāta o dinake karechi du’ṭi nidarśana; rātake karechi nirāloka evaṃ dinake karechi ālokamaẏa, yāte tomarā tomādera ravera anugraha sandhāna karate pāra evaṃ yāte tomarā varṣa saṃkhyā o hisāva sthira karate pāra; evaṃ āmi sava kichu viśadabhāve varṇanā karechi.
latin_ascii: ami rata o dinake karechi du’ti nidarsana; ratake karechi niraloka evam dinake karechi alokamaya, yate tomara tomadera ravera anugraha sandhana karate para evam yate tomara varsa samkhya o hisava sthira karate para; evam ami sava kichu visadabhave varnana karechi.

latin_iast: pratyeka mānuṣera kṛtakarma āmi tāra grīvālagna karechi evaṃ kiẏāmāta divase āmi tāra janya vera karava eka kitāva, yā se pāve unmukta.
latin_ascii: pratyeka manusera krtakarma ami tara grivalagna karechi evam kiyamata divase ami tara janya vera karava eka kitava, ya se pave unmukta.

latin_iast: (āmi valava) tumi tomāra kitāva pāṭha kara; āja tumi nijei tomāra hisāva nikāśera janya yatheṣṭa.
latin_ascii: (ami valava) tumi tomara kitava patha kara; aja tumi nijei tomara hisava nikasera janya yathesta.

latin_iast: yārā sat patha avalamvana karave tārāto nijederai maṅgalera janya tā avalamvana karave evaṃ yārā pathabhraṣṭa have tārāto pathabhraṣṭa have nijederai dhvaṃsera janya evaṃ keha anya kārao bhāra vahana karavenā; āmi rāsūla nā pāṭhāno paryanta kehakeo śāsti diinā.
latin_ascii: yara sat patha avalamvana karave tarato nijederai mangalera janya ta avalamvana karave evam yara pathabhrasta have tarato pathabhrasta have nijederai dhvamsera janya evam keha anya karao bhara vahana karavena; ami rasula na pathano paryanta kehakeo sasti diina.

latin_iast: yakhana āmi kona janapada dhvaṃsa karāra icchā kari takhana ora samṛddhaśālī vyaktiderake sat kāja karate ādeśa kari, kintu tārā sekhāne asat kāja kare. ataḥpara ora prati danḍājñā nyāẏa saṅgata haẏe yāẏa evaṃ āmi oṭāke sampūrṇa rūpe vidhvasta kari.
latin_ascii: yakhana ami kona janapada dhvamsa karara iccha kari takhana ora samrddhasali vyaktiderake sat kaja karate adesa kari, kintu tara sekhane asat kaja kare. atahpara ora prati dandajna nyaya sangata haye yaya evam ami otake sampurna rupe vidhvasta kari.

latin_iast: nūhera para āmi kata mānavagoṣṭhī dhvaṃsa karechi. tomāra rāvvai tā~ra dāsadera pāpācāraṇera saṃvāda rākhā o paryavekṣaṇera janya yatheṣṭa.
latin_ascii: nuhera para ami kata manavagosthi dhvamsa karechi. tomara ravvai ta~ra dasadera papacaranera samvada rakha o paryaveksanera janya yathesta.

latin_iast: keha pārthiva sukha sambhoga kāmanā karale āmi yāke yā icchā sattvara diẏe thāki; pare tāra janya jāhānnāma nirdhārita kari yekhāne se praveśa karave nindita o anugraha hate vañcita avasthāẏa.
latin_ascii: keha parthiva sukha sambhoga kamana karale ami yake ya iccha sattvara diye thaki; pare tara janya jahannama nirdharita kari yekhane se pravesa karave nindita o anugraha hate vancita avasthaya.

latin_iast: yārā viśvāsī haẏe parakāla kāmanā kare evaṃ ora janya yathāyatha ceṣṭā kare tādera praceṣṭāsamūha āllāhara kāche gṛhīta have.
latin_ascii: yara visvasi haye parakala kamana kare evam ora janya yathayatha cesta kare tadera pracestasamuha allahara kache grhita have.

latin_iast: tomāra rāvva tā~ra dāna dvārā ederake evaṃ oderake sāhāyya karena evaṃ tomāra ravera dāna avārita.
latin_ascii: tomara ravva ta~ra dana dvara ederake evam oderake sahayya karena evam tomara ravera dana avarita.

latin_iast: lakṣya kara, āmi kibhāve tādera eka dalake aparera upara śreṣṭhatva diẏechilāma. parakālato niścaẏai maryādāẏa śreṣṭha o śreẏatve śreṣṭhatara.
latin_ascii: laksya kara, ami kibhave tadera eka dalake aparera upara sresthatva diyechilama. parakalato niscayai maryadaya srestha o sreyatve sresthatara.

latin_iast: āllāhara sāthe apara kona mā‘vūda sthira karanā; tāhale nindita o niḥsahāẏa haẏe par̤ave.
latin_ascii: allahara sathe apara kona ma‘vuda sthira karana; tahale nindita o nihsahaya haye parave.

latin_iast: tomāra rāvva nirdeśa diẏechena ye, tomarā tini chār̤ā anya kārao ivādāta karavenā evaṃ mātā-pitāra prati sadvyavahāra karave; tādera ekajana athavā ubhaẏe tomāra jīvaddaśāẏa vārdhakye upanīta hale tāderake viraktisūcaka kichu valanā evaṃ tāderake bhatrsanā karanā; tādera sāthe kathā vala sammānasūcaka namrabhāve.
latin_ascii: tomara ravva nirdesa diyechena ye, tomara tini chara anya karao ivadata karavena evam mata-pitara prati sadvyavahara karave; tadera ekajana athava ubhaye tomara jivaddasaya vardhakye upanita hale taderake viraktisucaka kichu valana evam taderake bhatrsana karana; tadera sathe katha vala sammanasucaka namrabhave.

latin_iast: anukampāẏa tādera prati vinaẏāvanata thāka evaṃ valaḥ he āmāra rāvva! tā~dera prati daẏā karuna yebhāve śaiśave tā~rā āmāke lālana pālana karechilena.
latin_ascii: anukampaya tadera prati vinayavanata thaka evam valah he amara ravva! ta~dera prati daya karuna yebhave saisave ta~ra amake lalana palana karechilena.

latin_iast: tomādera rāvva tomādera antare yā āche tā bhāla jānena; tomarā yadi sat karmaparāẏaṇa hao tāhale tini tādera (āllāha abhimukhīdera) prati kṣamāśīla.
latin_ascii: tomadera ravva tomadera antare ya ache ta bhala janena; tomara yadi sat karmaparayana hao tahale tini tadera (allaha abhimukhidera) prati ksamasila.

latin_iast: ātmīẏa svajanake dive tāra prāpya evaṃ abhāvagrasta o paryaṭakakeo (musāphirakeo), evaṃ kichutei apavyaẏa karanā.
latin_ascii: atmiya svajanake dive tara prapya evam abhavagrasta o paryatakakeo (musaphirakeo), evam kichutei apavyaya karana.

latin_iast: niścaẏai yārā apavyaẏa kare tārā śāitānera bhāi evaṃ śāitāna tāra ravera prati atiśaẏa akṛtajña.
latin_ascii: niscayai yara apavyaya kare tara saitanera bhai evam saitana tara ravera prati atisaya akrtajna.

latin_iast: āra tumi yadi tādera theke mukha phiriẏe nāo evaṃ tumi tomāra ravera nikaṭa hate anukampā lābhera pratyāśāẏa o sandhāne thāka tāhale tādera sāthe namrabhāve kathā vala.
latin_ascii: ara tumi yadi tadera theke mukha phiriye nao evam tumi tomara ravera nikata hate anukampa labhera pratyasaya o sandhane thaka tahale tadera sathe namrabhave katha vala.

latin_iast: tumi vaddhamuṣṭi haẏonā evaṃ ekevāre mukta hastao haẏonā; tāhale tumi nindita o niḥsva have.
latin_ascii: tumi vaddhamusti hayona evam ekevare mukta hastao hayona; tahale tumi nindita o nihsva have.

latin_iast: tomāra rāvva yāra janya icchā tāra jīvanopakaraṇa vardhita karena evaṃ yāra janya icchā tā hrāsa karena; tini tā~ra dāsaderake bhālabhāve jānena o dekhena.
latin_ascii: tomara ravva yara janya iccha tara jivanopakarana vardhita karena evam yara janya iccha ta hrasa karena; tini ta~ra dasaderake bhalabhave janena o dekhena.

latin_iast: tomādera santānaderake tomarā dāridratāra bhaẏe hatyā karanā, tāderake evaṃ tomāderake āmii jīvanopakaraṇa dii; tāderake hatyā karā mahāpāpa.
latin_ascii: tomadera santanaderake tomara daridratara bhaye hatya karana, taderake evam tomaderake amii jivanopakarana dii; taderake hatya kara mahapapa.

latin_iast: tomarā avaidha yauna saṃyogera nikaṭavartī haẏonā, oṭā aślīla o nikṛṣṭa ācaraṇa.
latin_ascii: tomara avaidha yauna samyogera nikatavarti hayona, ota aslila o nikrsta acarana.

latin_iast: āllāha yāra hatyā niṣedha karechena yathārtha kāraṇa chār̤ā tāke hatyā karanā; keha anyāẏabhāve nihata hale tāra uttarādhikārīke āmi pratiśodha grahaṇera adhikāra diẏechi. kintu hatyāra vyāpāre se yena vār̤āvār̤i nā kare; seto sāhāyya prāpta haẏechei.
latin_ascii: allaha yara hatya nisedha karechena yathartha karana chara take hatya karana; keha anyayabhave nihata hale tara uttaradhikarike ami pratisodha grahanera adhikara diyechi. kintu hatyara vyapare se yena varavari na kare; seto sahayya prapta hayechei.

latin_iast: pitṛhīna vaẏaḥprāpta nā haoẏā paryanta saduddeśya chār̤ā tāra sampattira nikaṭavartī haẏonā evaṃ pratiśruti pālana kara; niścaẏai pratiśruti samparke kaiphiẏata talava karā have.
latin_ascii: pitrhina vayahprapta na haoya paryanta saduddesya chara tara sampattira nikatavarti hayona evam pratisruti palana kara; niscayai pratisruti samparke kaiphiyata talava kara have.

latin_iast: mepe deẏāra samaẏa pūrṇa māpe dive evaṃ oyana karave saṭhika dā~r̤i pāllāẏa, eṭāi uttama o pariṇāme utkṛṣṭa.
latin_ascii: mepe deyara samaya purna mape dive evam oyana karave sathika da~ri pallaya, etai uttama o pariname utkrsta.

latin_iast: ye viṣaẏe tomāra kona jñāna nei sei viṣaẏe anumāna dvārā paricālita haẏonā. karṇa, cakṣu, hṛdaẏa - odera pratyekera nikaṭa kaiphiẏata talava karā have.
latin_ascii: ye visaye tomara kona jnana nei sei visaye anumana dvara paricalita hayona. karna, caksu, hrdaya - odera pratyekera nikata kaiphiyata talava kara have.

latin_iast: bhūpṛṣṭhe dambha bhare vicaraṇa karanā, tumito kakhanai padabhare bhū-pṛṣṭha vidīrṇa karate pāravenā evaṃ uccatāẏa tumi kakhanai parvata samāna hate pāravenā.
latin_ascii: bhuprsthe dambha bhare vicarana karana, tumito kakhanai padabhare bhu-prstha vidirna karate paravena evam uccataya tumi kakhanai parvata samana hate paravena.

latin_iast: e savera madhye yeguli manda seguli tomāra ravera nikaṭa ghṛṇya.
latin_ascii: e savera madhye yeguli manda seguli tomara ravera nikata ghrnya.

latin_iast: tomāra rāvva ahīra dvārā tomāke ye hikamāta dāna karechena eguli uhāra antarbhukta; tumi āllāhara sāthe kona ilāha sthira karanā, tāhale tumi nindita o (āllāhara) anugraha hate dūrīkṛta avasthāẏa jāhānnāme nikṣipta have.
latin_ascii: tomara ravva ahira dvara tomake ye hikamata dana karechena eguli uhara antarbhukta; tumi allahara sathe kona ilaha sthira karana, tahale tumi nindita o (allahara) anugraha hate durikrta avasthaya jahanname niksipta have.

latin_iast: tomādera rāvva ki tomādera janya putra santāna nirdhāraṇa karechena evaṃ tini nije (phereśatādera) kanyā rūpe grahaṇa karechena? tomarāto niścaẏai bhaẏānaka kathā vale thāka.
latin_ascii: tomadera ravva ki tomadera janya putra santana nirdharana karechena evam tini nije (pheresatadera) kanya rupe grahana karechenay tomarato niscayai bhayanaka katha vale thaka.

latin_iast: ei kuraāne vahu nītivākya āmi vāravāra vivṛta karechi yāte tārā upadeśa grahaṇa kare; kintu tāte tādera vimukhatāi vṛddhi pāẏa.
latin_ascii: ei kuraane vahu nitivakya ami varavara vivrta karechi yate tara upadesa grahana kare; kintu tate tadera vimukhatai vrddhi paya.

latin_iast: valaḥ tādera kathā mata yadi tā~ra sāthe ārao mā‘vūda thākata tāhale tārā āraśa adhipatira sāthe pratidvandvitā karāra upāẏa anveṣana karata.
latin_ascii: valah tadera katha mata yadi ta~ra sathe arao ma‘vuda thakata tahale tara arasa adhipatira sathe pratidvandvita karara upaya anvesana karata.

latin_iast: tini pavitra, mahimānvita evaṃ tārā yā vale tā hate tini vahu urdhve.
latin_ascii: tini pavitra, mahimanvita evam tara ya vale ta hate tini vahu urdhve.

latin_iast: sapta ākāśa, pṛthivī evaṃ odera arntavartī sava kichu tā~rai pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā kare evaṃ emana kichu nei yā tā~ra sapraśaṃsa pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā karenā. kintu odera pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā tomarā anudhāvana karate pāranā; tini sahanaśīla, kṣamāparāẏaṇa.
latin_ascii: sapta akasa, prthivi evam odera arntavarti sava kichu ta~rai pavitrata o mahima ghosana kare evam emana kichu nei ya ta~ra saprasamsa pavitrata o mahima ghosana karena. kintu odera pavitrata o mahima ghosana tomara anudhavana karate parana; tini sahanasila, ksamaparayana.

latin_iast: tumi yakhana kuraāna pāṭha kara takhana tomāra o yārā paraloke viśvāsa karenā tādera madhye eka pracchanna pardā ṭene dii.
latin_ascii: tumi yakhana kuraana patha kara takhana tomara o yara paraloke visvasa karena tadera madhye eka pracchanna parda tene dii.

latin_iast: āmi tādera antarera upara āvaraṇa diẏechi yena tārā upaladdhi karate nā pāre evaṃ tāderake vadhira karechi. tomāra rāvva eka, eṭā yakhana tumi kuraāna hate āvṛtti kara takhana tārā sare par̤e.
latin_ascii: ami tadera antarera upara avarana diyechi yena tara upaladdhi karate na pare evam taderake vadhira karechi. tomara ravva eka, eta yakhana tumi kuraana hate avrtti kara takhana tara sare pare.

latin_iast: yakhana tārā kāna pete tomāra kathā śune takhana tārā kena tā śune āmi tā bhāla jāni, evaṃ eṭāo jāni ye, gopane ālocanā kāle sīmā laṃghanakārīrā valeḥ tomarāto eka yādugrasta vyaktira anusaraṇa karacha.
latin_ascii: yakhana tara kana pete tomara katha sune takhana tara kena ta sune ami ta bhala jani, evam etao jani ye, gopane alocana kale sima lamghanakarira valeh tomarato eka yadugrasta vyaktira anusarana karacha.

latin_iast: dekha, tārā tomāra ki upamā deẏa! tārā pathabhraṣṭa haẏeche evaṃ tārā sat patha khu~je pāvenā.
latin_ascii: dekha, tara tomara ki upama deya! tara pathabhrasta hayeche evam tara sat patha khu~je pavena.

latin_iast: tārā valeḥ āmarā asthite pariṇata o cūrṇa-vicūrṇa haleo ki natuna sṛṣṭi rūpe punarutthita hava?
latin_ascii: tara valeh amara asthite parinata o curna-vicurna haleo ki natuna srsti rupe punarutthita havay

latin_iast: valaḥ tomarā haẏe yāo pāthara athavā lauha –
latin_ascii: valah tomara haye yao pathara athava lauha –

latin_iast: athavā emana kichu yā tomādera dhāraṇāẏa khuvai kaṭhina. tārā valaveḥ ke āmāderake punarutthita karave? valaḥ tinii yini tomāderake prathama vāra sṛṣṭi karechena; ataḥpara tārā tomāra sāmane māthā nār̤āve evaṃ valaveḥ oṭā kave have? valaḥ have sambhavataḥ śīghrai –
latin_ascii: athava emana kichu ya tomadera dharanaya khuvai kathina. tara valaveh ke amaderake punarutthita karavey valah tinii yini tomaderake prathama vara srsti karechena; atahpara tara tomara samane matha narave evam valaveh ota kave havey valah have sambhavatah sighrai –

latin_iast: yedina tini tomāderake āhavāna karavena evaṃ tomarā praśaṃsāra sāthe tā~ra āhavāne sār̤ā dive evaṃ tomarā mane karave, tomarā alpakālai avasthāna karechile.
latin_ascii: yedina tini tomaderake ahavana karavena evam tomara prasamsara sathe ta~ra ahavane sara dive evam tomara mane karave, tomara alpakalai avasthana karechile.

latin_iast: āmāra vāndāderake yā uttama tā valate vala; śāitāna tādera madhye vibheda sṛṣṭira uskāni deẏa; śāitāna mānuṣera prakāśya śatru.
latin_ascii: amara vandaderake ya uttama ta valate vala; saitana tadera madhye vibheda srstira uskani deya; saitana manusera prakasya satru.

latin_iast: tomādera rāvva tomāderake bhālabhāve jānena; icchā karale tini tomādera prati daẏā karena evaṃ icchā karale tomāderake śāsti dena; āmi tomāke tādera abhibhāvaka kare pāṭhāini.
latin_ascii: tomadera ravva tomaderake bhalabhave janena; iccha karale tini tomadera prati daya karena evam iccha karale tomaderake sasti dena; ami tomake tadera abhibhavaka kare pathaini.

latin_iast: yārā ākāśamanḍalī o pṛthivīte āche tāderake tomāra rāvva bhālabhāve jānena; āmito nāvīdera katakake katakera upara maryādā diẏechi; dāudake āmi yāvura diẏechi.
latin_ascii: yara akasamandali o prthivite ache taderake tomara ravva bhalabhave janena; amito navidera katakake katakera upara maryada diyechi; daudake ami yavura diyechi.

latin_iast: valaḥ tomarā āllāha chār̤ā yāderake mā‘vūda mane kara tāderake āhavāna kara; karale dekhave tomādera duḥkha dainya dūra karāra athavā parivartana karāra śakti tādera nei.
latin_ascii: valah tomara allaha chara yaderake ma‘vuda mane kara taderake ahavana kara; karale dekhave tomadera duhkha dainya dura karara athava parivartana karara sakti tadera nei.

latin_iast: tārā yāderake āhavāna kare tādera madhye yārā nikaṭatara tārāito tādera ravera naikaṭya lābhera upāẏa sandhāna kare ye, ke kata nikaṭatara hate pāre, tā~ra daẏā pratyāśā kare evaṃ tā~ra śāstike bhaẏa kare. niścaẏai tomāra ravera śāsti bhaẏāvaha.
latin_ascii: tara yaderake ahavana kare tadera madhye yara nikatatara taraito tadera ravera naikatya labhera upaya sandhana kare ye, ke kata nikatatara hate pare, ta~ra daya pratyasa kare evam ta~ra sastike bhaya kare. niscayai tomara ravera sasti bhayavaha.

latin_iast: emana kona janapada nei yā āmi kiẏāmāta dinera pūrve dhvaṃsa karavanā athavā kaṭhora śāsti divanā; eṭāto kitāve lipivaddha āche.
latin_ascii: emana kona janapada nei ya ami kiyamata dinera purve dhvamsa karavana athava kathora sasti divana; etato kitave lipivaddha ache.

latin_iast: pūrvavartīgaṇa kartṛka nidarśana asvīkāra karāra kāraṇei āmāke nidarśana preraṇa karā hate virata rākhe; āmi spaṣṭa nidarśana svarūpa sāmūdera nikaṭa uṣṭrī pāṭhiẏechilāma, ataḥpara tārā ora prati yulama karechila; āmi bhaẏa pradarśanera janyai nidarśana preraṇa kari.
latin_ascii: purvavartigana kartrka nidarsana asvikara karara karanei amake nidarsana prerana kara hate virata rakhe; ami spasta nidarsana svarupa samudera nikata ustri pathiyechilama, atahpara tara ora prati yulama karechila; ami bhaya pradarsanera janyai nidarsana prerana kari.

latin_iast: smaraṇa kara, āmi tomāke valechilāma, tomāra rāvva mānuṣake pariveṣṭana kare āchena; āmi ye dṛśya tomāke dekhiẏechi kiṃvā kuraāne ullikhita abhiśapta vṛkṣa śudhu mānuṣera parīkṣāra janya āmi tāderake bhīti pradarśana kari. kintu eṭā tādera tīvra avādhyatāi vṛddhi kare.
latin_ascii: smarana kara, ami tomake valechilama, tomara ravva manusake parivestana kare achena; ami ye drsya tomake dekhiyechi kimva kuraane ullikhita abhisapta vrksa sudhu manusera pariksara janya ami taderake bhiti pradarsana kari. kintu eta tadera tivra avadhyatai vrddhi kare.

latin_iast: smaraṇa kara, yakhana āmi mālāikā/phereśatāderake valalāmaḥ ādamera prati sājadāhavanata hao; takhana ivalīsa chār̤ā savāi sājadāhavanata hala; se valalaḥ āmi ki tāke sājadāha karava yāke āpani māṭi hate sṛṣṭi karechena?
latin_ascii: smarana kara, yakhana ami malaika/pheresataderake valalamah adamera prati sajadahavanata hao; takhana ivalisa chara savai sajadahavanata hala; se valalah ami ki take sajadaha karava yake apani mati hate srsti karechenay

latin_iast: se ārao valalaḥ lakṣya karuna, tāke ye āpani āmāra upara maryādā dāna karalena, kiẏāmātera dina paryanta yadi āmāke avakāśa dena tāhale āmi alpa kaẏekajana chār̤ā tāra vaṃśadharaderake samūle vinaṣṭa karava.
latin_ascii: se arao valalah laksya karuna, take ye apani amara upara maryada dana karalena, kiyamatera dina paryanta yadi amake avakasa dena tahale ami alpa kayekajana chara tara vamsadharaderake samule vinasta karava.

latin_iast: (āllāha) valalenaḥ yā, jāhānnāmai tora evaṃ tādera samyaka śāsti yārā tora anusaraṇa karave.
latin_ascii: (allaha) valalenah ya, jahannamai tora evam tadera samyaka sasti yara tora anusarana karave.

latin_iast: tora āhavāne tādera madhya theke yāke pārisa satyacūta kara, tora aśvārohī o padātika vāhinī dvārā tāderake ākramaṇa kara evaṃ tādera dhana-sampade o santāna-santatite śarīka haẏe yā, evaṃ tāderake pratiśruti de. śāitāna tāderake ye pratiśruti deẏa tā chalanā mātra.
latin_ascii: tora ahavane tadera madhya theke yake parisa satyacuta kara, tora asvarohi o padatika vahini dvara taderake akramana kara evam tadera dhana-sampade o santana-santatite sarika haye ya, evam taderake pratisruti de. saitana taderake ye pratisruti deya ta chalana matra.

latin_iast: niścaẏai āmāra dāsadera upara tora kona kṣamatā nei; karma vidhāẏaka hisāve tora rāvvai yatheṣṭa.
latin_ascii: niscayai amara dasadera upara tora kona ksamata nei; karma vidhayaka hisave tora ravvai yathesta.

latin_iast: tomādera rāvva tinii yini tomādera janya samudre nauyāna paricālita karena yāte tomarā tā~ra anugraha sandhāna karate pāra; tini tomādera prati parama daẏālu.
latin_ascii: tomadera ravva tinii yini tomadera janya samudre nauyana paricalita karena yate tomara ta~ra anugraha sandhana karate para; tini tomadera prati parama dayalu.

latin_iast: samudre yakhana tomāderake vipada sparśa kare takhana śudhu tini chār̤ā apara yāderake tomarā āhavāna kara tārā tomādera mana hate udhāo haẏe yāẏa. ataḥpara tini yakhana sthale bhir̤iẏe tomāderake uddhāra karena takhana tomarā mukha phiriẏe nāo; vastutaḥ mānuṣa var̤ai akṛtajña.
latin_ascii: samudre yakhana tomaderake vipada sparsa kare takhana sudhu tini chara apara yaderake tomara ahavana kara tara tomadera mana hate udhao haye yaya. atahpara tini yakhana sthale bhiriye tomaderake uddhara karena takhana tomara mukha phiriye nao; vastutah manusa varai akrtajna.

latin_iast: tomarā ki niścita ācha ye, tini tomāderake sthale kothāo bhū-garbhastha karavenanā athavā tomādera upara kaṃkara varṣaṇa karavenanā? takhana tomarā tomādera kona karma vidhāẏaka pāvenā.
latin_ascii: tomara ki niscita acha ye, tini tomaderake sthale kothao bhu-garbhastha karavenana athava tomadera upara kamkara varsana karavenanay takhana tomara tomadera kona karma vidhayaka pavena.

latin_iast: athavā tomarā ki niścinta ācha ye, tomāderake āra ekavāra samudre niẏe yāvenanā evaṃ tomādera viruddhe pracanḍa jhaṭikā pāṭhāvenanā evaṃ tomādera satya pratyākhyāna karāra janya tomāderake nimajjita karavenanā? takhana tomarā e viṣaẏe āmāra viruddhe kona sāhāyyakārī pāvenā.
latin_ascii: athava tomara ki niscinta acha ye, tomaderake ara ekavara samudre niye yavenana evam tomadera viruddhe pracanda jhatika pathavenana evam tomadera satya pratyakhyana karara janya tomaderake nimajjita karavenanay takhana tomara e visaye amara viruddhe kona sahayyakari pavena.

latin_iast: āmito ādama-santānake maryādā dāna karechi, sthale o samudre tādera calācalera vāhana diẏechi; āra tāderake uttama jīvanopakaraṇa dāna karechi evaṃ āmi yāderake sṛṣṭi karechi tādera anekera upara tāderake śreṣṭhatva diẏechi.
latin_ascii: amito adama-santanake maryada dana karechi, sthale o samudre tadera calacalera vahana diyechi; ara taderake uttama jivanopakarana dana karechi evam ami yaderake srsti karechi tadera anekera upara taderake sresthatva diyechi.

latin_iast: smaraṇa kara sei dinake yakhana āmi pratyeka sampradāẏake tādera netāsaha āhavāna karava; yāderake ḍāna hāte ‘āmalanāmā deẏā have tārā tādera ‘āmalanāmā pāṭha karave (ānandera sāthe) evaṃ tādera upara sāmānya parimāṇao yulama karā have nā.
latin_ascii: smarana kara sei dinake yakhana ami pratyeka sampradayake tadera netasaha ahavana karava; yaderake dana hate ‘amalanama deya have tara tadera ‘amalanama patha karave (anandera sathe) evam tadera upara samanya parimanao yulama kara have na.

latin_iast: ye ihaloke andha paralokeo se andha evaṃ adhikatara pathabhraṣṭa.
latin_ascii: ye ihaloke andha paralokeo se andha evam adhikatara pathabhrasta.

latin_iast: āmi tomāra prati yā pratyādeśa karechi tā hate tomāra padaskhalana ghaṭānora janya tārā cūr̤ānta ceṣṭā kareche yāte tumi āmāra samvandhe kichu mithyā udbhāvana kara. saphalakāma hale tārā avaśyai tomāke vandhu rūpe grahaṇa karata.
latin_ascii: ami tomara prati ya pratyadesa karechi ta hate tomara padaskhalana ghatanora janya tara curanta cesta kareche yate tumi amara samvandhe kichu mithya udbhavana kara. saphalakama hale tara avasyai tomake vandhu rupe grahana karata.

latin_iast: āmi tomāke avicalita nā rākhale tumi tādera dike prāẏa kichuṭā jhu~kei par̤ate.
latin_ascii: ami tomake avicalita na rakhale tumi tadera dike praya kichuta jhu~kei parate.

latin_iast: tumi jhu~ke par̤ale avaśyai tomāke ihajīvane o parajīvane dviguṇa śāsti āsvādana karātāma; takhana āmāra viruddhe tomāra janya kona sāhāyyakārī petenā.
latin_ascii: tumi jhu~ke parale avasyai tomake ihajivane o parajivane dviguna sasti asvadana karatama; takhana amara viruddhe tomara janya kona sahayyakari petena.

latin_iast: tārā tomāke deśa hate utkhāta karāra cūr̤ānta ceṣṭā karechila tomāke sekhāna hate vahiskāra karāra janya. tāhale tomāra para tārāo sekhāne alpakālai ṭike thākata.
latin_ascii: tara tomake desa hate utkhata karara curanta cesta karechila tomake sekhana hate vahiskara karara janya. tahale tomara para tarao sekhane alpakalai tike thakata.

latin_iast: āmāra rāsūladera madhye tomāra pūrve yāderake āmi pāṭhiẏechilāma tādera kṣetreo chila erūpa niẏama evaṃ tumi āmāra niẏamera kona parivartana dekhate pāvenā.
latin_ascii: amara rasuladera madhye tomara purve yaderake ami pathiyechilama tadera ksetreo chila erupa niyama evam tumi amara niyamera kona parivartana dekhate pavena.

latin_iast: sūrya hele par̤āra para hate rātera ghana andhakāra paryanta sālāta kāẏema karave evaṃ kāẏema karave phājarera kuraāna pāṭhao. kāraṇa bhorera kuraāna pāṭha sākṣī svarūpa.
latin_ascii: surya hele parara para hate ratera ghana andhakara paryanta salata kayema karave evam kayema karave phajarera kuraana pathao. karana bhorera kuraana patha saksi svarupa.

latin_iast: āra rātera kichu aṃśe tāhājjuda kāẏema karave; eṭā tomāra eka atirikta kartavya; āśā karā yāẏa tomāra rāvva tomāke pratiṣṭhita karavena praśaṃsita sthāne.
latin_ascii: ara ratera kichu amse tahajjuda kayema karave; eta tomara eka atirikta kartavya; asa kara yaya tomara ravva tomake pratisthita karavena prasamsita sthane.

latin_iast: valaḥ he āmāra rāvva! yekhāne gamana śubha o santoṣajanaka āpani āmāke sekhāne niẏe yāna evaṃ yekhāna hate nirgamana śubha o santoṣajanaka sekhāna hate āmāke vera kare nina evaṃ āpanāra nikaṭa hate āmāke dāna karuna sāhāyyakārī śakti.
latin_ascii: valah he amara ravva! yekhane gamana subha o santosajanaka apani amake sekhane niye yana evam yekhana hate nirgamana subha o santosajanaka sekhana hate amake vera kare nina evam apanara nikata hate amake dana karuna sahayyakari sakti.

latin_iast: āra valaḥ satya eseche evaṃ mithyā vilupta haẏeche; mithyāto vilupta haẏei thāke.
latin_ascii: ara valah satya eseche evam mithya vilupta hayeche; mithyato vilupta hayei thake.

latin_iast: āmi avatīrṇa karechi kuraāna, yā viśvāsīdera janya sucikitsā o daẏā, kintu tā sīmā laṃghanakārīdera kṣatii vṛddhi kare.
latin_ascii: ami avatirna karechi kuraana, ya visvasidera janya sucikitsa o daya, kintu ta sima lamghanakaridera ksatii vrddhi kare.

latin_iast: yakhana āmi mānuṣera upara anugraha kari takhana se mukha phiriẏe neẏa o ahaṃkāre dūre sare yāẏa evaṃ tāke aniṣṭa sparśa karale se ekevāre hatāśa haẏe par̤e.
latin_ascii: yakhana ami manusera upara anugraha kari takhana se mukha phiriye neya o ahamkare dure sare yaya evam take anista sparsa karale se ekevare hatasa haye pare.

latin_iast: valaḥ pratyeke tāra nija nija rīti anusāre kāja kare. kintu tomāra rāvva bhāla kare jānena, ke sarvāpekṣā nirbhula pathe āche.
latin_ascii: valah pratyeke tara nija nija riti anusare kaja kare. kintu tomara ravva bhala kare janena, ke sarvapeksa nirbhula pathe ache.

latin_iast: tomāke tārā rūh samparke praśna kare, tumi valaḥ rūh āmāra ravera ādeśa ghaṭita; e viṣaẏe tomāderake sāmānya jñānai deẏā haẏeche.
latin_ascii: tomake tara ruh samparke prasna kare, tumi valah ruh amara ravera adesa ghatita; e visaye tomaderake samanya jnanai deya hayeche.

latin_iast: icchā karale āmi tomāra prati yā pratyādeśa karechi tā avaśyai pratyāhāra karate pāratāma; tāhale tumi e viṣaẏe āmāra viruddhe kona karmavidhāẏaka petenā.
latin_ascii: iccha karale ami tomara prati ya pratyadesa karechi ta avasyai pratyahara karate paratama; tahale tumi e visaye amara viruddhe kona karmavidhayaka petena.

latin_iast: eṭā pratyāhāra nā karā tomāra ravera daẏā; tomāra prati āche tā~ra mahā anugraha.
latin_ascii: eta pratyahara na kara tomara ravera daya; tomara prati ache ta~ra maha anugraha.

latin_iast: valaḥ yadi ei kuraānera anurūpa kuraāna racanā karāra janya mānuṣa o jina samaveta haẏa evaṃ tārā parasparake sāhāyya kare tavuo tārā era anurūpa kuraāna racanā karate pāravenā.
latin_ascii: valah yadi ei kuraanera anurupa kuraana racana karara janya manusa o jina samaveta haya evam tara parasparake sahayya kare tavuo tara era anurupa kuraana racana karate paravena.

latin_iast: āmi ei kuraāne mānuṣera janya vibhinna upamā dvārā āmāra vāṇī viśadabhāve varṇanā karechi. kintu adhikāṃśa mānuṣa kupharī karā chār̤ā kṣānta haẏanā.
latin_ascii: ami ei kuraane manusera janya vibhinna upama dvara amara vani visadabhave varnana karechi. kintu adhikamsa manusa kuphari kara chara ksanta hayana.

latin_iast: āra tārā valeḥ kakhanai āmarā tomāte viśvāsa sthāpana karavanā, yatakṣaṇa nā tumi āmādera janya bhūmi hate eka prasravaṇa utsārita karave.
latin_ascii: ara tara valeh kakhanai amara tomate visvasa sthapana karavana, yataksana na tumi amadera janya bhumi hate eka prasravana utsarita karave.

latin_iast: athavā tomāra kharjurera athavā āṅgurera eka vāgāna have yāra phā~ke phā~ke tumi ajasra dhārāẏa pravāhita kare dive nadīnālā.
latin_ascii: athava tomara kharjurera athava angurera eka vagana have yara pha~ke pha~ke tumi ajasra dharaya pravahita kare dive nadinala.

latin_iast: athavā tumi yemana vale thāka, tadanuyāẏī ākāśake khanḍa vikhanḍa kare āmādera upara phelave, athavā āllāha o mālāikāderake āmādera sāmane upasthita karave.
latin_ascii: athava tumi yemana vale thaka, tadanuyayi akasake khanda vikhanda kare amadera upara phelave, athava allaha o malaikaderake amadera samane upasthita karave.

latin_iast: athavā tomāra ekaṭi svarṇa nirmita gṛha have, athavā tumi ākāśe ārohaṇa karave, kintu tomāra ākāśe ārohaṇa āmarā takhanao viśvāsa karavanā yatakṣaṇa nā tumi āmādera prati eka kitāva avatīrṇa karave yā āmarā pāṭha karava. valaḥ pavitra āmāra mahāna rāvva! āmito śudhu ekajana mānuṣa, ekajana rāsūla.
latin_ascii: athava tomara ekati svarna nirmita grha have, athava tumi akase arohana karave, kintu tomara akase arohana amara takhanao visvasa karavana yataksana na tumi amadera prati eka kitava avatirna karave ya amara patha karava. valah pavitra amara mahana ravva! amito sudhu ekajana manusa, ekajana rasula.

latin_iast: ‘āllāha ki mānuṣake rāsūla kare pāṭhiẏechena?’ - tādera ei uktii viśvāsa sthāpana hate lokaderake virata rākhe, yakhana tādera nikaṭa āse patha nirdeśa.
latin_ascii: ‘allaha ki manusake rasula kare pathiyechenay’ - tadera ei uktii visvasa sthapana hate lokaderake virata rakhe, yakhana tadera nikata ase patha nirdesa.

latin_iast: valaḥ mālāikā/phereśatārā yadi niścita haẏe pṛthivīte vicaraṇa karata tāhale āmi ākāśa hate mālāka/phereśatākei tādera nikaṭa rāsūla kare pāṭhātāma.
latin_ascii: valah malaika/pheresatara yadi niscita haye prthivite vicarana karata tahale ami akasa hate malaka/pheresatakei tadera nikata rasula kare pathatama.

latin_iast: valaḥ āmāra o tomādera madhye svākṣī hisāve āllāhai yatheṣṭa; tini tā~ra dāsaderake saviśeṣa jānena o dekhena.
latin_ascii: valah amara o tomadera madhye svaksi hisave allahai yathesta; tini ta~ra dasaderake savisesa janena o dekhena.

latin_iast: āllāha yādera patha pradarśana karena tārāito saṭhika pathaprāpta evaṃ yāderake pathabhraṣṭa karena tādera janya tumi āllāha chār̤ā kona sāhāyyakārī pāvenā. kiẏāmātera dina āmi tāderake samaveta karava tādera mukhe bhara diẏe calā avasthāẏa, andha avasthāẏa, vovā avasthāẏa evaṃ vadhira avasthāẏa. tādera āvāsasthala jāhānnāma! yakhanai tā stimita have āmi takhana tādera janya āguna vṛddhi kare diva.
latin_ascii: allaha yadera patha pradarsana karena taraito sathika pathaprapta evam yaderake pathabhrasta karena tadera janya tumi allaha chara kona sahayyakari pavena. kiyamatera dina ami taderake samaveta karava tadera mukhe bhara diye cala avasthaya, andha avasthaya, vova avasthaya evam vadhira avasthaya. tadera avasasthala jahannama! yakhanai ta stimita have ami takhana tadera janya aguna vrddhi kare diva.

latin_iast: eṭāi tādera pratiphala, kāraṇa tārā āmāra nidarśana asvīkāra karechila o valechilaḥ āmarā asthite pariṇata o cūrṇa vicūrṇa haleo ki natuna sṛṣṭi rūpe punarutthita hava?
latin_ascii: etai tadera pratiphala, karana tara amara nidarsana asvikara karechila o valechilah amara asthite parinata o curna vicurna haleo ki natuna srsti rupe punarutthita havay

latin_iast: tārā ki lakṣya karenā ye, āllāha! yini ākāśamanḍalī o pṛthivī sṛṣṭi karechena tini ogulira anurūpa sṛṣṭi karate kṣamatāvāna? tini tādera janya sthira karechena eka nirdiṣṭa kāla, yāte kona sandeha nei; tathāpi sīmā laṃghanakārīrā pratyākhyāna karā chār̤ā āra savai asvīkāra kare.
latin_ascii: tara ki laksya karena ye, allaha! yini akasamandali o prthivi srsti karechena tini ogulira anurupa srsti karate ksamatavanay tini tadera janya sthira karechena eka nirdista kala, yate kona sandeha nei; tathapi sima lamghanakarira pratyakhyana kara chara ara savai asvikara kare.

latin_iast: valaḥ yadi tomarā āmāra ravera daẏāra bhānḍārera adhikārī hate tavuo ‘vyaẏa haẏe yāve’ ei āśaṃkāẏa tomarā oṭā dhare rākhate, mānuṣato atiśaẏa kṛpaṇa.
latin_ascii: valah yadi tomara amara ravera dayara bhandarera adhikari hate tavuo ‘vyaya haye yave’ ei asamkaya tomara ota dhare rakhate, manusato atisaya krpana.

latin_iast: tumi vānī isarāīlake jijñesa kare dekha, āmi mūsāke naẏaṭi suspaṣṭa nidarśana diẏechilāma; yakhana se tādera nikaṭa esechila takhana phira‘āuna tāke valechilaḥ he mūsā! āmito mane kari tumi yādugrasta.
latin_ascii: tumi vani isarailake jijnesa kare dekha, ami musake nayati suspasta nidarsana diyechilama; yakhana se tadera nikata esechila takhana phira‘auna take valechilah he musa! amito mane kari tumi yadugrasta.

latin_iast: mūsā valechilaḥ tumi avaśyai avagata ācha ye, ei samasta spaṣṭa nidarśana ākāśamanḍalī o pṛthivīra rāvvai avatīrṇa karechena pratyakṣa pramāṇa svarūpa. he phira‘āuna! āmito dekhachi, tumi dhvaṃsa haẏe gecha.
latin_ascii: musa valechilah tumi avasyai avagata acha ye, ei samasta spasta nidarsana akasamandali o prthivira ravvai avatirna karechena pratyaksa pramana svarupa. he phira‘auna! amito dekhachi, tumi dhvamsa haye gecha.

latin_iast: ataḥpara phira‘āuna tāderake deśa hate uccheda karāra saṃkalpa karala; takhana phira‘āuna o tāra saṅgīdera sakalake āmi nimajjita karalāma.
latin_ascii: atahpara phira‘auna taderake desa hate uccheda karara samkalpa karala; takhana phira‘auna o tara sangidera sakalake ami nimajjita karalama.

latin_iast: erapara āmi vānī isarāīlake valalāmaḥ tomarā ei deśe vasavāsa kara evaṃ yakhana kiẏāmātera pratiśruti vāstavāẏita have takhana tomādera sakalake āmi ekatrita kare upasthita karava.
latin_ascii: erapara ami vani isarailake valalamah tomara ei dese vasavasa kara evam yakhana kiyamatera pratisruti vastavayita have takhana tomadera sakalake ami ekatrita kare upasthita karava.

latin_iast: āmi satya satyai kuraāna avatīrṇa karechi evaṃ tā satyasahai avatīrṇa haẏeche; āmito tomāke śudhu susaṃvādadātā o satarkakārī rūpe preraṇa karechi.
latin_ascii: ami satya satyai kuraana avatirna karechi evam ta satyasahai avatirna hayeche; amito tomake sudhu susamvadadata o satarkakari rupe prerana karechi.

latin_iast: āmi kuraāna avatīrṇa karechi khanḍa khanḍabhāve yāte tumi tā mānuṣera kāche pāṭha karate pāra krame krame; evaṃ āmi tā yathāyathabhāve avatīrṇa karechi.
latin_ascii: ami kuraana avatirna karechi khanda khandabhave yate tumi ta manusera kache patha karate para krame krame; evam ami ta yathayathabhave avatirna karechi.

latin_iast: valaḥ tomarā viśvāsa kara athavā nā kara, yāderake era pūrve jñāna dāna karā haẏeche tādera sāmane yakhana āvṛtti karā haẏa takhana tārā vinaẏera sāthe kā~date kā~date bhūmite luṭiẏe par̤e .
latin_ascii: valah tomara visvasa kara athava na kara, yaderake era purve jnana dana kara hayeche tadera samane yakhana avrtti kara haya takhana tara vinayera sathe ka~date ka~date bhumite lutiye pare .

latin_iast: evaṃ valeḥ āmādera rāvva pavitra, mahāna! āmādera ravera pratiśruti kāryakara haẏei thāke. [sājadāha]
latin_ascii: evam valeh amadera ravva pavitra, mahana! amadera ravera pratisruti karyakara hayei thake. [sajadaha]

latin_iast: evaṃ kā~date kā~date tādera mukhamanḍala māṭite luṭiẏe par̤e evaṃ ete tādera vinaẏai vṛddhi pāẏa.[sājadāha]
latin_ascii: evam ka~date ka~date tadera mukhamandala matite lutiye pare evam ete tadera vinayai vrddhi paya.[sajadaha]

latin_iast: valaḥ tomarā ‘āllāha’ nāme āhavāna kara athavā ‘rāhamāna’ nāme āhavāna kara, tomarā ye nāmei āhavāna karanā kena, sava sundara nāmaito tā~ra! tomarā sālāte tomādera svara ucu karanā evaṃ atiśaẏa kṣīṇao karanā; ei dui era madhya panthā avalamvana kara.
latin_ascii: valah tomara ‘allaha’ name ahavana kara athava ‘rahamana’ name ahavana kara, tomara ye namei ahavana karana kena, sava sundara namaito ta~ra! tomara salate tomadera svara ucu karana evam atisaya ksinao karana; ei dui era madhya pantha avalamvana kara.

latin_iast: valaḥ praśaṃsā āllāharai yini santāna grahaṇa karenani, tā~ra sārvabhaumatve kona aṃśī nei evaṃ tini durdaśāgrasta hananā ye kāraṇe tā~ra abhibhāvakera praẏojana hate pāre; sutarāṃ svasambhrame tā~ra māhātmya ghoṣaṇā kara.
latin_ascii: valah prasamsa allaharai yini santana grahana karenani, ta~ra sarvabhaumatve kona amsi nei evam tini durdasagrasta hanana ye karane ta~ra abhibhavakera prayojana hate pare; sutaram svasambhrame ta~ra mahatmya ghosana kara.

latin_iast: samasta praśaṃsā āllāharai yini tā~ra dāsera prati ei kitāva avatīrṇa karechena evaṃ ete tini asaṅgati rākhenani.
latin_ascii: samasta prasamsa allaharai yini ta~ra dasera prati ei kitava avatirna karechena evam ete tini asangati rakhenani.

latin_iast: eke karechena supratiṣṭhita tā~ra kaṭhina śāsti samparke satarka karāra janya evaṃ viśvāsīgaṇa, yārā satkāja kare tāderake ei susaṃvāda deẏāra janya ye, tādera janya raẏeche uttama puraskāra –
latin_ascii: eke karechena supratisthita ta~ra kathina sasti samparke satarka karara janya evam visvasigana, yara satkaja kare taderake ei susamvada deyara janya ye, tadera janya rayeche uttama puraskara –

latin_iast: yekhāne tārā have cirasthāẏī –
latin_ascii: yekhane tara have cirasthayi –

latin_iast: evaṃ satarka karāra janya tāderake yārā vale ye, āllāha santāna grahaṇa karechena.
latin_ascii: evam satarka karara janya taderake yara vale ye, allaha santana grahana karechena.

latin_iast: e viṣaẏe tādera konai jñāna nei evaṃ tādera pitṛpuruṣaderao chilanā; tādera mukha-niḥsṛta vākya ki udbhaṭa! tārāto śudhu mithyāi vale.
latin_ascii: e visaye tadera konai jnana nei evam tadera pitrpurusaderao chilana; tadera mukha-nihsrta vakya ki udbhata! tarato sudhu mithyai vale.

latin_iast: tārā ei vāṇī viśvāsa nā karale tādera pichane pichane ghure sambhavataḥ tumi duḥkhe ātmavināśī haẏe par̤ave.
latin_ascii: tara ei vani visvasa na karale tadera pichane pichane ghure sambhavatah tumi duhkhe atmavinasi haye parave.

latin_iast: pṛthivīra upara yā kichu āche āmi segulike ora śobhanīẏa karechi mānuṣake ei parīkṣā karāra janya ye, tādera madhye karme ke śreṣṭha?
latin_ascii: prthivira upara ya kichu ache ami segulike ora sobhaniya karechi manusake ei pariksa karara janya ye, tadera madhye karme ke sresthay

latin_iast: ora upara yā kichu āche tā avaśyai āmi udbhidaśūnya mṛttikāẏa pariṇata karava.
