latin_iast: nūhake āmi preraṇa karechilāma tāra sampradāẏera prati ei nirdeśasahaḥ tumi tomāra sampradāẏake satarka kara tādera prati śāsti āsāra pūrve.
latin_ascii: nuhake ami prerana karechilama tara sampradayera prati ei nirdesasahah tumi tomara sampradayake satarka kara tadera prati sasti asara purve.

latin_iast: se valechilaḥ he āmāra sampradāẏa! āmito tomādera janya spaṣṭa satarkakārī –
latin_ascii: se valechilah he amara sampradaya! amito tomadera janya spasta satarkakari –

latin_iast: e viṣaẏe ye, tomarā āllāhara ivādāta kara, tā~ke bhaẏa kara evaṃ āmāra ānugatya kara.
latin_ascii: e visaye ye, tomara allahara ivadata kara, ta~ke bhaya kara evam amara anugatya kara.

latin_iast: tini tomādera pāpa kṣamā karavena evaṃ tini tomāderake avakāśa divena eka nirdiṣṭa kāla paryanta; niścaẏai āllāha kartṛka nirdhārita kāla upasthita hale uhā vilamvita haẏanā; yadi tomarā eṭā jānate.
latin_ascii: tini tomadera papa ksama karavena evam tini tomaderake avakasa divena eka nirdista kala paryanta; niscayai allaha kartrka nirdharita kala upasthita hale uha vilamvita hayana; yadi tomara eta janate.

latin_iast: se valechilaḥ he āmāra rāvva! āmito āmāra sampradāẏake dina-rāta āhavāna karachi.
latin_ascii: se valechilah he amara ravva! amito amara sampradayake dina-rata ahavana karachi.

latin_iast: kintu āmāra āhavāna tādera palāẏana pravaṇatāi vṛddhi karache.
latin_ascii: kintu amara ahavana tadera palayana pravanatai vrddhi karache.

latin_iast: āmi yakhana tādera āhavāna kari yāte tumi tāderake kṣamā kara, tārā kāne aṃguli deẏa, nijederake vastrāvṛta kare o jida karate thāke evaṃ atiśaẏa auddhatya prakāśa kare.
latin_ascii: ami yakhana tadera ahavana kari yate tumi taderake ksama kara, tara kane amguli deya, nijederake vastravrta kare o jida karate thake evam atisaya auddhatya prakasa kare.

latin_iast: ataḥpara āmi tādera āhavāna karechi prakāśye.
latin_ascii: atahpara ami tadera ahavana karechi prakasye.

latin_iast: pare āmi soccāra pracāra karechi o upadeśa diẏechi gopane.
latin_ascii: pare ami soccara pracara karechi o upadesa diyechi gopane.

latin_iast: valechiḥ tomādera ravera kāche kṣamā prārthanā kara, tinito mahā kṣamāśīla.
latin_ascii: valechih tomadera ravera kache ksama prarthana kara, tinito maha ksamasila.

latin_iast: tini tomādera janya pracura vṛṣṭipāta ghaṭāvena.
latin_ascii: tini tomadera janya pracura vrstipata ghatavena.

latin_iast: tini tomādera samṛddha karavena dhana-sampada o santāna-santatite evaṃ tomādera janya sthāpana karavena udyāna o pravāhita karavena nadī-nālā.
latin_ascii: tini tomadera samrddha karavena dhana-sampada o santana-santatite evam tomadera janya sthapana karavena udyana o pravahita karavena nadi-nala.

latin_iast: tomādera ki haẏeche ye, tomarā āllāhara śreṣṭhatva svīkāra karate cācchanā?
latin_ascii: tomadera ki hayeche ye, tomara allahara sresthatva svikara karate cacchanay

latin_iast: athaca tinii tomāderake sṛṣṭi karechena paryāẏakrame.
latin_ascii: athaca tinii tomaderake srsti karechena paryayakrame.

latin_iast: tomarā ki lakṣya karanā āllāha kibhāve sṛṣṭi karechena sapta ākāśa stare stare?
latin_ascii: tomara ki laksya karana allaha kibhave srsti karechena sapta akasa stare starey

latin_iast: evaṃ sekhāne cā~dake sthāpana karechena āloka rūpe o sūryake sthāpana karechena pradīpa rūpe;
latin_ascii: evam sekhane ca~dake sthapana karechena aloka rupe o suryake sthapana karechena pradipa rupe;

latin_iast: tini tomāderake sṛṣṭi karechena mṛttikā hate.
latin_ascii: tini tomaderake srsti karechena mrttika hate.

latin_iast: ataḥpara tāte tini tomādera pratyāvṛtta karavena o pare punarutthita karavena.
latin_ascii: atahpara tate tini tomadera pratyavrtta karavena o pare punarutthita karavena.

latin_iast: evaṃ āllāha tomādera janya bhūmike karechena vistṛta –
latin_ascii: evam allaha tomadera janya bhumike karechena vistrta –

latin_iast: yāte tomarā calāphirā karate pāra praśasta pathe.
latin_ascii: yate tomara calaphira karate para prasasta pathe.

latin_iast: nūha valechilaḥ he āmāra rāvva! āmāra sampradāẏato āmāke amānya karache evaṃ anusaraṇa karache emana lokera yāra dhana sampada o santāna-santati tāra kṣati vyatīta āra kichui vṛddhi kareni.
latin_ascii: nuha valechilah he amara ravva! amara sampradayato amake amanya karache evam anusarana karache emana lokera yara dhana sampada o santana-santati tara ksati vyatita ara kichui vrddhi kareni.

latin_iast: tārā bhaẏānaka ṣar̤ayantra karechila.
latin_ascii: tara bhayanaka sarayantra karechila.

latin_iast: evaṃ valechilaḥ tomarā kakhanao parityāga karanā tomādera deva-devīke; parityāga karanā oẏāda, suoẏā, āgucha, āuka o nāsarake.
latin_ascii: evam valechilah tomara kakhanao parityaga karana tomadera deva-devike; parityaga karana oyada, suoya, agucha, auka o nasarake.

latin_iast: tārā anekake vibhrānta karache; sutarāṃ yālimadera vibhrānti vyatīta āra kichui vṛddhi karenā.
latin_ascii: tara anekake vibhranta karache; sutaram yalimadera vibhranti vyatita ara kichui vrddhi karena.

latin_iast: tādera aparādhera janya tāderake nimajjita karā haẏechila evaṃ pare tāderake dākhila karā haẏechila āgune, ataḥpara tārā kehakeo āllāhara mukāvilāẏa pāẏani sāhāyyakārī.
latin_ascii: tadera aparadhera janya taderake nimajjita kara hayechila evam pare taderake dakhila kara hayechila agune, atahpara tara kehakeo allahara mukavilaya payani sahayyakari.

latin_iast: nūha ārao valechilaḥ he āmāra rāvva! pṛthivīte kāphiradera madhya hate kona gṛhavāsīke avyāhati dionā.
latin_ascii: nuha arao valechilah he amara ravva! prthivite kaphiradera madhya hate kona grhavasike avyahati diona.

latin_iast: tumi tāderake avyāhati dile tārā tomāra vāndāderake vibhrānta karave evaṃ janma dite thākave kevala duskṛtikārī o kāphira.
latin_ascii: tumi taderake avyahati dile tara tomara vandaderake vibhranta karave evam janma dite thakave kevala duskrtikari o kaphira.

latin_iast: he āmāra rāvva! tumi kṣamā kara āmāke, āmāra mātā-pitāke evaṃ yārā mu’mina haẏe āmāra gṛhe praveśa kare tāderake evaṃ mu’mina puruṣa o mu’minā nārīderake; āra yālimadera śudhu dhvaṃsai vṛddhi kara.
latin_ascii: he amara ravva! tumi ksama kara amake, amara mata-pitake evam yara mu’mina haye amara grhe pravesa kare taderake evam mu’mina purusa o mu’mina nariderake; ara yalimadera sudhu dhvamsai vrddhi kara.

latin_iast: valaḥ āmāra prati ahī prerita haẏeche ye, jinadera ekaṭi dala manoyoga sahakāre śravaṇa kareche evaṃ valeche, āmarāto eka vismaẏakara kuraāna śravaṇa karechi –
latin_ascii: valah amara prati ahi prerita hayeche ye, jinadera ekati dala manoyoga sahakare sravana kareche evam valeche, amarato eka vismayakara kuraana sravana karechi –

latin_iast: yā saṭhika patha nirdeśa kare; phale āmarā ete viśvāsa sthāpana karechi. āmarā kakhanao āmādera ravera sāthe kona śarīka sthira karavanā.
latin_ascii: ya sathika patha nirdesa kare; phale amara ete visvasa sthapana karechi. amara kakhanao amadera ravera sathe kona sarika sthira karavana.

latin_iast: evaṃ niścaẏai samucca āmādera ravera maryādā; tini grahaṇa karenani kona patnī evaṃ nā kona santāna.
latin_ascii: evam niscayai samucca amadera ravera maryada; tini grahana karenani kona patni evam na kona santana.

latin_iast: evaṃ āmādera madhyakāra nirvodharā āllāha samvandhe ati avāstava ukti karata.
latin_ascii: evam amadera madhyakara nirvodhara allaha samvandhe ati avastava ukti karata.

latin_iast: athaca āmarā mane karatāma mānuṣa evaṃ jina, āllāha samvandhe kakhanao mithyā āropa karavenā.
latin_ascii: athaca amara mane karatama manusa evam jina, allaha samvandhe kakhanao mithya aropa karavena.

latin_iast: āra ye katipaẏa mānuṣa kataka jinera smaraṇa nita, phale tārā jinadera ātmambharitā vār̤iẏe dita.
latin_ascii: ara ye katipaya manusa kataka jinera smarana nita, phale tara jinadera atmambharita variye dita.

latin_iast: āra jinarā valechilaḥ tomādera mata mānuṣao mane kare ye, mṛtyura para āllāha kehakeo punarutthita karavenanā.
latin_ascii: ara jinara valechilah tomadera mata manusao mane kare ye, mrtyura para allaha kehakeo punarutthita karavenana.

latin_iast: evaṃ āmarā ceẏechilāma ākāśera tathya saṃgraha karate. kintu āmarā dekhate pelāma kaṭhora praharī o ulkāpinḍa dvārā ākāśa paripūrṇa.
latin_ascii: evam amara ceyechilama akasera tathya samgraha karate. kintu amara dekhate pelama kathora prahari o ulkapinda dvara akasa paripurna.

latin_iast: āra pūrve āmarā ākāśera vibhinna ghā~ṭite saṃvāda śonāra janya vasatāma. kintu ekhana keha saṃvāda śunate cāile se tāra upara nikṣepera janya prastuta jvalanta ulkāpinḍera sammukhīna haẏa.
latin_ascii: ara purve amara akasera vibhinna gha~tite samvada sonara janya vasatama. kintu ekhana keha samvada sunate caile se tara upara niksepera janya prastuta jvalanta ulkapindera sammukhina haya.

latin_iast: āmarā jāninā, jagatavāsīra amaṃgalai abhipreta, nā ki tādera rāvva tādera maṃgala karāra icchā rākhena.
latin_ascii: amara janina, jagatavasira amamgalai abhipreta, na ki tadera ravva tadera mamgala karara iccha rakhena.

latin_iast: evaṃ āmādera kataka sat karmaparāẏaṇa evaṃ kataka era vyatikrama, āmarā chilāma vibhinna pathera anusārī;
latin_ascii: evam amadera kataka sat karmaparayana evam kataka era vyatikrama, amara chilama vibhinna pathera anusari;

latin_iast: ekhana āmarā vujhechi ye, āmarā pṛthivīte āllāhake parābhūta karate pāravanā evaṃ palāẏana kareo tā~ke vyartha karate pāravanā.
latin_ascii: ekhana amara vujhechi ye, amara prthivite allahake parabhuta karate paravana evam palayana kareo ta~ke vyartha karate paravana.

latin_iast: āmarā yakhana patha nirdeśaka vāṇī śunalāma takhana tāte viśvāsa sthāpana karalāma. ye vyakti tāra ravera prati īmāna āne tāra kona kṣati kiṃvā jora javaradastira āśaṃkā thākavenā.
latin_ascii: amara yakhana patha nirdesaka vani sunalama takhana tate visvasa sthapana karalama. ye vyakti tara ravera prati imana ane tara kona ksati kimva jora javaradastira asamka thakavena.

latin_iast: āmādera kataka ātmasamaparṇakārī evaṃ kataka sīmā laṃghanakārī; yārā ātmasamarpaṇa kare tārā sucintitabhāve satya patha veche neẏa.
latin_ascii: amadera kataka atmasamaparnakari evam kataka sima lamghanakari; yara atmasamarpana kare tara sucintitabhave satya patha veche neya.

latin_iast: apara pakṣe sīmā laṃghanakārīto jāhānnāmerai indhana.
latin_ascii: apara pakse sima lamghanakarito jahannamerai indhana.

latin_iast: tārā yadi satya pathe pratiṣṭhita thākata, tāderake āmi pracura vāri varṣaṇera mādhyame samṛddha karatāma –
latin_ascii: tara yadi satya pathe pratisthita thakata, taderake ami pracura vari varsanera madhyame samrddha karatama –

latin_iast: yadvārā āmi tāderake parīkṣā karatāma. ye vyakti tāra ravera smaraṇa hate vimukha haẏa tini tāke duḥsaha śāstite praveśa karāvena.
latin_ascii: yadvara ami taderake pariksa karatama. ye vyakti tara ravera smarana hate vimukha haya tini take duhsaha sastite pravesa karavena.

latin_iast: evaṃ ei ye māsajidasamūha, āllāharai janya. sutarāṃ āllāhara sāthe tomarā anya kehakeo ḍekanā.
latin_ascii: evam ei ye masajidasamuha, allaharai janya. sutaram allahara sathe tomara anya kehakeo dekana.

latin_iast: āra ei ye, yakhana āllāhara vāndā tā~ke ḍākāra janya danḍāẏamāna hala takhana tārā tāra nikaṭa bhir̤a jamālo.
latin_ascii: ara ei ye, yakhana allahara vanda ta~ke dakara janya dandayamana hala takhana tara tara nikata bhira jamalo.

latin_iast: valaḥ āmi āmāra rāvvake ḍāki evaṃ tā~ra sāthe kehake śarīka karinā.
latin_ascii: valah ami amara ravvake daki evam ta~ra sathe kehake sarika karina.

latin_iast: valaḥ āmi tomādera maṅgala-amaṅgalera mālika nai.
latin_ascii: valah ami tomadera mangala-amangalera malika nai.

latin_iast: valaḥ āllāhara śāsti hate keha āmāke rakṣā karate pāravenā evaṃ āllāha vyatīta āmi kona āśraẏa pāvanā.
latin_ascii: valah allahara sasti hate keha amake raksa karate paravena evam allaha vyatita ami kona asraya pavana.

latin_iast: kevala āllāhara vāṇī pau~chāno evaṃ tā pracāra karāi āmāra kāja. yārā āllāha o tā~ra rāsūlake amānya kare tādera janya raẏeche jāhānnāmera āguna, sekhāne tārā cirasthāẏī have.
latin_ascii: kevala allahara vani pau~chano evam ta pracara karai amara kaja. yara allaha o ta~ra rasulake amanya kare tadera janya rayeche jahannamera aguna, sekhane tara cirasthayi have.

latin_iast: yakhana tārā pratiśruti pratyakṣa karave takhana tārā vujhate pārave, ke sāhāyyakārīra dika diẏe durvala evaṃ ke saṃkhyāẏa svalpa.
latin_ascii: yakhana tara pratisruti pratyaksa karave takhana tara vujhate parave, ke sahayyakarira dika diye durvala evam ke samkhyaya svalpa.

latin_iast: valaḥ āmi jāninā tomāderake ye śāstira pratiśruti deẏā haẏeche tā ki āsanna, nā ki āmāra rāvva era janya kona dīrgha meẏāda sthira karavena?
latin_ascii: valah ami janina tomaderake ye sastira pratisruti deya hayeche ta ki asanna, na ki amara ravva era janya kona dirgha meyada sthira karavenay

latin_iast: tini adṛśyera parijñātā, tini tā~ra adṛśyera jñāna kārao nikaṭa prakāśa karenanā –
latin_ascii: tini adrsyera parijnata, tini ta~ra adrsyera jnana karao nikata prakasa karenana –

latin_iast: tā~ra manonīta rāsūla vyatīta. sekṣetre āllāha rāsūlera agre evaṃ paścāte praharī niẏojita karena,
latin_ascii: ta~ra manonita rasula vyatita. seksetre allaha rasulera agre evam pascate prahari niyojita karena,

latin_iast: rāsūlagaṇa tādera ravera vāṇī pau~che diẏechena ki nā jānāra janya. rāsūlagaṇera nikaṭa yā āche tā tā~ra jñāna gocara evaṃ tini samasta kichura vistārita hisāva rākhena.
latin_ascii: rasulagana tadera ravera vani pau~che diyechena ki na janara janya. rasulaganera nikata ya ache ta ta~ra jnana gocara evam tini samasta kichura vistarita hisava rakhena.

latin_iast: he vastrāvṛta!
latin_ascii: he vastravrta!

latin_iast: rāta jāgaraṇa kara kichu aṃśa vyatīta.
latin_ascii: rata jagarana kara kichu amsa vyatita.

latin_iast: ardha rāta kiṃvā tadapekṣā kichu kama.
latin_ascii: ardha rata kimva tadapeksa kichu kama.

latin_iast: athavā tadapekṣā veśī. āra kuraāna āvṛtti kara dhīre dhīre spaṣṭa o sundarabhāve.
latin_ascii: athava tadapeksa vesi. ara kuraana avrtti kara dhire dhire spasta o sundarabhave.

latin_iast: āmi tomāra prati avatīrṇa karechi gurutvapūrṇa vāṇī.
latin_ascii: ami tomara prati avatirna karechi gurutvapurna vani.

latin_iast: niścaẏai rāte jāgaraṇa ivādātera janya gabhīra manoniveśa, hṛdaẏaṅgama evaṃ spaṣṭa uccāraṇe anukūla.
latin_ascii: niscayai rate jagarana ivadatera janya gabhira manonivesa, hrdayangama evam spasta uccarane anukula.

latin_iast: dine tomāra janya raẏeche dīrgha karmavyastatā.
latin_ascii: dine tomara janya rayeche dirgha karmavyastata.

latin_iast: sutarāṃ tumi tomāra ravera nāma smaraṇa kara evaṃ ekaniṣṭhabhāve tāte magna hao.
latin_ascii: sutaram tumi tomara ravera nama smarana kara evam ekanisthabhave tate magna hao.

latin_iast: tini pūrva o paścimera rāvva, tini vyatīta kona ilāha nei; ataeva tā~kei karma-vidhāẏaka rūpe grahaṇa kara.
latin_ascii: tini purva o pascimera ravva, tini vyatita kona ilaha nei; ataeva ta~kei karma-vidhayaka rupe grahana kara.

latin_iast: loke yā vale, tāte tumi dhairya dhāraṇa kara evaṃ saujanya sahakāre uhāderake parihāra kare cala.
latin_ascii: loke ya vale, tate tumi dhairya dharana kara evam saujanya sahakare uhaderake parihara kare cala.

latin_iast: cher̤e dāo āmāke evaṃ vilāsa sāmagrīra adhikārī satya pratyākhyānakārīderake; āra kichu kālera janya tāderake avakāśa dāo.
latin_ascii: chere dao amake evam vilasa samagrira adhikari satya pratyakhyanakariderake; ara kichu kalera janya taderake avakasa dao.

latin_iast: āmāra nikaṭa āche śṛṃkhala prajjvalita āguna.
latin_ascii: amara nikata ache srmkhala prajjvalita aguna.

latin_iast: āra āche emana khādya yā galāẏa āṭake yāẏa evaṃ marmantada śāsti.
latin_ascii: ara ache emana khadya ya galaya atake yaya evam marmantada sasti.

latin_iast: sei dine pṛthivī o parvatamālā prakampita have evaṃ parvatasamūha vahamāna vālukārāśite pariṇata have.
latin_ascii: sei dine prthivi o parvatamala prakampita have evam parvatasamuha vahamana valukarasite parinata have.

latin_iast: āmi tomādera nikaṭa pāṭhiẏechi rāsūla tomādera janya svākṣī svarūpa, yemana rāsūla pāṭhiẏechilāma phiraāunera nikaṭa.
latin_ascii: ami tomadera nikata pathiyechi rasula tomadera janya svaksi svarupa, yemana rasula pathiyechilama phiraaunera nikata.

latin_iast: kintu phira‘āuna sei rāsūlake amānya karechila, phale āmi tāke kaṭhina śāsti diẏechilāma.
latin_ascii: kintu phira‘auna sei rasulake amanya karechila, phale ami take kathina sasti diyechilama.

latin_iast: ataeva yadi tomarā kupharī kara, ki kare ātmarakṣā karave sedina yedina śiśuderake pariṇata karave vṛddhe?
latin_ascii: ataeva yadi tomara kuphari kara, ki kare atmaraksa karave sedina yedina sisuderake parinata karave vrddhey

latin_iast: yedina ākāśa have vidīrṇa; tā~ra pratiśruti avaśyai vāstavāẏita have.
latin_ascii: yedina akasa have vidirna; ta~ra pratisruti avasyai vastavayita have.

latin_ascii: evam ai sava narira anistata hate yara granthite phutkara deya,

latin_iast: evaṃ aniṣṭatā hate hiṃsukera, yakhana se hiṃsā kare.
latin_ascii: evam anistata hate himsukera, yakhana se himsa kare.

latin_iast: valaḥ āmi āśraẏa cācchi mānuṣera ravera,
latin_ascii: valah ami asraya cacchi manusera ravera,

latin_iast: yini mānavamanḍalīra vādaśāha vā adhipati.
latin_ascii: yini manavamandalira vadasaha va adhipati.

latin_iast: yini mānavamanḍalīra upāsya.
latin_ascii: yini manavamandalira upasya.

latin_iast: ātmagopanakārī ku-mantraṇādātāra aniṣṭatā hate.
latin_ascii: atmagopanakari ku-mantranadatara anistata hate.

latin_iast: ye ku-mantraṇā deẏa mānuṣera antare,
latin_ascii: ye ku-mantrana deya manusera antare,

latin_iast: jinera madhya hate athavā mānuṣera madhya hate.
latin_ascii: jinera madhya hate athava manusera madhya hate.
